paras.zh: 据 FX 报道，在独立前传剧集《马拉松日》发布后，第二季的流媒体收视率翻了一番。 《成人》第二季由 Kronengold、Shaw、Nick Kroll、Sarah Naftalis、Jonathan Krisel、Alicia Van Couving 和 Rob Rosell 担任监制。

paras.en: The series is produced by FX Productions.
paras.zh: 该剧由 FX Productions 制作。

articles.title: FKA Twigs Becomes Josephine Baker in First Look at Maïmouna Doucouré’s Buzzy Biopic
articles.author: Patrick Brzeski

paras.en: StudioCanal and Bien ou Bien Productions have unveiled the first official image of FKA Twigs as Josephine Baker in Maïmouna Doucouré’s buzzy upcoming biopic, giving buyers at the American Film Market an early glimpse of the star’s uncanny transformation into the Jazz Age icon. (See the image below)
paras.zh: StudioCanal 和 Bien ou Bien Productions 公布了 FKA Twigs 在 Maïmouna Doucouré 即将上映的热门传记片中饰演约瑟芬·贝克 (Josephine Baker) 的首张官方形象，让美国电影市场的买家抢先一睹这位明星不可思议地转变为爵士乐时代偶像的过程。 （见下图）

paras.en: Released Wednesday, the still shows Twigs striking one of Baker’s classic playful poses atop a dining table in a pink, beaded and fringed dress, her hair styled in the singer’s signature close-cropped waves.
paras.zh: 周三发布的剧照中，Twigs 身着粉红色串珠流苏连衣裙，在餐桌上摆出贝克的经典俏皮姿势，头发设计成这位歌手标志性的短款波浪造型。

paras.en: Twigs’ flair for theatrical reinvention makes her an inspired fit for Baker, whose performances fused sensual glamour with a mischievous physical wit. The image captures some of that combination, with Twigs flashing a broad smile as she twists toward her audience.
paras.zh: Twigs 的戏剧重塑天赋使她非常适合 Baker，后者的表演将感性魅力与调皮的肢体智慧融为一体。这张照片捕捉到了这种组合的一部分，Twigs 转身走向观众时露出了灿烂的微笑。

paras.en: Written by Doucouré (Cuties, Hawa) with Olivier Lorelle, Josephine Baker will follow its subject’s rise to international stardom in 1920s Paris and her subsequent work with the French Resistance and the American civil rights movement.
paras.zh: 约瑟芬·贝克 (Josephine Baker) 由 Doucouré（《Cuties》、《Hawa》）和 Olivier Lorelle 共同撰写，将讲述该主题在 20 年代巴黎成为国际明星的故事，以及她随后在法国抵抗运动和美国民权运动中的工作。

paras.en: Born in St. Louis in 1906, Baker moved to Paris in 1925 and became one of the defining entertainers of the Jazz Age. Her later activism included appearing alongside Martin Luther King Jr. at the 1963 March on Washington. In 2021, she became the first Black woman inducted into France’s Panthéon.
paras.zh: 贝克 1906 年出生于圣路易斯，1925 年移居巴黎，成为爵士乐时代的标志性艺人之一。她后来的活动包括与马丁·路德·金一起出现在 1963 年华盛顿游行上。 2021年，她成为第一位入选法国先贤祠的黑人女性。

paras.en: “I cannot wait to embody Josephine Baker, bringing her fight, her love, her losses, her talent and her heroism to the big screen,” Twigs said when her casting was announced in May. “She lives on in our hearts as a visionary, ground-breaking woman whose story is as powerful as it is relevant today.”
paras.zh: “我迫不及待地想扮演约瑟芬·贝克，把她的战斗、她的爱、她的损失、她的才华和她的英雄主义搬上大银幕，”特威格斯在五月份宣布选角时说道。 “她作为一位富有远见、开创性的女性永远活在我们心中，她的故事在今天同样具有影响力。”

paras.en: The project has the support of Baker’s sons Jean-Claude Bouillon Baker and Brian Bouillon Baker, along with the Rainbow Tribe, the multiracial family of 12 children she raised at her château in southwest France.
paras.zh: 该项目得到了贝克的儿子让-克洛德·布永·贝克 (Jean-Claude Bouillon Baker) 和布赖恩·布永·贝克 (Brian Bouillon Baker) 以及彩虹部落 (Rainbow Tribe) 的支持。彩虹部落是她在法国西南部的城堡里养大的一个由 12 个孩子组成的多种族家庭。

paras.en: Twigs won her first Grammy in February, taking best dance/electronic album for Eusexua. Her prior screen credits include Alma Har’el’s Honey Boy, Rupert Sanders’ The Crow and David Lowery’s Mother Mary, opposite Anne Hathaway and Michaela Coel.
paras.zh: Twigs 在二月份赢得了她的第一个格莱美奖，Eusexua 获得了最佳舞曲/电子专辑奖。她之前的银幕作品包括阿尔玛·哈埃尔的《亲爱的男孩》、鲁珀特·桑德斯的《乌鸦》和大卫·洛厄里的《玛丽圣母》，与安妮·海瑟薇和米凯拉·科尔演对手戏。

paras.en: StudioCanal and Bien ou Bien Productions are producing, with CPB Films, Leyland Films and Dingie as associated producers. StudioCanal is handling worldwide sales at AFM and will release the film theatrically in France, the U.K., Germany, Italy, Benelux, Poland, Australia and New Zealand.
paras.zh: StudioCanal 和 Bien ou Bien Productions 负责制作，CPB Films、Leyland Films 和 Dingie 担任联合制片人。 StudioCanal 负责 AFM 的全球销售，并将在法国、英国、德国、意大利、比荷卢经济联盟、波兰、澳大利亚和新西兰上映这部电影。

articles.title: Watch Out Hollywood: Creators and Sports Are Eating More of the Content Budgets
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: Where the entertainment business spends its content budget is shifting, with sports and independent creators reaping the rewards.
paras.zh: 娱乐行业的内容预算正在发生变化，体育和独立创作者获得了回报。

paras.en: The consultancy KPMG released its annual media content spend analysis on Thursday, calculating the totals and outlining where the major entertainment platforms (like Disney and Netflix, but also YouTube, Meta and Amazon) are spending their money. Traditional film and TV content still has a role, but the report underscores how the winds are shifting.
paras.zh: 咨询公司毕马威周四发布了年度媒体内容支出分析，计算了总数并概述了主要娱乐平台（如迪士尼和 Netflix，还有 YouTube、Meta 和亚马逊）的支出情况。传统的电影和电视内容仍然发挥着作用，但报告强调了风向正在发生转变。

paras.en: The good news? Content spend is continuing to rise. In 2025, the companies KPMG tracks topped $207 billion, up from $156 billion in 2021. KPMG calculates spend based on costs associated with film and TV production, programming and licensing; sports rights; revenue sharing payments to creators; and music costs.
paras.zh: 好消息？内容支出持续增长。毕马威追踪的公司规模到 2025 年将达到 2070 亿美元，高于 2021 年的 1560 亿美元。毕马威根据与电影和电视制作、节目制作和许可相关的成本来计算支出；体育权利；向创作者支付收入分成；和音乐费用。

paras.en: But while most traditional players (Paramount, Comcast, Disney) are seeing their content spend stagnate, it is companies like YouTube, Amazon and Meta where spend is rising.
paras.zh: 但是，尽管大多数传统玩家（派拉蒙、康卡斯特、迪士尼）的内容支出停滞不前，但 YouTube、亚马逊和 Meta 等公司的支出却在上升。

paras.en: That is reflected in the data, where YouTube is now king of the spenders, with an estimated $28 billion annually. Creator content now accounts for $46 billion of the annual content pie, up 75 percent from 2021. Sports meanwhile is now 29 percent, up 59 percent from 2021, as places like Netflix, Amazon, Apple and others pour cash into the space.
paras.zh: 数据反映了这一点，YouTube 目前是支出之王，每年的支出估计为 280 亿美元。目前，创作者内容占年度内容份额为 460 亿美元，比 2021 年增长 75%。与此同时，随着 Netflix、亚马逊、苹果等公司向该领域投入大量资金，体育内容目前占 29%，比 2021 年增长 59%。

paras.en: And of course places like Netflix, Disney+ and others are also cutting creator deals, bringing more types of content into their streaming fold.
paras.zh: 当然，Netflix、Disney+ 等公司也在与创作者达成交易，将更多类型的内容纳入其流媒体业务。

paras.en: “Creator content is taking on a larger role in the content portfolio because it can build frequent engagement, attract highly engaged audiences, and create new opportunities for advertising and monetization,” said Frank Albarella, Jr., U.S. sector leader, media and telecommunications, at KPMG US. “As the lines between creator-led and traditional entertainment blur, the question for media companies is how those formats work together to win consumer engagement and drive value.”
paras.zh: 毕马威美国媒体和电信行业领导者 Frank Albarella, Jr. 表示：“创作者内容在内容组合中扮演着越来越重要的角色，因为它可以建立频繁的参与度，吸引高度参与的受众，并为广告和货币化创造新的机会。” “随着创作者主导的娱乐和传统娱乐之间的界限变得模糊，媒体公司面临的问题是这些格式如何协同工作以赢得消费者参与并推动价值。”

paras.en: In 2021, film, TV and streaming content accounted for 71 percent of all content spend, but the new KPMG report finds that number sinking to 64 percent, as both sports and creator content surge.
paras.zh: 2021 年，电影、电视和流媒体内容占所有内容支出的 71%，但新的毕马威报告发现，随着体育和创作者内容的激增，这一数字下降至 64%。

paras.en: “A successful ‘super app’ starts with a clear view of what your audience values,” said Scott Purdy, media sector leader, strategy, KPMG U.S. “The opportunity is to combine the content, experiences, and benefits that give your customers more reasons to stay, while making that relationship more valuable over time.”
paras.zh: 毕马威美国战略部门媒体部门负责人 Scott Purdy 表示：“成功的‘超级应用’首先要清楚地了解受众的价值观。机会在于将内容、体验和优势结合起来，让客户有更多理由留下来，同时让这种关系随着时间的推移变得更有价值。”

paras.en: Still, the data shows a shifting landscape for Hollywood, one that newly-enlarged giants like Fox-Roku and Skydance will need to navigate. Premium film and TV remains the heart of Hollywood, but it is careening toward a future where it is a smaller and smaller piece of the puzzle.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，数据显示好莱坞的格局正在发生变化，Fox-Roku 和 Skydance 等新扩张的巨头将需要应对这一变化。优质电影和电视仍然是好莱坞的核心，但它正在朝着一个越来越小的未来发展。

articles.title: Analysis: Is Nvidia too big to fail? Its AI financing web raises the stakes

paras.en: The swirl of sex-and-spying allegations around Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is raising a worrying question: Could trouble at the chipmaker spread through the tightly connected financial network Nvidia has built to support the artificial intelligence boom?
paras.zh: 围绕英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的一系列性和间谍指控引发了一个令人担忧的问题：这家芯片制造商的麻烦是否会通过英伟达为支持人工智能热潮而建立的紧密联系的金融网络蔓延？

paras.en: Serious problems with Nvidia could do far-reaching economic and financial damage. The company has made hundreds of billions of dollars in financial commitments to other firms to help the industry grow, earning it the nickname the "central bank of AI." The Federal Reserve and other financial institutions are closely watching the AI buildout to monitor for the possibility that an unexpected event could destabilize the global financial system.
paras.zh: 英伟达的严重问题可能会造成深远的经济和财务损失。该公司已向其他公司做出了数千亿美元的财务承诺，以帮助该行业发展，并赢得了“人工智能中央银行”的绰号。美联储和其他金融机构正在密切关注人工智能的发展，以监测意外事件可能破坏全球金融体系稳定的可能性。

paras.en: Even back in July Fed officials were discussing the possibility of of a "broad-based repricing of assets" in the event of problems in the AI sector.
paras.zh: 早在 7 月份，美联储官员就在讨论在人工智能行业出现问题时进行“广泛的资产重新定价”的可能性。

paras.en: A rerun of the 2007-2008 financial crisis isn't likely, according to analysts and current and former financial officials. Nvidia isn't "too big to fail in a bank sense at all," said Sheila Bair, a former government regulator who ran the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. Unlike a troubled bank, Nvidia isn't vulnerable to a sudden loss of confidence and would still produce a product customers want to buy even if something went wrong. And its massive equity gives it a cushion.
paras.zh: 分析师以及现任和前任财务官员表示，2007-2008 年金融危机不太可能重演。负责管理联邦存款保险公司的前政府监管者希拉·贝尔 (Sheila Bair) 表示，英伟达“从银行的角度来说根本就大到不能倒”。与陷入困境的银行不同，英伟达不会因为突然失去信心而受到影响，即使出了问题，英伟达仍会生产客户想要购买的产品。其庞大的股权为其提供了缓冲。

paras.en: But regulators need to watch carefully for exposure by the banks and the wider financial system to Nvidia and other firms like it, Bair said.
paras.zh: 但贝尔表示，监管机构需要仔细关注银行和更广泛的金融体系对英伟达和其他类似公司的风险敞口。

paras.en: "Nvidia going down would be a pretty seismic event," she said.
paras.zh: “英伟达的倒闭将是一个相当震撼的事件，”她说。

paras.en: Investors still have high hopes for Nvidia, which reports earnings on Tuesday. Analysts expect its revenue to more than double in the current fiscal year, and then to roughly double again over the following two years, according to LSEG data. But with Huang under scrutiny by the FBI, Congress, and Nvidia's board over his relationship with a woman who The New York Times reported was suspected of spying for China, analysts see a wide range of outcomes as suddenly possible, including the potential removal of Huang, who co-founded the company in 1993.
paras.zh: 投资者对周二公布财报的英伟达仍抱有很高的期望。根据伦敦证券交易所集团的数据，分析师预计其本财年的收入将增加一倍以上，然后在接下来的两年内再次大约翻一番。但随着黄仁勋因与《纽约时报》报道的一名涉嫌为中国从事间谍活动的女性的关系而受到联邦调查局、国会和英伟达董事会的审查，分析人士认为突然间可能出现一系列广泛的结果，包括黄仁勋可能被免职，她于 1993 年共同创立了该公司。

paras.en: The company didn't immediately respond to a request for comment. Nvidia's board has expressed confidence in its CEO.
paras.zh: 该公司没有立即回应置评请求。英伟达董事会表达了对其首席执行官的信心。

paras.en: Nvidia's stock fell 30% from its Oct. 6 peak through Tuesday's close, amid a broader reassessment of the AI trade prompted by Democrats' surprising victory in the Nov. 3 midterms. Its stock recovered Wednesday, rising more than 4% as of midday. Still, people who closely track the financial flows underlying AI say that even sharper losses by Nvidia likely wouldn't trigger the kind of systemic problems that regulators guard against.
paras.zh: 由于民主党在 11 月 3 日中期选举中意外获胜，引发了对人工智能行业的更广泛的重新评估，英伟达的股价从 10 月 6 日的峰值到周二收盘下跌了 30%。其股价周三回升，截至中午上涨逾 4%。尽管如此，密切跟踪人工智能基础资金流动的人士表示，即使英伟达出现更严重的亏损，也可能不会引发监管机构所防范的系统性问题。

paras.en: And yet the risks flowing from AI are keeping some finance officials up at night. They are watching for the possibility that many of the factors that have helped the AI boom could reverse simultaneously. If the value of Nvidia's GPU chips fell, for instance, it could prompt investors to ask whether companies that borrowed money to buy them would be able to pay off their debts.
paras.zh: 然而，人工智能带来的风险却让一些财务官员夜不能寐。他们正在关注许多推动人工智能繁荣的因素可能同时逆转的可能性。例如，如果英伟达 GPU 芯片的价值下跌，可能会促使投资者询问借钱购买这些芯片的公司是否有能力偿还债务。

paras.en: In that case, the financial assistance big tech firms have extended to others in the industry could suddenly become drags on their growth. Tech companies would have credit problems at the same time that their equity is falling. Problems among giant tech firms wouldn't stay contained to tech investors' portfolios, but could cause problems across the economy.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，大型科技公司向业内其他公司提供的财务援助可能会突然成为其增长的拖累。科技公司在股本下降的同时也会遇到信用问题。大型科技公司的问题不会仅限于科技投资者的投资组合，但可能会导致整个经济出现问题。

paras.en: "I think that's a real concern because both the economy and financial markets are standing on the same leg, which means a drawdown could have reinforcing effects between the two," said Jason Wu, an assistant director at the International Monetary Fund who oversees the Global Markets Analysis unit.
paras.zh: 国际货币基金组织负责全球市场分析部门的助理主任贾森·吴(Jason Wu)表示：“我认为这是一个真正令人担忧的问题，因为经济和金融市场都站在同一条腿上，这意味着撤资可能会在两者之间产生强化效应。”

paras.en: Wu was the lead author of a chapter of the IMF's Global Financial Stability report published in October that warned about the potential for growing leverage among AI firms and investors to trigger broader problems. The so-called hyperscalers — the biggest tech firms — have grown from just 1% of bond issuance in the $15 trillion investment-grade debt market to 10% in just two years. Hedge funds and retail investors are making risky bets even riskier by taking on debt to buy stocks or investing in funds that have embedded leverage.
paras.zh: 吴是国际货币基金组织 10 月份发布的《全球金融稳定》报告中一章的主要作者，该报告警告说，人工智能公司和投资者之间杠杆作用的增加可能会引发更广泛的问题。所谓的超大规模企业——最大的科技公司——在短短两年内就从仅占 15 万亿美元投资级债券市场债券发行量的 1% 增长到了 10%。对冲基金和散户投资者通过举债购买股票或投资嵌入杠杆的基金，进行风险更大的押注。

paras.en: Nvidia is at the center of all of that. The company has repeatedly stepped in to help backstop smaller AI companies known as neoclouds, which build data centers using Nvidia chips and lease capacity to other firms. Among other obligations, Nvidia disclosed in July that it has committed to buy up to $36 billion in cloud services from those companies. That helps Nvidia ensure that there will be more customers for its AI chips, and it helps those companies find easier financing.
paras.zh: Nvidia 处于这一切的中心。该公司多次介入帮助支持名为 Neoclouds 的小型人工智能公司，这些公司使用 Nvidia 芯片构建数据中心并将容量租赁给其他公司。除其他义务外，Nvidia 在 7 月份透露，它已承诺从这些公司购买高达 360 亿美元的云服务。这有助于英伟达确保其人工智能芯片拥有更多客户，并帮助这些公司找到更容易的融资。

paras.en: Wu and others refer to these kinds of arrangements as circular financing. When business is growing, it can be productive for bigger firms to help their customers buy their products. But if Nvidia couldn't honor its obligations, it would ripple through the firms that borrowed the money and the banks that lent to it. Relatively opaque private credit funds have also lent heavily into the AI boom, and how they would fare is a subject of debate among regulators.
paras.zh: 吴和其他人将此类安排称为循环融资。当业务增长时，大公司帮助客户购买他们的产品可能会富有成效。但如果英伟达无法履行其义务，就会波及借钱的公司和向其提供贷款的银行。相对不透明的私人信贷基金也为人工智能的繁荣提供了大量贷款，它们的表现如何是监管机构争论的话题。

paras.en: Nvidia didn't reveal its specific partners, but some neoclouds such as CoreWeave and IREN have separately disclosed their relationships with the bigger firm.
paras.zh: Nvidia 没有透露其具体合作伙伴，但 CoreWeave 和 IREN 等一些 Neocloud 已经分别披露了他们与这家更大公司的关系。

paras.en: Many neoclouds have been under stress in recent weeks. The cost of insuring CoreWeave debt, as measured by credit-default spreads, rose by 94% — nearly doubling — from Oct. 1 to Nov. 5, before settling, according to LSEG data. The price of an IREN convertible bond maturing in 2029 fell 23% from Nov. 3 to Nov. 5, amid a 26% decline in the company's share price.
paras.zh: 最近几周，许多新云都面临着压力。根据伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 的数据，从 10 月 1 日到 11 月 5 日，以信用违约利差衡量的 CoreWeave 债务保险成本在结算前上涨了 94%，几乎翻了一番。 2029年到期的IREN可转换债券的价格从11月3日到11月5日下跌了23%，公司股价下跌了26%。

paras.en: Nvidia's other obligations include a $105 billion phased guarantee to a major data center project in Ohio planned by OpenAI and SB Energy, subject to certain conditions. Nvidia promised to backstop up to $125 billion of a $500 billion credit program by Wall Street financial firms.
paras.zh: Nvidia 的其他义务包括为 OpenAI 和 SB Energy 计划的俄亥俄州大型数据中心项目提供 1050 亿美元的分阶段担保，但须满足某些条件。 Nvidia 承诺为华尔街金融公司 5000 亿美元信贷计划中的 1250 亿美元提供支持。

paras.en: These obligations come in different forms and are unlikely to come due all at once, if ever. Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh, a Columbia Business School finance professor, estimates them at $400 billion overall.
paras.zh: 这些义务有不同的形式，而且不太可能一次性全部到期（如果有的话）。哥伦比亚商学院金融学教授 Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh 估计其总价值为 4000 亿美元。

paras.en: That is a huge sum, but still a small fraction of the $4 trillion market capitalization Nvidia has even after its stock decline. "The company would have to get to the brink of extinction before all these guarantees come into jeopardy."
paras.zh: 这是一笔巨款，但即使在股价下跌后，英伟达的市值仍高达 4 万亿美元，但仍只是一小部分。 “在所有这些保证都陷入危险之前，该公司必须走到灭亡的边缘。”

paras.en: "I don't want to say it's a safe system, but I do want to say there's a lot of equity in the system right now," Van Nieuwerburgh said.
paras.zh: “我不想说这是一个安全的系统，但我确实想说这个系统现在有很多公平性，”范尼沃伯格说。

paras.en: But in the past few days, Nvidia's troubles have separated it from the pack. Most neoclouds' equity prices have recovered this week as Nvidia's share price has fallen. That suggests investors see Nvidia's problems as specific to the company, for now.
paras.zh: 但在过去的几天里，英伟达的麻烦让它脱颖而出。随着英伟达股价下跌，大多数 Neocloud 的股价本周有所回升。这表明投资者目前认为英伟达的问题是该公司特有的。

paras.en: Meanwhile the basic laws of economics are driving other firms to try to move into Nvidia's lucrative chips business. AMD, Broadcom, Intel, Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI all have efforts underway to build their own AI chips, Van Nieuwerburgh said.
paras.zh: 与此同时，基本的经济规律正在推动其他公司试图进入英伟达利润丰厚的芯片业务。 Van Nieuwerburgh 表示，AMD、博通、英特尔、谷歌、微软和 OpenAI 都在努力构建自己的人工智能芯片。

paras.en: Over time, they could replace Nvidia's products. That could cap the economic fallout of any potential troubles at the company.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，它们可能会取代英伟达的产品。这可能会限制该公司任何潜在问题的经济影响。

paras.en: And yet it's impossible to entirely write off the financial risks of the AI trade suddenly hitting a wall, added Van Nieuwerburgh, who spoke to me over Zoom from the sidelines of a bimonthly meeting of finance officials in Basel, Switzerland.
paras.zh: 然而，不可能完全消除人工智能贸易突然碰壁的财务风险，Van Nieuwerburgh 补充道，他在瑞士巴塞尔举行的双月期财务官员会议间隙通过 Zoom 与我交谈。

paras.en: Central bankers "are clearly very, very, very anxious about this and thinking hard about these questions," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，央行官员“显然对此非常、非常、非常焦虑，并认真思考这些问题”。

articles.title: Social Security could pay full benefits until 2059 if taxable payroll kept pace with GDP: AARP report

paras.en: Social Security's taxable payroll, which provides most of the revenue for the program that pays monthly benefits to millions of Americans, has fallen as a share of gross domestic product over the past four decades, according to a new report from the AARP Public Policy Institute.
paras.zh: 美国退休人员协会公共政策研究所的一份新报告显示，过去四十年来，社会保障的应税工资占国内生产总值的比例有所下降，该工资为数百万美国人每月支付福利的计划提供了大部分收入。

paras.en: Had payroll tax revenue kept up with GDP, the program could pay full benefits until 2059, according to the research — an additional 25 years beyond the latest projected depletion date of 2034 for the program's combined funds. The AARP Public Policy Institute provides policy research, analysis and development at AARP, a nonprofit, nonpartisan organization that represents Americans ages 50 and over.
paras.zh: 研究表明，如果工资税收入与 GDP 保持同步，该计划可以在 2059 年之前全额支付福利——比该计划合并资金的最新预计耗尽日期 2034 年还要晚 25 年。 AARP 公共政策研究所为 AARP 提供政策研究、分析和开发服务，AARP 是一个代表 50 岁及以上美国人的非营利性、无党派组织。

paras.en: "Social Security's finances have weakened not simply because America has grown older, but because the economy has changed, while the program's revenue system has not," Richard Johnson, vice president of financial security at the AARP Public Policy Institute, said during a Tuesday press briefing on the research.
paras.zh: 美国退休人员协会公共政策研究所负责财务安全的副总裁理查德·约翰逊在周二有关该研究的新闻发布会上表示：“社会保障的财务状况恶化，不仅是因为美国人口老龄化，还因为经济发生了变化，而该计划的收入体系却没有变化。”

paras.en: "America's economy is larger and more productive than it was four decades ago, but Social Security is receiving support from a smaller share of that economy," Johnson said.
paras.zh: 约翰逊说：“与四十年前相比，美国的经济规模更大、生产力更高，但社会保障只得到了经济中较小份额的支持。”

paras.en: Social Security's trustees projected in June that the program's combined retirement and disability trust funds may be depleted in the third quarter of 2034. Unless Congress takes action, 83% of scheduled benefits will be payable at that time, according to the trustees' projections.
paras.zh: 社会保障受托人 6 月份预测，该计划的退休和伤残信托基金总额可能会在 2034 年第三季度耗尽。根据受托人的预测，除非国会采取行动，否则届时将支付 83% 的预定福利。

paras.en: The trustees' report also included an earlier projected depletion date for Social Security's retirement trust fund — the fourth quarter of 2032, when 78% of benefits would be payable. However, the AARP said it based its analysis on the later 2034 date because Congress has shifted money between the funds in the past.
paras.zh: 受托人的报告还包括了社会保障退休信托基金较早预计的耗尽日期——2032 年第四季度，届时将支付 78% 的福利。然而，AARP 表示，其分析基于 2034 年晚些时候的日期，因为国会过去曾在基金之间转移资金。

paras.en: The program's current shortfall is worse than lawmakers had anticipated in 1983, when the last major Social Security reforms were enacted.
paras.zh: 该计划目前的缺口比立法者在 1983 年颁布最后一次重大社会保障改革时的预期还要严重。

paras.en: Rising income inequality means the payroll tax cap no longer covers 90% of earnings — a percentage lawmakers expected to remain constant when they made the 1983 reforms, according to research from the Roosevelt Institute, a New York-based liberal think tank. The share of earnings covered by Social Security payroll taxes fell to around 83% in 2000 and has mostly stabilized there, according to the institute.
paras.zh: 收入不平等的加剧意味着工资税上限不再涵盖90%的收入——根据纽约自由派智库罗斯福研究所的研究，立法者在1983年进行改革时预计这一比例将保持不变。据该研究所称，2000 年，社会保障工资税所涵盖的收入比例下降至 83% 左右，并且基本稳定在该水平。

paras.en: AARP points to an aging population as another reason for Social Security's funding challenges. The worker-to-beneficiary ratio will fall from 3.4 to 2.4 between 2000 and 2030. Falling fertility rates are also shrinking the worker-to-beneficiary ratio.
paras.zh: 美国退休人员协会指出，人口老龄化是社会保障资金面临挑战的另一个原因。 2000年至2030年间，工人与受益人之比将从3.4下降至2.4。生育率下降也导致工人与受益人之比缩小。

paras.en: Shifting income patterns have also meant that a smaller share of U.S. GDP is subject to the Social Security payroll tax. Taxable payroll has fallen from 41% of GDP in 1983 to 34% as of 2025, a level Social Security's trustees project will remain, according to the AARP.
paras.zh: 收入模式的转变还意味着美国国内生产总值中较小的一部分需要缴纳社会保障工资税。根据美国退休人员协会 (AARP) 的数据，应税工资占 GDP 的比例已从 1983 年的 41% 降至 2025 年的 34%，社会保障受托人项目将保持这一水平。

paras.en: AARP attributes the decline to a shift from wages toward business and investment income, which generally isn't subject to payroll taxes. Automation has reduced demand for workers, and pass-through businesses allow some owners to report compensation as profits rather than wages, according to the report.
paras.zh: 美国退休人员协会将这种下降归因于从工资收入转向商业和投资收入，而这些收入通常不需要缴纳工资税。报告称，自动化减少了对工人的需求，转手企业允许一些业主将补偿报告为利润而不是工资。

paras.en: Social Security would have collected $10.8 trillion in additional funding between 1984 and 2034 if taxable payroll had stayed at 41% of GDP, according to the AARP. That figure is in inflation-adjusted 2025 dollars.
paras.zh: 根据美国退休人员协会 (AARP) 的数据，如果应税工资保持在 GDP 的 41% 水平，那么 1984 年至 2034 年间，社会保障将筹集 10.8 万亿美元的额外资金。该数字按通货膨胀调整后的 2025 年美元计算。

paras.en: In 2026, up to $184,500 in wages are subject to the Social Security payroll tax.
paras.zh: 2026 年，高达 184,500 美元的工资需缴纳社会保障工资税。

paras.en: Payroll taxes accounted for 91% of Social Security's revenues in 2025, according to AARP's research, while 5% came from interest income and 4% was through federal income taxes paid by high-income beneficiaries on their benefits.
paras.zh: 根据美国退休人员协会的研究，到 2025 年，工资税将占社会保障收入的 91%，其中 5% 来自利息收入，4% 来自高收入受益人为其福利缴纳的联邦所得税。

paras.en: To increase Social Security's revenues, lawmakers may consider changes that make high-income taxpayers contribute more to the program while sparing low- to moderate-income taxpayers, according to the AARP report.
paras.zh: 根据美国退休人员协会的报告，为了增加社会保障的收入，立法者可能会考虑做出一些改变，让高收入纳税人为该计划做出更多贡献，同时保留中低收入纳税人的利益。

paras.en: "The fix for Social Security isn't cutting earned benefits; it's rebuilding the revenue behind them," Johnson said.
paras.zh: 约翰逊说：“解决社会保障问题的方法不是削减工资福利，而是重建福利背后的收入。”

paras.en: Raising the payroll tax threshold — which is incrementally adjusted each year to keep up with average wages — would not affect most workers, since just 6% of individuals had earnings at or above the cap in 2024, according to the AARP.
paras.zh: 根据美国退休人员协会 (AARP) 的数据，提高工资税起征点（每年逐步调整以跟上平均工资的步伐）不会影响大多数工人，因为到 2024 年，只有 6% 的个人收入达到或高于上限。

paras.en: In 2027, the Social Security taxable maximum is set to increase to $192,300.
paras.zh: 2027 年，社会保障应税最高限额将增至 192,300 美元。

paras.en: Bills have been introduced in Congress to raise the cap to apply to higher thresholds, such as $250,000 or $400,000, or to eliminate it altogether. Getting rid of the cap would close 67% of the 75-year funding gap if workers do not receive a benefit increase in exchange for those contributions, according to AARP research based on the Social Security Administration's assessments.
paras.zh: 国会已提出法案，提高上限以适用更高的门槛，例如 250,000 美元或 400,000 美元，或完全取消上限。根据美国退休人员协会 (AARP) 基于社会保障管理局评估的研究，如果工人没有获得增加福利以换取这些缴款，取消上限将弥补 75 年资金缺口的 67%。

paras.en: Another option: Lawmakers may also shore up the program by taxing income not currently subject to Social Security payroll taxes, according to the AARP, following an increase in business activity through pass-through entities — such as sole proprietorships, partnerships, limited liability companies and S corporations.
paras.zh: 另一种选择：根据美国退休人员协会的说法，随着通过独资企业、合伙企业、有限责任公司和小型公司等转嫁实体进行的商业活动增加，立法者还可以通过对目前无需缴纳社会保障工资税的收入征税来支持该计划。

paras.en: Lawmakers could create a new tax on investment income to help fund Social Security's trust funds. A new 12.4% tax on investment income for active S corp. officers and limited partners would close about 25% of Social Security's 75-year financing gap, according to the AARP, which cited research from Social Security's actuaries.
paras.zh: 立法者可以对投资收入征收新税，以帮助为社会保障信托基金提供资金。对 Active S 公司的投资收益征收新的 12.4% 税。美国退休人员协会 (AARP) 援引社会保障精算师的研究称，官员和有限合伙人将弥补社会保障 75 年融资缺口的约 25%。

paras.en: One option not mentioned in the AARP research is raising the payroll tax rate, which is currently 6.2% for workers and employers, or 12.4% combined. The Social Security trustees estimated that an increase in the combined rate to 16.65% beginning in January 2026 would have made the combined program solvent for the 75-year period ending in 2100.
paras.zh: AARP 研究中未提及的一项选择是提高工资税率，目前工人和雇主的工资税率为 6.2%，合计为 12.4%。社会保障受托人估计，从 2026 年 1 月开始将综合利率提高到 16.65%，将使该综合计划在截至 2100 年的 75 年期间具有偿付能力。

paras.en: A national survey conducted in February found 62% of individuals would support gradually increasing the payroll tax from 6.2% to 6.5%, according to the University of Maryland School of Public Policy. That poll included 2,509 adults.
paras.zh: 马里兰大学公共政策学院表示，2 月份进行的一项全国调查发现，62% 的人支持逐步将工资税从 6.2% 提高到 6.5%。该民意调查包括 2,509 名成年人。

paras.en: The 1983 Social Security reforms included changes to benefits, such as gradually raising the retirement age from 65 to 67, delaying the cost-of-living adjustment by six months and taxing Social Security benefits.
paras.zh: 1983年的社会保障改革包括福利方面的变化，例如逐步将退休年龄从65岁提高到67岁、将生活费用调整推迟六个月以及对社会保障福利征税。

paras.en: Research shows those changes have reduced lifetime retirement benefits by about 19% for people turning 65 in 2026 compared to what they would have received under the previous rules, Jenn Jones, vice president of financial security and livable communities at the AARP, said during the Tuesday press briefing.
paras.zh: 美国退休人员协会 (AARP) 财务安全和宜居社区副总裁詹·琼斯 (Jenn Jones) 在周二的新闻发布会上表示，研究表明，这些变化导致 2026 年年满 65 岁的人的终身退休福利比以前的规则减少了约 19%。

paras.en: While the AARP has not endorsed any specific benefit changes, Jones said the organization opposes cuts to monthly checks.
paras.zh: 虽然美国退休人员协会尚未批准任何具体的福利变化，但琼斯表示该组织反对削减每月支票。

paras.en: "Millions of Americans — we hear from them every day — cannot afford to lose a penny," Jones said.
paras.zh: 琼斯说：“我们每天都收到他们的来信，数以百万计的美国人承受不起损失一分钱的后果。”

articles.title: Mississippi Senate: Scott Colom lead over Hyde-Smith pops to more than 4,400 votes

paras.en: Democratic nominee Scott Colom on Wednesday significantly expanded his lead over incumbent Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith in the Mississippi Senate election to more than 4,400 votes as the ballot count continued.
paras.zh: 周三，随着计票工作继续进行，民主党候选人斯科特·科洛姆 (Scott Colom) 在密西西比州参议院选举中对现任共和党参议员辛迪·海德·史密斯 (Cindy Hyde-Smith) 的领先优势大幅扩大至 4,400 多票。

paras.en: When the day began, Colom had a 2,990-vote lead over Hyde-Smith.
paras.zh: 当天开始时，科罗姆领先海德史密斯 2,990 票。

paras.en: That spread ticked upward slowly until just after 2 p.m. ET when a surge of newly counted ballots boosted his tally by 607 votes, and then soon after by another 621 votes.
paras.zh: 价差缓慢上升，直到下午 2 点刚过。东部时间，新统计的选票激增，他的得票数增加了 607 票，不久之后又增加了 621 票。

paras.en: As of 2:30 p.m., Colom was ahead of Hyde-Smith by 4,404 votes, according to the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，截至下午 2 点 30 分，科罗姆领先海德史密斯 4,404 票。

paras.en: With an estimated 99% of the votes in, Colom led Hyde-Smith by 49.18% to 48.72%. Independent candidate Ty Pinkins had 2.1% of the vote.
paras.zh: 预计获得 99% 的选票，科罗姆以 49.18% 比 48.72% 领先海德史密斯。独立候选人泰·平金斯 (Ty Pinkins) 获得 2.1% 的选票。

paras.en: Colom has steadily expanded his lead over Hyde-Smith for days as he has won a higher share of so-called affidavit ballots than he received in ballots counted on Election Day night. Affidavit ballots are cast by voters on a provisional basis if there is a question about the voter's eligibility.
paras.zh: 几天来，科罗姆对海德史密斯的领先优势稳步扩大，因为他赢得的所谓宣誓选票的比例高于选举日晚上计票的比例。如果对选民的资格有疑问，选民将临时进行宣誓投票。

paras.en: The AP estimates that fewer than 15,000 ballots are left to be processed.
paras.zh: 美联社估计，尚待处理的选票不足 15,000 张。

paras.en: Colom was boosted by newly counted votes from Hinds County, the second-most populous county in Mississippi, which encompasses the capital of Jackson.
paras.zh: 科罗姆因新统计的海因兹县选票而受到提振，海因兹县是密西西比州人口第二多的县，涵盖了杰克逊首府。

paras.en: Most of the county's residents are, like Colom, Black.
paras.zh: 该县的大多数居民，如科罗姆，都是黑人。

paras.en: If Colom is elected, he would be the first Black senator from Mississippi since the Reconstruction Era after the Civil War.
paras.zh: 如果科洛姆当选，他将成为自内战后重建时代以来第一位来自密西西比州的黑人参议员。

paras.en: In 2024, Democratic presidential nominee Kamala Harris defeated President Donald Trump by 46 percentage points in Hinds County. As of Wednesday morning, Colom was winning 80% of the vote in the county, with just 19% for Hyde-Smith.
paras.zh: 2024 年，民主党总统候选人卡马拉·哈里斯在海因兹县以 46 个百分点的优势击败了唐纳德·特朗普总统。截至周三上午，科洛姆赢得了该县 80% 的选票，海德-史密斯仅获得 19%。

paras.en: Mississippi, which has not elected a Democratic senator since the segregationist John Stennis in 1982, was on the radar of few, if any, political analysts as a possible pickup for Democrats.
paras.zh: 自 1982 年种族隔离主义者约翰·斯坦尼斯 (John Stennis) 当选以来，密西西比州就再也没有选举过民主党参议员。很少有政治分析人士将密西西比州视为民主党可能的选区。

paras.en: Tuesday was the deadline for resolving affidavit ballots. It is also the deadline for the receipt of mail-in absentee ballots that are postmarked by Election Day, Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 周二是解决宣誓投票的最后期限。这也是收到邮寄缺席选票的截止日期，邮戳日期为 11 月 3 日选举日。

paras.en: Mississippi is one of just two states whose Senate election has not been called. Alaska is the other.
paras.zh: 密西西比州是仅有的两个尚未举行参议院选举的州之一。阿拉斯加是另一个。

paras.en: Democrats so far have flipped seven Senate seats held by Republicans going into the election. That gives Democrats a new majority in the Senate of at least 54 seats in the 100-member chamber come January.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，民主党已经在选举中推翻了共和党占据的七个参议院席位。这使得民主党在 1 月份在参议院拥有新的多数席位，在 100 名议员的参议院中至少获得 54 个席位。

paras.en: Alaska before Election Day was viewed as possibly key to the question of whether Republicans would retain their narrow majority in the Senate.
paras.zh: 选举日之前的阿拉斯加被认为可能是共和党能否保住参议院微弱多数席位问题的关键。

paras.en: In Alaska, Democratic nominee Mary Peltola's lead extended to 4,250 votes over incumbent Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan, with 84% of the total votes counted, a margin of 1.8 percentage points.
paras.zh: 在阿拉斯加州，民主党候选人玛丽·佩尔托拉（Mary Peltola）以 4,250 票领先于现任共和党参议员丹·沙利文（Dan Sullivan），总票数已统计 84%，领先 1.8 个百分点。

paras.en: If neither she nor Sullivan gets more than 50% of the total vote, the race will go to a ranked-choice round, in which the two other candidates, Gerald Heikes and another candidate named Dan Sullivan, will be eliminated, and the second choices of voters who made them their first choice will be allocated between Peltola and the incumbent.
paras.zh: 如果她和沙利文都没有获得超过50%的选票，比赛将进入排名选择轮，其中另外两名候选人杰拉尔德·海克斯和另一名候选人丹·沙利文将被淘汰，而将他们作为第一选择的选民的第二选择将在佩尔托拉和现任候选人之间分配。

articles.title: El Niño will push temperatures above 1.5 degrees C. Will we ever come back down?

paras.en: In the midst of an El Niño likely to be the strongest in living memory—perhaps even in the past 1,000 years—the massive pulse of heat being exhaled by the Pacific Ocean is sending global temperatures skyrocketing. Records are already being set well before the event is expected to peak. And this year could set a record, only to be eclipsed by 2027.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象可能是人们记忆中最强烈的一次，甚至可能是过去 1000 年来最强烈的一次，太平洋呼出的大量热量正在导致全球气温飙升。早在活动预计达到顶峰之前，记录就已经被创造出来了。今年可能会创下纪录，但到 2027 年就会被打破。

paras.en: Both 2026 and 2027 will almost certainly come in at more than 1.5 degrees Celsius above average temperatures in preindustrial times, before humans dramatically ramped up the burning of fossil fuels—the threshold the world hoped to keep warming beneath. The question now is: Will we ever come back down below that benchmark once El Niño has exhausted itself? Or will this event mark a permanent step up on our current warming trajectory?
paras.zh: 几乎可以肯定，2026 年和 2027 年的气温将比工业化前时期的平均气温高出 1.5 摄氏度以上，而在此之前，人类会大幅增加化石燃料的燃烧——世界希望将变暖控制在这个阈值以下。现在的问题是：一旦厄尔尼诺现象耗尽，我们是否还会回到这一基准以下？或者这一事件是否会标志着我们当前变暖轨迹的永久进步？

paras.en: “Eventually there’s going to be a year where we don’t dip below 1.5C [on average], and based on what I’m seeing here, it might be this year,” says climate scientist Daniel Swain, a climate scientist at University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources.
paras.zh: 加州大学农业与自然资源分校气候科学家丹尼尔·斯温 (Daniel Swain) 表示：“最终，我们的平均气温将不会低于 1.5 摄氏度，根据我在这里看到的情况，可能是今年。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: To understand why El Niño can have such a marked effect on global temperatures, let’s delve into what happens during one. Normally, westerly winds pile warm waters up in the western tropical Pacific Ocean, but every few years, those winds slacken and sometimes even reverse, sending that water sloshing over to the eastern Pacific. Aside from raising coastal sea levels and setting off a domino effect of changes in global weather patterns, this shift releases massive amounts of heat from the ocean into the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 为了理解为什么厄尔尼诺现象会对全球气温产生如此显着的影响，让我们深入研究一下厄尔尼诺现象期间发生的情况。通常情况下，西风会在热带西部太平洋上堆积温暖的海水，但每隔几年，这些风就会减弱，有时甚至逆转，将海水吹到东太平洋。除了沿海海平面上升和全球天气模式变化引发的多米诺骨牌效应之外，这种变化还将大量热量从海洋释放到大气中。

paras.en: But this year’s event is shaping up to be an El Niño unlike any we’ve ever seen. It’s “literally and figuratively out of uncharted waters,” says Zeke Hausfather, a climate scientist at Stripe and Berkeley Earth. By September of this year, sea surface temperatures in the part of the Pacific that is El Niño’s epicenter had already passed a daily record set in November 2015, and the phenomenon usually doesn’t reach its fever pitch until November or December. “This El Niño is growing so much faster than any other event,” Hausfather says.
paras.zh: 但今年的厄尔尼诺现象将是我们从未见过的。 Stripe 和伯克利地球公司的气候科学家泽克·豪斯法瑟 (Zeke Hausfather) 表示，它“无论从字面上还是比喻意义上都来自未知领域”。到今年9月，厄尔尼诺现象震中的太平洋部分海面温度已经超过了2015年11月创下的日记录，而且这种现象通常要到11月或12月才会达到最严重的程度。 “这次厄尔尼诺现象的发展速度比任何其他事件都要快得多，”豪斯法瑟说。

paras.en: Right now, models project that ocean temperatures in the Pacific core of El Niño could reach an astounding four degrees C above normal when the event reaches its zenith. They currently sit around a still jaw-dropping 3.4 degrees C above normal. Wherever sea surface temperatures peak between those numbers, they will absolutely smash the heat record from as long as we’ve had direct temperature measurements, which was set by an El Niño in 1877. (That event resulted in millions of deaths around the world from droughts and failed harvests linked to changes in weather patterns.) It would also be above estimates of past El Niño sea surface temperatures taken from coral and tree growth rings going back to the year 1100. And this year’s event would likely set a record even without the baseline ocean warming from climate change.
paras.zh: 目前，模型预测，当厄尔尼诺现象达到顶峰时，太平洋核心的海洋温度可能会比正常水平高出惊人的四摄氏度。目前气温比正常水平高出 3.4 摄氏度，仍然令人瞠目结舌。无论海面温度在这些数字之间达到峰值，它们都绝对会打破我们直接测量温度以来的高温记录，该记录是由 1877 年厄尔尼诺现象创下的。（该事件导致世界各地数百万人因干旱和与天气模式变化相关的歉收而死亡。）它也将高于从 1100 年珊瑚和树木年轮中获取的过去厄尔尼诺海面温度的估计值。即使没有，今年的事件也可能会创下记录。气候变化导致的海洋变暖基线。

paras.en: The extraordinary ocean heat released into the atmosphere will translate to a projected global average temperature of 1.52 degrees C above preindustrial temperatures for 2026 and perhaps a truly eye-popping 1.74 degrees C above for 2027. Typically the global heat effects of El Niño come in the year after the event begins because it takes time for that heat to spread. The rapid growth of this event means that 2026 could set the record for the hottest year, surpassing 2024. But whether or not it does, 2027 is virtually certain to take the crown.
paras.zh: 释放到大气中的大量海洋热量预计将导致 2026 年全球平均气温比工业化前温度高出 1.52 摄氏度，到 2027 年可能会高出令人瞠目结舌的 1.74 摄氏度。通常，厄尔尼诺现象的全球热效应会在事件开始后的一年内出现，因为热量需要时间传播。这一事件的迅速发展意味着 2026 年可能会超越 2024 年创下最热年份的记录。但无论是否如此，2027 年几乎肯定会夺得桂冠。

paras.en: Regardless of any records, this year and next will be the second and third years to surpass 1.5 degrees C above preindustrial levels (2024 being the first). Under the landmark 2015 Paris climate agreement, nearly 200 countries signed on to try to limit warming to no more than that amount, with two degrees C being a clear line that the world vowed not to cross.
paras.zh: 不管有什么记录，今年和明年将是第二年和第三年气温比工业化前水平高出 1.5 摄氏度（2024 年是第一次）。根据具有里程碑意义的 2015 年巴黎气候协议，近 200 个国家签署了协议，试图将气温升高限制在不超过这一水平，其中 2 摄氏度是世界发誓不会跨越的明确界限。

paras.en: Usually the temperature effects of an El Niño are temporary: ocean surface temperatures shift back to their normal configuration, and the heat released to the atmosphere is slowly emitted to space.
paras.zh: 通常，厄尔尼诺现象的温度影响是暂时的：海洋表面温度回到正常状态，释放到大气中的热量慢慢散发到太空。

paras.en: But in a rapidly changing climate, Swain, for one, wonders if the heat bomb released this year could fuel the feedback loops that are exacerbating global temperature rise. Sea ice melt could ramp up, meaning polar oceans absorb even more heat. More permafrost could thaw, releasing methane, a potent greenhouse gas. El Niño also drives drought that causes wildfires in many areas, which contribute massive amounts of planet-warming emissions to the atmosphere, says Kim Wood, an atmospheric scientist at the University of Arizona. It’s not impossible that these feedback effects could effectively lock in some of what would otherwise be a temporary global fever. “It’s possible that now at least a small portion of the warming from El Niños is not always so temporary anymore,” Swain says.
paras.zh: 但在气候迅速变化的情况下，斯温想知道今年释放的热弹是否会加剧加剧全球气温上升的反馈循环。海冰融化可能会加速，这意味着极地海洋会吸收更多的热量。更多的永久冻土可能会融化，释放出甲烷，一种强效温室气体。亚利桑那大学大气科学家金·伍德表示，厄尔尼诺现象还导致干旱，导致许多地区发生野火，向大气排放大量导致地球变暖的排放物。这些反馈效应并非不可能有效地锁定一些原本会暂时出现的全球热潮。 “现在厄尔尼诺现象造成的变暖至少有一小部分可能不再那么暂时了，”斯温说。

paras.en: But he does emphasize there is considerable uncertainty. After all, there’s also a good chance the Pacific will swing into a La Niña, in which cold waters from deep in the ocean well up in the eastern Pacific. This counterpart to El Niño depresses global temperatures, though even La Niña years now are much warmer than even El Niño years of decades past. For example, the La Niña year of 2022 was hotter than the El Niño year of 1998—a blockbuster event at the time. If we get a strong La Niña, global temperatures might go down to 1.45 degrees C above preindustrial.
paras.zh: 但他确实强调存在相当大的不确定性。毕竟，太平洋也很有可能陷入拉尼娜现象，即来自海洋深处的冷水涌入东太平洋。这种与厄尔尼诺现象相对应的现象会降低全球气温，尽管现在的拉尼娜现象年份比过去几十年的厄尔尼诺现象年份要温暖得多。例如，2022年的拉尼娜年比1998年的厄尔尼诺年更热，这在当时是一个轰动一时的事件。如果出现强烈的拉尼娜现象，全球气温可能会比工业化前下降至 1.45 摄氏度。

paras.en: Hausfather acknowledges the possibility of staying above 1.5 degrees C after this El Niño but says he “would not be surprised at all if we go back below it.”
paras.zh: 豪斯法瑟承认，在这次厄尔尼诺现象之后，气温有可能保持在 1.5 摄氏度以上，但他表示，“如果我们回到 1.5 摄氏度以下，他一点也不会感到惊讶。”

paras.en: If we don’t stay above 1.5 degrees C with this event, it’s only a matter of time before we do. A new study released on Monday in Nature Climate Change, though, has estimated that land areas around the world have already experienced 90 to 94 percent of the warming that would be expected in a world where global temperatures have reached 1.5 degrees C above preindustrial. United Nations agencies have also already acknowledged that we will blow past the 1.5-degree-C goal of the Paris agreement eventually, with estimates that warming will peak at 2.6 degrees C above preindustrial before we can begin reversing the trend.
paras.zh: 如果这次事件我们不能将气温保持在 1.5 摄氏度以上，那只是时间问题。不过，周一在《自然气候变化》杂志上发表的一项新研究估计，全球气温已比工业化前高出 1.5 摄氏度，全球陆地面积已经经历了 90% 至 94% 的变暖。联合国机构也已经承认，我们最终将超越《巴黎协定》设定的 1.5 摄氏度的目标，预计在我们开始扭转这一趋势之前，升温将达到比工业化前高 2.6 摄氏度的峰值。

paras.en: But when exactly we breach 1.5 degrees C for good and for how long we stay there depends heavily on decisions we make now and in the next few years.
paras.zh: 但是，我们究竟何时突破 1.5 摄氏度以及我们在这个水平上停留多久，在很大程度上取决于我们现在和未来几年做出的决定。

articles.title: Mountain heights across the country are about to change. Gravity is to blame

paras.en: A major change is coming for America’s mountains, valleys, forests and waters—or, at least, their official locations and sizes. Researchers at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration are nearly finished with a complete overhaul of the National Spatial Reference System (NSRS), the framework that defines where things are and their orientation in space for the U.S. and its territories. The new framework is in beta testing and will be finalized in early 2027. “Every latitude, longitude and height all across the country is going to change a little bit,” says Kevin Ahlgren, a geodesist with the National Geodetic Survey, the agency within NOAA that’s managing the transition.
paras.zh: 美国的山脉、山谷、森林和水域——或者至少是它们的官方位置和面积——即将发生重大变化。美国国家海洋和大气管理局的研究人员即将完成对国家空间参考系统（NSRS）的全面检修，该系统为美国及其领土定义了事物的位置及其在空间中的方向。新框架正在进行 beta 测试，将于 2027 年初最终确定。“全国各地的每个纬度、经度和高度都将发生一点变化，”美国国家大地测量局 (NOAA 内负责管理过渡的机构) 的大地测量师 Kevin Ahlgren 表示。

paras.en: The new models, which may alter measurements by up to around six feet, reflect actual changes to the environment, such as ice melt, as well as technological and scientific advances since the last update, including the release of GPS. The NSRS’s horizontal component accounts for the slowly spinning, crimping movements of continental plates, which have thrown off latitudes and longitudes since the last model was released in 1986. Vertical changes come down, in large part, to gravity.
paras.zh: 新模型可能会将测量值改变最多约六英尺，反映了环境的实际变化，例如冰融化，以及自上次更新以来的技术和科学进步，包括 GPS 的发布。 NSRS 的水平分量解释了大陆板块缓慢旋转、卷曲的运动，自 1986 年发布最后一个模型以来，大陆板块已经偏离了纬度和经度。垂直变化在很大程度上归因于重力。

paras.en: Scientists have known for centuries that gravity is not the same everywhere on Earth, and there is a theoretical model, the geoid, that depicts these fluctuations. More massive objects, such as mountains, exert a greater gravitational pull; even in relatively flat areas, geologic differences under the surface can produce bulges of gravity. As Derek van Westrum, a NOAA physicist specializing in a high-precision instrument called a gravity meter, puts it, Earth is a “blobby” place, both physically and gravitationally—as seen in the potatolike geoid.
paras.zh: 几个世纪以来，科学家们就知道地球上各处的重力并不相同，并且有一个理论模型，即大地水准面，可以描述这些波动。质量越大的物体，例如山脉，会产生更大的引力；即使在相对平坦的地区，地表下的地质差异也会产生重力隆起。正如美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 物理学家德里克·范韦斯特鲁姆 (Derek van Westrum) 所说，地球是一个“斑点”的地方，无论是在物理上还是在引力上，就像土豆一样的大地水准面。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Under the new system, scientists are using the geoid to help define the invisible “sea level” from which heights are measured in the NSRS. Over 17 years, research airplanes crisscrossed the country to develop a new gravitational picture based on direct measurements. Scientists combined these data with readings from the ground and from space to produce a comprehensive model of where sea level is at every point in the country—the vertical datum, which was last updated in 1991. Per the new model, elevation above sea level will undergo the smallest shift in the Southeast, and the extent of changes will increase toward the north and west; in Alaska the official height of geographic features may shrink by around six feet.
paras.zh: 在新系统下，科学家们正在使用大地水准面来帮助定义不可见的“海平面”，NSRS 中的高度就是从该海平面测量的。 17 年来，研究飞机在全国各地穿梭，以直接测量为基础开发新的引力图。科学家将这些数据与地面和太空的读数结合起来，生成了一个关于该国每个点海平面位置的综合模型——垂直基准，该模型最后一次更新是在1991年。根据新模型，东南部的海拔高度变化最小，向北和向西变化的程度将增加；在阿拉斯加，官方地理特征的高度可能会缩小约六英尺。

paras.en: “It’s a complete change—a new paradigm,” says Demián Gómez, a geodesist at the Ohio State University who has been studying applications of the updated system. More accurate and precise vertical measurements will improve floodplain mapping and models of water flow. National Geodetic Survey scientists say it will also improve surveying and construction, automated navigation, and early-warning systems for earthquakes. These updated coordinates and heights will be used by all federal agencies and for all federally funded projects—and, for the average user, they’ll also be reflected in GPS devices and mapping programs. Mountain peaks and floodplains aren’t going to physically change, but the new system will bring our mode of measuring the world into better alignment with our experience of it.
paras.zh: “这是一个彻底的改变——一个新的范式，”俄亥俄州立大学的大地测量学家德米安·戈麦斯（Demián Gómez）说，他一直在研究更新系统的应用。更准确和精确的垂直测量将改善漫滩绘图和水流模型。国家大地测量局的科学家表示，它还将改善测量和施工、自动导航和地震预警系统。这些更新的坐标和高度将由所有联邦机构和所有联邦资助的项目使用，并且对于普通用户来说，它们还将反映在 GPS 设备和地图程序中。山峰和洪泛区不会发生物理变化，但新系统将使我们测量世界的模式与我们的经验更好地保持一致。

articles.title: OpenAI’s ‘shepherds’ affirm blockbuster physics result

paras.en: OpenAI’s progress on another million-dollar problem is finally public. Experts appointed by the company to vet the work say they’ve now verified its artificial-intelligence-generated proof of the “existence” of the quantum Yang-Mills theory—a vital foundation for the Standard Model of particle physics.
paras.zh: OpenAI 在另一个价值百万美元的问题上的进展终于公开了。该公司任命的审查这项工作的专家表示，他们现在已经验证了人工智能生成的量子杨-米尔斯理论“存在”的证明——这是粒子物理学标准模型的重要基础。

paras.en: Like many AI proofs, this one is messy—too lengthy and complicated for human minds to immediately grasp. Seeking to avoid another “slop drop”—a term used for when OpenAI unleashed a flood of more than 700 AI-generated proofs on a single day in October—the company enlisted the eminent American theoretical physicist David Gross to lead a committee to supervise the Yang-Mills proof’s release.
paras.zh: 与许多人工智能证明一样，这个证明也很混乱——太长太复杂，人类大脑无法立即掌握。为了避免再次出现“漏水”（OpenAI 在 10 月份的一天内发布了超过 700 个人工智能生成的证明的术语），该公司聘请了著名的美国理论物理学家 David Gross 来领导一个委员会来监督 Yang-Mills 证明的发布。

paras.en: “We update the progress of our committee in shepherding the LLM [large language model] produced result,” the group said in a statement on November 9 previewing its findings. The team’s work confirms that OpenAI’s result “proves the existence of pure Yang-Mills theory according to the problem statements which are standard in physics and mathematics.”
paras.zh: 该组织在 11 月 9 日预览其调查结果的声明中表示：“我们更新了委员会在指导 LLM（大语言模型）产生结果方面的进展。”该团队的工作证实了 OpenAI 的结果“根据物理和数学标准的问题陈述证明了纯杨米尔斯理论的存在”。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: On the night of November 10, Gross and the four colleagues he selected for the committee posted a document explaining how the proof works, alongside their affirmation of the proof’s formal verification in Lean, a programming language that checks mathematical work. This “shepherding” approach, however, contradicts recommendations for transparency from an OpenAI-affiliated advisory group and has riled some mathematicians who have seen it as an act of needless gatekeeping.
paras.zh: 11 月 10 日晚，格罗斯和他为委员会挑选的四位同事发布了一份文件，解释了证明的工作原理，同时确认了证明在精益（一种检查数学工作的编程语言）中的形式验证。然而，这种“引导”方法与 OpenAI 附属咨询小组关于透明度的建议相矛盾，并激怒了一些数学家，他们认为这是一种不必要的把关行为。

paras.en: “I’m happy the shepherds are releasing the Lean proof, finally, so we can see what the result is. And I hope, in the future, the AI labs will share their results widely with the community,” says Scott Armstrong, a mathematician at New York University. “This review can be done more efficiently and quickly in the open.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴牧羊人终于发布了精益证明，这样我们就可以看到结果是什么。我希望人工智能实验室将来能够与社区广泛分享他们的结果，”纽约大学数学家斯科特·阿姆斯特朗 (Scott Armstrong) 说。 “这种审查可以在公开的情况下更有效、更快速地进行。”

paras.en: OpenAI’s blockbuster proof addresses the “Yang-Mills problem,” which is one of five remaining unsolved “Millennium Prize Problems,” a set of seven problems codified by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000. Successfully solving a Millennium Prize Problem comes with a $1-million prize. But solving Yang-Mills would carry a bigger reward by tidying up the mathematical sloppiness of modern particle physics.
paras.zh: OpenAI 的重磅证明解决了“杨-米尔斯问题”，这是五个尚未解决的“千年奖问题”之一，克莱数学研究所于 2000 年编纂了一组七个问题。成功解决千年奖问题将获得 100 万美元的奖金。但解决杨米尔斯问题将会带来更大的回报，因为它可以纠正现代粒子物理学的数学缺陷。

paras.en: By many measures, the Standard Model is the most thoroughly tested and successful scientific theory ever devised, predicting precisely what happens when physicists smash subatomic particles together at facilities such as CERN’s Large Hadron Collider near Geneva. But no one has managed to boil down the Standard Model’s tenets to simple logic-based statements called axioms and therefore prove that it’s mathematically sound.
paras.zh: 从许多方面来看，标准模型是迄今为止设计的经过最彻底测试和最成功的科学理论，它准确地预测了当物理学家在日内瓦附近的欧洲核子研究组织大型强子对撞机等设施中将亚原子粒子粉碎在一起时会发生什么。但没有人能够将标准模型的原则归结为称为公理的简单的基于逻辑的陈述，从而证明它在数学上是合理的。

paras.en: The Yang-Mills Millennium Prize Problem has two parts. The first is to prove that this theory underpinning the Standard Model “exists,” meaning that it can be constructed through valid mathematical steps. The second is more quantitative (and far more difficult), and it involves showing that an essential physical quantity called a “mass gap” emerges from the Yang-Mills equations.
paras.zh: 杨-米尔斯千年奖问题有两个部分。首先是证明支撑标准模型的理论“存在”，这意味着它可以通过有效的数学步骤构建。第二个是更定量的（也更困难），它涉及表明从杨-米尔斯方程中出现了一个称为“质量间隙”的基本物理量。

paras.en: In late October OpenAI announced that its model had solved the first part of the problem—the “existence” problem. The company’s claim cut ahead of another mathematician’s public, ongoing collaboration with an employee of OpenAI’s rival Anthropic to prove the same result. The “mass gap” remains unresolved.
paras.zh: 10 月底，OpenAI 宣布其模型已经解决了问题的第一部分——“存在”问题。该公司的声明领先于另一位数学家与 OpenAI 竞争对手 Anthropic 的一名员工的公开持续合作，以证明相同的结果。 “质量差距”仍未解决。

paras.en: The shepherds’ document is too cursory to provide a deep understanding of how the LLM’s proof works. Indeed, Gross and his colleagues have admitted they still lack that themselves. “We used OpenAI’s Astra [model] to assist with the digestion of the supplied Lean code,” they wrote in the their assessment. “We do not claim to fully understand the proof yet.” But with the proof and its Lean code now released to the world for deeper scrutiny, experts in the community can use their own agents to reverse-engineer and begin to parse it.
paras.zh: 牧羊人的文件过于粗略，无法深入理解法学硕士的证明是如何运作的。事实上，格罗斯和他的同事承认他们自己仍然缺乏这一点。 “我们使用 OpenAI 的 Astra [模型] 来帮助消化所提供的精益代码，”他们在评估中写道。 “我们还没有声称完全理解了证据。”但随着证据及其精益代码现已向全世界发布以供更深入的审查，社区中的专家可以使用自己的代理进行逆向工程并开始解析它。

articles.title: Light is hard to block from every direction. This physicist found a way
articles.author: Emily Conover

paras.en: This is a human-written story voiced by AI. Got feedback?
paras.zh: 这是一个由人工智能配音的人类书写的故事。有反馈吗？

paras.en: Physicist Stefano Martiniani has designed an entirely new class of materials that blurs the line between order and chaos. Called gyromorphs, these metamaterials rely on crystal-like geometric structure and liquidlike randomness to block light from penetrating at any angle.
paras.zh: 物理学家 Stefano Martiniani 设计了一种全新的材料，模糊了秩序与混乱之间的界限。这些超材料被称为陀螺仪，依靠类晶体的几何结构和类液体的随机性来阻止光线以任何角度穿透。

paras.en: Physicists thought, structurally speaking, that they could not create such hybrid materials. “But this is evidence that you can, under certain constraints,” says Martiniani, of New York University. He likens the gyromorphs’ disorderliness to a crowd of people. You could see through the crowd if individuals stood still in straight lines, but not if they are clustered together in random groups. But there’s order too: From anywhere you stand in a gyromorph crowd, you’ll see a ring of people at a given distance.
paras.zh: 物理学家认为，从结构上来说，他们无法制造出这种混合材料。纽约大学的马蒂尼亚尼说：“但这证明在某些限制下你可以做到。”他将陀螺怪的混乱状态比作一群人。如果人们站成一条直线，你可以透过人群看到，但如果他们随机聚集在一起，你就看不到。但也有秩序：无论你站在旋转人群中的任何地方，你都会看到在一定距离内有一圈人。

paras.en: Gyromorphs are a type of metamaterial, a substance with a structure designed to give it properties not found in naturally occurring materials. Metamaterials can control light, sound or other waves, and are often used in smartphones, medical imaging and computers. Martiniani says gyromorphs could be used to make more energy-efficient optical computers, which use light to process and store data.
paras.zh: 回旋体是一种超材料，这种物质的结构旨在赋予其天然材料所没有的特性。超材料可以控制光、声或其他波，通常用于智能手机、医学成像和计算机。马蒂尼亚尼表示，陀螺仪可用于制造更节能的光学计算机，该计算机利用光来处理和存储数据。

paras.en: To design a gyromorph, Martiniani needed to find a way to achieve the perfect structural balance. He turned to FReSCo, a program his lab created that designs molecular structures to meet researchers’ specifications, for help. “We had an algorithm, we gave it an objective, and then it was able to solve that objective, finding a solution that we were not expecting,” he says. “That is the best kind of discovery.”
paras.zh: 为了设计陀螺模型，马蒂尼亚尼需要找到一种方法来实现完美的结构平衡。他向 FReSCo 寻求帮助，这是他的实验室创建的一个程序，用于设计分子结构以满足研究人员的规格。 “我们有一个算法，我们给它一个目标，然后它能够​​解决这个目标，找到一个我们没有预料到的解决方案，”他说。 “这是最好的发现。”

articles.title: This magic mushroom can kill
articles.author: Tina Hesman Saey

paras.en: People who eat this tiny magic mushroom may hit a lethal low instead of getting high.
paras.zh: 吃了这种微小的神奇蘑菇的人可能会陷入致命的低谷，而不是变得兴奋。

paras.en: The fungus makes hallucinogenic psilocybin and deadly amatoxin, researchers report November 11 in Current Biology. Dubbed “dark magic mushrooms,” it is the first species of fungus discovered to make both types of compounds.
paras.zh: 研究人员 11 月 11 日在《当代生物学》杂志上报道称，这种真菌会产生致幻性裸盖菇素和致命的鹅膏毒素。它被称为“黑魔法蘑菇”，是第一种被发现能产生这两种化合物的真菌。

paras.en: Chemist and fungal biologist Andrew Kunik found the dark magic mushroom in 2025 growing on a decaying moss-covered palm trunk in a central Florida wetland. Kunik, who was then doing post-baccalaureate research in the lab of fungal biologist Matthew Smith at the University of Florida in Gainesville, identified the mini mushroom as Galerina indica.
paras.zh: 化学家兼真菌生物学家安德鲁·库尼克 (Andrew Kunik) 于 2025 年在佛罗里达州中部湿地的一棵腐烂的长满青苔的棕榈树干上发现了这种黑魔法蘑菇。库尼克当时正在盖恩斯维尔佛罗里达大学真菌生物学家马修·史密斯的实验室进行学士学位后研究，他将这种迷你蘑菇鉴定为 Galerina indica。

paras.en: That species had not been reported in Florida before, Kunik says. “It’s quite rare and unusual.” He also found two other new related species, tagged with the placeholder names Galerina species 1 and Galerina species 2.
paras.zh: 库尼克说，佛罗里达州以前从未报道过该物种。 “这是非常罕见和不寻常的。”他还发现了另外两个新的相关物种，并用占位符名称 Galerina 物种 1 和 Galerina 物种 2 进行了标记。

paras.en: Other researchers had previously described G. indica’s appearance and found DNA signatures that distinguish the fungus from related species. But no one had cataloged the mushroom’s complete chemical or genetic makeup.
paras.zh: 其他研究人员此前曾描述过 G. indica 的外观，并发现了将这种真菌与相关物种区分开来的 DNA 特征。但没有人对这种蘑菇的完整化学或基因组成进行分类。

paras.en: Related Galerina species make amatoxins, deadly chemicals that can kill in even tiny amounts and are found in death cap mushrooms and other species. Kunik and colleagues looked for those toxins in G. indica and the two other new Galerina species. G. indica makes a previously undiscovered form of amatoxin the team is calling alpha-proamanitin, the chemical analysis revealed.
paras.zh: 相关的 Galerina 物种会产生鹅膏毒素，这是一种致命的化学物质，即使微量也能致人死亡，死帽蘑菇和其他物种中也存在这种毒素。 Kunik 和同事在 G. indica 和另外两个新的 Galerina 物种中寻找这些毒素。化学分析显示，G. indica 会产生一种以前未被发现的鹅膏毒素，该团队将其称为 α-鹅膏毒原。

paras.en: The small mushroom also had blue bruises, a clue that it might make psilocybin, a psychedelic chemical being tested as a treatment for mental health disorders. Fungi usually make either amatoxin or psilocybin. Not both. Galerina species 1 also makes psilocybin but doesn’t make amatoxin, and species 2 makes neither.
paras.zh: 这种小蘑菇也有蓝色的瘀伤，这表明它可能会产生裸盖菇素，一种迷幻化学物质，正在测试用于治疗精神健康障碍。真菌通常产生鹅膏毒素或裸盖菇素。两者都不是。 Galerina 物种 1 也产生裸盖菇素，但不产生鹅膏毒素，而物种 2 则两者都不产生。

paras.en: “This finding shows that there’s a lot more diversity in [fungal] chemistry and the ways that they’re combined than we had really thought about,” says Anne Pringle, a mycologist at the University of Wisconsin–Madison who was not involved in the work.
paras.zh: “这一发现表明，[真菌]化学及其组合方式的多样性比我们真正想象的要多得多，”威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的真菌学家安妮·普林格尔（Anne Pringle）说，她没有参与这项工作。

paras.en: Discovering these dual compounds in one mushroom was both exciting and required further analysis to confirm, Kunik says. “Surprising discoveries require great depth of evidence,” he says.
paras.zh: 库尼克说，在一种蘑菇中发现这些双重化合物既令人兴奋，又需要进一步分析来证实。 “令人惊讶的发现需要大量深入的证据，”他说。

paras.en: A complete workup of the mushroom’s DNA revealed genes for producing both types of chemicals. Ancestors of these dark magic mushrooms probably picked up those genes by swapping DNA with other species. Such DNA swapping, called horizontal gene transfer, is one way that organisms can quickly evolve new traits, like when bacteria exchange antibiotic resistance genes with unrelated species.
paras.zh: 对蘑菇 DNA 的完整分析揭示了产生这两种化学物质的基因。这些黑魔法蘑菇的祖先可能通过与其他物种交换 DNA 获得了这些基因。这种 DNA 交换被称为水平基因转移，是生物体快速进化出新性状的一种方式，就像细菌与不相关物种交换抗生素抗性基因一样。

paras.en: Ancestors of G. indica and its relatives probably acquired amatoxin genes early on. Those toxins are made by many of G. indica’s cousins, which indicates that amatoxins are probably heirlooms passed down from common ancestors. Ancestors of species 1 and species 2 seem to have dropped the amatoxin genes at some point since they no longer make the compounds.
paras.zh: G. indica 及其近亲的祖先很可能很早就获得了鹅膏毒素基因。这些毒素是由许多 G. indica 的表亲产生的，这表明鹅膏毒素可能是从共同祖先遗传下来的传家宝。物种 1 和物种 2 的祖先似乎在某个时候已经放弃了鹅膏毒素基因，因为它们不再制造这些化合物。

paras.en: The two psilocybin-producing species may have independently obtained the psychedelic genes in separate DNA swap meets, or a common ancestor may have picked up the genes and then passed them down to G. indica and species 1. There’s not enough known about the fungi’s family tree to sort out which scenario is correct.
paras.zh: 这两个产生裸盖菇素的物种可能在不同的 DNA 交换中独立获得了致幻基因，或者共同的祖先可能获得了这些基因，然后将它们传递给 G. indica 和物种 1。对真菌的家谱还没有足够的了解，无法确定哪种情况是正确的。

paras.en: And there’s another unsolved evolutionary mystery, Pringle says. “We still don’t know why mushrooms are poisonous.” Many scientists think it is for defending against predators, but hard evidence is lacking, she says.
paras.zh: 普林格尔说，还有另一个未解的进化之谜。 “我们仍然不知道为什么蘑菇有毒。”她说，许多科学家认为这是为了防御掠食者，但缺乏确凿的证据。

paras.en: “Can I eat it?” is often the first question people ask when finding a new mushroom, Pringle says. “I’m always so uncomfortable with that question and that conversation. And this paper confirms that, in fact, you should be uncomfortable.” After all, eating these dark magic mushrooms could send people tripping into the grave.
paras.zh: “我可以吃吗？”普林格尔说，这通常是人们在寻找新蘑菇时提出的第一个问题。 “我总是对这个问题和谈话感到不舒服。这篇论文证实，事实上，你应该感到不舒服。”毕竟，吃了这些黑魔法蘑菇可能会让人绊倒进坟墓。

articles.title: Stone Age children left fingerprints on ancient art projects
articles.author: Freda Kreier

paras.en: Children have been making art with help from grown-ups for millennia.
paras.zh: 几千年来，孩子们一直在成年人的帮助下进行艺术创作。

paras.en: Fragmented clay figurines dating as far back as 15,000 years ago, discovered in what is now Israel, preserve the fingerprints of both adults and young children. The finding suggests the grown-ups taught the kids how to shape and decorate clay, researchers report November 11 in PLOS One.
paras.zh: 在现在的以色列发现的泥人碎片可以追溯到 15,000 年前，保留了成人和幼儿的指纹。研究人员 11 月 11 日在 PLOS One 上报道称，这一发现表明大人教孩子们如何塑造和装饰粘土。

paras.en: Children’s contributions to prehistoric art and culture aren’t well understood. Concrete evidence of their involvement has been hard to find, says archaeologist Laurent Davin of the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 儿童对史前艺术和文化的贡献尚不清楚。耶路撒冷希伯来大学的考古学家劳伦特·达文说，很难找到他们参与其中的具体证据。

paras.en: In recent decades, researchers have found a handful of objects made by children — including 200,000-year-old rock art bearing child-sized handprints in Tibet and 30,000-year-old clay sculptures pockmarked with child-sized fingerprints in Czech Republic.
paras.zh: 近几十年来，研究人员发现了一些由儿童制作的物品，其中包括西藏有 20 万年历史、带有儿童大小手印的岩画，以及捷克共和国有 3 万年历史、有儿童大小手印的泥塑。

paras.en: Davin and colleagues hadn’t set out to find Stone Age children’s artwork. They were investigating whether the Natufian culture — a group of hunter-gatherers who formed some of the first permanent settlements in the Levant about 14,000 years ago — made clay art before the advent of agriculture in the region.
paras.zh: 达文和同事并没有打算寻找石器时代儿童的艺术品。他们正在调查纳图夫文化（大约 14,000 年前，一群狩猎采集者在黎凡特形成了第一个永久定居点）是否在该地区出现农业之前就制作了粘土艺术。

paras.en: The archaeologists came across the first set of fingerprints while sorting through 40 kilograms of clay collected at three Natufian sites, which range in age from 15,000 to 11,600 years old. Among tens of thousands of clay lumps, the team found some 150 fragments of sculptures, including 15 recognizable bird, gazelle and human figures. Around 60 of these pieces preserved fingerprints from where people had pinched or prodded the clay.
paras.zh: 考古学家在对三个纳图夫遗址收集的 40 公斤粘土进行分类时发现了第一组指纹，这些粘土的年龄从 15,000 岁到 11,600 岁不等。在数万块粘土块中，研究小组发现了约 150 件雕塑碎片，其中包括 15 件可辨认的鸟类、瞪羚和人物雕像。其中大约 60 件作品保存了人们捏或戳粘土时留下的指纹。

paras.en: The distances between the fingerprints’ ridges, which are influenced by age and sex, suggest that most of the figurines were made by women and children — some younger than 10. Only a few sets of fingerprints belonged to men. And the torso of one tiny human statue had both adult and child fingerprints, hinting that an elder and child had passed it back and forth. Davin suspects that the adult actively taught a child how to work the clay.
paras.zh: 指纹脊线之间的距离受年龄和性别的影响，表明大多数雕像是由妇女和儿童制作的——有些还不到 10 岁。只有几组指纹属于男性。一座小型人体雕像的躯干上同时有成人和儿童的指纹，这表明有一位老人和一个孩子来回走过它。达文怀疑成年人主动教孩子如何制作粘土。

paras.en: This evidence of intergenerational learning so far back in time is fascinating, says archaeologist Steven Dorland of Grand Valley State University in Allendale, Mich. It demonstrates how much researchers can learn from broadening their focus beyond adult males, he says. Dorland has used pottery to understand social learning in Indigenous societies of the Great Lakes region. He has even studied children’s fingerprints on some of those artifacts.
paras.zh: 密歇根州艾伦代尔市大谷州立大学的考古学家史蒂文·多兰说，这种迄今为止代际学习的证据令人着迷。他说，这表明研究人员可以通过将关注点扩大到成年男性之外来学到很多东西。多兰利用陶器来了解五大湖地区土著社会的社会学习。他甚至研究了其中一些文物上的儿童指纹。

paras.en: The purpose of the Natufian figurines is unclear. Most of the statues are less than 2 centimeters long and don’t display signs of intense use, the team found, suggesting they weren’t treated as precious heirlooms.
paras.zh: 纳图夫人雕像的用途尚不清楚。研究小组发现，大多数雕像长度不到 2 厘米，并且没有显示出频繁使用的迹象，这表明它们没有被视为珍贵的传家宝。

paras.en: Davin suspects the figurines may have represented stories, like how kids draw Disney characters today, he says. “Maybe the idea is that the role of children here is not necessarily to learn to make figurines, but more to learn the story behind them.”
paras.zh: 达文怀疑这些雕像可能代表了故事，就像今天孩子们如何画迪士尼人物一样，他说。 “也许这个想法是，孩子们在这里的角色不一定是学习制作雕像，更多的是了解它们背​​后的故事。”

articles.title: Study Rewrites The Rules of The Blood-Brain Barrier, Including Proteins That May Be Involved in Alzheimer's
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: The blood-brain barrier is a powerful thing.
paras.zh: 血脑屏障是一个强大的东西。

paras.en: It maintains a strict 'guest list' of who's allowed in and who is banned from entering our most delicate organ.
paras.zh: 它保留了一份严格的“客人名单”，列出了哪些人可以进入，哪些人被禁止进入我们最脆弱的器官。

paras.en: But a new study, published in the journal Cell today, suggests the blood-brain barrier may be doing far more for our brains than we realized.
paras.zh: 但今天发表在《细胞》杂志上的一项新研究表明，血脑屏障对我们大脑的作用可能比我们想象的要大得多。

paras.en: The results could one day help scientists find new ways to treat Alzheimer's disease.
paras.zh: 研究结果有一天可能会帮助科学家找到治疗阿尔茨海默病的新方法。

paras.en: "For a century, we've treated the blood-brain barrier as a simple physical boundary protecting the brain from toxins," says the study's senior author, bioengineer Andrew Yang, of the Gladstone Institute in San Francisco.
paras.zh: “一个世纪以来，我们一直将血脑屏障视为保护大脑免受毒素侵害的简单物理边界，”该研究的资深作者、旧金山格拉德斯通研究所的生物工程师安德鲁·杨（Andrew Yang）说。

paras.en: "We're finding that it's an intelligent interface that plucks the right proteins in the blood, often from distant parts of the body, and delivers them to the right cell types in the brain. Brain health depends on this sophisticated molecular supply line from the body."
paras.zh: “我们发现它是一个智能界面，可以从血液中提取正确的蛋白质（通常是从身体的远处），并将它们输送到大脑中正确的细胞类型。大脑健康取决于来自身体的这种复杂的分子供应线。”

paras.en: The paper includes an atlas of the 92 different proteins that were transported across the BBB in the brains of mice, out of a total of 861 proteins tracked by the researchers.
paras.zh: 该论文包含了研究人员追踪的 861 种蛋白质中的 92 种不同蛋白质的图谱，这些蛋白质在小鼠大脑中通过 BBB 运输。

paras.en: Once certain proteins entered the brain, they were sent to specific types of brain cells, where they appear to be involved in some pretty important processes.
paras.zh: 一旦某些蛋白质进入大脑，它们就会被发送到特定类型的脑细胞，在那里它们似乎参与了一些非常重要的过程。

paras.en: "We think of blood proteins as messengers carrying signals from distant body parts, and the cells of the blood-brain barrier import only the ones the brain really needs," says Haoyue Zhou, a neuroscientist in Yang's lab at Gladstone.
paras.zh: “我们认为血液蛋白是携带来自远处身体部位的信号的信使，血脑屏障的细胞只输入大脑真正需要的信号，”格拉德斯通杨实验室的神经科学家周浩月说。

paras.en: "But that's just the beginning of the story."
paras.zh: “但这只是故事的开始。”

paras.en: The blood-brain barrier is a known casualty of Alzheimer's disease, physically breaking down as symptoms progress.
paras.zh: 血脑屏障是阿尔茨海默病的已知受害者，随着症状的进展，血脑屏障会逐渐崩溃。

paras.en: Could the BBB's little-understood role in delivering proteins to brain cells have something to do with Alzheimer's?
paras.zh: 血脑屏障在向脑细胞输送蛋白质方面的鲜为人知的作用是否与阿尔茨海默病有关？

paras.en: A protein that originates in the liver, APOA1, was directed towards astrocytes, star-shaped cells that perform multiple important functions in the brain. The arrival of APOA1 to the astrocytes activates a pathway involved in maintaining healthy neural connections.
paras.zh: APOA1 是一种源自肝脏的蛋白质，针对星形胶质细胞（在大脑中执行多种重要功能的星形细胞）。 APOA1 到达星形胶质细胞会激活一条涉及维持健康神经连接的通路。

paras.en: Earlier research suggests that Alzheimer's disease risk goes up when that pathway fails.
paras.zh: 早期研究表明，当该通路失效时，阿尔茨海默病的风险就会上升。

paras.en: Another protein from the liver, Alpha-1 antitrypsin, travels to the microglia, which are the brain's primary immune cells. In healthy mice, the microglia that took up more of this protein tended to express more genes that are associated with neurodegeneration.
paras.zh: 另一种来自肝脏的蛋白质 Alpha-1 抗胰蛋白酶会进入小胶质细胞，这是大脑的主要免疫细胞。在健康小鼠中，摄取更多这种蛋白质的小胶质细胞往往会表达更多与神经退行性变相关的基因。

paras.en: "Before the barrier starts leaking harmful proteins into the brain, it stops letting the beneficial ones through," Zhou says.
paras.zh: “在屏障开始将有害蛋白质泄漏到大脑之前，它会停止让有益蛋白质通过，”周说。

paras.en: "The brain's supply line from the body starts to fail."
paras.zh: “大脑与身体的供应线开始出现故障。”

paras.en: They looked at how the proteins facilitated by the blood-brain barrier differed in mice that had been genetically modified to model Alzheimer's-like symptoms (especially amyloid plaques), compared to healthy mice.
paras.zh: 他们研究了与健康小鼠相比，经过基因改造以模拟阿尔茨海默病样症状（尤其是淀粉样斑块）的小鼠中，血脑屏障促进的蛋白质有何不同。

paras.en: In the Alzheimer's model mice, APOA1 levels in the brain were reduced; Alpha-1 antitrypsin uptake increased.
paras.zh: 在阿尔茨海默病模型小鼠中，大脑中的 APOA1 水平降低； Alpha-1 抗胰蛋白酶摄取增加。

paras.en: Some mice were then given a liver-targeted gene therapy to increase the amount of APOA1 their livers produced.
paras.zh: 然后对一些小鼠进行肝脏靶向基因治疗，以增加肝脏产生的 APOA1 量。

paras.en: This modification meant APOA1 levels in the brain improved. And despite their genetic fate, the mice showed fewer signs of Alzheimer's disease.
paras.zh: 这种改变意味着大脑中的 APOA1 水平得到改善。尽管它们的基因命运不同，但这些小鼠表现出的阿尔茨海默病迹象较少。

paras.en: "Alzheimer's disease may not start entirely inside the brain; It may start when the brain's supply line from the body is severed," Yang says.
paras.zh: “阿尔茨海默病可能并不完全始于大脑内部；它可能在大脑与身体的供应线被切断时开始，”杨说。

paras.en: "If that's right, we may be able to fight this disease from outside the brain, by restoring what the brain has lost."
paras.zh: “如果这是正确的，我们也许能够通过恢复大脑失去的东西，从大脑外部对抗这种疾病。”

paras.en: It's important to remember that since this research was conducted in mice, the same may not necessarily go for humans.
paras.zh: 重要的是要记住，由于这项研究是在小鼠身上进行的，因此不一定适用于人类。

paras.en: We share a lot of evolutionary history with mice, so there are plenty of similarities in how our bodies work. But there are also many crucial differences.
paras.zh: 我们与老鼠有很多共同的进化历史，因此我们的身体运作方式有很多相似之处。但也存在许多关键的差异。

paras.en: "Generalizability to other neurological disorders and to humans remains to be established, and species differences in BBB receptor expression, plasma composition, and barrier properties may further limit extrapolation," the researchers note.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出：“对于其他神经系统疾病和人类的普遍适用性仍有待确定，BBB 受体表达、血浆成分和屏障特性的物种差异可能会进一步限制外推。”

paras.en: Plus, the mouse Alzheimer's model is just that – a model. Many results based on these models have not translated well to human patients.
paras.zh: 另外，小鼠阿尔茨海默病模型只是一个模型。基于这些模型的许多结果并没有很好地转化为人类患者。

paras.en: And because the model inherently relies on genetic drivers of the plaques associated with Alzheimer's, it could be missing other factors involved in the disease's development.
paras.zh: 而且由于该模型本质上依赖于与阿尔茨海默氏症相关的斑块的遗传驱动因素，因此它可能会忽略与该疾病发展有关的其他因素。

paras.en: Far more research is needed before we will know for sure whether these findings could actually translate into human treatments for Alzheimer's and other brain-related diseases, but Yang is optimistic.
paras.zh: 在我们确定这些发现是否可以真正转化为阿尔茨海默氏症和其他大脑相关疾病的人类治疗方法之前，还需要进行更多的研究，但杨很乐观。

paras.en: "We now have a map of the proteins the brain needs from the body and the transport system that delivers them," he says.
paras.zh: “我们现在有了一张大脑需要的蛋白质图谱，以及输送这些蛋白质的运输系统，”他说。

paras.en: "We are excited to translate this blueprint into new therapies for Alzheimer's that work from the outside-in, and into next-generation blood-brain barrier shuttles to deliver powerful medicines into the brain."
paras.zh: “我们很高兴能够将这一蓝图转化为从外到内发挥作用的阿尔茨海默病新疗法，并转化为下一代血脑屏障穿梭机，将强效药物输送到大脑中。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Cell.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《细胞》杂志上。

articles.title: Scientists Measure Gravitational Pull Between The Smallest Objects Yet in Quest For Quantum Gravity
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: We're used to thinking of gravity in the context of large masses – the whirl of planets, the inexorable pull of a black hole.
paras.zh: 我们习惯于在大质量的背景下思考引力——行星的旋转、黑洞不可阻挡的引力。

paras.en: But everything with mass, no matter how small, exerts a gravitational pull on everything else.
paras.zh: 但任何有质量的物体，无论多小，都会对其他物体施加引力。

paras.en: There is, however, an expected frontier where the classical dynamics described so elegantly by general relativity must somehow reconcile with the beautiful chaos of quantum mechanics.
paras.zh: 然而，存在一个预期的前沿，广义相对论如此优雅地描述的经典动力学必须以某种方式与量子力学的美丽混沌相协调。

paras.en: How do we find this frontier? By attempting to measure gravitational interactions on smaller and smaller scales, always refining the techniques so that one day, hopefully, we can glimpse what lies therein.
paras.zh: 我们如何找到这个边界？通过尝试在越来越小的尺度上测量引力相互作用，不断完善技术，希望有一天我们能够一睹其中的奥秘。

paras.en: And now, physicists led by Shan-Qing Yang of Sun Yat-sen University in China have announced a new milestone – a measurement of the gravitational attraction between the smallest pair of masses yet, two silicon wafers each weighing a mere 7.6 milligrams.
paras.zh: 现在，以中国中山大学杨善庆为首的物理学家宣布了一个新的里程碑——测量迄今为止最小的一对质量（每块重量仅为 7.6 毫克的硅片）之间的引力。

paras.en: It is, they write in a paper published in Nature Communications, "a significant step toward bridging the classical and quantum regimes of gravitation."
paras.zh: 他们在《自然通讯》上发表的一篇论文中写道，这是“弥合经典引力体系和量子引力体系的重要一步”。

paras.en: General relativity and quantum theory are two different ways of mathematically describing the behavior of the Universe on different scales.
paras.zh: 广义相对论和量子理论是在不同尺度上数学描述宇宙行为的两种不同方式。

paras.en: Relativity describes gravity as the curvature of a continuous fabric of spacetime, while quantum mechanics describes the behavior of matter and energy using the mathematics of probability.
paras.zh: 相对论将引力描述为连续时空结构的曲率，而量子力学则使用概率数学描述物质和能量的行为。

paras.en: Both theories are marvelously successful in their respective realms, but their mathematical frameworks don't fit neatly together, leaving physicists without a complete description of how gravity behaves when quantum effects come into play.
paras.zh: 这两种理论在各自的领域都取得了巨大的成功，但它们的数学框架并不完全吻合，导致物理学家无法完整地描述量子效应发挥作用时引力的行为方式。

paras.en: To find a door into this regime, physicists in recent years have turned to an experiment made famous by 18th-century English scientist Henry Cavendish, which could isolate the gravitational attraction between relatively small masses from Earth's overwhelming pull.
paras.zh: 为了找到进入这种状态的一扇门，物理学家近年来转向了 18 世纪英国科学家亨利·卡文迪什 (Henry Cavendish) 著名的一项实验，该实验可以将相对较小质量之间的引力与地球压倒性的引力隔离开来。

paras.en: The Cavendish experiment consisted of a torsion balance, with lead weights attached at each end of a horizontally suspended rod, and larger lead weights positioned nearby.
paras.zh: 卡文迪什实验包括一个扭力天平，水平悬挂杆的每一端都附有铅重，附近还有较大的铅重。

paras.en: The attraction between the nearby weights and those on the rod caused the rod to rotate, twisting the wire on which it was suspended, allowing Cavendish to measure the gravitational attraction based on how much the wire twisted.
paras.zh: 附近的重物与杆上的重物之间的吸引力导致杆旋转，扭曲悬挂它的金属丝，使卡文迪什能够根据金属丝扭曲的程度来测量万有引力。

paras.en: In 2021, a team of physicists described what was at the time the lightest demonstration of Cavendish yet – a measurement of the gravitational attraction between two tiny gold spheres, each weighing around 92 milligrams.
paras.zh: 2021 年，一组物理学家描述了当时最轻的卡文迪什演示——测量两个微小金球之间的引力，每个金球重约 92 毫克。

paras.en: And, in their paper, they laid down a challenge to push the envelope even further.
paras.zh: 而且，他们在论文中提出了进一步挑战极限的挑战。

paras.en: Yang and his colleagues apparently accepted.
paras.zh: 杨和他的同事显然接受了。

paras.en: Their version of the Cavendish experiment came with some special flair.
paras.zh: 他们的卡文迪什实验版本具有一些特殊的天赋。

paras.en: Using a technique called deep silicon etching, the researchers fashioned a miniature torsion balance, with a tiny silicon wafer weighing just 7.6 milligrams at one end of a suspended rod, and a counterweight at the other.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用一种称为深硅蚀刻的技术制作了一个微型扭力天平，在悬挂杆的一端装有一块仅重 7.6 毫克的微型硅片，另一端装有配重。

paras.en: But rather than placing a single mass nearby to exert a gravitational pull, the team built a rotating wheel, with 16 identical silicon wafers arranged around its circumference.
paras.zh: 但该团队并没有在附近放置一个质量来施加引力，而是建造了一个旋转轮，并在其圆周上排列了 16 个相同的硅片。

paras.en: As the wheel turned, each wafer passed close to the test mass in succession, exerting a tiny gravitational tug.
paras.zh: 当轮子转动时，每个晶片相继经过靠近测试质量的地方，施加微小的引力。

paras.en: The wheel completed a rotation every 10 minutes, meaning the gravitational tug repeated 16 times per rotation – a clear repeating signal that the researchers could distinguish from the background noise.
paras.zh: 轮子每 10 分钟旋转一圈，这意味着每旋转一圈，引力拖拽就会重复 16 次——这是一个清晰的重复信号，研究人员可以将其与背景噪音区分开来。

paras.en: The entire apparatus was enclosed in a vacuum chamber, with a thin, gold-coated silicon membrane separating the rotating masses from the torsion balance to minimize interference from electrostatic forces.
paras.zh: 整个装置被封闭在真空室中，用一层薄薄的镀金硅膜将旋转质量与扭力平衡分开，以尽量减少静电力的干扰。

paras.en: And rather than allowing the balance to twist freely, the researchers used an electronic feedback system to hold it almost perfectly still, measuring the force required to counteract the gravitational attraction.
paras.zh: 研究人员并没有让天平自由扭转，而是使用电子反馈系统使其几乎完全静止，测量抵消万有引力所需的力。

paras.en: When they looked at the torque on the torsion balance, they found a gravitational attraction consistent with Newton's predictions – including a minute tug calculated at just 471 attonewtons, or 0.000000000000000471 newtons, at the closest separation.
paras.zh: 当他们观察扭力天平上的扭矩时，他们发现了与牛顿预测一致的万有引力，包括在最接近的距离下计算出的一分钟拉力仅为 471 阿托牛顿，即 0.000000000000000471 牛顿。

paras.en: For context, that's around 20 billion times weaker than the gravitational force holding a single 1-milligram grain of sand to Earth's surface.
paras.zh: 就上下文而言，这比将 1 毫克沙粒固定在地球表面的引力弱约 200 亿倍。

paras.en: The researchers found that, even at these almost astronomically tiny scales, Newton's universal law of gravitation still holds firm.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，即使在这些几乎是天文数字的微小尺度上，牛顿万有引力定律仍然成立。

paras.en: From their measurements, they were even able to calculate the gravitational constant (G), deriving a value consistent with the internationally recommended value, with an uncertainty of 5.3 percent.
paras.zh: 通过测量，他们甚至能够计算出引力常数 (G)，得出的值与国际推荐值一致，不确定度为 5.3%。

paras.en: This, to be clear, is still nowhere close to quantum gravity. But it's a significant step closer than we were.
paras.zh: 需要明确的是，这与量子引力还相去甚远。但这比我们之前迈出了重要的一步。

paras.en: To get even closer still, physicists are developing a range of techniques to measure gravity at ever smaller scales, from torsion balances like Yang's to systems that suspend tiny objects using light or magnetic fields.
paras.zh: 为了更接近这一目标，物理学家正在开发一系列技术来测量更小尺度的重力，从杨氏的扭力天平到利用光或磁场悬浮微小物体的系统。

paras.en: Each approach comes with its own challenges, particularly the need to eliminate interference and preserve the delicate quantum states of the objects being studied.
paras.zh: 每种方法都有其自身的挑战，特别是需要消除干扰并保留所研究物体的微妙量子态。

paras.en: Eventually, the goal is to measure gravity between objects whose behavior is governed by quantum mechanics, to see whether gravity itself has quantum properties.
paras.zh: 最终的目标是测量行为受量子力学控制的物体之间的引力，看看引力本身是否具有量子特性。

paras.en: Together, these different approaches offer hope that such a measurement may be within reach.
paras.zh: 这些不同的方法共同带来了这样的测量可能实现的希望。

paras.en: "The continued advancement of these approaches, each operating across different but increasingly overlapping mass regimes, holds promise that gravitational interactions between quantum-state objects may be observed in the foreseeable future," Yang and his colleagues write.
