articles.title: Curiosity Blog, Sols 5050-5055: It’s Nazca, Our 49th Drill Hole

paras.en: Written by Susanne P. Schwenzer, Professor of Planetary Mineralogy at The Open University, UK
paras.zh: 作者：Susanne P. Schwenzer，英国开放大学行星矿物学教授

paras.en: Earth planning date: Friday, Oct. 23, 2026
paras.zh: 地球规划日期：2026 年 10 月 23 日星期五

paras.en: As regular readers of this blog will know, we returned to the area where we found disc shaped inclusions in the rocks, which we interpreted as potential crystals. If they are indeed crystals, and we compare them to Earth, they could be very interesting indicators of the environmental conditions. Hence, the excitement in the team is high that we found a good block to drill. Good means first and foremost that it contains abundant potential crystals, but of course there is more before we drill. We passed the rover’s stability test, as all wheels have to be on solid ground before we extend the arm. Then we passed the preload test, which tests the stability of the rock and the forces the arm experiences when the drill bit presses into the rock.
paras.zh: 正如本博客的普通读者所知，我们回到了在岩石中发现盘状包裹体的区域，我们将其解释为潜在的晶体。如果它们确实是晶体，并且我们将它们与地球进行比较，它们可能是环境条件的非常有趣的指标。因此，当我们找到一个好的钻探区块时，团队的兴奋程度很高。好的首先意味着它含有丰富的潜在晶体，但当然在我们钻探之前还有更多。我们通过了流动站的稳定性测试，因为在我们伸出手臂之前，所有轮子都必须放在坚实的地面上。然后我们通过了预载测试，该测试测试岩石的稳定性以及钻头压入岩石时手臂所受到的力。

paras.en: With all those tests passed, we successfully drilled our 49th drill hole, called “Nazca.”
paras.zh: 通过所有这些测试后，我们成功钻出了第 49 个钻孔，称为“纳斯卡”。

paras.en: The drill campaign comes with many investigations before and after the drilling itself. Before the drill, we investigated the block with APXS, MAHLI and ChemCam – all on the target Nazca. After drilling, the sample was dropped off to CheMin, with the results still making their way from Mars to Earth. They are eagerly anticipated to reach us over the coming weekend. ChemCam obtained both passive spectral and active LIBS of the tailings and a LIBS measurement down the drill hole wall.
paras.zh: 钻探活动在钻探前后进行了许多调查。在演习之前，我们使用 APXS、MAHLI 和 ChemCam 对该区块进行了调查——所有这些都位于目标纳斯卡。钻探结束后，样本被送往 CheMin，结果仍在从火星到地球的途中。热切期待他们在下周末与我们联系。 ChemCam 获得了尾矿的被动光谱和主动 LIBS 以及沿钻孔壁的 LIBS 测量结果。

paras.en: Other ChemCam activities this week included a LIBS investigation of “Palpala,” which is a dark pebble. We are on the lookout for those pebbles for a while and find that not all of them have the same composition. To make sure we understand their origin, we are measuring them when there are some in reach that are big enough. If a pebble is too small, it can move when it is being hit by the laser. Hence, we need to look out for some that are big enough.
paras.zh: 本周 ChemCam 的其他活动包括对“Papala”（一种黑色卵石）进行 LIBS 调查。我们一段时间以来一直在寻找这些鹅卵石，发现并非所有鹅卵石都具有相同的成分。为了确保我们了解它们的起源，当有一些足够大的范围时，我们就会对它们进行测量。如果卵石太小，它在被激光击中时就会移动。因此，我们需要留意一些足够大的。

paras.en: Another such pebble was the target “Puna” identified in Friday’s planning. ChemCam LIBS on the target “Llama” is to get another depth profile to check whether our observations in the first such depth profile are consistently observed or whether they vary between locations.
paras.zh: 另一个这样的卵石是周五计划中确定的目标“普纳”。对目标“Llama”进行 ChemCam LIBS 的目的是获得另一个深度剖面，以检查我们在第一个深度剖面中的观察结果是否一致，或者它们在不同位置之间是否有所不同。

paras.en: The target “Pacaya” is another measurement of the disc shaped forms that drew us back to this region. In addition to the LIBS measurements, ChemCam has several long distance RMIs in the plan. They are all focused on the two buttes that have drawn a long-standing interest of the team for the various sedimentary structures and textures they reveal: Mishe Mokwa and Cordillera.
paras.zh: 目标“帕卡亚”是圆盘形状的另一种测量，它把我们带回了这个地区。除了 LIBS 测量之外，ChemCam 计划中还有几个长距离 RMI。他们都专注于两个孤峰，这两个孤峰长期以来因其揭示的各种沉积结构和纹理而引起了团队的兴趣：Mishe Mokwa 和 Cordillera。

articles.title: Egypt: Fact-checking site’s entire newsroom jailed as assault on press freedom widens

paras.en: Egypt: Fact-checking site’s entire newsroom jailed as assault on press freedom widens
paras.zh: 埃及：事实核查网站的整个新闻编辑室因对新闻自由的侵犯扩大而被监禁

paras.en: Six journalists who make up the entire newsroom of the Egyptian fact-checking website Matsadash remain in detention, the UN human rights office (OHCHR) said on Tuesday, warning of proliferating assaults on press freedom by the Government.
paras.zh: 联合国人权高专办周二表示，埃及事实核查网站 Matsadash 整个新闻编辑室的六名记者仍被拘留，并警告政府对新闻自由的攻击不断增加。

paras.en: “We are witnessing widening assaults on press freedom by Egyptian authorities, including the targeting, persecution and harassment of independent journalists,” the human rights chief’s spokesperson Thameen Al-Kheetan told journalists in Geneva.
paras.zh: 人权事务负责人发言人塔梅恩·赫坦 (Thameen Al-Kheetan) 在日内瓦对记者表示：“我们目睹埃及当局对新闻自由的攻击范围不断扩大，包括针对、迫害和骚扰独立记者。”

paras.en: “These alarming developments must end immediately, and journalists must be able to carry out their essential work free from intimidation and reprisals.”
paras.zh: “这些令人震惊的事态发展必须立即结束，记者必须能够在不受恐吓和报复的情况下开展其重要工作。”

paras.en: The detained reporters are Mohamed Ashraf Abu Emeira, Abdallah Qadry, Islam Barakat, Omar Helal, Mohamed Mahmoud and Mohamed Adel. According to their lawyers, they were tortured and otherwise ill-treated and forced to record fabricated confessions.
paras.zh: 被拘留的记者包括穆罕默德·阿什拉夫·阿布·埃梅拉、阿卜杜拉·卡德里、伊斯兰·巴拉卡特、奥马尔·希拉勒、穆罕默德·马哈茂德和穆罕默德·阿德尔。据他们的律师称，他们受到酷刑和其他虐待，并被迫录制捏造的供词。

paras.en: Lina Attalah, chief editor of the independent online news outlet Mada Masr, also faces continuing judicial harassment linked to her journalistic work, the OHCHR spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 人权高专办发言人表示，独立在线新闻媒体 Mada Masr 的主编莉娜·阿塔拉 (Lina Attalah) 也面临着与其新闻工作相关的持续司法骚扰。

paras.en: Last month, an Egyptian court convicted her of operating an unlicensed website. She was detained, then released after paying a fine, and the court ordered the website closed.
paras.zh: 上个月，埃及一家法院判定她经营未经许可的网站罪名成立。她被拘留，缴纳罚款后被释放，法院下令关闭该网站。

paras.en: This week, she faces another hearing in a separate case dating back to 2024 – raising fresh concerns over legal due process and the right to a fair trial, including obstacles to appeal.
paras.zh: 本周，她将面临另一起可追溯到 2024 年的单独案件的听证会，这引发了人们对法律正当程序和公平审判权的新担忧，包括上诉障碍。

paras.en: OHCHR called on Egypt to end all forms of harassment of journalists and media outlets, and to respect and fulfil the right to freedom of expression, including the right to information.
paras.zh: 人权高专办呼吁埃及停止对记者和媒体的一切形式骚扰，尊重和实现言论自由权，包括知情权。

paras.en: The authorities must release all the Matsadash reporters and drop charges arising from their legitimate journalistic work, the UN rights office said. Until then, they must have confidential access to lawyers, contact with their families, necessary healthcare and medication, and humane conditions of detention.
paras.zh: 联合国人权办公室表示，当局必须释放所有马萨达什记者，并撤销对他们合法新闻工作的指控。在此之前，他们必须能够秘密接触律师、与家人联系、获得必要的医疗保健和药物以及人道的拘留条件。

paras.en: “All allegations of torture, ill-treatment or forced confessions must be promptly investigated, and those responsible held to account,” Mr. Al-Kheetan said.
paras.zh: “所有有关酷刑、虐待或逼供的指控都必须立即调查，并追究责任人的责任，”阿尔赫坦先生说。

paras.en: The office also called for the measures taken to suppress the work of both Matsadash and Mada Masr to be overturned.
paras.zh: 该办公室还呼吁推翻为镇压马萨达什和马达马斯尔的工作而采取的措施。

paras.en: “The people of Egypt have a right to read and hear views expressed through these fora on issues of legitimate public concern.”
paras.zh: “埃及人民有权阅读和听到通过这些论坛就公众合法关心的问题表达的观点。”

paras.en: Alessandra Vellucci, Director of the UN Information Service in Geneva, recalled the Secretary-General’s message on the International Day to End Impunity for Crimes against Journalists on 2 November.
paras.zh: 联合国日内瓦新闻处主任亚历山德拉·韦鲁奇 (Alessandra Vellucci) 回顾了秘书长在 11 月 2 日结束针对记者犯罪不受惩罚现象国际日发表的讲话。

articles.title: ‘Make or bake time’: Guterres urges climate justice pact as leaders gather at COP31

paras.en: ‘Make or bake time’: Guterres urges climate justice pact as leaders gather at COP31
paras.zh: “制造或烘焙时间”：古特雷斯在各国领导人齐聚 COP31 时敦促达成气候正义协议

paras.en: UN chief António Guterres called for a new global climate justice agreement at COP31 on Wednesday, urging governments to tax fossil fuel companies to help countries bearing the brunt of a crisis they did little to cause. His appeal came as world leaders gathered in Antalya amid unresolved questions over climate finance and the future of fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯周三呼吁在第 31 次缔约方会议上达成一项新的全球气候正义协议，敦促各国政府对化石燃料公司征税，以帮助那些遭受危机冲击的国家，而这些危机却是由它们造成的。他发出呼吁之际，世界领导人齐聚安塔利亚，气候融资和化石燃料的未来等问题尚未解决。

paras.en: - Leaders’ Summit: Guterres calls for climate justice and taxes on oil giants.
paras.zh: - 领导人峰会：古特雷斯呼吁实现气候正义和对石油巨头征税。

paras.en: - Negotiations: Disagreements persist over adaptation finance.
paras.zh: - 谈判：在适应资金方面仍存在分歧。

paras.en: - Zero Waste Day: Methane and innovative solutions headline the discussions.
paras.zh: - 零废物日：甲烷和创新解决方案成为讨论的焦点。

paras.en: Today saw packed corridors at the COP31 conference venue in Antalya as world leaders arrived for a two-day high-level Summit, bringing tighter security, road closures and an early start for delegates, some of whom reached the venue as early as 5 a.m.
paras.zh: 今天，安塔利亚 COP31 会议场地的走廊里挤满了人，世界各国领导人抵达参加为期两天的高级别峰会，安全措施更加严格，道路封闭，代表们提早出发，其中一些人早在凌晨 5 点就到达了会场。

paras.en: Those who arrived before dawn were rewarded with a spectacular sunrise. Later, at the opening ceremony, traditional Turkish dancing, colourful performances, videos and even a COP31 theme song gave the opening ceremony an unusually festive air for a gathering confronting one of the world’s most pressing crises.
paras.zh: 那些在黎明前到达的人将欣赏到壮观的日出。随后，在开幕式上，传统的土耳其舞蹈、丰富多彩的表演、视频，甚至还有一首 COP31 主题曲，为这场面对世界上最紧迫危机之一的聚会带来了不同寻常的节日气氛。

paras.en: But the day’s most memorable message came from the Secretary-General, who accused polluters of delaying action, and once again warned that the climate crisis is advancing faster than global efforts to contain it.
paras.zh: 但当天最令人难忘的信息来自秘书长，他指责污染者拖延行动，并再次警告说，气候危机的进展速度超过了全球遏制危机的努力。

paras.en: “Our planet is heating up. The clock is winding down. It’s make or bake time,” he said, reminding world leaders that even if current national plans are fully implemented, the planet is heading towards more than 2.5°C of warming by century’s end.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们的星球正在升温。时钟正在走完。现在是制作或烘烤的时间。”他提醒世界领导人，即使当前的国家计划得到全面实施，到本世纪末，地球的升温也将超过 2.5°C。

paras.en: But he insisted that breaching the 1.5°C threshold does not mean giving up. “Science is not telling us to surrender. It is telling us to fight harder” the UN chief said, stressing that every fraction of a degree of warming avoided matters.
paras.zh: 但他坚称，突破1.5℃门槛并不意味着放弃。联合国秘书长表示：“科学并不是告诉我们投降。它是告诉我们要更加努力地战斗。”他强调，每一度的变暖都可以避免产生影响。

paras.en: Against that backdrop, the Secretary-General proposed a ‘climate justice compact’ to help developing countries move away from fossil fuels while protecting those already suffering from climate change.
paras.zh: 在此背景下，秘书长提出了一项“气候正义契约”，以帮助发展中国家摆脱化石燃料，同时保护那些已经遭受气候变化之害的国家。

paras.en: “We cannot demand that countries transform their economies while denying them the means to do so,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们不能要求各国进行经济转型，同时又拒绝他们这样做的手段，”他说。

paras.en: The proposed compact rests on four priorities:
paras.zh: 拟议的契约基于四个优先事项：

paras.en: - Accelerate the transition away from fossil fuels through national plans that protect workers and communities, while expanding renewable energy.
paras.zh: - 通过保护工人和社区的国家计划加速摆脱化石燃料，同时扩大可再生能源。

paras.en: - Protect vulnerable populations with early-warning systems, stronger adaptation measures and faster support after climate disasters.
paras.zh: - 通过预警系统、更强有力的适应措施和气候灾害后更快的支持来保护弱势群体。

paras.en: - Deliver affordable climate finance, with wealthy countries fulfilling their commitments and more investment reaching developing nations.
paras.zh: - 提供负担得起的气候融资，富裕国家履行其承诺，并向发展中国家提供更多投资。

paras.en: - Strengthen international cooperation to overcome trade barriers, technological divides and geopolitical rivalries.
paras.zh: - 加强国际合作，克服贸易壁垒、技术鸿沟和地缘政治竞争。

paras.en: The UN chief took aim at fossil fuel interests, accusing them of distorting science and delaying climate action.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长将矛头指向化石燃料利益集团，指责他们歪曲科学并拖延气候行动。

paras.en: “Fossil fuels must go the way of the dinosaurs,” he declared. “The dinosaurs did not have a lobby. Fossil fuels do.”
paras.zh: “化石燃料必须走恐龙的道路，”他宣称。 “恐龙没有大厅。化石燃料有。”

paras.en: He contrasted the $95 billion earned by the world’s nine largest oil companies in one quarter with the roughly $600 million received by the international fund helping vulnerable countries recover from climate-related loss and damage.
paras.zh: 他将全球九大石油公司一季度赚取的 950 亿美元与帮助脆弱国家从气候相关损失和损害中恢复过来的国际基金收到的约 6 亿美元进行了对比。

paras.en: That was equivalent to just 14 hours of those companies’ profits, he said, urging governments to tax windfall profits.
paras.zh: 他表示，这仅相当于这些公司 14 小时的利润，并敦促政府对暴利征税。

paras.en: “Polluters must pay”, a line that earned him an ovation in the plenary.
paras.zh: “污染者必须付出代价”这句话让他在全体会议上赢得了阵阵掌声。

paras.en: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, whose country is co-hosting COP31 in Antalya with Australia, acknowledged that three decades of climate negotiations had failed to deliver sufficient results.
paras.zh: 土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安正在与澳大利亚在安塔利亚共同主办第三十一届缔约方会议，他承认三十年的气候谈判未能取得足够的成果。

paras.en: “This success at the level of ideas has not produced the same results when it comes to implementation,” he said, calling for greater support for developing countries.
paras.zh: 他说：“理念层面的成功在实施方面并未产生同样的结果。”他呼吁为发展中国家提供更多支持。

paras.en: Brazilian President Lula da Silva, meanwhile, warned that climate change was losing ground on the international agenda as wars and trade disputes overshadowed the fight against global warming.
paras.zh: 与此同时，巴西总统卢拉·达席尔瓦警告说，由于战争和贸易争端掩盖了应对全球变暖的斗争，气候变化在国际议程上正在失去地位。

paras.en: “We started talking more about weapons and tariffs than the survival of future generations,” he said, defending international cooperation at a time when climate science and multilateralism are increasingly under attack.
paras.zh: “我们开始更多地谈论武器和关税，而不是子孙后代的生存，”他说，在气候科学和多边主义日益受到攻击之际捍卫国际合作。

paras.en: Mr. Lula also announced that Brazil would develop national roadmaps to reduce its dependence on fossil fuels and end deforestation, building on the work of last year's COP30, which was held in the Amazon.
paras.zh: 卢拉先生还宣布，巴西将在去年在亚马逊举行的 COP30 会议的基础上制定国家路线图，以减少对化石燃料的依赖并结束森林砍伐。

paras.en: Tackling methane: The ‘climate emergency brake’
paras.zh: 解决甲烷问题：“气候紧急刹车”

paras.en: An invisible gas that traps more than 80 times as much heat as carbon dioxide over 20 years featured prominently during Wednesday's “Zero Waste” thematic day.
paras.zh: 一种看不见的气体在 20 年内捕获的热量是二氧化碳的 80 多倍，在周三的“零浪费”主题日中成为了重点。

paras.en: Methane, released by fossil fuel operations, agriculture and rotting waste, is responsible for nearly a third of global warming to date. At a special event, Mr. Guterres called on the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) to develop a global standard for near-zero methane emissions from oil and gas.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，全球变暖的近三分之一是由化石燃料生产、农业和腐烂废物释放的甲烷造成的。在一次特别活动中，古特雷斯先生呼吁联合国环境规划署（环境署）制定石油和天然气甲烷接近零排放的全球标准。

paras.en: UNEP is already tracking major leaks from space, using satellites and artificial intelligence to identify emissions and alert governments and companies.
paras.zh: 环境署已经在追踪太空中的重大泄漏，利用卫星和人工智能来识别排放并向政府和公司发出警报。

paras.en: Julia Ferini, who leads UNEP’s International Methane Emissions Observatory, told UN News that the system has helped reduce emissions in 45 cases across 13 countries.
paras.zh: 环境署国际甲烷排放观测站负责人朱莉娅·费里尼 (Julia Ferini) 告诉《联合国新闻》，该系统已帮助 13 个国家的 45 个案例减少了排放。

paras.en: She pointed to a recent case in Iraq, where a damaged gas pipeline had been leaking methane for two years, producing emissions equivalent to those of 350,000 cars. The leak was stopped by applying a coating to the corroded pipe.
paras.zh: 她提到了伊拉克最近的一个案例，受损的天然气管道两年来一直在泄漏甲烷，产生的排放量相当于 35 万辆汽车的排放量。通过在腐蚀的管道上涂敷涂层来阻止泄漏。

paras.en: “Methane is our climate emergency brake,” she said, explaining that cutting this short-lived gas could slow warming relatively quickly, buying time to reduce carbon dioxide emissions.
paras.zh: “甲烷是我们的气候紧急制动器，”她说，并解释说，减少这种短命气体可以相对较快地减缓变暖速度，为减少二氧化碳排放赢得时间。

paras.en: Yet despite more than 5,000 alerts issued since 2023, barely one in eight has received a response, the UN chief noted.
paras.zh: 然而，联合国秘书长指出，尽管自 2023 年以来发出了 5000 多次警报，但只有八分之一的人收到了回应。

paras.en: Worms turning waste into something useful
paras.zh: 蠕虫将废物变成有用的东西

paras.en: And while negotiators in Antalya wrestle with how to accelerate climate action, young entrepreneurs are already putting some of them into practice.
paras.zh: 当安塔利亚的谈判代表们苦苦思索如何加速气候行动时，年轻的企业家已经将其中的一些付诸实践。

paras.en: In Botswana, Makwena Moesi is tackling food waste with an unusual workforce: more than half a million worms.
paras.zh: 在博茨瓦纳，马克维纳·莫埃西 (Makwena Moesi) 正在利用一支不同寻常的劳动力来解决食物浪费问题：超过 50 万条蠕虫。

paras.en: Her company, Viva Organica, collects organic waste from food retailers and turns it into fertilizer through a process known as vermicomposting, improving soil health while keeping waste out of landfills.
paras.zh: 她的公司 Viva Organica 从食品零售商那里收集有机废物，并通过一种称为蚯蚓堆肥的过程将其转化为肥料，改善土壤健康，同时防止废物进入垃圾填埋场。

paras.en: The business has already processed more than 1,000 tonnes of organic waste.
paras.zh: 该企业已处理了 1,000 多吨有机废物。

paras.en: But Ms. Moesi, a biologist by training, says climate-friendly solutions must also make economic sense.
paras.zh: 但生物学家出身的莫埃西女士表示，气候友好型解决方案还必须具有经济意义。

paras.en: “A farmer does not wake up in the morning thinking about what am I gonna do to help sequester this amount of carbon dioxide from the air,” she told UN News.
paras.zh: “农民早上醒来时不会思考我要做什么来帮助隔离空气中这么多的二氧化碳，”她告诉联合国新闻。

paras.en: Instead, she said, farmers want to know how much food they can grow, how to improve their harvests and whether they can afford the products that could help them.
paras.zh: 相反，她说，农民想知道他们可以种植多少粮食，如何提高收成，以及他们是否能负担得起对他们有帮助的产品。

paras.en: Alongside the leaders’ speeches, negotiators continued grappling with key unresolved issues:
paras.zh: 除了领导人的讲话外，谈判代表还继续努力解决一些尚未解决的关键问题：

paras.en: - Climate finance: Developing countries pushed for more predictable funding, warning of shortfalls in support for adaptation and climate action.
paras.zh: - 气候融资：发展中国家推动提供更可预测的资金，并警告适应和气候行动的支持不足。

paras.en: - Loss and damage: Nepal’s request for assistance following a glacial collapse raised questions about how quickly emergency funding can reach affected countries.
paras.zh: - 损失和损害：尼泊尔在冰川崩塌后提出的援助请求引发了人们对紧急资金能够多快到达受影响国家的疑问。

paras.en: - Emissions cuts: Countries disagreed over how long the UN’s programme to accelerate emissions reductions should continue and how it should operate.
paras.zh: - 减排：各国对于联合国加速减排计划应持续多久以及如何运作存在分歧。

paras.en: - A just transition: Negotiators discussed a new mechanism to help countries shift to cleaner economies while protecting workers and communities.
paras.zh: - 公正的过渡：谈判人员讨论了一种新机制，以帮助各国转向更清洁的经济，同时保护工人和社区。

articles.title: Lebanon: After 48 years patrolling the Blue Line, UN peacekeepers prepare exit

paras.en: Lebanon: After 48 years patrolling the Blue Line, UN peacekeepers prepare exit
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩：在蓝线巡逻 48 年后，联合国维和人员准备撤离

paras.en: The situation in southern Lebanon remains volatile and extremely difficult for communities trying to rebuild their lives, UN peacekeepers based there report, despite a significant decrease in hostilities following an agreement in June between the United States, Lebanon and Israel.
paras.zh: 联合国维和人员报告说，黎巴嫩南部的局势仍然不稳定，对于试图重建生活的社区来说极其困难，尽管美国、黎巴嫩和以色列六月达成协议后敌对行动大幅减少。

paras.en: Speaking to UN News from Naqoura in southern Lebanon, Kandice Ardiel, spokesperson for the UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL), said that daily violations by Israeli forces continue to be observed across southern Lebanon.
paras.zh: 联合国驻黎巴嫩临时部队（联黎部队）发言人坎迪斯·阿尔迪尔在黎巴嫩南部纳古拉接受《联合国新闻》采访时表示，以色列军队在黎巴嫩南部各地每天都在发生侵犯行为。

paras.en: These include the construction of military positions and roads, military operations, demolitions, airstrikes and artillery fire.
paras.zh: 其中包括修建军事阵地和道路、军事行动、拆除、空袭和炮火。

paras.en: In addition, on Tuesday, UNIFIL reported that a routine patrol near Wadi Jilu was also fired upon. Peacekeepers returned fire and reported that the shooting stopped, with no injuries reported. The force has called for a prompt investigation from the Lebanese Government.
paras.zh: 此外，联黎部队周二报告称，瓦迪吉鲁附近的例行巡逻队也遭到枪击。维和人员还击，并报告枪击事件停止，没有人员伤亡的报告。该部队呼吁黎巴嫩政府立即展开调查。

paras.en: Latest UN data indicates that the number of internally displaced who’ve returned home has increased by 13 per cent since September, to nearly one million. Around 304,500 people remain displaced outside their areas of origin.
paras.zh: 联合国最新数据显示，自 9 月以来，返回家园的国内流离失所者人数增加了 13%，达到近百万。约 304,500 人仍然流离失所，远离原籍地区。

paras.en: “We’re seeing kids going back to school. We’re seeing farmers trying to harvest their crops, particularly olive crops. But they’re coming back to a really difficult situation,” Ms. Ardiel stressed.
paras.zh: “我们看到孩子们重返学校。我们看到农民试图收割庄稼，特别是橄榄作物。但他们又面临着非常困难的处境，”阿迪尔女士强调说。

paras.en: She noted that many villages have suffered extensive damage, making daily life extremely challenging for returning residents.
paras.zh: 她指出，许多村庄遭受了严重破坏，使返回居民的日常生活面临极大挑战。

paras.en: “A lot of the essential infrastructure, including electricity networks, water systems, and roads, has been destroyed and will need to be rebuilt,” she explained.
paras.zh: “许多重要的基础设施，包括电力网络、供水系统和道路，都已被摧毁，需要重建，”她解释道。

paras.en: UNIFIL was established by the UN Security Council on 19 March 1978 with three primary objectives: to confirm the withdrawal of Israeli forces from Lebanon, to restore international peace and security, and to assist the Lebanese Government in re-establishing its authority in the region.
paras.zh: 联黎部队于1978年3月19日由联合国安理会成立，其主要目标有三个：确认以色列军队从黎巴嫩撤军、恢复国际和平与安全以及协助黎巴嫩政府重建其在该地区的权威。

paras.en: The mission’s first peacekeepers arrived on 23 March 1978.
paras.zh: 该特派团的第一批维和人员于 1978 年 3 月 23 日抵达。

paras.en: In August 2025, the UN Security Council unanimously voted not to renew UNIFIL’s mandate beyond the end of 2026. As a result, preparations for the mission’s withdrawal are expected to begin in January 2027.
paras.zh: 2025年8月，联合国安理会一致投票决定不再将联黎部队的任务期限延长至2026年底之后。因此，联黎部队撤军的准备工作预计将于2027年1月开始。

paras.en: "There’s a lot of talk and speculation about what might come next. We know the Security Council is considering options, but so far nothing has been decided. So that’s led to a lot of uncertainty. And people are, of course, concerned," Ms. Ardiel said.
paras.zh: “对于接下来会发生什么，有很多讨论和猜测。我们知道安理会正在考虑各种选择，但到目前为止还没有做出任何决定。所以这导致了很多不确定性。人们当然很担心，”阿迪尔女士说。

paras.en: The withdrawal of UNIFIL will affect not only the mission’s personnel but also the communities of southern Lebanon, where the peacekeeping force has been an integral part of local life for decades. Beyond its security role, UNIFIL provides employment opportunities and contributes significantly to the local economy.
paras.zh: 联黎部队的撤出不仅会影响特派团人员，还会影响黎巴嫩南部社区，几十年来，维和部队一直是当地生活不可或缺的一部分。除了其安全职责外，联黎部队还提供就业机会并为当地经济做出重大贡献。

paras.en: For staff members, the transition is expected to be particularly difficult.
paras.zh: 对于工作人员来说，过渡预计会特别困难。

paras.en: “This is especially true for our national staff, who are Lebanese, many of whom have lost homes or family members because of the ongoing conflict," Ms. Ardiel said.
paras.zh: “对于我们的黎巴嫩籍国家工作人员来说尤其如此，他们中的许多人由于持续的冲突而失去了家园或家人，”阿迪尔女士说。

paras.en: Ms. Ardiel describes growing concern about what lies ahead.
paras.zh: 阿迪尔女士描述了人们对未来的担忧。

paras.en: “There’s a great deal of nervousness now that we’re leaving in a situation where southern Lebanon remains unstable because of ongoing military activity, the continuation of the conflict, and the uncertain future that people here are anticipating,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“由于持续的军事活动、冲突的持续以及这里的人们对未来的不确定性，黎巴嫩南部仍然不稳定，我们现在感到非常紧张。”

paras.en: She also emphasized the importance of maintaining an international presence in southern Lebanon. Impartial monitoring and international engagement have played a crucial role in the region over the years and will remain essential for Lebanon’s future stability, the UNIFIL spokesperson insisted.
paras.zh: 她还强调了在黎巴嫩南部维持国际存在的重要性。联黎部队发言人坚称，多年来，公正的监测和国际参与在该地区发挥了至关重要的作用，并且对于黎巴嫩未来的稳定仍然至关重要。

articles.title: Australia dredge up past blunders as England learn from theirs

paras.en: England learn from Ashes mistakes ahead of ODIs vs Australia side engulfed by Usman Khawaja 'Sandpapergate' claims
paras.zh: 英格兰队在 ODI 对阵澳大利亚队之前从灰烬中的错误中吸取教训

paras.en: England return to Perth for series-opening ODI against Australia, a year on from host of mistakes in the city setting the tone for dismal 4-1 Ashes thrashing; now it is Australia with the problems after Usman Khawaja's explosive claims about the 2018 ball-tampering scandal in South Africa
paras.zh: 英格兰队重返珀斯，参加系列赛揭幕战对阵澳大利亚队的 ODI 比赛，一年前，这座城市犯了很多错误，为灰烬杯 4-1 惨败奠定了基调；乌斯曼·卡瓦贾 (Usman Khawaja) 对 2018 年南非的球篡改丑闻发表爆炸性言论后，现在的问题是澳大利亚了

paras.en: As Australia dredge up the past, England seem determined to learn from theirs.
paras.zh: 当澳大利亚挖掘过去的历史时，英格兰似乎决心向他们学习。

paras.en: The build-up to this run of white-ball matches between the Ashes rivals, which starts with the first ODI in Perth on Friday, has been dominated by Usman Khawaja's claims in his autobiography about the 2018 Australia ball-tampering scandal in South Africa.
paras.zh: 灰烬杯对手之间的这轮白球比赛从周五在珀斯举行的第一场 ODI 开始，乌斯曼·卡瓦贾 (Usman Khawaja) 在自传中对 2018 年澳大利亚在南非发生的控球丑闻的指控占据主导地位。

paras.en: Khawaja says every member of the Baggy Greens team back then knew in advance about the plot to alter the condition of the ball in Cape Town and that sandpaper had even been used in the previous Test of that series against the Proteas, in Gqeberha.
paras.zh: Khawaja 表示，当时 Baggy Greens 队的每个成员都事先知道开普敦改变球状况的阴谋，甚至在 Gqeberha 对阵 Proteas 的系列赛之前的测试中也使用了砂纸。

paras.en: - England's Jacob Bethell out of white-ball games in Australia
paras.zh: - 英格兰球员雅各布·贝塞尔缺席澳大利亚的白球比赛

paras.en: - Listen to latest episode of the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast
paras.zh: - 收听天空体育板球播客的最新一集

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: Mitchell Starc, one of the Australia bowlers eight years ago and still going strong now, disputes, as he always has, that he was aware of the scheme. This who-knew-what-and-who-didn't affair could rumble on for a while. There may never be a resolution.
paras.zh: 米切尔·斯塔克（Mitchell Starc）是八年前的澳大利亚保龄球手之一，现在仍然很强大，他一如既往地否认自己知道这个计划。这场谁知道又谁不知道的事件可能会持续一段时间。可能永远不会有解决方案。

paras.en: England out to atone for last year's Ashes errors
paras.zh: 英格兰队要弥补去年灰烬杯的失误

paras.en: Watching this unfold, presumably with more than a hint of glee, are England, who have returned to the scene of their own cricketing crime last winter. Not ball-tampering, of course, but a complete lack of acceptable preparation for a series as big as The Ashes.
paras.zh: 英格兰队看着这一切的展开，想必带着一丝喜悦，他们去年冬天又回到了自己的板球犯罪现场。当然，这不是篡改球，而是对像《灰烬》这样的大型系列赛完全缺乏可接受的准备。

paras.en: Brendon McCullum was Test coach at that point - not now, having being sacked in July as the 4-1 Ashes debacle was followed by a 2-1 series defeat at home to his native New Zealand - and presided over a shabby lead-in to the first Test.
paras.zh: 布伦登·麦卡勒姆当时担任测试教练——不是现在，他在 7 月份因 1-4 灰烬杯惨败而被解雇，之后又在主场 1-2-1 输给了他的祖国新西兰——并主持了第一次测试的糟糕引导。

paras.en: The sole warm-up was an intra-squad fixture on a docile deck at Lilac Hill which in no way teed the team up for the bouncy nature of the Optus Stadium surface they came up against across Perth in the Ashes opener. The result? England went down in flames.
paras.zh: 唯一的热身是在丁香山的一个温顺的甲板上进行的一场队内比赛，这根本没有让球队为他们在灰烬揭幕战中面对珀斯对面的奥普都斯体育场的弹性表面做好准备。结果呢？英格兰陷入战火之中。

paras.en: A game they looked destined to win they ended up losing inside two days after a remarkable batting collapse induced by the unwise decision to continually drive on the up.
paras.zh: 这场看似注定要赢的比赛，由于持续进攻的不明智决定而导致击球率大幅下滑，但他们最终在两天内输掉了比赛。

paras.en: Even more unwise was not talking about dismissals driving on the up in between their defeat in Perth and the loss in the day-night game in Brisbane that followed.
paras.zh: 更不明智的是，在他们在珀斯的失利和随后在布里斯班的日夜比赛中失利之间，没有谈论解雇人数的增加。

paras.en: After a pink-ball pummelling at The Gabba, the series was almost beyond them. When they retuned from a beach break in Noosa, which some observers claim was drink-laden, and they then lost in Adelaide, the series was beyond them. Ashes over.
paras.zh: 在加巴球场（The Gabba）的一场粉红球重击之后，这个系列赛几乎超出了他们的范围。当他们从努萨的海滩度假回来时，一些观察家声称那里喝醉了，然后他们在阿德莱德输了，这个系列赛超出了他们的范围。灰烬已过。

paras.en: This, though, might be a new England - with the same guy as coach in Brendon McCullum and a white-ball captain in Harry Book eager to bounce back from the chastening trip a year ago.
paras.zh: 不过，这可能是一个新英格兰——布伦登·麦卡勒姆是同一个人担任教练，哈利·布克是白球队长，渴望从一年前的磨难之旅中恢复过来。

paras.en: Michael Atherton told the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast: "I think the Ashes was a bit of a wake-up call for players like Brook so he will come to this tour now a bit older and a bit wiser - and hopefully hurting to a degree where England are motivated to put on a show."
paras.zh: 迈克尔·阿瑟顿告诉天空体育板球播客：“我认为灰烬杯对像布鲁克这样的球员来说是一个警钟，所以他现在会年龄更大一些，也更聪明一些，并希望伤害到英格兰队有动力上演一场表演的程度。”

paras.en: Warm-up game shows change of approach from England
paras.zh: 热身赛显示英格兰队的做法发生了变化

paras.en: The laid-back McCullum was kept on as limited-overs head coach after losing the Test job and, bar a sticky tri-series in the subcontinent when they fluffed their lines with the ball in run chases versus Pakistan and Sri Lanka, things have been going swimmingly.
paras.zh: 悠闲的麦卡勒姆在失去测试工作后继续担任有限轮主教练，除了在次大陆的三连赛中，他们在与巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡的跑动追逐中弄乱了球线，一切进展顺利。

paras.en: Three straight bilateral 50-over series wins and also top spot in the T20 rankings, first after routing India 4-0 in July and then again by sweeping Sri Lanka 3-0 in September.
paras.zh: 双边系列赛连续三场超过 50 场的胜利，也在 T20 排名中名列前茅，首先是 7 月 4-0 击败印度，然后是 9 月 3-0 横扫斯里兰卡。

paras.en: England are, in the main, making shrewd calls on the field through Brook and shrewd calls off them, too, including the choice to play a proper warm-up ahead of the Australia ODIs - last Saturday's 92-run win over Western Australia at The WACA.
paras.zh: 英格兰队主要通过布鲁克在场上做出了精明的判罚，同时也做出了精明的判罚，包括选择在澳大利亚 ODI 比赛之前进行适当的热身——上周六在 WACA 上以 92 分战胜西澳大利亚队。

paras.en: That tune-up match is something that will be replicated ahead of the three-Test series in South Africa from December 17 as Joe Root's red-ball squad play a Cricket South Africa XI in Durban, while a practice game is also pencilled in when they return to Australia in March for the 150th anniversary Test in Melbourne.
paras.zh: 这场热身赛将于 12 月 17 日起在南非举行的三场测试系列赛之前进行，乔·鲁特的红球队将在德班与南非板球十一人队进行比赛，同时他们将于 3 月份返回澳大利亚参加在墨尔本举行的 150 周年纪念测试赛时也将进行一场练习赛。

paras.en: On how better prepared they are for Friday's outing at the Optus than they were last November, captain Brook said: "The conditions [at the WACA] always feel a lot closer than Lilac Hill. The bounce, the carry, the pace of the pitch - it's miles away from what Lilac Hill offered us. Thankfully we got the opportunity to play there.
paras.zh: 关于周五在 Optus 的比赛，他们比去年 11 月准备得更好，队长布鲁克说：“（WACA）的条件总是感觉比丁香山更近。球场的弹跳、运球和节奏 - 这与丁香山为我们提供的相去甚远。值得庆幸的是，我们有机会在那里比赛。

paras.en: "The key is to try and be one of the fittest and strongest sides in the world. You can never guarantee [winning] but you can guarantee the off-field preparation can be a lot better."
paras.zh: “关键是要努力成为世界上最健康、最强的球队之一。你永远不能保证[获胜]，但你可以保证场外的准备会更好。”

paras.en: Australia build-up dominated by 'Sandpapergate'
paras.zh: 澳大利亚建设以“砂纸门”为主

paras.en: Australia's off-field preparations have surely been disrupted by Khawaja's blockbuster declarations, even if all but one of the men who played for the Baggy Greens in that Cape Town Test eight years ago are not involved in the three ODIs and five T20s.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队的场外准备工作肯定会被 Khawaja 的轰动性声明打乱，即使除了一名在八年前开普敦测试中为 Baggy Greens 效力的球员之外，其他所有人都没有参加 3 场 ODI 和 5 场 T20 比赛。

paras.en: Mitchell Marsh is the sole figure from the Newlands drama who will be around. He is captaining Australia against England and will no doubt be heavily quizzed on what he did or did not know about Cameron Bancroft's use of sandpaper on the ball.
paras.zh: 米切尔·马什是纽兰兹戏剧中唯一出现的人物。他是澳大利亚队对阵英格兰队的队长，毫无疑问，他会受到严厉的质疑，他是否知道卡梅伦·班克罗夫特在球上使用砂纸的情况。

paras.en: Starc and fellow seam-bowling stalwarts (and fellow 'Sandpapergate' Test players, for that matter) Josh Hazlewood and Pat Cummins have been rested from the England white-ball contests - Starc has already retired from international T20s anyway.
paras.zh: 斯塔克和其他缝线保龄球的坚定支持者（以及“沙纸门”测试球员，就此而言）乔什·黑兹尔伍德和帕特·康明斯已经从英格兰白球比赛中休息了 - 无论如何，斯塔克已经从国际T20退役了。

paras.en: You sense Australia will miss them in the ODIs against a strong touring team, with the pace bowling attack looking a little raw in their absence. You also sense that their names will be mentioned a lot in the wake of Khawaja's headline-making claims.
paras.zh: 你感觉澳大利亚会想念他们在 ODI 中对阵一支强大的巡回赛球队的比赛，在他们缺席的情况下，节奏保龄球的进攻看起来有点生硬。你还感觉到，在卡瓦贾的言论成为头条新闻之后，他们的名字将会被大量提及。

paras.en: Starc, Hazlewood and Cummins, along with spin bowler Nathan Lyon, issued a joint statement in 2021 denying any prior knowledge of the ball-tampering.
paras.zh: Starc、Hazlewood 和 Cummins 以及旋转投球手 Nathan Lyon 于 2021 年发表联合声明，否认事先了解球篡改事件。

paras.en: Will they feel compelled to release another official one, either as a group or individually, or has all their talking been done?
paras.zh: 他们是否会觉得有必要以集体或个人的形式发布另一份官方文件，或者他们的谈话已经结束了？

paras.en: What is clear is that England have a chance to make a statement in the ODIs, by proverbially kicking Australia when they are down. Down because of the 2-1 Test series defeat in South Africa and down because of 'Sandpapergate' rearing its head again.
paras.zh: 显而易见的是，英格兰有机会在 ODI 中发表声明，众所周知，当澳大利亚落后时，英格兰将踢澳大利亚。因在南非的测试系列赛 2-1 失利而下降，并因“沙纸门”再次抬头而下降。

paras.en: Atherton added: "When England arrived a year ago, all the guns were trained on them, the classic Pommie-bashing.
paras.zh: 阿瑟顿补充道：“当英格兰一年前抵达时，所有的枪口都瞄准了他们，这是经典的波米式攻击。

paras.en: "Average Joe" Root, never got a Test hundred here. Pictures of the 'New Zealand-born, whining' Ben Stokes coming through the airport. All the usual focus on England.
paras.zh: “普通乔”根，在这里从未获得过测试百分。 “出生于新西兰、爱发牢骚的”本·斯托克斯 (Ben Stokes) 通过机场的照片。所有通常的焦点都集中在英格兰身上。

paras.en: "Now the focus is on the home team - and for an Englishman there is no better time to be in Australia than when the Australian team are tearing themselves apart, as they seem to be doing right now."
paras.zh: “现在的焦点是主队——对于一个英国人来说，在澳大利亚的最佳时机莫过于澳大利亚队正在撕裂自己，就像他们现在所做的那样。”

paras.zh: 英格兰队澳大利亚之行日程

paras.zh: - 第三次 ODI：11 月 18 日星期三（霍巴特）

paras.zh: - 首趟 T20I：11 月 21 日星期六（墨尔本）

paras.zh: - 第二个 T20I：11 月 24 日星期二（卡拉拉）

paras.zh: - 第三次 T20I：11 月 27 日星期五（布里斯班）

articles.title: Could King really become 'one of the best players in the world'?

paras.en: Josh King: The making of the rising star tipped to become one of world's best players after England call-up
paras.zh: 约什·金：这位后起之秀在入选英格兰队后有望成为世界上最好的球员之一

paras.en: Fulham's Josh King is in England's squad to face Croatia and Spain; Alvaro Arbeloa says he has 'everything' to become one of the world's best; Sky Sports finds out how he flourished in Fulham's academy, despite interest from Chelsea, and why he's destined for the very top
paras.zh: 富勒姆队的约什·金（Josh King）入选了英格兰队对阵克罗地亚队和西班牙队的阵容；阿尔瓦罗·阿贝洛亚 (Alvaro Arbeloa) 表示，他拥有成为世界最佳球员之一的“一切”；天空体育了解他如何在富勒姆青训营蓬勃发展，尽管切尔西对他感兴趣，以及为什么他注定会成为顶级球员

paras.en: Josh King was always one of the best players in his age group. "Nationally," clarifies Charlie Turnbull, his coach in Fulham's academy for five seasons between his U10 and U14 years, to Sky Sports. But there was another quality that set him apart.
paras.zh: 约什·金一直是他这个年龄段中最好的球员之一。 “全国范围内”，查理·特恩布尔（Charlie Turnbull）向天空体育澄清道，他在U10和U14岁之间在富勒姆青训学院执教了五个赛季。但还有另一个品质让他与众不同。

paras.en: "One of the most outstanding things about Josh is that whenever the level went up, whenever there was a pressure game, he loved it," adds Turnbull. "He loved it when things got hard. He loved it when there was a little bit of extra pressure.
paras.zh: 特恩布尔补充道：“约什最突出的事情之一就是，每当水平上升，每当有压力比赛时，他都会喜欢它。” “当事情变得困难时，他喜欢它。当有一点额外的压力时，他喜欢它。

paras.en: "He wanted it. He wanted to feel like the pressure was on him and the responsibility was on him to produce for the team. He enjoyed that. You always saw the best of Josh when the ante was up. I never once saw him not deliver in those circumstances.
paras.zh: “他想要它。他想要感觉压力在他身上，责任在他身上，为球队做出贡献。他喜欢这样。当赌注增加时，你总是看到约什最好的表现。我从来没有见过他在那种情况下表现不佳。

paras.en: "We would play tournaments in France, Spain and Portugal, against the giants of Europe, and afterwards the staff from each club would have to pick the best player they'd seen across the weekend. I remember Josh winning that accolade more than once."
paras.zh: “我们会在法国、西班牙和葡萄牙参加比赛，对阵欧洲的豪门，然后每个俱乐部的工作人员都必须选出他们在整个周末看到的最好的球员。我记得乔什不止一次赢得了这一荣誉。”

paras.en: King's temperament now forms part of his appeal to Thomas Tuchel, who called him up for England ahead of Cole Palmer and Phil Foden. "It's the attitude and the personality," he said last week. It all bodes well ahead of a possible debut against Croatia or Spain.
paras.zh: 金的气质现在成为他对托马斯·图赫尔的吸引力的一部分，图赫尔在科尔·帕尔默和菲尔·福登之前将他招入英格兰队。 “这是态度和个性，”他上周表示。这一切都预示着他们可能在对阵克罗地亚或西班牙的比赛中首次亮相。

paras.en: Tuchel sees a bright future for King, who has represented England at every level from U15 up. He has another champion in Alvaro Arbeloa. "He has everything to become one of the best players in the world," said the Fulham head coach after his call-up.
paras.zh: 图赫尔看到了金的光明未来，他代表英格兰U15以上各个级别参赛。他的另一个冠军是阿尔瓦罗·阿韦洛亚。 “他拥有成为世界上最好的球员之一的一切，”富勒姆主教练在征召后说道。

paras.en: Turnbull nods in agreement at the mention of that Arbeloa comment. "Development is never a straight line, so you can never really predict. But I'd be lying if I said I didn't think he could play at the very highest level of the game when I was working with him."
paras.zh: 特恩布尔在提到阿韦洛亚的评论时点头表示同意。 “发展从来都不是一条直线，所以你永远无法真正预测。但如果我说当我和他一起工作时我不认为他能打出最高水平的比赛，那我就是在撒谎。”

paras.en: His talent prompted interest from elsewhere.
paras.zh: 他的才华引起了其他地方的兴趣。

paras.en: "Chelsea were considered the best academy in the country at that time," says Turnbull. "They were generally able to bring in any player they wanted. We were aware of interest, but you never felt like it would materialise because Josh and his family never courted it."
paras.zh: “切尔西被认为是当时全国最好的学院，”特恩布尔说。 “他们通常能够引进任何他们想要的球员。我们意识到了他们的兴趣，但你永远不会觉得它会成为现实，因为约什和他的家人从来没有追求过它。”

paras.en: Turnbull, who most recently worked as assistant to Kieran McKenna at Ipswich, talks up the role of King's parents, Michelle, a university lecturer, and Steve, a lawyer, in keeping him grounded. He mentions King's private education and his multi-sport background too.
paras.zh: 特恩布尔最近在伊普斯维奇担任基兰·麦肯纳的助理，他谈到了金的父母、大学讲师米歇尔和律师史蒂夫在让金保持脚踏实地方面所发挥的作用。他还提到了金的私立教育和他的多项运动背景。

paras.en: "If all you have is football as a young player, it piles even more pressure on your shoulders than if your identity is bigger than that," he says. "And I think that's something his mum and dad have taken very deliberate steps to try to curate over time."
paras.zh: “作为一名年轻球员，如果你所拥有的只是足球，那么它会给你带来比你的身份更大的压力，”他说。 “我认为这是他的父母采取非常审慎的措施，试图随着时间的推移而策划的事情。”

paras.en: He describes King as having a "level of maturity that wasn't typical of boys his age" - and ability to match. "Interestingly, for someone who works so hard and is really open to learning, his game hasn't changed that much. It was pretty fully formed when I met him.
paras.zh: 他形容金拥有“他这个年龄段的男孩所不具备的成熟程度”，并且有与之相匹配的能力。 “有趣的是，对于一个如此努力工作并且真正乐于学习的人来说，他的比赛并没有太大改变。当我见到他时，他的比赛已经相当成熟了。

paras.en: "The most obvious thing with Josh, and you're seeing it in the Premier League now, is the way he moves. The way he twists and changes direction is probably his standout attribute.
paras.zh: “约什最明显的事情，你现在在英超联赛中看到的，就是他的移动方式。他扭转和改变方向的方式可能是他的突出特点。

paras.en: "His receiving skills are also elite. There's no debate over that. His ability to receive the ball in small spaces and be able to retain the ball and still go forwards and twist and shimmy and beat opponents is of top Premier League level, I would say."
paras.zh: “他的接球技巧也很出色。这是毫无争议的。我想说，他在狭小的空间内接球、控球并向前推进、扭转、摇摆并击败对手的能力是英超顶级水平。”

paras.en: King has been showing those qualities on a regular basis for Fulham since making his senior breakthrough under Marco Silva. It is a testament to his ability that he has played more Premier League minutes than any other teenager in the last two seasons.
paras.zh: 自从在马尔科·席尔瓦的带领下取得成年队突破以来，金一直在富勒姆定期展现出这些品质。在过去的两个赛季中，他在英超联赛中出场的时间比任何其他青少年都多，这证明了他的能力。

paras.en: As in his academy days, he has happily taken on added responsibility this season. King has more goal involvements than any other Fulham player and ranks highly in several other attacking areas, reflecting his importance to the side in the No 10 position.
paras.zh: 和在学院时期一样，他很高兴在本赛季承担了更多的责任。金的进球参与次数比任何其他富勒姆球员都多，并且在其他几个进攻领域排名很高，这反映了他对球队第 10 号位置的重要性。

paras.en: His success is no surprise to Turnbull. But there is satisfaction at some of the parts of his game in which King continues to show improvement. "The two big areas we focused on in his development plan were his ball striking and his left side," he says.
paras.zh: 他的成功对特恩布尔来说并不奇怪。但金在比赛的某些方面继续表现出进步，这令人感到满意。 “我们在他的发展计划中关注的两大领域是他的击球和他的左侧，”他说。

paras.en: Fulham carefully tailored his training programme. Turnbull describes taking King out of group sessions for focused shooting practice. The fruits of that work at youth level are now apparent in his ability to generate immense power with minimal backlift.
paras.zh: 富勒姆精心定制了他的训练计划。特恩布尔描述了让金退出小组训练进行集中射击练习的情况。现在，他在青年时期的工作成果已经显而易见，他能够以最小的后举力产生巨大的力量。

paras.en: His goal against Chelsea, when he beat Robert Sanchez at his near post, was one example. Others include a spectacular volley from outside the box parried by Lukas Hornicek against Newcastle and a thunderous shot onto the post against Coventry.
paras.zh: 他在对阵切尔西的比赛中在近门柱击败罗伯特·桑切斯的进球就是一个例子。其他进球还包括对阵纽卡斯尔的比赛中卢卡斯·霍尼切克在禁区外精彩的抽射，以及对阵考文垂的比赛中雷鸣般的射门。

paras.en: King also has a knack for arriving in the right place at the right time. He ranks behind only Erling Haaland for touches in the opposition box in the Premier League this season.
paras.zh: 金还拥有在正确的时间到达正确的地点的诀窍。本赛季英超联赛中，他在对方禁区触球次数仅次于埃尔林·哈兰德。

paras.en: "That was the same throughout his youth career," says Turnbull. "He gets into those positions so easily because of his intellect, his positioning and his movement. His ability to get into those positions is of a world-class level. He has a fantastic instinct for it."
paras.zh: “在他的整个青年生涯中都是如此，”特恩布尔说。 “他如此轻松地进入这些位置，是因为他的智慧、他的位置和他的动作。他进入这些位置的能力是世界一流的。他对此有一种奇妙的直觉。”

paras.en: The only frustration, if there is one, is that he hasn't scored more goals. "Probably, to take himself to the next level, he just needs to become more decisive when he gets into those positions because he is certainly arriving there enough," adds Turnbull.
paras.zh: 唯一令人沮丧的是，如果有的话，他没有取得更多进球。特恩布尔补充道：“也许，为了让自己更上一层楼，他只需要在担任这些职位时变得更加果断，因为他已经达到了足够的水平。”

paras.en: His shooting continues to be an area of focus under Arbeloa. The Spaniard has used King almost exclusively in the No 10 position this season. But Tuchel has talked up the value of his versatility and Turnbull sees his future slightly further back.
paras.zh: 在阿韦洛亚的带领下，他的投篮仍然是人们关注的焦点。西班牙人本赛季几乎只用金打10号位。但图赫尔谈到了他多才多艺的价值，而特恩布尔则认为他的未来稍远一些。

paras.en: "I think probably his best position will end up being as a No 8.
paras.zh: “我认为他最好的位置最终可能是8号位。

paras.en: "So, not quite a No 10, not quite a six, but someone that goes box to box, who can contribute in the final third, but who can also contribute to build-up.
paras.zh: “所以，他不完全是一个十号位，也不完全是一个六号位，而是一个能够从各个位置进入禁区的人，他可以在进攻三分之一中做出贡献，但也可以为组织进攻做出贡献。

paras.en: "Because one of his best attributes is undoubtedly his ability to take the ball in build-up. He's so hard to get the ball off, and his understanding of how to progress the game is of a very high level.
paras.zh: “因为他最好的属性之一无疑是他在组织进攻时的拿球能力。他很难把球拿走，而且他对如何推进比赛的理解水平非常高。

paras.en: "You would want to be able to maximise that, but you wouldn't want to restrain him from arriving in the final third as well. I think he can do everything. In an ideal world, you would want him to be there for the build-up, then follow the game up the pitch."
paras.zh: “你会希望能够最大限度地发挥这一点，但你也不会想限制他进入最后三分之一。我认为他可以做一切。在理想的世界中，你会希望他在那里进行组织进攻，然后在球场上跟踪比赛。”

paras.en: The extent of King's potential is made more tantalising by the fact that, at 19, he still has room for physical development.
paras.zh: 19 岁的金仍然有身体发展的空间，这一事实使他的潜力更加诱人。

paras.en: "He was always what we call in academy circles 'under-maturated', playing against a lot of kids who were physically stronger," says Turnbull. "There's a lot of research that points to that being a positive thing, if you're under-maturated and you still survive.
paras.zh: “他一直是我们在学术界所说的‘不成熟’的人，与很多身体更强壮的孩子比赛，”特恩布尔说。 “有很多研究表明，如果你尚未成熟并且仍然能够生存，那么这是一件积极的事情。

paras.en: "And Josh didn't just survive, he thrived.
paras.zh: “乔什不仅活了下来，而且还茁壮成长。

paras.en: "I look at Josh and I still think he hasn't even got close to developing into the athlete that he will be. And that's a great thought, because he is performing so well in the Premier League already.
paras.zh: “我看着约什，我仍然认为他还没有接近发展成为他将成为的运动员。这是一个很好的想法，因为他已经在英超联赛中表现得很好。

paras.en: "I think there's a lot more to come from him."
paras.zh: “我认为他还有很多事情要做。”

articles.title: Tuchel committed to England but keen on club return in future

paras.en: Thomas Tuchel committed to England until Euro 2028 but keen on club return in future
paras.zh: 托马斯·图赫尔承诺为英格兰效力直至 2028 年欧洲杯，但热衷于未来回归俱乐部

paras.en: Thomas Tuchel said is committed to England until Euro 2028 - even if a big club comes calling for his services; he does hope to return to the club game in the future; Tuchel also hopes FA bids for Nations League finals
paras.zh: 托马斯·图切尔表示，他将在2028年欧洲杯之前为英格兰效力——即使有一家大俱乐部需要他的服务；他确实希望将来能够重返俱乐部比赛；图赫尔还希望英足总申办欧国联决赛

paras.en: Thomas Tuchel revealed he has no release clause in his England contract but is committed to leading them until Euro 2028 at least - even if a big club comes calling.
paras.zh: 托马斯·图切尔透露，他在英格兰队的合同中没有解约金条款，但他致力于带领球队至少到2028年欧洲杯——即使有一家大俱乐部来找他。

paras.en: The Three Lions boss was asked the question in relation to incoming-Manchester United head coach Mauricio Pochettino having a £7m buyout clause in his deal with the USA.
paras.zh: 这位三狮军团主帅被问到有关即将上任的曼联主教练毛里西奥·波切蒂诺在与美国队的交易中包含700万英镑买断条款的问题。

paras.en: In response to the written media, Tuchel said: "No release clause. And there's no intention. I signed the contract - I want to stay until the Euros. I want to do the Euros. We have unfinished business."
paras.zh: 图赫尔在回应书面媒体时表示：“没有解约金条款。也没有任何意图。我签了合同——我想留下来直到欧洲杯。我想做欧洲杯。我们还有未完成的事情。”

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch Premier League games LIVE on your phone📱
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看英超联赛直播📱

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream PL games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 PL 比赛📺

paras.en: Tuchel was then asked if there was "zero chance" he would leave England if a big club came in for him between now and the 2028 Euros. He said: "Yeah, I would say so."
paras.zh: 随后图赫尔被问到，如果有一家大俱乐部从现在到 2028 年欧洲杯期间引进他，他离开英格兰的可能性是否“为零”。他说：“是的，我会这么说。”

paras.en: Speaking about The FA's commitment to him after the World Cup exit, Tuchel added: "They made it very early in the World Cup. Even before the clause was activated, they just made it very clear. And it comes from a place of trust and that's what you look for as a coach.
paras.zh: 谈到世界杯出局后英足总对他的承诺，图赫尔补充道：“他们在世界杯很早就做到了。甚至在该条款启动之前，他们就明确表示了这一点。它来自于信任，这就是作为一名教练所寻求的。”

paras.en: "I love my group of players, I love my staff and I have bosses who trust me and are happy with the way we do things.
paras.zh: “我爱我的球员团队，我爱我的员工，我的老板们信任我，并对我们做事的方式感到满意。

paras.en: "It's a lot, and I know how to appreciate it a lot, so it's in a good place, I'm in a good place. And like I said, I love the players.
paras.zh: “这很多，我知道如何欣赏它，所以它处于一个好的位置，我处于一个好的位置。就像我说的，我爱球员。

paras.en: "I miss my players and I miss my team and I miss the 50 matches that I'm not involved in in a year, but I'm desperate to win the Nations League and I'm desperate to play and try to win the Euros."
paras.zh: “我想念我的球员，我想念我的球队，我想念一年内我没有参加的 50 场比赛，但我非常渴望赢得国家联赛，我非常渴望参加比赛并努力赢得欧洲杯。”

paras.en: Asked if he plans to return to club management after England, Tuchel said: "Yeah, definitely. I miss the 50 matches, like I said. I miss these two minutes when everything is done. You go out the two minutes before the whistle goes, it's like the best two minutes, everything is done and you're in a full stadium, lights are on and you're just so excited and you're part of it.
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否计划在英格兰队结束后重返俱乐部管理层时，图赫尔说：“是的，当然。我想念这50场比赛，就像我说的。我想念一切都完成后的这两分钟。你在哨声响起前两分钟就出去了，这就像最好的两分钟，一切都完成了，你在一个拥挤的体育场里，灯亮了，你非常兴奋，你是其中的一部分。

paras.en: "That's actually the two minutes where I kind of a little bit realise how lucky and how grateful I am and then the whistle goes and you're just in the tunnel again and you're trying to win the game for your team. And you do that every four days."
paras.zh: “实际上，在那两分钟里，我有点意识到自己是多么幸运和多么感激，然后哨声响起，你又回到了隧道里，你正在努力为你的球队赢得比赛。你每四天就会这样做一次。”

paras.en: Tuchel also suggested that the FA could make a bid to bring the Nations League finals to England - something he hopes will happen.
paras.zh: 图赫尔还表示，英足总可以争取将欧国联决赛带到英格兰举行——他希望这会发生。

paras.en: He said: "We don't know where the final of the Nations League will be yet. The FA has an option to put their hat in the ring.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们还不知道国联决赛将在哪里举行。英足总可以选择参加比赛。

paras.en: "We've talked before about this group of players struggling to bring their training performances to the field other England managers have spoken about the shirt being heavy.
paras.zh: “我们之前谈到过这群球员努力将训练表现带到球场上，其他英格兰主教练也谈到过球衣很重。

paras.en: "It's [the Euros] going to be a home tournament, the pressures of that tournament will be unique.
paras.zh: “这[欧洲杯]将是一场主场比赛，比赛的压力将是独一无二的。

paras.en: "It's almost like a dress rehearsal, playing in front of your own fans. Nations League helps in general for us. It would be exciting, it would be nice to have it here. First of all, we need to reach the final."
paras.zh: “这几乎就像一次彩排，在自己的球迷面前比赛。国家联赛对我们来说总体上有帮助。这会很令人兴奋，很高兴能在这里举行。首先，我们需要进入决赛。”

articles.title: Gunman with far-right views who killed 6 in Poland shooting rampage dies in hospital
articles.author: Reuters

paras.en: The man who killed six people and wounded 15 others in a suspected far-right terrorist attack in the Polish city of Kraków has died, police said early Monday.
paras.zh: 警方周一早些时候表示，在波兰克拉科夫市发生的疑似极右翼恐怖袭击中，造成 6 人死亡、15 人受伤的男子已经死亡。

paras.en: Michał Oksiński, 24, died at 4:30 a.m. local time (10:30 p.m. ET), authorities said. He had been in critical condition since the attack and had undergone several operations.
paras.zh: 当局称，24 岁的米哈乌·奥克辛斯基 (Michał Oksiński) 于当地时间凌晨 4:30（美国东部时间晚上 10:30）去世。自袭击发生以来，他一直处于危急状态，并接受了多次手术。

paras.en: Police shot Oksiński during Saturday’s midday rampage in Main Market Square, the historic center and major tourist destination in Kraków, Poland’s second-largest city.
paras.zh: 周六中午，波兰第二大城市克拉科夫的历史中心和主要旅游目的地主集市广场发生骚乱，警方开枪射杀了奥克辛斯基。

paras.en: Four women and two men were killed. Three of the women and one of the men were Polish, authorities said. A British man and an Austrian woman were among the dead, they said.
paras.zh: 四名妇女和两名男子被杀。当局称，其中三名女性和一名男性是波兰人。他们说，死者中有一名英国男子和一名奥地利妇女。

paras.en: Two police officers were in “serious” condition after they were injured along with dozens of others, regional official Krzysztof Jan Klęczar said Sunday. Five foreigners, from the U.K., Portugal, Russia, Germany and Austria, were injured, officials said.
paras.zh: 地区官员克日什托夫·扬·克勒查周日表示，两名警察和其他数十人受伤，伤势“严重”。官员称，来自英国、葡萄牙、俄罗斯、德国和奥地利的五名外国人受伤。

paras.en: The bodies of Oksiński’s sister, mother and father were found at the family home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, about 90 miles northeast of Kraków, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，奥克辛斯基的姐姐、母亲和父亲的尸体在位于克拉科夫东北约 90 英里的奥斯特罗维茨维托克日斯基 (Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski) 的家中被发现。

paras.en: Very little information has come out about Oksiński. Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said Saturday that he used an automatic rifle to carry out the attack and that he “was fascinated by far-right ideologies.” The shooter held “very radical” and “ultranationalistic” views, Kierwiński added.
paras.zh: 关于奥克辛斯基的信息很少。内政部长马尔辛·基尔温斯基周六表示，他使用自动步枪进行了袭击，并且他“对极右意识形态着迷”。基尔文斯基补充说，枪手持有“非常激进”和“超民族主义”的观点。

paras.en: Authorities were still examining the evidence Monday.
paras.zh: 当局周一仍在审查证据。

paras.en: The nationalist opposition has questioned the grounds on which the motive was established, with Law & Justice party leader Jarosław Kaczyński saying the claims were a “blatant lie.”
paras.zh: 民族主义反对派质疑这一动机的成立依据，法律与正义党领导人雅罗斯瓦夫·卡钦斯基表示，这些说法是“公然的谎言”。

paras.en: And National Prosecutor’s Office spokesperson Przemyslaw Nowak said at a news conference Monday that investigators did not yet know what motivated the killer.
paras.zh: 国家检察官办公室发言人普热米斯瓦夫·诺瓦克在周一的新闻发布会上表示，调查人员尚不清楚凶手的动机。

paras.en: He said a yellow flag with a snake and the words “Don’t tread on me” on it, known as the Gadsden flag, was found in his room.
paras.zh: 他说，在他的房间里发现了一面带有蛇的黄色旗帜，上面写着“别踩我”，被称为加兹登旗帜。

paras.en: First used during the American Revolution in the 18th century, Nowak said, the flag was associated with “various meanings related to freedom or rebellion” but was not widely known as being linked to any form of extremism.
paras.zh: 诺瓦克说，这面旗帜在 18 世纪的美国革命期间首次使用，它与“与自由或叛乱相关的各种含义”相关联，但并未被广泛认为与任何形式的极端主义有关。

paras.en: Interior Ministry spokesperson Karolina Galecka said there were many different emblems on the perpetrator’s clothing that had already been partially examined and interpreted.
paras.zh: 内政部发言人卡罗琳娜·加莱卡(Karolina Galecka)表示，肇事者的衣服上有许多不同的标志，这些标志已经过部分检查和解释。

paras.en: Separately, government spokesperson Adam Szłapka told Polish broadcaster TVN24 that it was “best to refrain from making comments” about Oksiński’s political views “until the matter is fully clarified and the authorities are in possession of complete information,” even if there were “some initial indications.”
paras.zh: 另外，政府发言人 Adam Szłapka 告诉波兰广播公司 TVN24，即使有“一些初步迹象”，“最好不要对奥克辛斯基的政治观点发表评论，直到事情完全澄清并且当局掌握完整信息”。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Justice Minister Waldemar Żurek told Radio Zet that the investigation would continue to establish whether Oksiński acted alone or was inspired by any group.
paras.zh: 另一方面，司法部长瓦尔德马·祖雷克 (Waldemar Żurek) 告诉 Zet 广播电台，调查将继续确定奥克辛斯基是单独行动还是受到任何团体的怂恿。

paras.en: However, authorities have said they believed the attacker killed his family, possibly while they slept, before he headed to Krakow.
paras.zh: 然而，当局表示，他们相信袭击者在前往克拉科夫之前杀死了他的家人，可能是在他们睡觉时杀害的。

paras.en: Seven weapons were found in the home, bringing the total recovered to 11, prosecutors said. Four others, including two AR-15 semiautomatic rifles, were found on the attacker or in his car in Kraków. Dozens, if not hundreds, of shots were fired, they said.
paras.zh: 检察官称，在家中发现了 7 件武器，使查获的武器总数达到 11 件。在克拉科夫的袭击者身上或他的车里还发现了另外四支枪，其中包括两支 AR-15 半自动步枪。他们说，开了数十枪，甚至数百枪。

paras.en: However, it has emerged that Oksiński and his father held gun permits and that he had trained at a local shooting club, which said in a statement that he “was never trained in our club in the areas of dynamic, tactical or combat shooting.”
paras.zh: 然而，有消息称，奥克辛斯基和他的父亲持有枪支许可证，并且他曾在当地一家射击俱乐部接受过训练，该俱乐部在一份声明中表示，他“从未在我们的俱乐部接受过动态、战术或格斗射击方面的培训”。

paras.en: Poland had never experienced such a large mass shooting, and the scenes of bodies and blood strewn across the heart of one of its most historic cities have shocked people in a country that has long viewed itself as safer than its Western European neighbors.
paras.zh: 波兰从未经历过如此大规模的枪击事件，在其历史最悠久的城市之一的中心地带，尸体和血迹遍布的场景让这个长期以来一直认为自己比西欧邻国更安全的国家的人们感到震惊。

articles.title: Russell Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assaults
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: LONDON — British comedian and actor Russell Brand was sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison for rape and sexual assault by a London court Monday.
paras.zh: 伦敦——周一，英国喜剧演员兼演员拉塞尔·布兰德因强奸和性侵犯被伦敦一家法院判处 10 年零 6 个月监禁。

paras.en: The lengthy prison term completes a stunning fall from grace for Brand, 51, who found fame on both sides of the Atlantic chronicling his promiscuity and battles with addiction.
paras.zh: 51 岁的布兰德因记录自己的滥交和与毒瘾的斗争而在大西洋两岸声名鹊起，漫长的监狱生涯让他彻底失宠。

paras.en: He was found guilty Thursday of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. He had pleaded not guilty to all counts and denied all of the allegations.
paras.zh: 周四，他被判犯有一项强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪。他对所有罪名均表示不认罪，并否认所有指控。

paras.en: Brand appeared in the London court Monday wearing a dark suit and at times making a sign of the cross as the judge, Justice Joel Bennathan, called him a “sexual predator” before he delivered the sentence. Bennathan had warned last week that Brand faced a “significant” prison term for his crimes.
paras.zh: 布兰德周一穿着深色西装出现在伦敦法庭，法官乔尔·本纳森(Joel Bennathan)在宣判前称他为“性掠夺者”，他时不时地比划十字。本纳森上周警告说，布兰德因其罪行将面临“重大”监禁。

paras.en: Stressing that he had to be careful not to punish Brand more “because you are famous,” Bennathan also paid tribute to the “determination and bravery” of the women who testified against him.
paras.zh: 本纳森强调，他必须小心，不要“因为你很有名”而对布兰德进行更多惩罚，他还对那些作证反对他的女性的“决心和勇敢”表示敬意。

paras.en: “Whatever women wear, wherever they go, indeed whatever they drink, they retain the right to say no and to demand justice from the criminal courts when sexual predators like you, Russell Brand, act without their consent,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“无论女性穿什么，去哪里，喝什么，当像你拉塞尔·布兰德这样的性掠夺者未经她们同意的情况下采取行动时，她们都保留说不的权利，并要求刑事法庭伸张正义。”

paras.en: According to Britain’s sentencing council, the maximum sentence for rape is life imprisonment and 10 years for one count of sexual assault.
paras.zh: 根据英国判刑委员会的规定，强奸罪的最高刑罚是无期徒刑，性侵罪的一项罪名最高可判处10年有期徒刑。

paras.en: Brand’s victims told the court Monday — in person and in written statements — that they were still living with the trauma and effects in their daily lives.
paras.zh: 布兰德的受害者周一以亲自和书面陈述的形式告诉法庭，他们仍然生活在日常生活中的创伤和影响中。

paras.en: “I’ve been in shock and turmoil for years,” a woman told the sentencing hearing, while another said he appeared to show “no remorse.” Victims of alleged sexual offenses are granted anonymity for life under British law.
paras.zh: 一名女子在量刑听证会上表示，“多年来我一直处于震惊和混乱之中”，而另一名女子则表示，他似乎“没有悔意”。根据英国法律，涉嫌性犯罪的受害者可以终身匿名。

paras.en: London’s Metropolitan Police said it had provided prosecutors with investigations into two more rape allegations against Brand since he was convicted.
paras.zh: 伦敦大都会警察局表示，自布兰德被定罪以来，已向检察官提供了对另外两起针对布兰德的强奸指控的调查。

paras.en: Asked by reporters whether he had a message for the victims as he left court, Brand’s father, Ron Brand, said he didn’t care about them and suggested they had “chased and harassed” his son. He added that he didn’t believe in the justice system “on the basis of what I just watched.”
paras.zh: 当记者问他离开法庭时是否有什么话要对受害者说时，布兰德的父亲罗恩·布兰德表示，他并不关心他们，并暗示他们“追逐和骚扰”了他的儿子。他补充说，“根据我刚刚看到的情况”，他不相信司法系统。

paras.en: Brand’s case has renewed scrutiny of the ethics of the entertainment industry, through which Brand rose from a flamboyant British broadcaster and stand-up comedian to a star of Hollywood movies.
paras.zh: 布兰德案让人们重新审视娱乐业的道德规范，布兰德从一位浮夸的英国播音员和单口喜剧演员一跃成为好莱坞电影明星。

paras.en: After the four-week trial at Southwark Crown Court in London, a jury of eight men and four women found Brand guilty of having raped a female fan at his home after she met him at one of his shows in 2009.
paras.zh: 在伦敦南华克皇家法院进行了为期四个星期的审判后，由八名男子和四名女子组成的陪审团裁定布兰德犯有在他家中强奸一名女粉丝的罪名，当时这名女粉丝是在 2009 年布兰德的一场演出中认识他的。

paras.en: He was also found guilty of sexually assaulting a woman whose breasts he grabbed at a party in 2004 and another woman who said he kissed and groped her at a London radio station in 2004 or 2005.
paras.zh: 他还被判犯有 2004 年在一次聚会上性侵犯一名妇女的罪名，该妇女曾被他抓住，并于 2004 年或 2005 年在伦敦一家广播电台对另一名妇女进行了亲吻和抚摸。

paras.en: He was found not guilty of two other counts of rape and one count of attempted indecent assault.
paras.zh: 他被判犯有另外两项强奸罪和一项未遂猥亵罪。

paras.en: Prosecutors said that the women do not know one another and that they separately went to police after a TV documentary was broadcast in Britain in 2023.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，这些妇女彼此不认识，2023 年一部电视纪录片在英国播出后，她们分别向警方报案。

paras.en: During the trial, prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones called Brand a ruthless, calculating, manipulative “sexual predator” who treated women as a “disposable commodity.”
paras.zh: 在审判期间，检察官里尔·卡米·琼斯称布兰德是一个冷酷无情、精于算计、善于操纵的“性掠夺者”，他将女性视为“一次性商品”。

paras.en: Brand admitted in his testimony to being sex-obsessed as a young and famous man. He denied ever having had nonconsensual sex.
paras.zh: 布兰德在他的证词中承认，作为一个年轻的名人，他对性很痴迷。他否认曾发生过非自愿的性行为。

paras.en: At the height of his fame, Brand featured in several Hollywood movies, including “Forgetting Sarah Marshall” and “Get Him to the Greek.” His fame stateside was cemented when he briefly wed singer Katy Perry in a lavish ceremony in India in 2010. The couple divorced in 2012.
paras.zh: 在他的名声鼎盛时期，布兰德出演了多部好莱坞电影，包括《忘记莎拉·马歇尔》和《带他去希腊》。 2010 年，他在印度与歌手凯蒂·佩里 (Katy Perry) 举行了一场盛大的婚礼，短暂结婚后，他在美国的名声进一步巩固。两人于 2012 年离婚。

paras.en: Brand’s current wife, Laura Gallacher, who was in the courtroom Monday, previously testified that he was a “caring, kind and a wonderful father.” The couple married in 2017 and have three young children.
paras.zh: 布兰德现任妻子劳拉·加拉赫周一在法庭上作证，称布兰德是一位“有爱心、善良、很棒的父亲”。这对夫妇于 2017 年结婚，育有三个年幼的孩子。

paras.en: In recent years, Brand had moved away from mainstream media, becoming an antiestablishment commentator. He briefly relocated to Florida and has built a large online following with videos that discuss U.S. politics, wellness, conspiracy theories and his newfound Christian faith.
paras.zh: 近年来，布兰德逐渐远离主流媒体，成为一名反建制评论员。他短暂移居佛罗里达州，并通过讨论美国政治、健康、阴谋论和他新发现的基督教信仰的视频在网上建立了大批追随者。

paras.en: Speaking after the sentencing, Detective Superintendent Andy Furphy told reporters that the sentence marked “a significant milestone in our investigation and means Russell Brand has been held accountable for his crimes.”
paras.zh: 侦探警司安迪·弗菲在宣判后对记者表示，这一判决标志着“我们调查的一个重要里程碑，意味着拉塞尔·布兰德已被追究其罪行的责任”。

paras.en: Praising the victims, he said: “Reporting sexual offenses can be incredibly difficult, and they have shown immense bravery, dignity and resilience throughout what has been a lengthy investigation and challenging trial process.
paras.zh: 他赞扬受害者说：“举报性犯罪可能非常困难，但在漫长的调查和充满挑战的审判过程中，他们表现出了巨大的勇气、尊严和韧性。

paras.en: “The victims have had to revisit deeply traumatic experiences and endure significant public and media attention. I hope today’s outcome provides some measure of closure and allows them to continue rebuilding their lives,” he said.
paras.zh: “受害者不得不重新审视深深的创伤经历，并承受公众和媒体的广泛关注。我希望今天的结果能够在一定程度上结束，让他们能够继续重建生活，”他说。

paras.en: If you or someone you know has been sexually assaulted, call the National Sexual Assault Hotline at 1-800-656-4673. The hotline, run by the Rape, Abuse, & Incest National Network (RAINN), can put you in contact with your local rape crisis center. You can also access RAINN’s online chat service at rainn.org/get-help.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人遭到性侵犯，请拨打全国性侵犯热线 1-800-656-4673。该热线由全国强奸、虐待和乱伦网络 (RAINN) 运营，可以让您与当地的强奸危机中心取得联系。您还可以访问 Rainn.org/get-help 访问 RAINN 的在线聊天服务。

articles.title: The women's RLWC final is a fight against fate
articles.author: Nick Campton

paras.en: Fri, 18 Sept, 7:50 pm, Final score, Tigers 0, Raiders 6
paras.zh: 9 月 18 日星期五，晚上 7:50，最终比分，老虎 0，突袭者 6

paras.en: The women's Rugby League World Cup has ended up exactly where it was fated to be, with Australia to face New Zealand in the final for the third tournament in a row.
paras.zh: 女子橄榄球联盟世界杯最终如期而至，澳大利亚连续第三次在决赛中对阵新西兰。

paras.en: Barring the kind of upset that sends bookies broke, this was the only way it could be given the Jillaroos and Kiwi Ferns have romped their way through with a near contemptuous ease.
paras.zh: 除非出现那种让博彩公司破产的情况，否则这是唯一可以让 Jillaroos 和 Kiwi Ferns 以近乎轻蔑的轻松方式轻松晋级的方式。

paras.en: Only Fiji, a delightful surprise packet in their maiden tournament who lost to New Zealand by six in the group stage and Australia by 16 in the semi-final, managed to run either of them close. The former is the only game of the World Cup to be decided by one score or fewer.
paras.zh: 只有斐济队在他们的首次比赛中令人惊喜，他们在小组赛中以 6 分输给了新西兰队，在半决赛中以 16 分输给了澳大利亚队，成功地追平了他们。前者是世界杯上唯一一场以一分或更少比分决定胜负的比赛。

paras.en: Even counting the valiant efforts of the Bulikula, Australia and New Zealand have outscored their opponents by a combined 272-20 and 182-24 respectively.
paras.zh: 即使算上布利库拉队的奋勇拼搏，澳大利亚队和新西兰队也分别以272比20和182比24的总比分战胜了对手。

paras.en: Fiji's emergence and Papua New Guinea and Samoa's continued development are positives but if the journey truly matters more than the destination this one has been a trudge.
paras.zh: 斐济的崛起以及巴布亚新几内亚和萨摩亚的持续发展都是积极的，但如果旅程真的比目的地更重要，那么这就是一场长途跋涉。

paras.en: It has felt inevitable from the start and perhaps it was. There could have been improvements to the draw — Australia had no business playing a team like Wales — but none that would have changed this outcome.
paras.zh: 从一开始就感觉这是不可避免的，也许确实如此。抽签结果本可以有所改善——澳大利亚没有资格对阵像威尔士这样的球队——但没有任何办法可以改变这一结果。

paras.en: A tournament like this and a final like this, where Australia are deserved 20-point favourites given they've only lost to New Zealand once in the past ten years, is the wrong end of the double-edged sword women's rugby league is trying to wield.
paras.zh: 像这样的锦标赛和这样的决赛，澳大利亚理应获得20分的优势，因为她们在过去十年中只输给新西兰一次，这是女子橄榄球联盟试图使用的双刃剑的错误结局。

paras.en: The Jillaroos are the game's lone superpower, without peer or rival, because they are the end-product of almost a decade of transformation via the NRLW.
paras.zh: Jillaroos 是这项运动中唯一的超级大国，没有对手或对手，因为他们是 NRLW 近十年转型的最终产品。

paras.en: They play the same sport as developing nations, but they're in a different game to nations like Wales, France and Papua New Guinea.
paras.zh: 他们与发展中国家从事同样的运动，但与威尔士、法国和巴布亚新几内亚等国家的比赛不同。

paras.en: There's a value in having a team that stands so tall because they're a gold standard to aspire to for some and a target to aim at for others.
paras.zh: 拥有一支如此高的团队是有价值的，因为他们是某些人渴望的黄金标准，也是另一些人的目标。

paras.en: They are proof of what is possible for women's rugby league with investment from the bottom up and the top down, as well as giving it the patience for that investment to rise to the top.
paras.zh: 它们证明了女子橄榄球联盟通过自下而上和自上而下的投资的可能性，并给予其耐心让投资上升到最高层。

paras.en: It makes the Jillaroos an incredible creation and victory on Sunday would confirm what most already know — that this is the greatest collection of talent in the history of women's rugby league.
paras.zh: 这使得 Jillaroos 队成为了令人难以置信的创造者，而周日的胜利将证实大多数人已经知道的事情——这是女子橄榄球联盟历史上最伟大的人才聚集地。

paras.en: Just as the 2017 final, the last before the start of the NRLW, signalled the beginning of a new kind of history so would a Jillaroos win here be the capstone on Australia remaking the game in their own image.
paras.zh: 正如 2017 年决赛，即 NRLW 开始前的最后一场决赛，标志着一种新历史的开始，同样，Jillaroos 在此获胜也将成为澳大利亚按照自己的形象重塑比赛的压轴之作。

paras.en: It would mark their fourth World Cup final win in a row, pulling them past New Zealand who currently have three with the last coming back in 2008.
paras.zh: 这将标志着他们在世界杯决赛中连续第四次获胜，击败了新西兰队，新西兰队目前已经取得了三场胜利，上一次胜利是在 2008 年。

paras.en: Their dominance is a by-product of the game's progress but it's also so complete and smothering it's become a problem. The things that have made them great have worked too well.
paras.zh: 他们的统治地位是游戏进步的副产品，但它也如此完整和令人窒息，这已经成为一个问题。那些让他们变得伟大的事情效果太好了。

paras.en: Australia have moved so far and so fast not only is there nothing left for them to overtake, they can barely see New Zealand over their shoulders. They must keep looking though, because there is nobody else to see.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚已经走得太远、太快了，他们不仅没有什么可以超越的，而且几乎看不到新西兰的身影。但他们必须继续寻找，因为没有其他人可以看到。

paras.en: They are Everest and New Zealand are the only other team who have even been able to try to climb a mountain before. Everybody else is stuck at base camp.
paras.zh: 他们是珠穆朗玛峰，新西兰是唯一一支曾经尝试过攀登珠穆朗玛峰的球队。其他人都被困在大本营。

paras.en: As talented as their opponents are — and with Raecene McGregor at halfback, Mele Hufanga and Stacey Waaka in the centres and inspirational captain Georgia Hale leading a forward pack who could skin a crocodile their talent is considerable — just playing well is not enough for New Zealand to win.
paras.zh: 尽管他们的对手才华横溢——中卫雷塞内·麦格雷戈(Raecene McGregor)，中卫梅勒·胡方加(Mele Hufanga)和史黛西·瓦卡(Stacey Waaka)，鼓舞人心的队长乔治亚·黑尔(Georgia Hale)带领着一群可以剥鳄鱼皮的前锋，但他们的天赋相当可观——仅仅打得好不足以让新西兰队获胜。

paras.en: They'll need an off night by the Australians, a few bounces of the ball, perhaps a referee call or two falling their way, just to bring them into the contest.
paras.zh: 他们需要澳大利亚队度过一个休息之夜，几次球的弹跳，也许一两次裁判的吹罚，才能让他们进入比赛。

paras.en: A win is possible, but it would be the greatest upset of this era and when the second-best team in the world needs a fair bit of luck to take it to the best, things have gotten way too top heavy.
paras.zh: 胜利是可能的，但这将是这个时代最大的冷门，当世界第二好的球队需要一点运气才能达到最好的水平时，事情就变得太过头重脚轻了。

paras.en: Australia have taken giant strides while everyone else is trying to catch up with smaller steps.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚已经取得了巨大的进步，而其他国家都在努力追赶较小的步伐。

paras.en: The great-grandparent rule might help in the short-term if it allows more elite talent to filter through to other nations.
paras.zh: 如果曾祖父母规则允许更多精英人才进入其他国家，那么它可能会在短期内有所帮助。

paras.en: Any potential NRL investment in Super League would surely include a women's component and that would give the game in the northern hemisphere a boost it sorely needs.
paras.zh: NRL 对超级联赛的任何潜在投资肯定会包括女子联赛，这将为北半球的这项运动带来急需的推动力。

paras.en: Both moves would build on the progress of this World Cup, which has mainly come through in excellent television ratings even if the contests haven't been close.
paras.zh: 这两项举措都将建立在本届世界杯的进展基础上，尽管比赛结果并不接近，但世界杯的主要表现还是出色的电视收视率。

paras.en: But further development is required before there's any thought of a standalone World Cup, which will likely be tabled until 2034 at the earliest because it cannot happen until this game is for more than one player.
paras.zh: 但在考虑举办独立的世界杯之前，还需要进一步的发展，世界杯最早可能会推迟到 2034 年，因为只有在这场比赛有不止一名球员参加时才能实现。

paras.en: There are glories that lie outside ultimate victory and those can be easier to find once teams like Fiji, Samoa and Papua New Guinea have more time to develop but when it comes to Australia that's a hard thing to remember.
paras.zh: 最终胜利之外还有一些荣耀，一旦像斐济、萨摩亚和巴布亚新几内亚这样的球队有更多的时间发展，这些荣耀就更容易找到，但对于澳大利亚来说，这是一件很难记住的事情。

paras.en: They are the best by such a margin the rest are barely in sight, a grim fate they can confirm with glory on Sunday.
paras.zh: 他们以如此大的差距成为最好的，其他人几乎看不到他们的命运，他们可以在周日的荣耀中证实这一严峻的命运。

articles.title: Farm worker health fears as Q fever vaccine shortage hits rural Australia
articles.author: Lucy Thackray

paras.en: Australia is expected to run out of Q fever vaccines this week.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚 Q 热疫苗预计本周将用完。

paras.en: The shortage is due to unexpected manufacturing issues.
paras.zh: 短缺是由于意外的制造问题造成的。

paras.en: It is hoped vaccines will be available again by the end of December.
paras.zh: 希望疫苗能在 12 月底再次上市。

paras.en: The vaccine that protects Australians from a serious bacterial infection is expected to run out this week.
paras.zh: 保护澳大利亚人免受严重细菌感染的疫苗预计将于本周用完。

paras.en: Q fever is spread by animals, including sheep and cattle, and causes severe flu-like symptoms that can become chronic and, in some cases, lead to serious cardiovascular complications.
paras.zh: Q热由羊和牛等动物传播，会引起严重的流感样症状，这些症状可能会变成慢性，在某些情况下，会导致严重的心血管并发症。

paras.en: Last year Australia recorded 991 Q fever cases; the highest number since national monitoring began in 1991
paras.zh: 去年澳大利亚记录了 991 例 Q 热病例；自 1991 年开始国家监测以来数量最高

paras.en: Australian manufacturer CSL Seqirus is contracted by Australia's Department of Health (ADH) to supply the vaccine.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚制造商 CSL Seqirus 与澳大利亚卫生部 (ADH) 签订了供应疫苗的合同。

paras.en: "Unfortunately, we actually expect a short temporary stock out starting now through to the end of the year," senior vice-president of operations Chris Larkins said.
paras.zh: 运营高级副总裁克里斯·拉金斯 (Chris Lakins) 表示：“不幸的是，我们实际上预计从现在到年底都会出现短暂的暂时缺货。”

paras.en: "We've expedited the next two batches that are being manufactured. They'll be available, we believe, late December.
paras.zh: “我们已经加快了接下来两批的生产速度。我们相信，它们将在 12 月底上市。

paras.en: "We are very sorry. We know it affects public health, especially in the country and also affects businesses financially out there."
paras.zh: “我们非常抱歉。我们知道这会影响公众健康，尤其是在该国，也会影响企业的财务状况。”

paras.en: Mr Larkins said stabilising supply was the company's highest priority "given how critical it is to public health and getting our agricultural businesses back up and functioning".
paras.zh: 拉金斯表示，稳定供应是该公司的首要任务，“鉴于它对公众健康以及让我们的农业业务恢复和运转至关重要”。

paras.en: Rawsonville dairy owner Erika Chesworth said she had been unable to vaccinate her staff since March.
paras.zh: 罗森维尔 (Rawsonville) 乳品厂老板埃里卡·切斯沃斯 (Erika Chesworth) 表示，自三月份以来，她一直无法为员工接种疫苗。

paras.en: "We've just had very short responses from the only local clinic saying they are unable to source the vaccine," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们刚刚从当地唯一一家诊所得到了非常简短的答复，称他们无法采购疫苗。”

paras.en: "It's just been dead ends everywhere; there's been no communication from anyone in any capacity."
paras.zh: “到处都是死胡同；没有任何人以任何身份进行任何沟通。”

paras.en: Ms Chesworth said the situation left staff and the business "vulnerable to a disease that animals can't be vaccinated for".
paras.zh: 切斯沃斯女士表示，这种情况使员工和企业“很容易受到动物无法接种疫苗的疾病的影响”。

paras.en: "It puts us at a high risk. It's hard enough to secure staff with skills," she said.
paras.zh: “这让我们面临很高的风险。要找到有技能的员工已经够难的了，”她说。

paras.en: "We had an experience two summers ago when two staff members contracted Q fever and they were really sick.
paras.zh: “两年前的夏天，我们有过一次经历，当时两名工作人员感染了 Q 热，他们病得很厉害。

paras.en: "We had a seven-year-old grandson contract Q fever … people can't be done until they're 15, there are so many problems."
paras.zh: “我们有一个 7 岁的孙子患有合同 Q 热……人们要到 15 岁才能完成任务，有很多问题。”

paras.en: Mr Larkins said the Q fever vaccine was "an exceptionally complex product to manufacture", with each batch taking nine months to produce using an inactivated form of the bacteria.
paras.zh: 拉金斯表示，Q 热疫苗是“一种制造起来极其复杂的产品”，每批疫苗都需要九个月的时间才能使用灭活的细菌生产。

paras.en: "Over the last 12 months we've seen an unfortunate situation where we've had a combination of raw material supply issues … and then we've had unexpected manufacturing equipment issues on our filling lines with our electronic system," he said.
paras.zh: “在过去的 12 个月里，我们看到了一种不幸的情况，我们遇到了原材料供应问题……然后我们的电子系统灌装线上出现了意外的制造设备问题，”他说。

paras.en: "It's been a perfect storm where we've been unable to release about three or four batches to the market that were coming through this nine-month cycle period.
paras.zh: “这是一场完美的风暴，我们无法在这九个月的周期内向市场发布大约三到四批产品。

paras.en: "We think from later this year or early next year the constrained supply situation will ease up and we'll be able to get that product out to customers."
paras.zh: “我们认为从今年晚些时候或明年初开始，供应紧张的情况将会缓解，我们将能够将该产品提供给客户。”

paras.en: Mr Larkins said the company expected production issues to ease after moving operations to two new, state-of-the-art sites in Melbourne.
paras.zh: 拉金斯先生表示，该公司预计在将业务转移到墨尔本两个最先进的新工厂后，生产问题将会得到缓解。

paras.en: Nurse and shearer Carol Mudford said she waited five years to get a Q fever vaccine after she started working in the sheds in 2020.
paras.zh: 护士兼剪羊毛工卡罗尔·穆德福德 (Carol Mudford) 表示，自 2020 年开始在棚屋工作后，她等了五年才接种 Q 热疫苗。

paras.en: "It's either not been available or very difficult to get for the last five, six years," she said.
paras.zh: “在过去的五六年里，要么无法获得，要么很难获得，”她说。

paras.en: "People want it and need it and it will save lives."
paras.zh: “人们想要它并且需要它，它将拯救生命。”

paras.en: Ms Mudford said Q fever was a public health problem, not just an agricultural issue.
paras.zh: 穆德福德女士表示，Q热是一个公共卫生问题，而不仅仅是一个农业问题。

paras.en: "A lot of people still don't know about Q fever; we need more awareness because anyone in rural Australia is at risk," she said.
paras.zh: “很多人仍然不了解 Q 热；我们需要更多的认识，因为澳大利亚农村地区的任何人都面临风险，”她说。

paras.en: "It is highly contagious as a bacteria that travels in the dust.
paras.zh: “作为一种在灰尘中传播的细菌，它具有高度传染性。

paras.en: "It spreads very well; it can linger on clothing that comes back to a family home, through dust that flies off a livestock truck or spread through mowing lawns."
paras.zh: “它传播得很好；它可以残留在带回家的衣服上，通过牲畜卡车飞扬的灰尘或通过修剪的草坪传播。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Health Department said in a statement that CSL Seqirus was responsible for managing the manufacture and commercial supply of Q-VAX, "including distribution arrangements and the allocation of available stock".
paras.zh: 卫生部发言人在一份声明中表示，CSL Seqirus 负责管理 Q-VAX 的生产和商业供应，“包括分销安排和可用库存的分配”。

paras.en: "This arrangement with CSL Seqirus, over 10 years and worth $1 billion, supports the continued availability of domestic manufacturing capability," they said.
paras.zh: 他们表示：“与 CSL Seqirus 的这项协议历时 10 年，价值 10 亿美元，支持国内制造能力的持续可用性。”

articles.title: Setting timber ceilings on fire in the name safety and research
articles.author: Sarah Richards

paras.en: Queensland researchers are using supervised fires to investigate how to develop safer timber buildings.
paras.zh: 昆士兰研究人员正在利用监督火灾来研究如何开发更安全的木结构建筑。

paras.en: Under the supervision of firefighters, researchers monitored fires that reached about 1,000 degrees Celsius.
paras.zh: 在消防员的监督下，研究人员监测了温度达到约 1000 摄氏度的火灾。

paras.en: Fire engineer Mick Conway said understanding new materials and innovative design was crucial to building safer timber structures.
paras.zh: 消防工程师米克·康威表示，了解新材料和创新设计对于建造更安全的木结构至关重要。

paras.en: Queensland researchers investigating how to improve the safety of timber houses have set ceiling compartments on fire at temperatures of about 1,000 degrees Celsius.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州的研究人员正在研究如何提高木屋的安全性，他们在大约 1000 摄氏度的温度下点燃了天花板隔间。

paras.en: Firefighters supervised the tests, which were monitored with live streaming cameras and heat-and pressure-sensing instruments.
paras.zh: 消防队员监督了测试，并通过实时流媒体摄像头和热压力传感仪器进行监控。

paras.en: "It was a pretty unreal experience," University of Queensland's PhD candidate Josh Madden said.
paras.zh: “这是一次非常不真实的经历，”昆士兰大学的博士生乔什·马登说。

paras.en: The research is central to a PhD project he led and part of a wider body of work at the ARC Research Hub to Advance Timber for Australia's Future Built Environment.
paras.zh: 这项研究是他领导的博士项目的核心，也是 ARC 研究中心为澳大利亚未来建筑环境推进木材发展的更广泛工作的一部分。

paras.en: "For me, being a researcher, I know all the theory behind it … It was pretty eye-opening," he said.
paras.zh: “对我来说，作为一名研究人员，我知道其背后的所有理论......这真是令人大开眼界，”他说。

paras.en: Mr Madden, who has worked as a fire safety engineer, said mass timber was becoming increasingly common in the building sector.
paras.zh: 曾担任消防安全工程师的马登先生表示，大量木材在建筑领域变得越来越普遍。

paras.en: "Current fire safety guidance was generally built around the assumption that structural materials don't burn," he said.
paras.zh: “当前的消防安全指南通常是围绕结构材料不燃烧的假设制定的，”他说。

paras.en: "But the issue with timber is that timber actually burns."
paras.zh: “但木材的问题在于木材实际上会燃烧。”

paras.en: Mass timber is engineered layers of wood compressed, glued, or nailed together to form uniform panels and slabs.
paras.zh: 大体积木材是经过压缩、粘合或钉在一起形成均匀的面板和厚板的工程木材层。

paras.en: The product is a faster alternative to steel and concrete and can be constructed off-site.
paras.zh: 该产品是钢材和混凝土的更快替代品，并且可以在场外建造。

paras.en: "In traditional concrete building, you need to wait a month for the concrete to cure," Mr Madden said.
paras.zh: “在传统的混凝土建筑中，你需要等待一个月才能让混凝土固化，”马登先生说。

paras.en: "Whereas a timber building can just essentially be like Lego bricks. You can just go in, click it all together."
paras.zh: “而木结构建筑本质上就像乐高积木一样。你可以进去，把它们全部放在一起。”

paras.en: The experiment, conducted at the Queensland Fire Department's (QFD) training ground at the Port of Brisbane, each time slightly changed the design parameters of the cross-laminated timber ceiling compartments, such as the ventilation and ceiling's height.
paras.zh: 该实验在布里斯班港昆士兰消防局 (QFD) 训练场进行，每次都会稍微改变交叉层压木材天花板隔间的设计参数，例如通风和天花板高度。

paras.en: "We built these large 12-metre-long compartments which are about 2.5 metres wide," Mr Madden said.
paras.zh: “我们建造了这些 12 米长、宽约 2.5 米的大型隔间，”Madden 先生说。

paras.en: "We essentially ignite the fire down one end and watch how fire spreads underneath the ceiling."
paras.zh: “我们基本上是从一端点燃火，然后观察火如何在天花板下蔓延。”

paras.en: Timber loses strength at about 60C and loses all its strength at roughly 300C onwards.
paras.zh: 木材在大约 60°C 时会失去强度，在大约 300°C 之后会失去所有强度。

paras.en: "We got some of our temperature readings going up to about 1,000 degrees Celsius."
paras.zh: “我们得到的一些温度读数高达 1000 摄氏度左右。”

paras.en: UQ and the QFD have been sharing information to help improve public safety since 2014.
paras.zh: 自 2014 年以来，昆士兰大学和 QFD 一直在共享信息，以帮助改善公共安全。

paras.en: QFD fire engineer Mick Conway said understanding new materials and innovative design was crucial to building safer timber structures.
paras.zh: QFD 消防工程师 Mick Conway 表示，了解新材料和创新设计对于建造更安全的木结构至关重要。
