paras.en: "By burning materials under experimental conditions, our firefighters are learning things that they otherwise might have had to experience for the first time in a live scenario," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“通过在实验条件下燃烧材料，我们的消防员正在学习他们可能必须在现场场景中第一次经历的事情。”

paras.en: The test results are being analysed and will be presented in Mr Madden's final thesis.
paras.zh: 测试结果正在分析中，并将在马登先生的期末论文中呈现。

paras.en: "What we're trying to develop is this sort of design methodology or framework for fire safety engineers to go out and have the confidence to be able to build these buildings," Mr Madden said.
paras.zh: 马登先生说：“我们正在努力开发这种设计方法或框架，让消防安全工程师有信心能够建造这些建筑物。”

paras.en: "If we have the knowledge and expertise to be able to design these safely, hopefully the idea will be that we'll see lots more of these beautiful massive buildings."
paras.zh: “如果我们拥有能够安全设计这些的知识和专业知识，希望我们能看到更多这些美丽的大型建筑。”

articles.title: Joining lawsuit, Kennedy family members say Trump's arch would be 'denigration' of JFK, RFK plots at Arlington

paras.en: Joining lawsuit, Kennedy family members say Trump's arch would be 'denigration' of JFK, RFK plots at Arlington
paras.zh: 肯尼迪家族成员加入诉讼，称特朗普的拱门将是对肯尼迪、肯尼迪在阿灵顿阴谋的“诽谤”

paras.en: Legal filing comes with Trump administration eager to break ground on temporarily blocked project
paras.zh: 特朗普政府急于在暂时受阻的项目上破土动工，提交法律文件

paras.en: Nine family members of the Kennedy political dynasty asked a judge on Tuesday to block U.S. President Donald Trump's plan to build a towering memorial arch, saying the 250-foot (76-metre) structure would cast a shadow over their relatives' gravesites at Arlington National Cemetery.
paras.zh: 肯尼迪政治王朝的九名家族成员周二请求法官阻止美国总统唐纳德·特朗普建造一座高耸的纪念拱门的计划，称这座250英尺（76米）高的建筑会给他们亲人在阿灵顿国家公墓的墓地投下阴影。

paras.en: The shadow would "fundamentally alter the experience of visiting the gravesites," the relatives argued. They filed a motion to intervene in two existing lawsuits seeking to block construction of the arch.
paras.zh: 亲戚们认为，阴影将“从根本上改变参观墓地的体验”。他们提出了一项动议，要求介入两起旨在阻止拱门建设的现有诉讼。

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan last week prohibited the Trump administration from breaking ground on the structure for 14 days.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官 Tanya Chutkan 上周禁止特朗普政府在 14 天内破土动工。

paras.en: The nine Kennedy family members who filed suit are children and grandchildren of Robert F. Kennedy and Edward M. Kennedy, brothers of the slain U.S. president John F. Kennedy, both of whom served in the U.S. Senate. They are buried close to the eternal flame that marks JFK's gravesite, a trio of memorials that are a major draw for the millions of people who visit the Arlington cemetery each year.
paras.zh: 提起诉讼的九名肯尼迪家族成员是被杀的美国总统约翰·F·肯尼迪的兄弟罗伯特·F·肯尼迪和爱德华·M·肯尼迪的子孙，两人都曾在美国参议院任职。它们被埋葬在肯尼迪墓地的永恒火焰附近，这三座纪念碑对每年参观阿灵顿公墓的数百万人来说是一大吸引力。

paras.en: Sen. Tammy Duckworth, of Illinois, speaks at a demonstration against U.S. President Donald Trump's proposed arch on Oct. 1 in Washington. (Kylie Cooper/Reuters)
paras.zh: 10 月 1 日，伊利诺伊州参议员塔米·达克沃斯 (Tammy Duckworth) 在华盛顿举行的反对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普提议的拱门的示威活动中发表讲话。 （凯莉库珀/路透社）

paras.en: Building the arch would be a "permanent denigration" of the gravesites, lawyers for the relatives wrote.
paras.zh: 亲属的律师写道，建造拱门将是对墓地的“永久侮辱”。

paras.en: "The Arch would significantly damage the memorial to the Kennedys, as well as the heroes who eternally rest at Arlington National Cemetery," the filing said.
paras.zh: 文件称：“拱门将严重损坏肯尼迪家族的纪念碑，以及永远安息在阿灵顿国家公墓的英雄纪念碑。”

paras.en: "It is unfortunate to see that some members of the Kennedy family have joined the litigation against the Arch, as the project is intended to honour our heroes who rest in Arlington Cemetery," said White House spokesperson Davis Ingle. "The judiciary should not be abused to politicize a structure designed to unite our nation."
paras.zh: 白宫发言人戴维斯·英格尔说：“不幸的是，肯尼迪家族的一些成员加入了针对拱门的诉讼，因为该项目旨在纪念安息在阿灵顿公墓的英雄。” “司法机构不应该被滥用，将旨在团结我们国家的结构政治化。”

paras.en: Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Trump's health and human services secretary, who has a fractured relationship with many of his relatives, did not join the lawsuit.
paras.zh: 特朗普的卫生与公共服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪(Robert F. Kennedy Jr.)没有加入诉讼，他与许多亲戚关系破裂。

paras.en: The arch project is one of several around Washington that the Republican president has undertaken as he alters the capital to his tastes — from renovating one of its storied public golf courses, to threatening to demolish the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts. Those projects could soon face intense scrutiny as Democrats will take control of Congress in early January after the results of last week's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 这座拱门项目是这位共和党总统在华盛顿周边实施的几个项目之一，他根据自己的喜好改造首都——从翻新一座著名的公共高尔夫球场，到威胁拆除约翰·F·肯尼迪表演艺术中心。随着上周中期选举结果公布后，民主党将于一月初控制国会，这些项目可能很快就会面临严格审查。

paras.en: The White House last week unveiled a glitzy new website to showcase the arch, which is slated to rise in a mass of gold ornamentation and stately grey granite between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery.
paras.zh: 白宫上周推出了一个炫目的新网站来展示这座拱门，该拱门预计将在林肯纪念堂和阿灵顿国家公墓之间矗立在大量金色装饰和庄严的灰色花岗岩中。

paras.en: The family is represented by veteran Washington lawyer Norm Eisen and Democracy Defenders Fund. Eisen and his organization have also filed lawsuits against the Kennedy Center plans and represented a man who successfully fought off prosecution related to an incident at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, after Trump ordered renovations for that Washington, D.C., monument in a no-bid contract.
paras.zh: 该家族由华盛顿资深律师诺姆·艾森和民主捍卫者基金会代表。艾森和他的组织还针对肯尼迪中心的计划提起了诉讼，并代表一名男子成功地避免了与林肯纪念堂倒影池事件相关的起诉，此前特朗普在一份无投标合同中下令对华盛顿特区的这座纪念碑进行翻修。

articles.title: Jim Jordan, once called a 'legislative terrorist' by a top Republican, will now lead the party in U.S. House
articles.author: Chris Iorfida

paras.en: Jim Jordan, once called a 'legislative terrorist' by a top Republican, will now lead the party in U.S. House
paras.zh: 曾被共和党高层称为“立法恐怖分子”的吉姆·乔丹现在将在美国众议院领导该党

paras.en: Democrats say the pick reflects Republicans rejecting message to them in last week's midterms
paras.zh: 民主党人表示，这一选择反映出共和党人拒绝在上周的中期选举中向他们传达的信息

paras.en: The Republicans may have just lost control of the House of Representatives in resounding fashion, but they signalled Tuesday they may not be in a conciliatory mood with Democrats, picking combative Ohio Rep. Jim Jordan as their leader in the chamber.
paras.zh: 共和党可能刚刚以响亮的方式失去了对众议院的控制权，但他们周二表示，他们可能不会对民主党抱有和解情绪，并选择好斗的俄亥俄州众议员吉姆·乔丹作为众议院领袖。

paras.en: Jordan, a longtime ally of U.S. President Donald Trump, emerged from a closed-door session with party colleagues Tuesday as the winner over Rep. Steve Scalise of Louisiana to become House minority leader.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的长期盟友乔丹周二在与党内同僚的闭门会议上击败路易斯安那州众议员史蒂夫·斯卡利斯，成为众议院少数党领袖。

paras.en: Jordan, 62, said Republicans would focus on fighting for American families over the next two years.
paras.zh: 62 岁的乔丹表示，共和党人将在未来两年专注于为美国家庭而战。

paras.en: “When Democrats offer more government, we’ll offer more freedom,” he said. “We will bring that fight in committee, on the floor and on the stump every single day.”
paras.zh: “当民主党提供更多政府时，我们将提供更多自由，”他说。 “我们每天都会在委员会、会场和树桩上进行这场斗争。”

paras.en: Jordan, once described as the "walking embodiment of conflict-mindedness" by a member of the conservative Federalist Society, was first elected to Congress in 2006. He was seen as one of the prime Republicans legislators responsible for a 16-day shutdown in late 2013 over a government funding bill, in opposition to plans from Barack Obama's administration to push ahead with landmark health-care legislation.
paras.zh: 乔丹曾被保守派联邦党人协会的一名成员形容为“冲突意识的活生生体现”，他于 2006 年首次当选国会议员。他被认为是主要共和党议员之一，他因一项政府拨款法案而导致 2013 年年底政府停摆 16 天，反对巴拉克·奥巴马政府推动具有里程碑意义的医疗保健立法的计划。

paras.en: Not seeing his party's leadership as sufficiently to the right, Jordan soon founded the House Freedom Caucus with Ron DeSantis, Mark Meadows (North Carolina) and Mick Mulvaney (South Carolina). DeSantis would eventually leave Congress for two terms as Florida governor, while Meadows and Mulvaney served in the first Trump administration.
paras.zh: 乔丹认为自己的政党的领导层不够右倾，因此很快与罗恩·德桑蒂斯、马克·梅多斯（北卡罗来纳州）和米克·马尔瓦尼（南卡罗来纳州）成立了众议院自由核心小组。德桑蒂斯最终离开国会，担任佛罗里达州州长两届，而梅多斯和马尔瓦尼则在特朗普第一届政府任职。

paras.en: John Boehner, the former Republican House Speaker from Ohio who often bore the brunt of appeals from that caucus, once described Jordan as a "legislative terrorist."
paras.zh: 来自俄亥俄州的前共和党众议院议长约翰·博纳经常在核心小组的呼吁中首当其冲，他曾将乔丹描述为“立法恐怖分子”。

paras.en: "I just never saw a guy who spent more time tearing things apart — never building anything, never putting anything together," Boehner told CBS News in a 2021 interview.
paras.zh: 博纳在 2021 年接受哥伦比亚广播公司新闻采访时表示：“我从来没有见过一个人会花更多时间把东西拆散，从不建造任何东西，从不把任何东西组装在一起。”

paras.en: Boehner's comments may not have been just a matter of a retired politician settling scores.
paras.zh: 博纳的言论可能不仅仅是一位退休政治家算账的问题。

paras.en: Two years ago, the Center for Effective Lawmaking rated Jordan 202nd out of 205 House Republicans in terms of legislative effectiveness. The ongoing joint project between the University of Virginia and Vanderbilt University examines a number of criteria, including number of bills sponsored, whether the bills made it into or out of committees, and whether they were subsequently passed by the House.
paras.zh: 两年前，有效立法中心将约旦的立法有效性评为在 205 名众议院共和党议员中排名第 202 位。弗吉尼亚大学和范德比尔特大学正在进行的联合项目审查了一系列标准，包括提案的数量、这些法案是否进入或退出委员会，以及这些法案随后是否获得众议院通过。

paras.en: - Republicans took big hits in the U.S. midterms. Does that mean Trump's political era is over?
paras.zh: - 共和党在美国中期选举中遭受重创。这是否意味着特朗普的政治时代结束了？

paras.en: - Analysis JD Vance blames Iran war for midterm thumping. Is he really blaming Trump?
paras.zh: - 分析 JD 万斯将中期选举的重击归咎于伊朗战争。他真的在指责特朗普吗？

paras.en: Passing legislation is never the prime responsibility of a minority leader however, as Alyssa Farah Griffin hinted at in a post on Tuesday. Griffin, who served in the first Trump administration and is now a panelist on The View, praised Jordan's elevation.
paras.zh: 然而，正如阿莉莎·法拉·格里芬周二在一篇帖子中暗示的那样，通过立法从来都不是少数党领袖的主要责任。格里芬曾在第一届特朗普政府任职，现在是《观点》的小组成员，他对乔丹的晋升表示赞赏。

paras.en: "In the new Congress, House Republicans will have very little actual power," she said. "They need a pitbull who will fight it out with Democrats, and on TV and who has the ear of the [White House]. That’s Jim Jordan."
paras.zh: “在新一届国会中，众议院共和党人的实际权力非常小，”她说。 “他们需要一只斗牛犬，能够与民主党人一决高下，在电视上，并且能得到[白宫]的注意。那就是吉姆·乔丹。”

paras.en: Democratic legislators and pundits argued Jordan’s selection suggested that Republicans aren't receiving the message sent to them last week in the midterms.
paras.zh: 民主党议员和专家认为，乔丹的当选表明共和党人没有收到上周在中期选举中发送给他们的信息。

paras.en: Democrats so far have gained a new total of 42 seats in the 435-member House — they have flipped 44 Republican seats, while Republicans flipped 2 Democrat seats — with 13 races yet to be called.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，民主党在 435 名议员的众议院中获得了新的 42 个席位，他们已经推翻了 44 个共和党席位，而共和党则推翻了 2 个民主党席位，还有 13 场比赛尚未揭晓。

paras.en: “I would think that they would want somebody that was going to moderate towards what the voters want. They lost so many Republican voters,” said Rep. Pramila Jayapal, a Democrat from Washington. “Obviously that’s not the case.”
paras.zh: “我认为他们会想要一个能够温和地迎合选民想要的东西的人。他们失去了很多共和党选民，”来自华盛顿的民主党众议员普拉米拉·贾亚帕尔说。 “显然事实并非如此。”

paras.en: Former U.S. senator and Saturday Night Live cast member Al Franken quipped on social media: "Picking Jim Jordan to be Minority Leader is surviving Republican House members saying, 'We heard you, America!'"
paras.zh: 前美国参议员、《周六夜现场》剧组成员艾尔·弗兰肯在社交媒体上打趣道：“选择吉姆·乔丹担任少数党领袖，就像幸存的共和党众议院议员在说，‘美国，我们听到了你的声音！’”

paras.en: Jordan has been a vigorous defender of the current president, excoriating special counsel investigations into Trump's 2016 campaign contacts with Russia and his handling of classified documents as a private citizen. Leading up to Trump's 2019 impeachment related to foreign policy with Ukraine, Jordan encouraged a group of Republicans who stormed a closed-door deposition, a move Lindsey Graham, the late Republican senator from South Carolina, called "nuts."
paras.zh: 乔丹一直是现任总统的积极捍卫者，谴责特别检察官对特朗普 2016 年竞选期间与俄罗斯的接触以及他作为普通公民处理机密文件的调查。在特朗普 2019 年因乌克兰外交政策而被弹劾之前，乔丹鼓励一群共和党人对闭门证词进行猛烈抨击，南卡罗来纳州已故共和党参议员林赛·格雷厄姆 (Lindsey Graham) 称此举“疯狂”。

paras.en: Jordan ran for House Speaker in 2023, but couldn't get the necessary votes. Some lawmakers reported they had received threats of violence in emails and phone calls from citizens supporting Jordan's effort.
paras.zh: 乔丹于 2023 年竞选众议院议长，但未能获得必要的选票。一些立法者报告说，他们收到了支持约旦努力的公民通过电子邮件和电话发出的暴力威胁。

paras.en: In a social media post Tuesday, Ayanna Pressley, Democratic representative from Massachusetts, highlighted what she saw as a number of Jordan's failings, leading with his activities supporting Trump's election denialism after his 2020 loss to Joe Biden.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞州民主党代表阿亚娜·普莱斯利 (Ayanna Pressley) 在周二的社交媒体帖子中强调了她所认为的乔丹的一些失败，其中包括在 2020 年输给乔·拜登后，他支持特朗普的选举否认主义活动。

paras.en: The committee with seven Democrats and two Republicans that examined the 2020 election and the lead-up to the Jan. 6, 2021, riot at the Capitol said in its final report that Jordan led a conference call four days earlier "in which he, President Trump, and other members of Congress discussed strategies for delaying the Jan. 6 joint session" to certify Biden's win.
paras.zh: 由七名民主党人和两名共和党人组成的委员会负责审查 2020 年大选以及 2021 年 1 月 6 日国会大厦骚乱的准备情况，在其最终报告中表示，乔丹在四天前主持了一次电话会议，“他、特朗普总统和其他国会议员在会上讨论了推迟 1 月 6 日联席会议的策略”，以证明拜登的胜利。

paras.en: The panel wanted to hear more from Jordan about his communications with the White House during those feverish days, but he defied a subpoena. Despite that fact, in his time as a leading Republican member of the House's judiciary and oversight committees, Jordan has frequently been in favour of issuing subpoenas to elicit testimony in Congress.
paras.zh: 专家组希望更多地了解乔丹在那些狂热的日子里与白宫的沟通，但他拒绝了传票。尽管如此，在担任众议院司法和监督委员会的主要共和党成员期间，乔丹经常赞成发出传票以在国会获取证词。

paras.en: Trump honoured Jordan five days after the Capitol riot with the Presidential Medal of Freedom, praising him as "an inspiration to freedom-loving Americans everywhere."
paras.zh: 国会大厦骚乱五天后，特朗普向乔丹授予总统自由勋章，称赞他“激励了世界各地热爱自由的美国人”。

paras.en: Jordan might also be considered an interesting choice in terms of optics, given how prominently Jeffrey Epstein figured in hundreds of midterm campaign ads before the convicted sex offender died in 2019. On the same day Jordan was named minority leader, a Republican-led committee issued a report finding fault with the Trump administration's handling of the Epstein files, with the release leading to some female victims and accusers having their identities revealed when their names should have been redacted.
paras.zh: 考虑到杰弗里·爱泼斯坦 (Jeffrey Epstein) 在 2019 年被定罪的性犯罪者去世之前在数百个中期竞选广告中的显着地位，乔丹在光学方面也可能被认为是一个有趣的选择。在乔丹被任命为少数党领袖的同一天，共和党领导的委员会发布了一份报告，对特朗普政府处理爱泼斯坦文件的方式提出了错误，该报告的发布导致一些女性受害者和原告的身份在本应被隐去的情况下被泄露。

paras.en: Jordan, a two-time NCAA wrestling champion at Ohio State, later served as an assistant coach for the university from 1986 to 1994. That period of time encompassed a small portion of a two-decade period in which a physician who worked for the school's athletic department was alleged to have sexually abused athletes.
paras.zh: 乔丹是俄亥俄州立大学两届 NCAA 摔跤冠军，后来从 1986 年到 1994 年担任该大学的助理教练。那段时期只占了该校体育部门一名医生被指控对运动员进行性虐待的二十年时间的一小部分。

paras.en: Watch: Miller move shows White House not looking to moderate:
paras.zh: 观看：米勒的举动表明白宫不打算采取温和措施：

paras.en: Some former wrestlers say Jordan was among those who knew of the allegations and failed to intervene in a meaningful way, though Jordan has denied any such knowledge of any abuse taking place.
paras.zh: 一些前摔跤手表示，乔丹是了解这些指控的人之一，但未能以有意义的方式进行干预，尽管乔丹否认对发生的任何虐待行为有任何了解。

paras.en: In 2022, when reports emerged that a 10-year-old Ohio girl had to travel across state lines to get an abortion after being raped, Jordan suggested in a social media post that it was "another lie" from Democratic and progressive factions. He deleted the tweet after the allegations were confirmed.
paras.zh: 2022 年，当有报道称一名 10 岁俄亥俄州女孩在被强奸后不得不跨越州界去堕胎时，乔丹在社交媒体帖子中表示，这是民主党和进步派系的“另一个谎言”。指控得到证实后，他删除了这条推文。

paras.en: As the Republicans settled on Jordan in the House on Tuesday, their Senate colleagues voted to keep John Thune as their leader in that chamber.
paras.zh: 周二，当共和党在众议院就乔丹达成一致时，他们的参议院同事投票决定让约翰·图恩继续担任众议院的领导人。

paras.en: The Democrats have yet to formally deliberate on who will lead them as House Speaker and Senate majority leader in the next Congress. The House leadership decision is expected next week, with the Democratic senators to vote for their leaders in early December.
paras.zh: 民主党尚未正式审议谁将在下一届国会中领导他们担任众议院议长和参议院多数党领袖。众议院领导层预计将于下周作出决定，民主党参议员将在 12 月初投票选出他们的领导人。

articles.title: Missing baby rescued after being buried alive in a dog crate in South Carolina

paras.en: Missing baby rescued after being buried alive in a dog crate in South Carolina
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州一名失踪婴儿被活埋在狗笼中，后被成功救出

paras.en: Searchers found the infant wrapped in a towel about 24 hours after he was reported missing
paras.zh: 据称失踪大约24小时后，搜救人员发现了裹着毛巾的婴儿

paras.en: A missing 11-month-old infant was rescued Tuesday after being buried alive in a dog crate in South Carolina.
paras.zh: 一名失踪的 11 个月大婴儿周二在南卡罗来纳州被活埋在狗笼中后获救。

paras.en: A county sheriff says little Koah Sharp had been underground for about 24 hours but survived, likely due to an air pocket created by a towel wrapped around the crate. Cool temperatures may also have helped.
paras.zh: 一名县治安官表示，小科阿·夏普 (Koah Sharp) 在地下呆了大约 24 小时，但幸存下来，可能是因为板条箱周围缠着毛巾形成了气穴。凉爽的温度也可能有所帮助。

paras.en: Dozens of first responders combed the countryside for the "bright boy with reddish blond hair" that the sheriff's office said had disappeared while his grandmother ran errands.
paras.zh: 数十名急救人员在乡村搜寻了这名“有着红金色头发的聪明男孩”，治安官办公室称他在他的祖母外出办事时失踪了。

paras.en: After a full day of searching, authorities found freshly disturbed soil in the woods not far from the home of the boy's grandfather. They began digging and soon unearthed the baby, who was "clinging to life," the sheriff said.
paras.zh: 经过一整天的搜寻，当局在距离男孩祖父家不远的树林里发现了新翻动的土壤。警长说，他们开始挖掘，很快就发现了婴儿，他“还活着”。

paras.en: "Certainly, God is good," Lexington County Sheriff Jay Koon said at a news conference, not long after Koah was found. "He was screaming at the top of his lungs, which is a good thing in the baby world, I would guess."
paras.zh: “当然，上帝是良善的，”科阿被发现后不久，列克星敦县治安官杰伊·库恩在新闻发布会上说道。 “他用尽全力尖叫，我猜这对婴儿世界来说是一件好事。”

paras.en: A photo provided by the Lexington County Sheriff's office in Lexington, S.C., shows Michael Comer in custody after his son was found buried alive. (Lexington County Sheriff's Office/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州列克星敦县治安官办公室提供的一张照片显示，迈克尔·科默的儿子被发现被活埋后被拘留。 （列克星敦县治安官办公室/美联社）

paras.en: The child's father, Michael Comer, 25, was arrested and was being held without bond on a burglary charge, Koon said. Investigators were working with prosecutors to confirm further charges, he said.
paras.zh: 库恩说，孩子 25 岁的父亲迈克尔·科默 (Michael Comer) 因入室盗窃罪被捕，不得保释。他说，调查人员正在与检察官合作以确认进一步的指控。

paras.en: Koah, who disappeared Monday in the county just west of Columbia, was taken to a hospital. His condition was not immediately known Wednesday.
paras.zh: 科阿周一在哥伦比亚西部的县失踪，被送往医院。周三，他的病情尚未立即得知。

paras.en: "We're better now that we know that Koah is safe," his great aunt, Amber Hammond, told The Associated Press in an interview. She was watching as he was freed from the crate.
paras.zh: “我们现在好多了，因为我们知道科阿很安全，”他的姨婆安布尔·哈蒙德在接受美联社采访时告诉美联社。她看着他从板条箱中被释放出来。

paras.en: Deputies who searched the grandfather's home found the doors open and baby belongings inside, but they did not see Comer or the child, the sheriff said. Then the digging started.
paras.zh: 治安官说，搜查祖父家的警员发现门开着，里面有婴儿物品，但他们没有看到科默或孩子。然后挖掘开始了。

paras.en: "It was shallow," Koon said. "It was probably about at least a foot from the top of that crate to the top of the ground."
paras.zh: “它很浅，”库恩说。 “从那个板条箱的顶部到地面的顶部可能至少有一英尺左右。”

paras.en: It was not immediately known if Comer had a lawyer. A phone number could not be found for him. The Associated Press sent emails seeking information to the public defender and prosecutors.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚科默是否有律师。找不到他的电话号码。美联社向公设辩护人和检察官发送了寻求信息的电子邮件。

paras.en: Nearly 100 first responders participated in the search.
paras.zh: 近100名急救人员参与了搜寻。

paras.en: Authorities said Koah had been in the care of Comer's mother. She had to run an errand and left the boy in Comer's care. Another caregiver was on the way, Koon said.
paras.zh: 当局称科阿一直由科默的母亲照顾。她要去办点事，把男孩交给科默照顾。库恩说，另一名护理人员正在路上。

paras.en: "By the time the caregiver got there, Michael was gone, and Koah was gone with him," Koon said.
paras.zh: “当护理人员到达那里时，迈克尔已经走了，科阿也跟着他走了，”库恩说。

paras.en: - Quebec toddler found alive and well after intensive 4-day search, police say
paras.zh: - 警方称，经过四天的密集搜查，魁北克幼儿被发现还活着，状况良好

paras.en: - B.C. man who went missing in mountains for several days found alive
paras.zh: - BC山里失踪多日的男子被发现生还

paras.en: Surveillance video from several businesses in the area showed Comer without the infant on Monday afternoon, Koon said. The father was found Monday night and was arrested.
paras.zh: 库恩说，该地区几家企业的监控视频显示，周一下午科默没有带婴儿。周一晚上，父亲被发现并被捕。

paras.en: Koah's parents "have had some situations" regarding domestic violence charges, the sheriff said.
paras.zh: 治安官说，科阿的父母在家庭暴力指控方面“遇到过一些情况”。

paras.en: "Children," he said, "sometimes get caught in the middle."
paras.zh: “孩子们，”他说，“有时会被夹在中间。”

paras.en: Comer was sentenced to probation in October after pleading guilty to domestic violence and aggravated breach-of-peace charges related to an arrest in July, Lexington County online court records show. Prosecutors dropped a gun charge as part of the plea deal.
paras.zh: 列克星敦县在线法庭记录显示，科默在承认家庭暴力以及与 7 月份逮捕相关的严重破坏和平罪名后，于 10 月份被判处缓刑。作为认罪协议的一部分，检察官撤销了枪支指控。

articles.title: Wael Mohya could make German football history at 17

paras.en: If you watch the Bundesliga, then you'll know Wael Mohya is a fast-footed, quick-thinking footballer. But not even the 17-year-old (Mohya turns 18 on December 31) Borussia Mönchengladbach youngster would have expected to be called up to the Germany squad so soon.
paras.zh: 如果你看过德甲联赛，你就会知道瓦尔·莫希亚是一位脚步敏捷、思维敏捷的足球运动员。但即使是这位 17 岁的门兴格拉德巴赫小将（莫希亚将于 12 月 31 日年满 18 岁）也没有想到会这么快被征召入德国队。

paras.en: "Of course, I was absolutely thrilled. It means a great, great deal to me. I think everyone dreams of being selected for the national team at some point," Mohya said.
paras.zh: “当然，我非常兴奋。这对我来说意义重大。我想每个人都梦想在某个时候入选国家队，”莫希亚说。

paras.en: "And the fact that it's come to this now is, of course, just awesome and makes me very proud."
paras.zh: “当然，现在事情发展到这一步，真是太棒了，让我感到非常自豪。”

paras.en: Mohya was at the gym when the call came in. He then shared the good news with his parents over dinner. "They started crying," the teenager said in a video posted on Gladbach's social media channels.
paras.zh: 接到电话时，莫亚正在健身房。随后，他在晚餐时与父母分享了这个好消息。 “他们开始哭泣，”这名少年在格拉德巴赫社交媒体频道上发布的视频中说道。

paras.en: The youngster, who was born in a small town east of Düsseldorf, smiles and laughs a lot in interviews. He is always friendly, and in a good mood. On the field, too, he exudes the lightheartedness and carefree spirit of a 17-year-old.
paras.zh: 这位出生在杜塞尔多夫东部小镇的年轻人在采访中经常微笑。他总是很友善，心情也很好。在球场上，他也散发着17岁少年的轻松和无忧无虑的精神。

paras.en: As a technically skilled and creative player, Mohya often seeks out one-on-one situations and puts his opponents under pressure with quick dribbles. In nine Bundesliga appearances this season, Mohya has scored twice and delivered one assist.
paras.zh: 作为一名技术娴熟且富有创造力的球员，莫希亚经常寻找一对一的机会，并通过快速运球给对手施加压力。本赛季莫希亚在德甲出场9次，打进2球并送出1次助攻。

paras.en: "He's so cool and just plays really well. It's fun to watch him," Borussia coach Alexander Blessin said recently.
paras.zh: “他很酷，而且踢得非常好。看他踢球很有趣，”门兴教练亚历山大·布莱辛最近说道。

paras.en: "Wael brings a lot to the team with his laid-back attitude on the field. He's not afraid to take risks, no matter how much pressure there is," added Gladbach's sporting director Rouven Schröder at a talk show on Sport1.
paras.zh: “韦尔在场上悠闲的态度给球队带来了很多。无论压力有多大，他都不怕冒险，”格拉德巴赫的体育总监鲁文·施罗德在 Sport1 的脱口秀节目中补充道。

paras.en: Wael 'Waffel' Mohya working on and off the pitch
paras.zh: Wael 'Waffel' Mohya 在球场内外工作

paras.en: Borussia Mönchengladbach has been Mohya's sporting home since he was seven years old. Last season, previous head coach Eugen Polanski promoted him to the first team, and in December 2025, Mohya made his Bundesliga debut. Against Wolfsburg, aged 16 years and 347 days old, he became the youngest Bundesliga player in the club's history.
paras.zh: 从莫希亚七岁起，门兴格拉德巴赫就一直是他的运动之家。上赛季，前任主教练尤金·波兰斯基将他提拔至一线队，2025年12月，莫希亚完成了德甲首秀。对阵沃尔夫斯堡时，年仅16岁零347天的他成为俱乐部历史上最年轻的德甲球员。

paras.en: Mohya also recently completed a voluntary social year at an elementary school in Mönchengladbach. This is a program in Germany for young people who volunteer in the social sector — at hospitals, schools, or nursing homes, for example — for about six to 18 months. They gain work experience, help others, and earn a little money.
paras.zh: 莫希亚最近还在门兴格拉德巴赫的一所小学完成了志愿社交年活动。这是德国的一个项目，面向在社会部门（例如医院、学校或疗养院）做志愿者的年轻人，为期约 6 至 18 个月。他们获得工作经验，帮助别人，赚一点钱。

paras.en: At the school's open all-day care program, Mohya helped serve meals, assisted children with their homework, and played with them. That's also where his nickname comes from. Because a girl hadn't understood his first name correctly or couldn't pronounce it, she called him "Waffel." Now, that name has stuck.
paras.zh: 在学校的开放式全日托服务项目中，莫希亚帮助提供膳食、辅导孩子们做作业并与他们一起玩耍。这也是他的绰号的由来。因为一个女孩无法正确理解他的名字或无法发音，所以她称他为“华夫饼”。现在，这个名字已经被保留了下来。

paras.en: Even before being called up to the Germany team, clubs in the Bundesliga and across Europe's top leagues had taken notice of Mohya and were trying to sign him. His contract with Borussia Mönchengladbach runs through 2028.
paras.zh: 甚至在被征召入德国队之前，德甲和欧洲顶级联赛的俱乐部就已经注意到了莫希亚，并试图签下他。他与门兴格拉德巴赫的合同将持续到 2028 年。

paras.en: With Gladbach currently in a relegation battle, his future appears likely to be elsewhere. If the club wants to generate transfer revenue from its biggest talent, next summer would likely be the opportunity to sell him — unless he extends his contract with Borussia.
paras.zh: 由于格拉德巴赫目前正处于保级大战中，他的未来似乎可能在其他地方。如果俱乐部想从其最大的天才球员身上获得转会收入，明年夏天可能是出售他的机会——除非他与门兴续约。

paras.en: The 17-year-old's career is managed by his parents. Whichever club can convince them that their son is in good hands and help him reach his full potential likely has the best chance of securing Mohya's signing.
paras.zh: 这位17岁的年轻人的职业生涯由他的父母管理。无论哪家具乐部能让他们相信他们的儿子得到了良好的照顾并帮助他充分发挥潜力，都可能最有机会签下莫希亚。

paras.en: Mohya himself says he doesn't even know how much he's currently earning at Gladbach.
paras.zh: 莫希亚本人表示，他甚至不知道自己目前在格拉德巴赫的收入是多少。

paras.en: "My parents take care of all that," he told Bild recently. "I get a monthly allowance, which is more than enough for me."
paras.zh: “我的父母会照顾这一切，”他最近告诉《图片报》。 “我每个月都有零用钱，这对我来说绰绰有余。”

paras.en: Germany head coach Jürgen Klopp recently revealed how much he had enjoyed his conversations with the youngster.
paras.zh: 德国队主教练尤尔根·克洛普最近透露，他非常喜欢与这位年轻球员的谈话。

paras.en: "The conversations I had with him were great," Klopp said with a laugh. "I wasn't that confident at 17, but then again, I wasn't that good either."
paras.zh: “我和他的谈话很棒，”克洛普笑着说。 “17岁时我没有那么自信，但话又说回来，我也没有那么好。”

paras.en: Decision in favor of Germany over Morocco
paras.zh: 有利于德国而不是摩洛哥的决定

paras.en: Since Mohya's parents are from Morocco, their son also holds Moroccan citizenship. As a result, he could have played for Morocco, but he has now decided against it. In fact, the Moroccan football association had been actively courting Mohya as early as last year and had already reached out to him in the run-up to the 2026 World Cup.
paras.zh: 由于莫希亚的父母来自摩洛哥，他们的儿子也拥有摩洛哥公民身份。因此，他本来可以为摩洛哥效力，但他现在决定不去。事实上，摩洛哥足协早在去年就开始积极争取莫希亚，并在2026年世界杯前夕就已经与他进行了接触。

paras.en: Now, like Frankfurt's Younes Ebnoutalib, Mohya will continue to play in the German jersey, unlike Schalke's Soufiane El-Faouzi, who chose Morocco, or Bayer Leverkusen's Ibrahim Maza, who likely would have been selected by Klopp as well if he hadn't already opted for Algeria.
paras.zh: 现在，与法兰克福队的尤尼斯·埃布努塔利布一样，莫希亚将继续身披德国队球衣，不像沙尔克04队的苏菲安·法乌齐选择了摩洛哥，也不像勒沃库森队的易卜拉欣·马扎，如果他没有选择阿尔及利亚的话，他很可能也会被克洛普选中。

paras.en: For Mohya, who played for Germany's youth teams from the U16s through to the U21s, the door to Morocco remains open only as long as he hasn't yet played a competitive match for Germany. If Mohya plays in the upcoming UEFA Nations League games in Serbia or against the Netherlands, another record is on the horizon. Although there were two even younger players who made their debuts in the Germany jersey — Willy Baumgärtner in 1908 (at 17 years and 104 days) and Marius Hiller in 1910 (at 17 years and 241 days) — the era in which they debuted is hardly comparable. And so, while Wael Mohya would rank third overall on the list, he would become the youngest Germany player in the modern era. The youngest to date was Hamburg legend Uwe Seeler in 1954, aged 17 years and 345 days.
paras.zh: 对于从U16到U21为德国青年队效力的莫希亚来说，只有在他还没有为德国踢过正式比赛的情况下，摩洛哥的大门才会一直敞开。如果莫希亚参加即将在塞尔维亚举行的欧洲国家联赛或对阵荷兰的比赛，那么另一项纪录即将到来。尽管有两名更年轻的球员在德国球衣上首次亮相——1908年的威利·鲍姆加特纳（17岁零104天）和1910年的马吕斯·希勒（17岁零241天），但他们首次亮相的时代几乎没有可比性。因此，虽然瓦尔·莫亚在榜单上排名第三，但他将成为现代最年轻的德国球员。迄今为止最年轻的是1954年的汉堡传奇人物乌韦·席勒（Uwe Seeler），当时年仅17岁零345天。

articles.title: Is AIIB's complaint mechanism failing affected communities?

paras.en: For members of the Indigenous Sasak community on the Indonesian island of Lombok, the conflict over their land is not over.
paras.zh: 对于印度尼西亚龙目岛萨萨克族土著社区的成员来说，围绕其土地的冲突尚未结束。

paras.en: For them, a tourism and infrastructure project co-financed by the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) is a source of frustration, as they believe it has led to the expropriation of their land and destruction of their livelihoods.
paras.zh: 对他们来说，由亚洲基础设施投资银行（AIIB）共同资助的旅游和基础设施项目令人沮丧，因为他们认为该项目导致他们的土地被征用并破坏了他们的生计。

paras.en: In late September, they officially filed a complaint with the bank. It remains unclear whether this complaint will lead to an independent investigation.
paras.zh: 9月下旬，他们正式向银行提出投诉。目前尚不清楚该投诉是否会导致独立调查。

paras.en: The AIIB, which finances major infrastructure projects across Asia, has a mechanism in place to deal with such complaints.
paras.zh: 为亚洲各地的重大基础设施项目提供融资的亚投行已经制定了处理此类投诉的机制。

paras.en: Individuals who suffer adverse effects from the bank-financed projects may, under certain conditions, file a complaint with the institution.
paras.zh: 因银行资助项目而受到不利影响的个人在一定条件下可以向该机构提出投诉。

paras.en: However, access to this process — known as the Project Complaints Mechanism (PPM) — remains controversial.
paras.zh: 然而，进入这一流程——称为项目投诉机制（PPM）——仍然存在争议。

paras.en: According to a report by The Diplomat, a magazine that covers political and economic developments in Asia, none of the 45 complaints listed on the AIIB's website had been deemed admissible as of mid-September.
paras.zh: 据报道亚洲政治和经济发展的杂志《外交家》报道，截至 9 月中旬，亚投行网站上列出的 45 项投诉均未被视为可受理。

paras.en: The bank acknowledged that "no cases have passed the PPM's eligibility assessment," but it stressed that this is "only part of the story."
paras.zh: 该银行承认“没有案例通过 PPM 的资格评估”，但强调这“只是故事的一部分”。

paras.en: The AIIB emphasized that not every issue needs to be resolved through this mechanism.
paras.zh: 亚投行强调，并非所有问题都需要通过这一机制解决。

paras.en: The PPM is "only one part of AIIB's grievance redress ecosystem," the Beijing-based bank said in response to a query from DW.
paras.zh: 这家总部位于北京的银行在回应德国之声的询问时表示，PPM“只是亚投行申诉生态系统的一部分”。

paras.en: Those affected should first attempt to resolve concerns directly with the project team at the local level, it said.
paras.zh: 报告称，受影响者应首先尝试直接与当地项目团队解决问题。

paras.en: According to the bank, "twelve complaints were in fact resolved at the project level — as a direct result of AIIB's follow-up and intervention — and one was resolved through domestic courts."
paras.zh: 据该行称，“由于亚投行的跟进和干预，实际上有十二项投诉在项目层面得到了解决，其中一项是通过国内法院解决的。”

paras.en: But critics see this as a major weakness.
paras.zh: 但批评者认为这是一个主要弱点。

paras.en: "The mechanism must be easily accessible," said Arntraud Hartmann, a development economist at the Johns Hopkins University School of Advanced International Studies (SAIS Europe) in Bologna, Italy.
paras.zh: 意大利博洛尼亚约翰·霍普金斯大学高级国际研究学院（SAIS Europe）的发展经济学家阿恩特劳德·哈特曼（Arntraud Hartmann）表示：“该机制必须易于使用。”

paras.en: She argued that people affected by the projects, for instance, are required to document potential violations of environmental and social standards from the start. "How is the affected party supposed to know which standards might have been violated?" she questioned.
paras.zh: 例如，她认为受项目影响的人们必须从一开始就记录可能违反环境和社会标准的行为。 “受影响方如何知道可能违反了哪些标准？”她问道。

paras.en: The AIIB disputes this claim. "In terms of accessibility, we have made the submission form simpler and translated it into 12 languages," it said, adding that complaints can be submitted online, by phone, or by email.
paras.zh: 亚投行对这一说法提出异议。 “在可访问性方面，我们简化了提交表格，并将其翻译成 12 种语言，”它表示，并补充说投诉可以通过在线、电话或电子邮件提交。

paras.en: Urgewald, a German environmental NGO, cites another problem with AIIB-financed projects. For many of them, information on environmental impacts and resettlements is either missing or published late, it noted.
paras.zh: 德国环保非政府组织厄格瓦尔德提到了亚投行资助项目的另一个问题。报告指出，对于其中许多人来说，有关环境影响和重新安置的信息要么缺失，要么发布较晚。

paras.en: For 2024, the NGO found that 11 of the 16 projects it examined lacked complete environmental and social impact assessments. In many cases, information on the potential number of displaced residents was also missing, it added.
paras.zh: 对于 2024 年，该非政府组织发现其审查的 16 个项目中有 11 个缺乏完整的环境和社会影响评估。报告补充说，在许多情况下，有关流离失所居民的潜在人数的信息也缺失。

paras.en: "The information published on the bank's website is often insufficient and inconsistent. Particularly important documents, such as environmental impact assessments or resettlement plans, vary widely or are missing entirely," said Nora Sausmikat, a China expert at Urgewald.
paras.zh: “银行网站上发布的信息往往不充分且不一致。特别重要的文件，例如环境影响评估或移民安置计划，差异很大或完全缺失，”Urgewald的中国问题专家诺拉·索斯米卡特(Nora Sausmikat)表示。

paras.en: The lack of information makes it difficult for those affected to respond in a timely manner and report violations early on, she underscored, adding that the situation is particularly difficult for people without formal land titles.
paras.zh: 她强调，由于缺乏信息，受影响的人很难及时做出反应并尽早报告违法行为，并补充说，对于没有正式土地所有权的人来说，情况尤其困难。

paras.en: Christoph Steinert, a political scientist at the University of Konstanz, said the mere existence of such grievance redressal mechanisms "is not enough."
paras.zh: 康斯坦茨大学政治学家克里斯托夫·斯坦纳特表示，仅仅存在这种申诉补救机制“是不够的”。

paras.en: Particularly vulnerable groups often know little about their rights, he said, adding that information should be available in local languages and targeted outreach directed at affected communities.
paras.zh: 他说，特别弱势群体往往对自己的权利知之甚少，并补充说，应该以当地语言提供信息，并针对受影响社区进行有针对性的宣传。

paras.en: Criticism of the AIIB's procedures is not new.
paras.zh: 对亚投行程序的批评并不新鲜。

paras.en: A 2023 report by international aid organizations, including Recourse, Accountability Counsel, and Inclusive Development International, revealed that the AIIB's grievance mechanism had failed to accept a single complaint since its 2019 inception.
paras.zh: Recourse、Accountability Counsel、Inclusive Development International等国际援助组织2023年的一份报告显示，亚投行的申诉机制自2019年成立以来未受理任何投诉。

paras.en: The study highlighted that 101 of the 219 AIIB-financed projects, or 46% of of the total projects at the time, were ineligible for review due to co-financing exemptions.
paras.zh: 该研究强调，亚投行资助的 219 个项目中有 101 个（占当时项目总数的 46%）由于联合融资豁免而没有资格接受审查。

paras.en: The AIIB typically provides funding without leading projects, a standard practice in development finance. When complaints arise, it directs complainants to the lead lender. As a result, nine of the 45 complaints fell outside its jurisdiction.
paras.zh: 亚投行通常在没有主导项目的情况下提供资金，这是开发融资的标准做法。当投诉出现时，它会将投诉人引导至主要贷款人。结果，45 起投诉中有 9 起不属于其管辖范围。

paras.en: For Sausmikat, this is part of the problem. "The AIIB, however, decided against revising this requirement and established a mechanism that is very difficult to access," she said.
paras.zh: 对于索斯米卡特来说，这是问题的一部分。 “然而，亚投行决定不修改这一要求，并建立了一个很难进入的机制，”她说。

paras.en: As of January 1, 2026, following two years of external consultations, the AIIB reformed its complaints mechanism. Under certain conditions, complaints can now be filed even while legal proceedings are ongoing.
paras.zh: 自2026年1月1日起，经过两年的外部磋商，亚投行改革了投诉机制。在某些情况下，即使法律诉讼正在进行中，现在也可以提出投诉。

paras.en: But Sausmikat stressed that the changes are insufficient. Of the eight key recommendations made by an independent expert, only three were adopted, she underlined. "The revision did not remove the actual obstacles."
paras.zh: 但索斯米卡特强调，这些改变还不够。她强调，在独立专家提出的八项关键建议中，只有三项被采纳。 “这次修订并没有消除实际的障碍。”

paras.en: The AIIB stated that the reforms are intended to make the mechanism "more accessible and responsive."
paras.zh: 亚投行表示，改革的目的是使该机制“更容易获得、反应更灵敏”。

paras.en: The new rules have been in effect for only ten months, and their implementation is being closely monitored, the bank said.
paras.zh: 该银行表示，新规定仅生效十个月，其实施情况正在受到密切关注。

paras.en: Steinert said fear of reprisals poses another fundamental challenge to such procedures.
paras.zh: 斯坦纳特表示，担心遭到报复是此类程序的另一个根本挑战。

paras.en: Documented cases from Latin America, for instance, show that complainants have faced administrative or legal problems, and in some cases even violence.
paras.zh: 例如，来自拉丁美洲的记录案例表明，申诉人面临行政或法律问题，在某些情况下甚至面临暴力。

paras.en: Such risks could deter others from filing complaints, Steinert said.
paras.zh: 斯坦纳特说，此类风险可能会阻止其他人提出投诉。

paras.en: However, his research does not specifically address AIIB projects.
paras.zh: 然而，他的研究并未专门针对亚投行项目。

paras.en: The bank said that it "does not tolerate retaliation against anyone who raises concerns."
paras.zh: 该银行表示，“不会容忍对任何提出担忧的人进行报复”。

paras.en: "Requestors may ask for confidentiality, and the revised PPM policy strengthens protection against reprisals," it added.
paras.zh: “请求者可以要求保密，修订后的 PPM 政策加强了防止报复的保护，”它补充道。

paras.en: Sausmikat said Germany — as a co-founder and the fourth-largest shareholder of the AIIB — could also play a role, working with other member states to push for changes.
paras.zh: 索斯米卡特表示，德国作为亚投行的联合创始人和第四大股东，也可以发挥作用，与其他成员国合作推动变革。

paras.en: Hartmann also stressed that the bank's shareholders bear responsibility and urged the AIIB's Board of Directors to amend the rules governing the grievance mechanism. "We need a policy based on good-practice standards."
paras.zh: 哈特曼还强调，亚投行股东负有责任，并敦促亚投行董事会修改申诉机制规则。 “我们需要一项基于良好实践标准的政策。”

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Brazil electoral court fines Meta, sees no deliberate election bias

paras.en: Brazil's top electoral court has ordered Meta to pay 7.5 million reais ($1.34 million; €1.22 million) for failing to fully comply with judicial orders during last month's presidential election.
paras.zh: 巴西最高选举法院因 Meta 在上个月的总统选举期间未能完全遵守司法命令而责令 Meta 支付 750 万雷亚尔（134 万美元；122 万欧元）。

paras.en: However, the judicial body has so far found no evidence that Meta deliberately acted to influence the election outcome.
paras.zh: 不过，司法机构迄今尚未发现任何证据表明梅塔故意采取行动影响选举结果。

paras.en: Ahead of the runoff vote on October 25, leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's coalition filed a complaint, accusing Meta of "algorithmic manipulation" favoring his far-right rival Flavio Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 25 日决选投票之前，左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦的联盟提出申诉，指责梅塔“操纵算法”，有利于他的极右翼竞争对手弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗。

paras.en: Platforms owned by Meta include Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.
paras.zh: Meta 拥有的平台包括 Facebook、Instagram 和 WhatsApp。

paras.en: Meta told the court last month that it had implemented measures to guarantee equal treatment for both campaigns.
paras.zh: 梅塔上个月告诉法庭，它已采取措施保证这两个竞选活动的平等待遇。

paras.en: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously ruled on Tuesday to impose the 7.5 million reais fine on the US tech giant.
paras.zh: 高级选举法院 (TSE) 周二一致裁定对这家美国科技巨头处以 750 万雷亚尔的罚款。

paras.en: Meta missed deadlines and lacked transparency in its investigation, the court said.
paras.zh: 法院表示，Meta 错过了最后期限，而且调查缺乏透明度。

paras.en: On the other hand, the court's reporting judge Marco Aurelio Belizze wrote in his ruling that there were no preliminary evidence indicating that any intentional actions were taken to influence the election.
paras.zh: 另一方面，法院报告法官Marco Aurelio Belizze在裁决中写道，没有初步证据表明存在任何故意影响选举的行为。

paras.en: "That conclusion would require robust evidence, to be produced through the appropriate legal proceedings," he said.
paras.zh: “这一结论需要通过适当的法律程序提供强有力的证据，”他说。

paras.en: According to Bellizze, the fine was based on Meta's overall handling of the court orders, including delays, incomplete disclosures, and challenges in verifying some of the information it provided.
paras.zh: Bellizze 表示，罚款是基于 Meta 对法院命令的整体处理，包括延迟、不完整披露以及在验证其提供的部分信息方面遇到的挑战。

paras.en: In a statement on Wednesday, Meta strongly denied the court's ruling.
paras.zh: Meta 在周三的一份声明中强烈否认了法院的裁决。

paras.en: "We will continue to present the facts and defend ourselves against false allegations in the ongoing legal proceedings," Meta said in a statement on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 梅塔在周三的一份声明中表示：“我们将在正在进行的法律诉讼中继续陈述事实，并针对虚假指控为自己辩护。”

paras.en: Lula defeated Bolsonaro in a tight run-off in October 25 with him winning 51.7% of the vote against Bolsonaro's 48.2%.
paras.zh: 10月25日，卢拉在一场激烈的决选中击败了博尔索纳罗，他赢得了51.7%的选票，而博尔索纳罗的得票率为48.2%。

paras.en: In his victory speech, Lula urged more regulation of big tech platforms after allegations that Meta interfered in the race.
paras.zh: 在被指控梅塔干预竞选后，卢拉在胜利演讲中敦促对大型科技平台进行更多监管。

paras.en: "We had to overcome foreign interference in the election, coming from outside through digital platforms that we will have to regulate," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们必须克服外国对选举的干扰，这些干扰是通过我们必须监管的数字平台从外部进行的。”

articles.title: Will Sheikh Hasina return to Bangladesh?

paras.en: The former Bangladeshi PM says she is planning to go back, despite a death sentence.
paras.zh: 这位孟加拉国前总理表示，尽管被判处死刑，她仍计划回国。

paras.en: She faces being hanged. Yet, Sheikh Hasina says she will return to Bangladesh and would rather die in her country.
paras.zh: 她面临被绞死的危险。然而，谢赫·哈西娜表示，她将返回孟加拉国，宁愿死在自己的国家。

paras.en: She served twice as prime minister, but was forced to resign and flee after large-scale street protests more than two years ago.
paras.zh: 她曾两度担任总理，但在两年多前的大规模街头抗议后被迫辞职并逃离。

paras.en: Since then, she has been living in India, which has refused a request by Bangladesh to hand her over.
paras.zh: 此后，她一直居住在印度，印度拒绝了孟加拉国将她移交的请求。

paras.en: Hasina says she asked for a new passport to return. But the government in Dhaka turned down the request.
paras.zh: 哈西娜说，她要求返回一本新护照。但达卡政府拒绝了这一请求。

paras.en: The former leader announced she will return home in December, no matter what.
paras.zh: 这位前领导人宣布，无论如何，她将于 12 月回国。

paras.en: So, what would her possible return mean for politics in Bangladesh?
paras.zh: 那么，她可能的回归对孟加拉国的政治意味着什么？

paras.en: Shahab Enam Khan – Professor at the Department of International Relations at Jahangirnagar University
paras.zh: Shahab Enam Khan – 贾汉吉尔讷格尔大学国际关系系教授

paras.en: Sanjay Kumar Bhardwaj – Professor at the Centre for South Asian Studies at Jawaharlal Nehru University, specialising in India-Bangladesh relations
paras.zh: Sanjay Kumar Bhardwaj – 贾瓦哈拉尔尼赫鲁大学南亚研究中心教授，专门研究印度与孟加拉国关系

paras.en: Taqbir Huda – Human rights lawyer and a Clarendon scholar at the University of Oxford
paras.zh: Taqbir Huda – 人权律师、牛津大学克拉伦登学者

articles.title: More than one million people in Lebanon face acute food shortages, UN says

paras.en: Nearly a quarter of Lebanon’s population, or more than one million people, is facing acute food shortages due to two consecutive conflicts in less than two years and a dire economic situation, according to the United Nations.
paras.zh: 据联合国称，由于不到两年内连续发生两场冲突以及严峻的经济形势，黎巴嫩近四分之一的人口（即超过一百万人）面临严重的粮食短缺。

paras.en: The UN’s Food and Agriculture Organization, the World Food Programme (WFP) and Lebanon’s Ministry of Agriculture warned in a joint statement published on Wednesday that the number is expected to rise to 1.15 million by the middle of next year.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织、世界粮食计划署和黎巴嫩农业部在周三发表的联合声明中警告称，到明年年中，这一数字预计将增至 115 万。

paras.en: “Employment opportunities remain limited, savings have been depleted, and debt remains high, while the cost of food, fuel and other essentials continues to strain household budgets,” the joint statement said.
paras.zh: 联合声明称：“就业机会仍然有限，储蓄已经耗尽，债务仍然很高，而食品、燃料和其他必需品的成本继续使家庭预算紧张。”

paras.en: “Some households can still draw on savings, borrow, cut expenses or find other ways to put food on the table. For others, those options are being exhausted. When families have nothing left to fall back on, even a small additional shock can push them deeper into crisis,” Allison Oman Lawi, WFP representative and country director in Lebanon, said.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署驻黎巴嫩代表兼国家主任艾利森·奥曼·拉维表示：“一些家庭仍然可以动用储蓄、借贷、削减开支或寻找其他方式来维持生计。对另一些家庭来说，这些选择已经用尽。当家庭没有什么可以依靠时，即使是很小的额外冲击也会让他们陷入更深的危机。”

paras.en: Lebanon’s Agriculture Minister Nizar Hani said: “These findings call for a coordinated national response that addresses urgent food needs while protecting livelihoods and restoring productive capacity.”
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩农业部长尼扎尔·哈尼表示：“这些调查结果要求全国采取协调一致的应对措施，解决紧迫的粮食需求，同时保护生计并恢复生产能力。”

paras.en: Lebanon’s authorities estimate that the cost of two wars between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since October 2023 amounts to about $27bn.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩当局估计，自 2023 年 10 月以来以色列和黎巴嫩武装组织真主党之间的两场战争造成的损失约为 270 亿美元。

paras.en: The last war, launched in March, displaced more than one million people in Lebanon. That number has fallen to about 300,000 since violence subsided in June.
paras.zh: 上一场战争于三月份爆发，导致黎巴嫩超过一百万人流离失所。自 6 月份暴力事件平息以来，这一数字已降至约 30 万。

paras.en: Despite a United States-brokered framework deal signed between Israel and Lebanon’s government in June to bring fighting to an end, Israel is still occupying land in Lebanon.
paras.zh: 尽管以色列和黎巴嫩政府于六月在美国斡旋下签署了结束战斗的框架协议，但以色列仍然占领着黎巴嫩的土地。

paras.en: Under the terms, Israeli forces were to withdraw, and Lebanon’s army was to take up positions in vacated territory.
paras.zh: 根据条款，以色列军队将撤军，黎巴嫩军队将在空出的领土上占领阵地。

paras.en: Lebanon was meant to disarm Hezbollah, which is not a party to the agreement.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩原本打算解除真主党的武装，但真主党不是该协议的缔约方。

paras.en: The fighting broke out as Lebanon struggled to recover from its worst-ever economic crisis, which began in 2019.
paras.zh: 这场战斗爆发之际，黎巴嫩正在努力从 2019 年开始的有史以来最严重的经济危机中恢复过来。

paras.en: Beirut has been seeking a bailout from the International Monetary Fund but has yet to implement reforms demanded by the institution to release the aid.
paras.zh: 贝鲁特一直在寻求国际货币基金组织的救助，但尚未实施该机构要求的改革以释放援助。

articles.title: Which key races remain undecided one week after the US midterms?

paras.en: It has been more than a week since voters in the United States cast ballots in the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 美国中期选举选民投票已经过去一周多了。

paras.en: But the size of Democrats’ majorities in the House of Representatives and Senate remained undetermined. More than a dozen congressional races are still waiting to be called.
paras.zh: 但民主党在众议院和参议院的多数席位规模仍悬而未决。十多场国会竞选仍在等待召集。

paras.en: Democrats have already won 54 Senate seats in the incoming Congress in January, but they could pick up one or two more as votes are counted in Alaska and Mississippi.
paras.zh: 民主党已经在 1 月份即将召开的国会中赢得了 54 个参议院席位，但随着阿拉斯加和密西西比州计票，他们可能会再获得一两个席位。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in the House of Representatives, Democrats have notched their largest elected majority since 2008, with 255 seats in the 435-member chamber. But they have the potential to add to their lead with several more seats as the remaining races are decided.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在众议院，民主党获得了自 2008 年以来最大的民选多数席位，在 435 名议员中拥有 255 个席位。但随着剩余比赛的确定，他们有可能通过更多席位来扩大领先优势。

paras.en: Here’s a look at where things stand in some of the uncalled races:
paras.zh: 以下是一些无名比赛的情况：

paras.en: Mississippi’s Senate seat remains too early to call
paras.zh: 密西西比州参议院席位现在下定论还为时过早

paras.en: Late on Tuesday, Democrat Scott Colom was about 2,600 votes ahead of Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith in the race for the US Senate in Mississippi.
paras.zh: 周二晚间，在密西西比州的美国参议院竞选中，民主党人斯科特·科洛姆 (Scott Colom) 以约 2,600 票领先共和党现任议员辛迪·海德·史密斯 (Cindy Hyde-Smith)。

paras.en: There are two key deadlines in the vote-counting process in Mississippi this week: Mail-in absentee ballots must be received by Tuesday, and counties are required to submit their certified election results — including tallies of provisional ballots — to the state by Friday.
paras.zh: 密西西比州本周的计票过程有两个关键截止日期：必须在周二之前收到邮寄的缺席选票，各县必须在周五之前向该州提交经过认证的选举结果，包括临时选票的统计。

paras.en: It is unclear exactly how many ballots are left to count.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚到底还有多少张选票需要统计。

paras.en: Unlike in some other states, there is no central vote reporting system for Mississippi, and few counties release election results online. Instead, journalists from The Associated Press and analysts communicate with each of the state’s 82 counties directly for the latest available information on vote counts.
paras.zh: 与其他一些州不同，密西西比州没有中央投票报告系统，也很少有县在网上发布选举结果。相反，美联社的记者和分析师直接与该州 82 个县进行沟通，以获取最新的计票信息。

paras.en: The state will certify its results on December 3.
paras.zh: 该州将于 12 月 3 日验证其结果。

paras.en: On Monday, Mississippi Secretary of State Michael Watson said about 14,200 provisional ballots had been processed, of which about 80 percent were accepted, and about 2,700 mail-in absentee ballots had not yet been returned.
paras.zh: 周一，密西西比州国务卿迈克尔·沃森表示，约 14,200 张临时选票已得到处理，其中约 80% 已被接受，约 2,700 张邮寄缺席选票尚未退回。

paras.en: Mississippi does not have automatic recounts or permit candidates to request a recount. Recounts in the state are held only in the event of a court order. The Associated Press may declare a winner in a race that is eligible for a recount if it can determine the lead is too large for a recount or legal challenge to change the outcome.
paras.zh: 密西西比州没有自动重新计票，也不允许候选人请求重新计票。该州只有在法院下令的情况下才会重新计票。如果美联社确定领先优势太大而无法重新计票或通过法律挑战来改变结果，则可以宣布有资格重新计票的比赛的获胜者。

paras.en: The vote count is ongoing in Alaska’s Senate race
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加州参议员竞选的计票工作正在进行中

paras.en: Democrat Mary Peltola led Republican Senator Dan Sullivan by about 2,500 votes in Alaska’s US Senate race as of Tuesday, with an estimated 76 percent of the vote counted.
paras.zh: 截至周二，在阿拉斯加美国参议院竞选中，民主党人玛丽·佩尔托拉领先共和党参议员丹·沙利文约 2,500 票，估计已计票 76%。

paras.en: Absentee ballots are among those that continue to be counted. The final absentee ballots mailed from outside the US are accepted as late as November 18, which is 15 days after Election Day.
paras.zh: 缺席选票属于继续计算的选票之一。从美国境外邮寄的最终缺席选票最迟将于 11 月 18 日（即选举日后 15 天）接受。

paras.en: Ranked-choice voting could also affect the timeline. Peltola is just over one percentage point short of the majority needed to win outright. If neither candidate wins a majority, the race will proceed to ranked-choice tabulation on November 18.
paras.zh: 排名选择投票也可能影响时间表。佩尔托拉距离彻底获胜所需的多数票仅差一个百分点多一点。如果两位候选人均未赢得多数席位，则比赛将于 11 月 18 日进入排名选择表。

paras.en: The state’s “target date” for certifying the election results is November 25.
paras.zh: 该州认证选举结果的“目标日期”是 11 月 25 日。

paras.en: Recounts in Alaska are automatic only in the event of a tie vote. Candidates may also request a recount within five days of the state’s certification.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加只有在票数相同的情况下才会自动重新计票。候选人还可以在州认证后五天内请求重新计票。

paras.en: A dozen House races are still up in the air
paras.zh: 十几场众议院比赛仍悬而未决

paras.en: In most of the US House races that have not been called, the margin between the leading candidates was less than one percentage point among votes counted, as of late Tuesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 截至周二下午晚些时候，在大多数尚未宣布的美国众议院竞选中，领先候选人之间的计票差距不到一个百分点。

paras.en: In North Carolina, four races remain undecided, the most of any state, and Republican incumbents were being challenged in each one. There are no automatic recounts in North Carolina, but candidates may request a recount if the margin between candidates is one percent or less of the total votes.
paras.zh: 在北卡罗来纳州，有四场竞选尚未决定，是所有州中最多的，共和党现任议员在每一场比赛中都受到挑战。北卡罗来纳州没有自动重新计票，但如果候选人之间的差距为总票数的百分之一或更少，候选人可以要求重新计票。

paras.en: The state must receive the recount request by noon Eastern Time (17:00 GMT) on November 17, two business days after the county canvass in the state. The state is scheduled to certify its results on November 24.
paras.zh: 该州必须在东部时间 11 月 17 日中午（格林威治标准时间 17:00）之前收到重新计票请求，即该州县拉票后的两个工作日。该州定于 11 月 24 日验证其结果。

paras.en: In California, only one of the remaining House races, in the 23rd District, will affect the chamber’s balance of power. The other uncalled race is between two Democrats. Mail-in ballots must be received by Tuesday, and counties must certify their results by December 3. The state will certify its results on December 11.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州，只有第 23 选区剩下的一场众议院竞选会影响众议院的权力平衡。另一场未召集的竞选是在两名民主党人之间进行的。邮寄选票必须在周二之前收到，各县必须在 12 月 3 日之前验证结果。州政府将于 12 月 11 日验证结果。

paras.en: In South Carolina’s 2nd District, a recount is ongoing in the race between Republican incumbent Joe Wilson and Democrat Zyon Khalifa. Wilson led Khalifa by only about 3,000 votes in the original tally by late Tuesday afternoon, when 99 percent of the votes had been counted.
paras.zh: 在南卡罗来纳州第二选区，共和党现任议员乔·威尔逊和民主党人齐恩·哈利法之间的竞选正在进行重新计票。截至周二下午晚些时候，99% 的选票已经清点完毕，威尔逊在最初计票中仅领先哈利法约 3,000 票。

paras.en: In Minnesota’s 1st District, the race was still undecided late by Tuesday, with about 300 votes separating the top two candidates and an estimated 99 percent of votes counted. Recounts are not automatic in Minnesota, but a candidate can request a publicly funded recount if the margin between the winning and losing candidates is less than 0.25 percent of the vote.
paras.zh: 在明尼苏达州第一选区，截至周二晚间，竞选仍未分出胜负，排名前两名的候选人之间相差约 300 张选票，估计已完成 99% 的选票统计。明尼苏达州不会自动重新计票，但如果获胜和失败候选人之间的差距低于选票的 0.25%，候选人可以请求公共资助的重新计票。

paras.en: In Tennessee’s 4th District, about 300 votes lay between Democrat Victoria Broderick and Republican incumbent Scott DesJarlais as of Tuesday. In that state, recounts are held only as part of a legal challenge in the courts. There are no automatic recounts, and losing candidates may not request recounts.
paras.zh: 截至周二，在田纳西州第四选区，民主党人维多利亚·布罗德里克 (Victoria Broderick) 和共和党人斯科特·德贾莱斯 (Scott DesJarlais) 之间持有约 300 张选票。在该州，重新计票仅作为法庭法律质疑的一部分。没有自动重新计票，落选的候选人不得要求重新计票。

paras.en: In the race to be Kansas’s next governor, Democratic state Senator Cindy Holscher led state Republican Senate President Ty Masterson by less than one percentage point on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 在堪萨斯州下一任州长的竞选中，周二，民主党州参议员辛迪·霍尔舍尔(Cindy Holscher)领先州共和党参议院主席泰·马斯特森(Ty Masterson)不到一个百分点。

paras.en: On November 4, the state announced that a close-race audit had been triggered in six close Kansas races, including the gubernatorial race.
paras.zh: 11月4日，该州宣布对堪萨斯州六场势均力敌的竞选启动了势均力敌的审计，其中包括州长竞选。

paras.en: That process requires a hand count of selected ballots, and it must be completed before November 16, the day by which counties must certify their results.
paras.zh: 该过程需要对选定的选票进行手工清点，并且必须在 11 月 16 日之前完成，该日各县必须验证其结果。

paras.en: In the race for governor of Alaska, only about 76 percent of votes were estimated to have been counted by Tuesday.
paras.zh: 在阿拉斯加州州长竞选中，预计截至周二仅统计了约 76% 的选票。

paras.en: The Democratic gubernatorial candidate, Jonathan Kreiss‑Tomkins, was leading Bernadette Wilson by about 45,000 votes, 49.6 percent to 28.9 percent. The race will advance to ranked-choice tabulation if no candidate receives more than 50 percent of the vote.
paras.zh: 民主党州长候选人乔纳森·克莱斯·汤姆金斯以 49.6% 比 28.9% 的优势领先伯纳黛特·威尔逊约 45,000 票。如果没有候选人获得超过 50% 的选票，比赛将进入排名选择表。

articles.title: An Iran-backed trio is accused of plotting attacks on a U.K. base hosting U.S. jets
articles.author: Willem Marx

paras.en: An Iran-backed trio is accused of plotting attacks on a U.K. base hosting U.S. jets
paras.zh: 伊朗支持的三人被指控策划袭击驻有美国飞机的英国基地

paras.en: LONDON — Federal prosecutors in New York have charged three men with terrorism offenses over what they describe as an Iran-backed campaign of nearly 20 attacks and attempted attacks across Europe and the United States. The charges include a September plot against a British air base where American forces were stationed.
paras.zh: 伦敦——纽约联邦检察官以恐怖主义罪对三名男子提出指控，他们称这三名男子受到伊朗支持，在欧洲和美国发动了近 20 起袭击和未遂袭击。这些指控包括9月份策划针对美军驻扎的英国空军基地的阴谋。

paras.en: The indictment, unsealed on Tuesday, names Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood Al-Saadi, 32, who holds Iranian and Iraqi citizenship, Mohsen Mohajeri, 48, an Iranian, and Mohammed Ali Al-Hassani, 35, an Iraqi.
paras.zh: 周二启封的起诉书提到，穆罕默德·巴克尔·萨阿德·达伍德·阿尔萨迪（Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood Al-Saadi），32 岁，拥有伊朗和伊拉克公民身份；莫森·莫哈杰里（Mohsen Mohajeri），48 岁，伊朗人；穆罕默德·阿里·阿尔哈桑尼（Mohammed Ali Al-Hassani），35 岁，伊拉克人。

paras.en: Prosecutors allege the men acted on behalf of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and the Iraqi militia Kata'ib Hezbollah to orchestrate, plan and conduct the attacks through a network of associates across Europe and the U.S., targeting Jewish communities and a British base hosting American troops. The indictment cites plots against synagogues in London and in New York. Both Iran's Revolutionary Guard and Kata'ib Hezbollah are designated by the United States as foreign terrorist organizations.
paras.zh: 检察官指控这些人代表伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队和伊拉克民兵真主党旅，通过遍布欧洲和美国的同伙网络策划、策划和实施袭击，目标是犹太社区和驻有美军的英国基地。起诉书援引了针对伦敦和纽约犹太教堂的阴谋。伊朗革命卫队和真主党旅均被美国认定为外国恐怖组织。

paras.en: The court filings describe an operation that was directed, in part, by the suspects who were thousands of miles away. In April, prosecutors have alleged, the three men gathered in a room and watched an attack unfold live on a large screen via Apple's FaceTime video calling app. Al-Hassani allegedly coached the attacker through igniting and hurling a series of seemingly incendiary devices while Al-Saadi filmed.
paras.zh: 法庭文件描述了一次行动，部分是由千里之外的嫌疑人指挥的。检察官称，四月份，这三名男子聚集在一个房间里，通过苹果公司的 FaceTime 视频通话应用程序在大屏幕上观看了袭击事件的现场直播。据称，哈桑尼在萨阿迪拍摄期间指导袭击者点燃并投掷一系列看似燃烧的装置。

paras.en: The following day, Al-Hassani is accused of guiding another man on a video call as he lit an improvised explosive and threw it at a synagogue in London.
paras.zh: 第二天，哈桑尼被指控在视频通话中引导另一名男子点燃简易爆炸物并将其扔向伦敦的一座犹太教堂。

paras.en: The men "helped orchestrate a campaign of terror" on behalf of the two designated terror groups, according to U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York, Jamie McDonald.
paras.zh: 纽约南区美国检察官杰米·麦克唐纳 (Jamie McDonald) 表示，这些人代表两个指定的恐怖组织“帮助策划了一场恐怖活动”。

paras.en: The United Kingdom seems to have been a central target of the plot allegedly perpetrated by the three men: among the roughly 18 attacks claimed last spring by a group calling itself Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya, which prosecutors say was a front for Kata'ib Hezbollah, as many as seven took place in the U.K. It was the most intensely targeted country in Europe, though the indictment does not specify the location of other plots or attacks.
paras.zh: 英国似乎是这三人涉嫌实施的阴谋的中心目标：去年春天，一个自称为 Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya 的组织（检察官称该组织是卡塔布真主党的前线）声称声称发动了大约 18 起袭击，其中多达 7 起发生在英国。英国是欧洲最受攻击的国家，尽管起诉书没有具体说明其他阴谋或袭击的地点。

paras.en: These included arson attacks, the use of explosives, and a near-fatal stabbing of two Jewish men in London — one of whom was a dual U.S.-British citizen.
paras.zh: 其中包括纵火袭击、使用爆炸物以及伦敦两名犹太男子被刺伤险些丧命——其中一名拥有美国和英国双重国籍。

paras.en: Prosecutors say that in April the men sat in a room, and directed an attack remotely, in real time, over FaceTime, telling the attacker when to light and throw what seems to have been some kind of incendiary device.
paras.zh: 检察官称，四月份，这些人坐在一个房间里，通过 FaceTime 远程实时指挥攻击，告诉攻击者何时点燃并投掷似乎是某种燃烧装置的东西。

paras.en: The next day, one of the men, Mohammed Ali Al-Hassani, allegedly told another man attacking a London synagogue to "light it up like a Christmas tree."
paras.zh: 第二天，其中一名男子穆罕默德·阿里·哈桑尼据称告诉另一名袭击伦敦犹太教堂的男子“把它像圣诞树一样点亮”。

paras.en: According to the indictment, Al-Hassani was operating from Iran, but he began paying associates in Britain in August to film the perimeter of Royal Air Force (RAF) Fairford, in Gloucestershire, several hours west of London.
paras.zh: 根据起诉书，哈桑尼在伊朗开展活动，但他从 8 月份开始付钱给英国的同事，让他们拍摄位于伦敦以西几小时车程的格洛斯特郡皇家空军 (RAF) 费尔福德的周边环境。

paras.en: They allegedly obtained vans and drums of fuel, looked into buying chemical accelerants, and gathered metal items that could potentially serve as shrapnel. The vans were fitted with sham branding for a fuel delivery firm as well as a pool supply company.
paras.zh: 据称，他们获得了货车和燃料桶，考虑购买化学促进剂，并收集了可能充当弹片的金属物品。这些货车贴有一家燃油运输公司和一家泳池供应公司的假品牌。

paras.en: On Sept. 26, three of these vans had set off toward the base that housed large numbers of U.S. military aircraft. At least two vehicles were stopped at a security roadblock, and British authorities seized all three early the next morning and arrested those inside.
paras.zh: 9月26日，三辆面包车驶向驻有大量美军飞机的基地。至少有两辆车被拦在安全路障处，英国当局第二天一早扣押了这三辆车，并逮捕了里面的人。

paras.en: The U.S. almost immediately redeployed several of its long range bombing aircraft from the base at the time of this incident.
paras.zh: 事件发生时，美国几乎立即从基地重新部署了几架远程轰炸机。

paras.en: The indictment said Al-Saadi had been detained abroad in May and brought to the United States, where prosecutors say he kept directing the network from his jail cell by relaying coded messages through phone calls with relatives in Iraq. He used aliases to refer to his alleged co-conspirators and referred to terrorist activity, including ongoing alleged plots, as "work," while those he spoke to used the phrase "international section" to mean overseas travel, according to the indictment. His sister and mother were among his interlocutors on some of those calls. Three days before the plot, in late September, he allegedly asked them to get money to Al-Hassani for the RAF Fairford operation.
paras.zh: 起诉书称，萨阿迪于 5 月在国外被拘留并被带到美国，检察官表示，他一直在牢房中通过与伊拉克亲戚的电话转发编码信息来指挥网络。起诉书称，他使用化名来称呼他所谓的同谋，并将恐怖活动（包括正在进行的所谓阴谋）称为“工作”，而与他交谈的人则使用“国际部分”一词来表示海外旅行。在其中一些电话中，他的妹妹和母亲是他的对话者之一。阴谋发生前三天，即九月下旬，据称他要求他们向阿尔·哈桑尼提供用于英国皇家空军费尔福德行动的资金。

paras.en: British authorities had earlier charged two men with national security related offenses tied to the incident.
paras.zh: 英国当局早些时候指控两名男子犯有与该事件有关的国家安全相关罪行。

paras.en: U.S. soldier held over Russia allegations
paras.zh: 美国士兵因俄罗斯指控而被拘留

paras.en: In a separate case, British counterterrorism police said on Tuesday it arrested a 41-year-old member of the U.S. Army on suspicion of offenses under Sections 1 and 3 of Britain's National Security Act 2023.
paras.zh: 在另一起案件中，英国反恐警察周二表示，因涉嫌违反《2023 年英国国家安全法》第 1 条和第 3 条，逮捕了一名 41 岁的美国陆军成员。

paras.en: The suspect, who has not been named by authorities, is a senior U.S. soldier who was stationed at Imjin Barracks near Gloucester, in western England, which is home to NATO's Allied Rapid Reaction Corps, the U.S. Army's Counterintelligence Command told NPR.
paras.zh: 美国陆军反情报司令部告诉美国国家公共广播电台，这名嫌疑人的名字尚未被当局透露，他是一名美国高级士兵，驻扎在英格兰西部格洛斯特附近的临津军营，该军营是北约盟军快速反应部队的所在地。

paras.en: Officers have been searching two addresses in the same region of Gloucestershire, to the west of London. The man is being held at a London police station. Police said the allegations concern Russia, and the investigation was "very much ongoing," according to Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans, senior national coordinator for counterterrorism policing in the U.K.
paras.zh: 警方一直在伦敦西部格洛斯特郡同一地区搜查两个地址。该男子目前被关押在伦敦警察局。英国反恐警务高级国家协调员、副助理专员维琪·埃文斯 (Vicki Evans) 表示，警方表示，这些指控涉及俄罗斯，调查“正在进行中”。

paras.en: FBI Director Kash Patel called the arrest important in the context of an uptick in FBI counterintelligence arrest, and said it "involves allegations of espionage" — without giving further details.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔称，在联邦调查局反情报逮捕数量增加的背景下，这次逮捕很重要，并表示这“涉及间谍活动的指控”，但没有透露更多细节。

paras.en: "The alleged conduct of a senior soldier, entrusted with sensitive information, is a sobering reminder that insider threats are real and persistent," Brig. Gen. Sean Stinchon, commanding general of U.S. Army Counterintelligence Command, said in a statement to NPR.
paras.zh: 准将称：“一名被委托掌握敏感信息的高级士兵的行为令人警醒，提醒我们内部威胁是真实且持久的。”美国陆军反情报司令部司令肖恩·斯廷琼将军在给美国公共广播电台的一份声明中表示。

paras.en: Though unrelated, both these cases have occurred in the U.K., a country which hosts a large American military presence. At the start of the war in Iran, Britain's Defense Ministry confirmed to the U.K. Parliament in March that U.S. forces operate eleven RAF bases across the country, with approximately 12,300 American military and civilian defense personnel at various sites.
paras.zh: 尽管无关，这两起案件都发生在拥有大量美国军事存在的英国。伊朗战争爆发时，英国国防部于 3 月份向英国议会证实，美军在全国各地运营着 11 个英国皇家空军基地，各个地点约有 12,300 名美国军事和民防人员。

paras.en: Responding in January to a written question from a member of Parliament, the ministry said that there were around 11,000 uniformed U.S. personnel in the country, excluding families, civilians and contractors.
paras.zh: 1 月份，该部在回应一名国会议员的书面提问时表示，该国约有 11,000 名穿制服的美国人员，不包括家庭、平民和承包商。

paras.en: The ministry has declined to give figures for individual bases, citing the security of personnel.
paras.zh: 该部以人员安全为由拒绝透露各个基地的数据。

paras.en: The U.S. Air Force's two main operating bases are RAF Lakenheath and RAF Mildenhall in Suffolk, in eastern England. Other sites include RAF Croughton, a communications station in Northamptonshire, and RAF Menwith Hill in North Yorkshire, used primarily by the National Security Agency, according to a House of Commons Library briefing. RAF Fairford serves as a forward operating base for the U.S. Air Force Global Strike Command.
paras.zh: 美国空军的两个主要作战基地是位于英格兰东部萨福克的英国皇家空军拉肯希思基地和英国皇家空军米尔登霍尔基地。根据下议院图书馆的简报，其他站点包括北安普敦郡的皇家空军克劳顿通讯站和北约克郡的皇家空军门威斯山站，主要由国家安全局使用。英国皇家空军费尔福德基地是美国空军全球打击司令部的前沿作战基地。

paras.en: In March, the British government allowed the U.S. to use British bases for limited strikes against missile sites in Iran, according to a parliamentary research service, which identifies Fairford as one of the bases potentially involved.
paras.zh: 据议会研究机构称，今年三月，英国政府允许美国使用英国基地对伊朗境内的导弹基地进行有限打击，其中费尔福德基地是可能涉及的基地之一。

paras.en: The threat picture around some U.S. bases seems to have sharpened in recent days. The Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter, that the U.S. military had moved aircraft out of RAF Mildenhall on Monday because of a threat from Iran. NPR did not independently confirm the reports.
paras.zh: 最近几天，美国一些基地周围的威胁似乎有所加剧。 《华尔街日报》援引知情人士的话报道称，由于来自伊朗的威胁，美国军方周一已将飞机从英国皇家空军米尔登霍尔基地撤出。 NPR 没有独立证实这些报道。

paras.en: Neither the U.K. nor the U.S. government has confirmed the reason for the aircraft movements that have been reported. Britain's Defense Ministry has said aircraft relocate routinely for operational reasons.
paras.zh: 英国和美国政府均未证实所报道的飞机起降的原因。英国国防部表示，出于运营原因，飞机会例行迁移。

articles.title: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
paras.zh: 众议院有效结束了对赫格斯的弹劾。并且，三名男子被指控策划英国袭击

paras.en: The House has effectively killed Republican Rep. Thomas Massie's effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The chamber voted 211 to 204 to send the impeachment articles back to the House Judiciary Committee for review. The move circumvents any potential floor vote on the impeachment and virtually ensures it won't be addressed before the current Congress session ends. Massie had reintroduced the impeachment articles on Monday, accusing Hegseth of high crimes related to the war with Iran and U.S. strikes against drug boats in the Caribbean and Eastern Pacific.
paras.zh: 众议院实际上否决了共和党众议员托马斯·马西弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格斯的努力。众议院以211票对204票将弹劾条款送回众议院司法委员会审查。此举规避了任何可能对弹劾案进行的众议院投票，并且实际上确保了在本届国会会议结束之前不会解决该问题。马西周一重新提出弹劾条款，指控赫格斯犯有与伊朗战争以及美国在加勒比海和东太平洋打击贩毒船有关的重罪。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Eric McDaniel describes yesterday's vote to Up First as a game of attendance. There were enough Democrats in Washington to pass the impeachment resolution, but not enough were on the floor to vote, so Republicans had the simple majority. McDaniel spoke to Warren Davidson, a GOP congressman from Ohio, the day before the vote. Davidson said he thinks the war in Iran is unconstitutional, but argued that Hegseth was just a scapegoat for the "status quo politics in Washington."
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Eric McDaniel 将昨天对 Up First 的投票描述为一场出勤游戏。华盛顿有足够多的民主党人通过弹劾决议，但没有足够多的人参加投票，因此共和党获得了简单多数。投票前一天，麦克丹尼尔与来自俄亥俄州的共和党国会议员沃伦·戴维森进行了交谈。戴维森表示，他认为伊朗战争违宪，但他认为赫格塞斯只是“华盛顿政治现状”的替罪羊。

paras.en: - ➡️ The GOP had a lot on their agenda yesterday. The Republican-controlled House Oversight Committee released a report on its investigation into the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and his associates. The report concluded that the federal government mishandled criminal investigations into the disgraced financier and failed survivors.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 共和党昨天的议程有很多。共和党控制的众议院监督委员会发布了一份关于对已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦及其同伙的调查报告。报告的结论是，联邦政府对这位名誉扫地的金融家和失败的幸存者的刑事调查处理不当。

paras.en: Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio will be the new minority leader of the House. House Republicans voted yesterday to replace Speaker Mike Johnson, who is stepping down after last week's midterm losses. At 62, Jordan brings experience from the House Oversight and Judiciary committees. The two panels are poised to play a central role in the new Congress as Democrats plan investigations into President Trump and his administration.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州众议员吉姆·乔丹将成为众议院新的少数党领袖。众议院共和党人昨天投票替换了众议院议长迈克·约翰逊(Mike Johnson)，后者在上周中期选举失败后辞职。 62 岁的乔丹带来了众议院监督和司法委员会的经验。随着民主党计划对特朗普总统及其政府进行调查，这两个小组将在新国会中发挥核心作用。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Barbara Sprunt says she viewed the election as a choice between continuity and change, and Jordan clearly represented change. Jordan's selection, along with Stephen Miller's appointment as the president's new chief of staff, highlights a shift towards a combative political approach, Sprunt says. Democratic leadership elections are expected to happen next week and are likely to keep current leaders Hakeem Jeffries in the House and Chuck Schumer in the Senate in place.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的芭芭拉·斯普伦特 (Barbara Sprunt) 表示，她认为这次选举是连续性与变革之间的选择，而乔丹显然代表了变革。斯普伦特说，乔丹的当选以及斯蒂芬·米勒被任命为总统的新办公厅主任，凸显了向好斗的政治方针的转变。民主党领导人选举预计将于下周举行，现任领导人哈基姆·杰弗里斯(Hakeem Jeffries)和查克·舒默(Chuck Schumer)可能会继续留在众议院和参议院。

paras.en: U.S. federal prosecutors have indicted three men accused of being Iran-backed operatives allegedly involved in nearly 20 terrorist attacks and attempted attacks in Europe and the U.S. The charges include a plot in September against a British air base where American forces were stationed. The Justice Department says some of these attacks were directed live via FaceTime from Iraq.
paras.zh: 美国联邦检察官已起诉三名男子，他们被指控为伊朗支持的特工，涉嫌在欧洲和美国参与近 20 起恐怖袭击和未遂袭击。这些指控包括 9 月份密谋袭击美军驻扎的英国空军基地。司法部表示，其中一些攻击是通过 FaceTime 从伊拉克进行的现场直播。

paras.en: - 🎧 Federal prosecutors in Manhattan accuse the men of working for Iran's Revolutionary Guard and the Iraqi militia Kata'ib Hezbollah, both classified as terrorist groups, according to reporter Willem Marx. Seven of the attacks happened in Britain. They included arson, explosives and a near-fatal stabbing of two Jewish men in London. Marx also noted that, in a separate case, British counter-terrorism police have arrested a 41-year-old U.S. Army soldier on suspicion of spying for Russia under the National Security Act. Authorities emphasized that this spying investigation is not linked to the Iran-related case. But Marx says these incidents raise significant concerns about security around American military bases in Britain and the safety of nearby residents.
paras.zh: - 据记者威廉·马克思报道，曼哈顿联邦检察官指控这些人为伊朗革命卫队和伊拉克民兵真主党工作，这两个组织均被列为恐怖组织。其中七次袭击发生在英国。其中包括在伦敦纵火、爆炸以及刺伤两名犹太男子，导致两名犹太男子险些丧命。马克思还指出，在另一起案件中，英国反恐警察逮捕了一名 41 岁的美国陆军士兵，罪名是涉嫌根据《国家安全法》为俄罗斯从事间谍活动。当局强调，此次间谍调查与伊朗相关案件无关。但马克思表示，这些事件引起了人们对英国美国军事基地周围安全以及附近居民安全的严重担忧。

paras.en: by Quil Lawrence, Veterans correspondent
paras.zh: 作者：Quil Lawrence，退伍军人通讯员

paras.en: A Navy admiral fired by the Trump administration is returning to Washington as a Democratic congresswoman. In Virginia, a former Army Colonel beat another former Army Colonel, and a female Navy vet won a rematch to unseat another female Navy vet. In Florida, a staunchly pro-Trump Air Force Vet narrowly fended off a former Army Brigadier General (both also women.) In Montana, two military veterans lost, splitting the votes against a Republican former attorney general with no military background.
paras.zh: 一名被特朗普政府解雇的海军上将将以民主党国会女议员的身份返回华盛顿。在弗吉尼亚州，一名前陆军上校击败了另一名前陆军上校，一名女海军老兵赢得了复赛，取代了另一名女海军老兵。在佛罗里达州，一名坚定支持特朗普的空军退伍军人以微弱优势击败了一名前陆军准将（两人都是女性）。在蒙大拿州，两名退伍军人落败，将选票平分给了一名没有军事背景的共和党前司法部长。

paras.en: What conclusion to draw? There isn't any!
paras.zh: 得出什么结论？没有啊！

paras.en: Americans dependably say they admire military service, and political campaigns recruit vets to run on tough races. Whether it works remains an open question, though some research suggests Democrats in particular may benefit from veterans status with voters.
paras.zh: 美国人一贯表示他们钦佩服兵役，政治竞选活动招募退伍军人参加艰苦的竞选。它是否有效仍然是一个悬而未决的问题，尽管一些研究表明民主党人尤其可能受益于退伍军人在选民中的地位。

paras.en: The next Congress includes at least 80 veterans, with a few races still too close to call. And according to With Honor, which supports veteran candidates from both parties who promise to sponsor legislation across the aisle, more than 50 vets in the next Congress have signed their pledge.
paras.zh: 下届国会将至少有 80 名退伍军人参加，但仍有几场竞选势均力敌。根据“With Honor”组织的说法，该组织支持承诺支持跨党派立法的两党资深候选人，下届国会中已有 50 多名退伍军人签署了他们的承诺。

paras.en: But the number of vets is shrinking, down to 15% from the 19% currently in office. That's probably just demographics. Relatively few Americans serve in today's all-volunteer military, while past generations were drafted by the millions to Vietnam and Korea. During World War 2, military service was almost a given for men. When that generation entered politics, both chambers had around 70% veterans for a decade, from 1965 to 1975.
paras.zh: 但退伍军人的数量正在减少，从目前在任的 19% 降至 15%。这可能只是人口统计数据。如今，在全志愿军队中服役的美国人相对较少，而过去几代人则有数百万人应征入伍前往越南和朝鲜。第二次世界大战期间，服兵役几乎是男性的必然选择。当这一代人进入政坛时，从 1965 年到 1975 年的十年间，参众两院大约有 70% 的退伍军人。

paras.en: The 120th Congress will host more female vets than ever, about double the last class. Analysis by the Veterans Campaign and the University of San Francisco found that Democrats chose veterans as candidates for the toughest races, in districts President Trump won in 2024 by an average of 22 points.
paras.zh: 第 120 届大会将接待比以往更多的女性退伍军人，大约是上一届的两倍。退伍军人运动和旧金山大学的分析发现，民主党选择退伍军人作为最艰难竞选的候选人，特朗普总统在 2024 年以平均 22 个百分点的优势获胜。

paras.en: There's another way vets are serving: as poll workers. The group Vet the Vote recruits veterans and their families to help run elections. Starting from a goal of 150,000 volunteers during the 2024 presidential cycle, their campaign counted more than 175,000 for this midterm, from all 50 states, helping bolster the understaffed and overworked polling officials nationwide. The group says it had volunteers in 4 out of 5 zip codes across the country.
paras.zh: 退伍军人还有另一种服务方式：作为投票站工作人员。 “审查投票”组织招募退伍军人及其家人来帮助进行选举。从 2024 年总统周期期间招募 15 万名志愿者的目标开始，他们的竞选团队在本次中期选举中招募了来自所有 50 个州的超过 175,000 名志愿者，帮助支持全国人手不足和过度劳累的投票官员。该组织表示，全国五分之四的邮政编码地区都有志愿者。

paras.en: And veterans like to vote. Syracuse University D'Aniello Institute for Veterans and Military Families found that vets turned out in relatively higher numbers than civilians in every election since 2014, a difference especially pronounced in midterm elections.
paras.zh: 退伍军人喜欢投票。雪城大学达尼洛退伍军人和军人家庭研究所发现，自 2014 年以来的每次选举中，退伍军人的投票人数都相对高于平民，这一差异在中期选举中尤其明显。

paras.en: Being honest with people can be tricky. Sometimes, deciding whether to say anything at all can be harder than finding the right words to say. Social psychologist Vanessa Bohns says that giving feedback or criticism often feels like a dilemma. But with care, you can make better choices about when to share your thoughts. Bohns has shared three questions with Life Kit that you could consider before voicing your opinion.
paras.zh: 与人诚实可能很棘手。有时，决定是否说某件事可能比找到合适的词语更难。社会心理学家凡妮莎·博恩斯表示，提供反馈或批评常常让人感觉陷入两难境地。但只要小心，您就可以更好地选择何时分享您的想法。 Bohns 与 Life Kit 分享了三个问题，您在发表意见之前可以考虑一下。

paras.en: - 🗣️ Is this information helpful? Honesty is beneficial if your feedback helps someone improve, avoid embarrassment or learn something about themselves. If your comments are mean-spirited, irrelevant or impractical to enact, it's probably better to stay silent.
paras.zh: - 🗣️这些信息有帮助吗？如果您的反馈有助于某人进步、避免尴尬或了解自己，那么诚实是有益的。如果你的评论是卑鄙的、无关紧要的或不切实际的，那么最好保持沉默。

paras.en: - 🗣️ Would I want to hear this? Just because you don't want to share the truth doesn't mean the other person doesn't want to hear it. A 2022 survey found that people often underestimate others' desire for feedback even when it is constructive.
paras.zh: - 🗣️我想听这个吗？你不想分享真相并不意味着其他人不想听。 2022 年的一项调查发现，人们常常低估他人对反馈的渴望，即使反馈是建设性的。

paras.en: - 🗣️ Do they want your feedback? When in doubt, don't assume you know what someone needs. Pre-assessing how valuable your advice is or how well someone can handle the truth can make well-meaning feedback sound patronizing.
paras.zh: - 🗣️ 他们想要你的反馈吗？如有疑问，不要假设您知道某人的需求。预先评估你的建议有多有价值，或者某人处理事实的能力有多好，可能会让善意的反馈听起来显得居高临下。

paras.en: - Volunteer musicians from Musicians On Call perform for veterans at the VA Medical Center in Washington, D.C., and other hospitalized patients nationwide. They typically visit hospitals three to four times a month.
paras.zh: - 来自 Musicians On Call 的志愿者音乐家在华盛顿特区的退伍军人管理局医疗中心和全国其他住院患者为退伍军人表演。他们通常每月去医院三到四次。

paras.en: - The Rembrandt House Museum in Amsterdam came alive recently as a renowned tattoo artist brought 17th-century masterpieces to life on visitors' skin.
paras.zh: - 阿姆斯特丹伦勃朗故居博物馆 (Rembrandt House Museum) 最近焕发活力，一位著名纹身艺术家将 17 世纪的杰作栩栩如生地呈现在参观者的皮肤上。

paras.en: - The Professional Women's Hockey League has announced the name of its new women's hockey team: the San José Sea Lions. (via KQED)
paras.zh: - 职业女子曲棍球联盟宣布了新女子曲棍球队的名称：圣何塞海狮队。 （来自 KQED）

articles.title: Greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers are competing in the Youth Olympics
articles.author: Ricci Shryock

paras.en: Greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers are competing in the Youth Olympics
paras.zh: 来自塞内加尔的问候，霹雳舞者正在那里参加青年奥运会

paras.en: Hip-hop music blasted over a portable speaker while half-a-dozen teenagers practiced their best breakdancing moves in Senagal's capital Dakar. They glided on their shins and jumped into the air, clutched their heels and struck midair poses.
paras.zh: 便携式扬声器中播放着嘻哈音乐，六名青少年在塞内加尔首都达喀尔练习他们最拿手的霹雳舞动作。他们用小腿滑行，跳到空中，抓住脚后跟，摆出空中姿势。

paras.en: Senegal's breakdancers were honing their craft ahead of the country's historic hosting of the Youth Olympic Games this month. It's the first time an Olympic event is being held on African soil.
paras.zh: 塞内加尔的霹雳舞者在本月该国历史性地举办青奥会之前磨练自己的技艺。这是奥运会首次在非洲土地上举行。

paras.en: I took the photo above last month as 15-year-old Suzanne Toure struck a breakdancing pose. She is the only girl on the Senegal National Sport Dance and Break Team. Three years ago, her little brother introduced her to breakdancing.
paras.zh: 上个月我拍了这张照片，当时 15 岁的苏珊娜·杜尔 (Suzanne Toure) 摆出了霹雳舞的姿势。她是塞内加尔国家体育舞蹈和霹雳队中唯一的女孩。三年前，她的弟弟向她介绍了霹雳舞。

paras.en: Dancers on the Senegalese team mix traditional moves into their routines from national styles such as mbalax and Yela, swirling their arms and legs in a windmill-like motion. "You can sense some American and European influence in our routines, yes, but there are also African dances. It's about mixing these African dances into the breaking," says coach Francis Siméon Gomis.
paras.zh: 塞内加尔队的舞者将传统动作融入姆巴拉克斯和耶拉等民族风格的舞蹈中，以风车般的动作旋转手臂和腿。 “是的，你可以感觉到我们的舞蹈受到了一些美国和欧洲的影响，但也有非洲舞蹈。我们要把这些非洲舞蹈融入到霹雳舞中，”教练弗朗西斯·西蒙·戈米斯 (Francis Siméon Gomis) 说道。

paras.en: They see this as their chance to show the world what their nation can offer on the dance floor, and hope to win a medal on home turf.
paras.zh: 他们认为这是向世界展示他们的国家在舞池上的能力的机会，并希望在主场赢得奖牌。

articles.title: It's official: now avoid credit card interest into 2024

paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。
