articles.title: The Maya Loved Using Mercury-Rich Red Paint to Decorate Pottery, Temple Walls and Even Burials. They May Have Accidentally Poisoned Their Own Water and Food Supply in the Process

paras.en: The Maya loved cinnabar, a bright red ore used to decorate pottery, burial sites, structures and more. But cinnabar is roughly 86 percent mercury, a highly toxic element that can harm humans, animals and ecosystems.
paras.zh: 玛雅人喜欢朱砂，这是一种鲜红色的矿石，用于装饰陶器、墓地、建筑物等。但朱砂大约含有 86% 的汞，这是一种剧毒元素，会危害人类、动物和生态系统。

paras.en: The Maya used so much of this prized pigment that they polluted some of their cities. Now, new research suggests the Maya’s cinnabar-derived mercury contamination was even more widespread than previously thought—and it could have contributed to the civilization’s downfall.
paras.zh: 玛雅人大量使用这种珍贵的颜料，以至于污染了一些城市。现在，新的研究表明，玛雅人朱砂产生的汞污染比之前想象的更为广泛，而且它可能导致了文明的衰落。

paras.en: Testing of ancient sediment from two lakes in modern-day Mexico’s Yucatán Peninsula has revealed high concentrations of mercury during ancient Maya occupation. The findings, published November 4 in the journal Science Advances, suggest mercury pollution took a toll on the lakes’ aquatic ecosystems, causing their populations of aquatic creatures to decline or collapse. If the Maya ate fish or drank water from the lakes, they could have been exposed to toxic concentrations of mercury for decades or even centuries.
paras.zh: 对现代墨西哥尤卡坦半岛两个湖泊的古代沉积物进行的测试显示，在古代玛雅人占领期间，汞浓度很高。 11 月 4 日发表在《科学进展》杂志上的研究结果表明，汞污染对湖泊的水生生态系统造成了损害，导致水生生物数量减少或崩溃。如果玛雅人吃鱼或喝湖水，他们可能会接触有毒浓度的汞数十年甚至数百年。

paras.en: In 2022, scientists reported finding high levels of mercury at several archaeological sites in the Maya’s southern highlands and south-central lowlands, attributing the contamination to the use of cinnabar. The new study, conducted by a different team of researchers, builds on that work, investigating mercury levels at bodies of water in the Maya’s northern lowlands.
paras.zh: 2022 年，科学家报告称，在玛雅南部高地和中南部低地的多个考古遗址发现了高含量的汞，并将污染归因于朱砂的使用。这项新研究由另一个研究小组进行，以这项工作为基础，调查了玛雅北部低地水体中的汞含量。

paras.en: Researchers stuck long, heavy, hollow cylinders deep into the lakebeds of two lakes near ancient Maya cities, Coba and Xcach (pronounced “scotch”). They pulled up thick columns of sediment that had preserved centuries of environmental history, layer by layer.
paras.zh: 研究人员将又长又重的空心圆柱体深深插入玛雅古城科巴和Xcach（发音为“scotch”）附近的两个湖的湖床中。他们逐层拉起厚厚的沉积物柱，这些沉积物保存了几个世纪的环境历史。

paras.en: At one site, Lago Coba, the sediment revealed centuries of elevated mercury levels, lasting from around 40 C.E. to 300 C.E. That corresponds with the end of the late Preclassic Period and the beginning of the Classic Period, which is considered the golden age of Maya civilization.
paras.zh: 在科巴湖 (Lago Coba) 的一个地点，沉积物显示了几个世纪以来汞含量的升高，从公元 40 年左右持续到公元 300 年。这对应于前古典时期晚期的结束和古典时期的开始，古典时期被认为是玛雅文明的黄金时代。

paras.en: At Cenote Xcach, mercury levels spiked three different times: First, from roughly 125 C.E. to 200 C.E., just before the Classic Period; again, from 330 to 350 C.E., in the middle of the Classic Period; and, finally, from 535 C.E. to 820 C.E., toward the end of the Classic Period.
paras.zh: 在 Cenote Xcach，汞含量在三个不同的时期出现峰值：首先是从大约公元 125 年到公元 200 年，即古典时期之前；再次，公元 330 年至 350 年，古典时期中期；最后，从公元 535 年到公元 820 年，古典时期即将结束。

paras.en: Some of the samples had mercury levels of 2.3 parts per million, which is over 1,000 times more concentrated than the 2 parts per billion maximum contaminant level set by the Environmental Protection Agency for safe drinking water. The Maya people who lived near the lakes would have been exposed to these high levels for years.
paras.zh: 其中一些样品的汞含量为百万分之 2.3，比美国环境保护局针对安全饮用水设定的十亿分之二的最高污染物含量高出 1,000 倍以上。居住在湖泊附近的玛雅人多年来一直暴露在如此高的浓度下。

paras.en: “The mercury data was crazy,” lead author Matthew Waters, an environmental scientist at Auburn University, says in a statement. “Off the charts. These mercury levels aren’t normal.”
paras.zh: “汞数据太疯狂了，”主要作者、奥本大学环境科学家马修·沃特斯在一份声明中说。 “超出了图表。这些汞含量不正常。”

paras.en: The scientists also looked at various biological markers in the ancient sediments, which revealed that bacteria, algae, shelled organisms, midges and other populations had decreased or vanished during the high mercury periods.
paras.zh: 科学家们还研究了古代沉积物中的各种生物标记，这些标记表明细菌、藻类、带壳生物、蠓和其他种群在高汞时期减少或消失。

paras.en: These results suggest mercury was making its way up the food web. Based on their proximity to and penchant for fish and shellfish, the Maya could have suffered from mercury poisoning, which can cause damage to the central nervous system, kidneys, lungs and heart.
paras.zh: 这些结果表明汞正在进入食物网。由于玛雅人对鱼类和贝类的亲近和喜爱，他们可能患有汞中毒，汞中毒会对中枢神经系统、肾脏、肺和心脏造成损害。

paras.en: At the very least, the Maya living near the lakes would have seen “a strange color change in the water … and a drop in its productivity, such as fish for protein,” Waters tells Live Science’s Tom Metcalfe.
paras.zh: 沃特斯告诉《生活科学》杂志的汤姆·梅特卡夫，至少，生活在湖泊附近的玛雅人会看到“水发生了奇怪的颜色变化......并且其生产力下降，例如鱼类蛋白质的下降”。

paras.en: The scientists suspect the Maya imported cinnabar to Coba and Xcach because it does not occur naturally in the Yucatán Peninsula. If confirmed, this hunch could add cinnabar to the list of valuable commodities traded across the Maya world, alongside obsidian, jade and weapons. Researchers hope to take core samples from lakes located near Maya trade hubs to further explore this idea.
paras.zh: 科学家怀疑玛雅人将朱砂引入了科巴和Xcach，因为朱砂在尤卡坦半岛并不自然存在。如果这一预感得到证实，朱砂可能会与黑曜石、玉石和武器一起加入到玛雅世界的贵重商品交易清单中。研究人员希望从玛雅贸易中心附近的湖泊中采集岩芯样本，以进一步探索这一想法。

paras.en: In 2025, a team of archaeologists working at the Maya site of Caracol in modern-day Belize discovered the cinnabar-coated tomb of dynasty founder Te K’ab Chaak.
paras.zh: 2025 年，一组考古学家在位于现代伯利兹的卡拉科尔玛雅遗址发现了王朝创始人 Te K’ab Chaak 的朱砂坟墓。

paras.en: - The finds included more than 100 shards of obsidian, jade and shell that composed a mosaic death mask for the deceased ruler.
paras.zh: - 这些发现包括 100 多块黑曜石、玉石和贝壳碎片，为已故统治者制作了马赛克死亡面具。

paras.en: They’re also investigating another theory: whether mercury poisoning might have played a role in the abandonment of several large Maya cities toward the end of the Classic Period.
paras.zh: 他们还在研究另一种理论：汞中毒是否可能在古典时期末期几个玛雅大城市的废弃中发挥了作用。

paras.en: Scientists have put forward numerous theories to explain this collapse, ranging from overpopulation and warfare to drought and deforestation. The new paper doesn’t directly link mercury to the demise of these Maya cities, but it does add “one more stressor” to the list of pressures scientists know the civilization was already facing, study co-author Savanna Wooten, an environmental scientist at the Jones Center at Ichauway, a nonprofit research facility in Georgia, tells Reuters’ Will Dunham.
paras.zh: 科学家们提出了许多理论来解释这种崩溃，从人口过剩和战争到干旱和森林砍伐。这篇新论文并没有直接将汞与这些玛雅城市的灭亡联系起来，但它确实在科学家们所知道的文明已经面临的压力清单上添加了“另一个压力源”，该研究的合著者、佐治亚州非营利性研究机构伊肖韦琼斯中心的环境科学家萨凡娜·伍滕告诉路透社的威尔·邓纳姆。

articles.title: Octopuses Are the Ultimate Escape Artists. Now Scientists Know How the Creatures Contort Themselves to Squeeze Through Tiny Holes

paras.en: Octopuses are talented escape artists, capable of squeezing their bodies through seemingly impenetrable gaps to avoid danger, find hidden prey or break out of captivity. Scientists have long wondered how these eight-limbed creatures manage such impressive feats of flexibility. Now, they say they have some answers.
paras.zh: 章鱼是天才的逃脱艺术家，它们能够将自己的身体挤过看似无法穿透的缝隙，以避免危险、寻找隐藏的猎物或挣脱束缚。长期以来，科学家们一直想知道这些八肢生物是如何实现如此令人印象深刻的灵活性的。现在，他们说他们有了一些答案。

paras.en: A study published November 5 in the Journal of Experimental Biology describes the step-by-step processes some octopuses use to cram themselves into tight spaces. In addition to expanding our understanding of these crafty cephalopods, the findings could help engineers improve the design of soft robots that need to fit into small spaces, such as those used during search-and-rescue missions.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日发表在《实验生物学杂志》上的一项研究描述了一些章鱼将自己塞进狭小空间的逐步过程。除了扩大我们对这些狡猾的头足类动物的了解之外，这些发现还可以帮助工程师改进需要适应狭小空间的软机器人的设计，例如在搜救任务中使用的软机器人。

paras.en: “You always just think as a biologist that this is a minor question: How to squeeze your body into a crevice, through a hole or into a cave,” study co-author Michael Kuba, a biologist at the University of Naples Federico II in Italy, tells IFLScience’s Rachael Funnell. “But working with soft robotic engineers, you realize that there is so much more to how they manage to do this. They have several steps of the movement, and they have specific postures and body parts they use to move through a hole.”
paras.zh: “作为一名生物学家，你总是认为这是一个小问题：如何将你的身体挤进缝隙、洞或洞穴中，”研究合著者、意大利那不勒斯费德里科二世大学的生物学家迈克尔·库巴 (Michael Kuba) 告诉 IFLScience 的 Rachael Funnell。 “但是与软机​​器人工程师一起工作，你会意识到他们如何做到这一点还有很多。他们有几个运动步骤，并且他们有特定的姿势和身体部位用于穿过洞。”

paras.en: In the study, Kuba and colleagues conducted laboratory experiments involving three subadult common octopuses (Octopus vulgaris) and four juvenile Mayan octopuses (O. maya). The team started by measuring the distance between each animal’s eyes to determine the size of the semi-rigid cartilage casing surrounding their brains. Then, they adjusted a clear, acrylic tank partition to create a single, central hole that was either smaller or larger than the measurements, which ranged from about 0.4 to 1.4 inches. One at a time, they placed the octopuses in the tank, then watched and filmed what happened next.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，库巴和同事进行了实验室实验，涉及三只亚成年普通章鱼（Octopus vulgaris）和四只幼年玛雅章鱼（O.maya）。研究小组首先测量每只动物眼睛之间的距离，以确定它们大脑周围的半刚性软骨外壳的大小。然后，他们调整了透明的丙烯酸水箱隔板，以创建一个比测量值更小或更大的单个中心孔，测量值的范围约为 0.4 到 1.4 英寸。他们一次一只地把章鱼放入水箱中，然后观察并拍摄接下来发生的事情。

paras.en: “We know that they can squeeze through all these spaces, but nobody’s actually looked at how they do this,” study co-author Tamar Gutnick, a biologist at the Haus des Meeres-Aqua Terra Zoo in Austria, tells NPR’s Ari Daniel. “So, what we did was take octopuses and systematically make them go through different-sized holes.”
paras.zh: “我们知道它们可以挤过所有这些空间，但没有人真正研究过它们是如何做到这一点的，”该研究的合著者、奥地利 Haus des Meeres-Aqua Terra 动物园的生物学家塔玛尔·古特尼克 (Tamar Gutnick) 告诉 NPR 的阿里·丹尼尔 (Ari Daniel)。 “所以，我们所做的就是让章鱼系统地穿过不同大小的洞。”

paras.en: Octopus bodies are mostly soft and pliable. These creatures have only two stiffer body parts: a cartilaginous shell that protects their brains and a beak—made of a hard material called chitin—that they use to eat.
paras.zh: 章鱼的身体大多柔软且柔韧。这些生物只有两个更坚硬的身体部分：保护大脑的软骨壳和由称为甲壳素的坚硬材料制成的喙，它们用来进食。

paras.en: The common octopuses used two different strategies, depending on the size of the hole. When the opening was larger than the distance between their eyes, they tended to perform a three-step maneuver. First, they probed the hole with one arm, initially creating a U-shaped bend at the opening, then sticking the limb through. That might be the animals’ way of feeling out the situation.
paras.zh: 常见的章鱼根据洞的大小使用两种不同的策略。当开口大于眼睛之间的距离时，他们倾向于执行三步操作。首先，他们用一只手臂探查这个洞，最初在开口处形成一个 U 形弯曲，然后将肢体插入其中。这可能是动物感知情况的方式。

paras.en: “The idea is that the octopuses use the tactile sense on the arms to investigate the opening,” Kuba tells Reuters’ Marta Serafinko.
paras.zh: “我们的想法是，章鱼利用手臂上的触觉来调查开口，”库巴告诉路透社的玛塔·塞拉芬科。

paras.en: Then, they snaked a few more arms through the hole. Finally, they used the arms that were already through the hole to push against the back side of the partition, using leverage to pull the rest of their bodies through.
paras.zh: 然后，他们又从洞里伸了几条手臂。最后，他们用已经穿过洞的手臂推着隔板的背面，利用杠杆作用将身体的其余部分拉了进去。

paras.en: When the hole was smaller than the distance between their eyes, the common octopuses used a similar strategy, except they broke the final step into two stages. After probing and then threading a few arms through, they put the remaining arms through. Then, they pulled their head and mantle through.
paras.zh: 当洞小于眼睛之间的距离时，普通章鱼会使用类似的策略，只不过它们将最后一步分为两个阶段。在探测并穿过几条手臂后，他们将其余的手臂穿过。然后，他们把头和斗篷拉了出来。

paras.en: “This change initially puzzled all of us,” lead author Wenci Xin, a roboticist at the National University of Singapore, tells IFLScience. “However, after thinking about it carefully, we felt that it made sense: The animals were still following the same general pattern, while the new strategy simply divided the process of pulling the body through into separate stages.”
paras.zh: “这一变化最初让我们所有人都感到困惑，”新加坡国立大学的机器人专家、主要作者 Wenci Xin 告诉 IFLScience。 “然而，仔细思考后，我们觉得这是有道理的：动物仍然遵循相同的一般模式，而新策略只是将拉动身体的过程分为不同的阶段。”

paras.en: The Mayan octopuses deployed a similar strategy as the common octopuses when the hole was larger than the distance between their eyes. But when the hole was smaller, they simply ignored it—they didn’t even try to squeeze through.
paras.zh: 当洞大于它们眼睛之间的距离时，玛雅章鱼采取了与普通章鱼类似的策略。但当洞变小时，他们就直接忽略它——甚至没有试图挤过去。

paras.en: It’s not clear why the two species behaved differently. However, the researchers suspect their unique approaches likely stem from differences in their biologies or environments. Other species of octopuses might also have their own squeezing strategies.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚为什么这两个物种表现不同。然而，研究人员怀疑他们独特的方法可能源于他们的生物学或环境的差异。其他种类的章鱼也可能有自己的挤压策略。

paras.en: The new work sheds light on how some octopuses pull off their acrobatic stunts. But scientists still don’t fully understand how octopuses can tolerate the physical demands of these movements.
paras.zh: 这项新研究揭示了一些章鱼如何完成杂技特技。但科学家们仍然不完全了解章鱼如何忍受这些运动的身体要求。

paras.en: “It’s really remarkable that they carry on about their daily business,” Trevor Wardill, a neuroethologist at the University of Minnesota who was not involved with the study, tells the Washington Post’s Meghan Bartels.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的明尼苏达大学神经行为学家特雷弗·沃迪尔 (Trevor Wardill) 告诉《华盛顿邮报》的梅根·巴特尔斯 (Meghan Bartels)，“他们继续处理日常事务真是太了不起了。”

paras.en: If humans or other animals with backbones tried something similar, he says, “that level of brain distortion … would be like a massive concussion—you’d be really spaced out for a very long time, if not dead.”
paras.zh: 他说，如果人类或其他有脊椎的动物尝试类似的事情，“那种程度的大脑扭曲……就像一次巨大的脑震荡——你会在很长一段时间内昏迷不醒，甚至死亡。”

paras.en: Moving forward, the researchers hope the results of their experiments will help them develop flexible, octopus-like robots that can successfully navigate confined spaces. Today, most search-and-rescue robots are long and slender—more like snakes than octopuses, a design that helps them wriggle through narrow crevices. But an octopus-inspired robot might have other benefits, such as the ability to carry sensors, communication devices and tools on its flexible arms.
paras.zh: 展望未来，研究人员希望他们的实验结果能够帮助他们开发出灵活的、类似章鱼的机器人，能够成功地在密闭空间中航行。如今，大多数搜救机器人都又长又细——更像蛇而不是章鱼，这种设计可以帮助它们蠕动穿过狭窄的缝隙。但受章鱼启发的机器人可能还有其他好处，例如能够在其灵活的手臂上携带传感器、通信设备和工具。

paras.en: “This incredible capability could enable robots to overcome environmental limitations and enter spaces that are difficult to reach,” Xin tells Science News’ Nora Bradford.
paras.zh: “这种令人难以置信的能力可以使机器人克服环境限制并进入难以到达的空间，”辛告诉《科学新闻》的诺拉·布拉德福德。

articles.title: The Handwritten Final Draft of Martin Luther King Jr.'s 'I Have a Dream' Speech Was Considered Lost. It Turned Out to Be Sitting in a Desk Drawer for Decades

paras.en: It was late on August 27, 1963, and Martin Luther King Jr. was huddled with a group of his closest advisors in the lobby of the Willard Hotel in Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 1963 年 8 月 27 日深夜，马丁·路德·金 (Martin Luther King Jr.) 和他最亲密的一群顾问挤在华盛顿特区威拉德酒店的大厅里。

paras.en: They were drafting King’s closing remarks for the March on Washington, officially the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, which was set to start in just 12 hours. The group went back and forth on the message: Should it be ideological or Biblical? Directed towards the students marching or the nation at large?
paras.zh: 他们正在起草马丁·路德·金为“华盛顿大游行”（正式名称为“华盛顿争取就业和自由大游行”）的闭幕词，该活动原定在 12 小时内开始。小组就这个信息反复讨论：它应该是意识形态的还是圣经的？针对学生游行还是针对整个国家？

paras.en: As the night wore on, King eventually bowed out. “Okay brothers,” Clarence B. Jones, an activist and speechwriter for King, recalled him saying. “Thank you so much everybody for your suggestions and input … I am now going upstairs to my room to counsel with my Lord.”
paras.zh: 随着夜幕降临，金最终退出了。 “好吧，兄弟们，”金的活动家兼演讲撰稿人克拉伦斯·B·琼斯 (Clarence B. Jones) 回忆起金的说法。 “非常感谢大家的建议和意见……我现在上楼到我的房间向我的主商议。”

paras.en: Alone in his suite, King stayed up until 4 a.m., writing and revising his remarks on a yellow notepad, scratching out swaths of text in blue ink. He then sent these marked-up pages to be typed, forming the basis of his canonical “I Have a Dream” speech, delivered to more than 250,000 demonstrators gathered by the Lincoln Memorial.
paras.zh: 金独自在套房里熬夜到凌晨 4 点，在黄色记事本上书写和修改自己的言论，并用蓝色墨水划出大段文字。然后，他将这些标记好的页面发送给打字员，构成了他向林肯纪念堂聚集的超过 250,000 名示威者发表的经典演讲“我有一个梦想”的基础。

paras.en: Scholars have long assumed that the original, handwritten final draft had been discarded amid the day’s chaos. But six decades later, the manuscript has resurfaced from a drawer of one of King’s former aides. The seven yellow pages are set to be auctioned at Christie’s in January, where the draft is expected to sell for more than $10 million.
paras.zh: 长期以来，学者们一直认为手写的最终草稿在当天的混乱中已被丢弃。但六年后，这份手稿又从金的一位前助手的抽屉里重新出现。这七本黄页将于 1 月份在佳士得拍卖，预计售价将超过 1000 万美元。

paras.en: “When I first saw these pages and realized what they were, I was astounded,” Christie’s manuscripts specialist Peter Klarnet says in a statement. “This is a treasure of American history … Reading along, you’re there in the moment with Dr. King, watching him compose it and making edits in real time.”
paras.zh: “当我第一次看到这些页面并意识到它们是什么时，我感到震惊，”佳士得手稿专家彼得·克拉内特（Peter Klarnet）在一份声明中说道。 “这是美国历史的瑰宝……一边读，一边与金博士在一起，看着他实时创作并进行编辑。”

paras.en: Civil rights leader and philanthropist Xernona Clayton found the pages in the late 1990s. They were tucked in an envelope labeled “speech,” nestled among other papers in a desk drawer belonging to her late husband, Edward, one of King’s aides and speechwriters.
paras.zh: 民权领袖兼慈善家 Xernona Clayton 在 20 世纪 90 年代末发现了这些页面。它们被塞在一个贴着“演讲”标签的信封里，与她已故丈夫爱德华（金的助手和演讲撰稿人之一）的办公桌抽屉里的其他文件放在一起。

paras.en: Clayton knew it was an important document related to the “I Have a Dream” speech but not that it was the final manuscript. She tucked it back in the desk drawer, not wanting to disrespect King’s memory by selling or displaying his memorabilia.
paras.zh: 克莱顿知道这是一份与“我有一个梦想”演讲相关的重要文件，但不知道它是最终手稿。她把它塞回书桌抽屉里，不想通过出售或展示金的纪念品来不尊重他的记忆。

paras.en: But in recent years, she changed her mind. “Now that I’m older, I’m wiser,” Clayton, now 96, tells the New York Times’ Jennifer Schuessler. “It just seems like something that important ought to be shared.”
paras.zh: 但近年来，她改变了想法。 “现在我年纪大了，我更聪明了，”现年 96 岁的克莱顿告诉《纽约时报》的詹妮弗·舒斯勒。 “这似乎是一些重要的事情应该被分享。”

paras.en: In 2024, she shared the pages with her financial manager, who worked with the Christie’s team to identify it as the only known handwritten final draft of the famous speech.
paras.zh: 2024 年，她与财务经理分享了这些页面，财务经理与佳士得团队合作，将其确定为唯一已知的著名演讲的手写最终草稿。

paras.en: “I’m just glad I looked at the drawer,” Clayton says in the statement. “Now, the world will have the opportunity to see those words of wisdom that continue to inspire hope, freedom and the pursuit of equality.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴看到了抽屉，”克莱顿在声明中说道。 “现在，世界将有机会看到那些继续激发希望、自由和追求平等的智慧之言。”

paras.en: The handwritten manuscript is nearly identical to the final, typeface draft King carried with him to the lectern, a copy of which is currently on view at Smithsonian’s National Museum of African American History and Culture (NMAAHC).
paras.zh: 这份手写手稿与金随身携带到讲台上的最终字体草稿几乎完全相同，该手稿的副本目前正在史密森尼国家非裔美国人历史和文化博物馆 (NMAAHC) 展出。

paras.en: “The speech was slotted to be a four-minute closing to the march,” NMAAHC curator Kevin Strait explained in 2021. “However, it became a powerful, 16-minute rallying cry for the entire civil rights movement.”
paras.zh: NMAAHC 策展人凯文·斯特雷特 (Kevin Strait) 在 2021 年解释说：“这场演讲原定为游行结束时的四分钟。然而，它成为整个民权运动强有力的 16 分钟战斗口号。”

paras.en: In fact, neither the original, handwritten pages nor the printed copy bear any mention of the speech’s most memorable line, King’s “I have a dream” refrain. Those words, along with much of the speech’s second half, were improvised on the spot after gospel singer Mahalia Jackson shouted to King, “Tell ‘em about the ‘dream.’” The rediscovered draft does contain the speech’s enduring final line, “Free at last, free at last; thank God almighty, we are free at last.”
paras.zh: 事实上，手写原稿和印刷本都没有提及演讲中最令人难忘的一句话，即金的“我有一个梦想”。这些话以及演讲后半部分的大部分内容都是在福音歌手玛哈莉亚·杰克逊向金喊道“告诉他们‘梦想’”后即兴创作的。重新发现的草稿确实包含了演讲经久不衰的最后一句：“终于自由了，终于自由了；感谢全能的上帝，我们终于自由了。”

paras.en: King’s address has been extensively studied, but this manuscript may shed new light on the activist’s thinking in the hours leading up to the monumental march. For example, King rewrote the speech’s warning about “the tranquilizing drug of gradualism” three times. First, he wrote “tokenism,” before replacing it with “waitism.” He eventually crossing both out in favor of “gradualism,” per the Times.
paras.zh: 金的演讲已被广泛研究，但这份手稿可能会为这位活动家在纪念性游行前几个小时的想法提供新的线索。例如，金将演讲中关于“渐进主义镇静剂”的警告重写了三遍。首先，他写了“象征主义”，然后用“等待主义”代替。据《泰晤士报》报道，他最终将两者划掉，转而支持“渐进主义”。

paras.en: Scholars say the opportunity to see the speech in King’s own writing is an incredible opportunity. “When [Christie’s] called me, I was almost in disbelief. It’s almost like it gives us a chance to get between King’s ears, to get in his mind,” Lerone A. Martin, director of the Martin Luther King Jr. Research and Education Institute at Stanford University, tells the Times.
paras.zh: 学者们表示，有机会看到金自己撰写的演讲稿是一个难以置信的机会。 “当（佳士得）打电话给我时，我几乎不敢相信。这几乎就像给了我们一个深入金的耳朵、进入他的思想的机会，”斯坦福大学马丁·路德·金研究与教育研究所所长莱隆·马丁 (Lerone A. Martin) 告诉《泰晤士报》。

paras.en: Malcolm X attended the March on Washington but did not participate. He critiqued the event, calling it “the Farce in Washington,” and took issue with King’s "Dream" speech, declaring that “the black masses in America were—and still are—having a nightmare.”
paras.zh: 马尔科姆·X 参加了华盛顿游行，但没有参加。他批评了这一事件，称其为“华盛顿的闹剧”，并对金的“梦想”演讲提出异议，宣称“美国的黑人群众过去和现在仍然在做一场噩梦。”

paras.en: All proceeds from the sale will go to philanthropic efforts, including the Xernona Clayton Foundation and the King Center in Atlanta, which was founded by King’s wife and fellow civil rights activist Coretta Scott King.
paras.zh: 出售的所有收益将用于慈善事业，包括 Xernona Clayton 基金会和亚特兰大国王中心，该中心由金的妻子、民权活动家科雷塔·斯科特·金 (Coretta Scott King) 创立。

paras.en: The manuscript will be exhibited at the National Center for Civil and Human Rights in Atlanta from November 16 to 22, followed by a display in Chicago. The pages will also be on public display at Christie’s New York starting on King’s birthday, January 15, through January 21. The draft will be sold on January 22 in a single-lot sale.
paras.zh: 该手稿将于 11 月 16 日至 22 日在亚特兰大国家公民和人权中心展出，随后在芝加哥展出。这些页面还将在金的生日 1 月 15 日至 1 月 21 日期间在纽约佳士得公开展出。该草稿将于 1 月 22 日以单拍拍卖的形式出售。

paras.en: “It’s poetic that the past will protect the future,” Martin Luther King III, a human rights activist and the eldest son of the civil rights leader, says in the statement. “We are grateful that this treasure was preserved over the decades by the Clayton family … Now, for the first time, the public will have the opportunity to be inspired by this document.”
paras.zh: “过去将保护未来，这是诗意的，”人权活动家、民权领袖的长子马丁·路德·金三世在声明中说道。 “我们很感激克莱顿家族几十年来保存了这一宝藏......现在，公众将第一次有机会从这份文件中受到启发。”

articles.title: Ulta Promo Codes: Up to 20% Off in November 2026
articles.author: Boutayna Chokrane

paras.en: At Ulta Beauty, you can stock up on skin care, makeup, and haircare, then head to the salon for brows shaped, hair styled, and ears pierced, all in one visit. You’ll find brands like Dior, Estée Lauder, and Gucci alongside more affordable favorites and drugstore staples. Many locations feature a Benefit Cosmetics BrowBar, so you can sample products and book an in-store brow service in the same visit. Ulta’s return policy is very forgiving, allowing you to return “gently used” products within 30 days for a full refund. Add in its weekly sales, the 21+ Days of Beauty Event, and stackable Ulta coupons, and you’ll rarely pay full price.
paras.zh: 在 Ulta Beauty，您可以购买护肤品、化妆品和护发产品，然后前往沙龙进行修眉、做发型和打耳洞，这一切只需一次即可完成。您会发现迪奥、雅诗兰黛和古驰等品牌，以及更实惠的最爱和药店主打商品。许多门店都设有 Benefit Cosmetics BrowBar，因此您可以在一次访问店内品尝产品并预订店内修眉服务。 Ulta 的退货政策非常宽松，允许您在 30 天内退回“轻度使用”的产品并获得全额退款。再加上每周的促销、超过 21 天的美容活动以及可叠加的 Ulta 优惠券，您很少会支付全价。

paras.en: I’ve tested a wide range of beauty products sold at Ulta, from hair tools and red-light therapy devices for hair growth to LED devices, pimple patches, and lip balms. Here’s how to shop smarter, with the best Ulta promo codes and Ulta coupons to keep on your radar.
paras.zh: 我测试过 Ulta 出售的各种美容产品，从美发工具和用于毛发生长的红光治疗设备到 LED 设备、痘痘贴和润唇膏。以下是如何更明智地购物，让您时刻关注最好的 Ulta 促销代码和 Ulta 优惠券。

paras.en: One of the best ways to save regularly on both small, everyday purchases and bigger beauty tech and tools is to shop Ulta’s weekly and daily sales. With Ulta’s Daily & Weekly Beauty Steals, you’ll find up to 50% off everything from perfume to facial cleansers to makeup essentials. You can save big on brands like Ralph Lauren, Murad, Bumble & Bumble, and more.
paras.zh: 无论是日常小额购买还是大型美容技术和工具，定期节省开支的最佳方法之一就是购买 Ulta 的每周和每日促销活动。通过 Ulta 的每日和每周 Beauty Steals，您会发现从香水到洗面奶再到化妆必需品的所有商品均可享受高达 50% 的折扣。您可以节省大量购买 Ralph Lauren、Murad、Bumble & Bumble 等品牌的费用。

paras.en: 15% Off at Ulta Beauty When You Download the App
paras.zh: 下载 Ulta Beauty 应用程序即可享受 15% 折扣

paras.en: If you already shop at Ulta often, downloading and using the Ulta app is one of the best ways to save money on purchases you were planning to make. All you need to do is download the Ulta app (for free) by texting "Beauty" to 95637. From there, you’ll receive an Ulta promo code, APP15, for 15% off your next purchase. Plus, with the Ulta app, you’ll be able to virtually try on thousands of beauty products with GLAMlab, use the Ulta Foundation Matcher to match your skin tone and find your best shade, and get an AI-powered skin analysis for customized skin care recommendations.
paras.zh: 如果您已经经常在 Ulta 购物，下载并使用 Ulta 应用程序是您计划购买时省钱的最佳方法之一。您所需要做的就是发送短信“Beauty”至 95637，下载 Ulta 应用程序（免费）。从那里，您将收到 Ulta 促销代码 APP15，下次购买可享受 15% 的折扣。此外，借助 Ulta 应用程序，您将能够通过 GLAMlab 虚拟试用数千种美容产品，使用 Ulta Foundation Matcher 来匹配您的肤色并找到最佳色调，并获得人工智能驱动的皮肤分析以提供定制的皮肤护理建议。

paras.en: Plus, Ulta app members get exclusive in-app features, offers, and deals. You’ll also be able to monitor your membership rewards status and points, and get notified of app-exclusive deals, discounts, brand offers, and more. And with the handy barcode scanner, shopping has never been easier—you can scan any product’s barcode to see information on ingredients and product reviews. When you’re an Ulta member, you’ll get 1 point for every $1 spent and birthday perks.
paras.zh: 此外，Ulta 应用程序会员还可获得独家应用程序内功能、优惠和优惠。您还可以监控您的会员奖励状态和积分，并获得有关应用程序独家优惠、折扣、品牌优惠等的通知。借助方便的条形码扫描仪，购物变得前所未有的简单 - 您可以扫描任何产品的条形码以查看有关成分和产品评论的信息。当您是 Ulta 会员时，每消费 1​​ 美元即可获得 1 积分以及生日福利。

paras.en: Use Ulta Beauty Rewards for Ulta Discounts
paras.zh: 使用 Ulta Beauty Rewards 享受 Ulta 折扣

paras.en: The Ulta Beauty Rewards program is free to join and offers many perks with minimal effort. First, you earn points for every dollar you spend. The program has multiple tiers: standard members earn 1 point per dollar; platinum members earn 1.25 points; and diamond members earn 1.5 points. To qualify for platinum status, you need to spend $500 per year, and diamond members must spend $1,200 annually.
paras.zh: Ulta Beauty Rewards 计划可免费加入，并以最少的努力提供许多福利。首先，您花费的每一美元都可以赚取积分。该计划有多个等级：标准会员每消费 1​​ 美元可赚取 1 点积分；白金会员赚取1.25积分；钻石会员可获得1.5积分。要获得白金会员资格，您需要每年花费 500 美元，钻石会员则必须每年花费 1,200 美元。

paras.en: These points can be redeemed for discounts, and the best part is that they do not expire. (To activate your rewards, you need to download the Ulta Beauty app.) Here's how the points translate into savings: 100 points give you $3 off, 250 points offer an $8 discount, 500 points save you $17.50, and 750 points grant you $30 off.
paras.zh: 这些积分可以兑换折扣，而且最好的一点是它们不会过期。 （要激活您的奖励，您需要下载 Ulta Beauty 应用程序。）以下是积分如何转化为折扣：100 点积分可优惠 3 美元，250 点积分可优惠 8 美元，500 点积分可节省 17.5 美元，750 点积分可优惠 30 美元。

paras.en: During your birthday month, you get even more special perks. These include earning extra points on every qualifying purchase, a free gift, and a $10 coupon exclusively for platinum and diamond members. Other benefits include exclusive beauty deals, early access to sales, and full-size gifts for diamond members. Diamond members also get a $25 discount on beauty services and free shipping on orders over $25.
paras.zh: 在您的生日月份，您将获得更多特别福利。其中包括每次符合资格的购买即可赚取额外积分、一份免费礼物以及专为白金和钻石会员提供的 10 美元优惠券。其他福利包括独家美容优惠、抢先销售以及为钻石会员提供的全尺寸礼物。钻石会员还可享受美容服务 25 美元折扣，订单超过 25 美元可免运费。

paras.en: Unlock Free Standard Shipping on Your $35 Purchase
paras.zh: 购买满 35 美元即可解锁免费标准运费

paras.en: All online customers qualify for free standard shipping on purchases of $35 or more. It's easy to reach that amount at Ulta, even with all the discounts.
paras.zh: 所有在线客户购买满 35 美元或以上均可享受免费标准运费。即使有各种折扣，在 Ulta 也很容易达到这个金额。

paras.en: What We’ve Learned From Tracking Ulta Beauty Coupon Deals
paras.zh: 我们从跟踪 Ulta Beauty 优惠券交易中学到了什么

paras.en: We’ve been doing this for a while, and we’ve become pretty good at tracking and identifying the best offers available and bringing them to you, of course. We check Ulta often, testing the Ulta coupon codes ourselves and bringing them to you here weekly (if not more often). These are often deals for things like 20% off certain beloved brands or beauty categories, as well as BOGO deals.
paras.zh: 我们这样做已经有一段时间了，当然，我们已经非常擅长跟踪和识别可用的最佳优惠并将其带给您。我们经常检查 Ulta，亲自测试 Ulta 优惠券代码，并每周将它们带给您（如果不是更频繁的话）。这些优惠通常是某些受欢迎的品牌或美容类别的 20% 折扣，以及 BOGO 优惠。

paras.en: One of my favorite gifts to give (to myself or others) is an Ulta Beauty advent calendar. It’s a super fun gift, especially if you aren’t sure which brands or products the beauty guru in your life usually buys. These sets often come in themes, by product type, brand, and more. It’s a fun way to discover new products and brands and possibly find your next must-have.
paras.zh: 我最喜欢送给自己或他人的礼物之一是 Ulta Beauty 降临节日历。这是一份超级有趣的礼物，尤其是当您不确定生活中的美容大师通常购买哪些品牌或产品时。这些套装通常按产品类型、品牌等划分主题。这是发现新产品和品牌并可能找到您的下一个必备品的有趣方式。

articles.title: Home Depot Promo Codes: 30% Off in November 2026
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: The company pretty much invented the hardware superstore when it began in 1978, simply by being so big. It inflated the neighborhood tool shop into a whole city of lumber, hammers, caulk, power saws, and big rolls of wire. I would know I’m in a Home Depot blindfolded because of a distinct quality to the air—crisp and particulate, smelling like wood dust, paint, and the oiled metal of power tools. The Home Depot smell is buried deep in my childhood, filed somewhere between “building a deck” and “first day of spring.” Anyway, the Home Depot website is just as big. And while it doesn’t smell like sawdust, it’s easier to find stuff. Our roundup includes Home Depot promo codes from 20% to $100 off, new customer coupons, free shipping offers, and Pro discounts that can drop prices by as much as 50% when you buy online.
paras.zh: 该公司在 1978 年成立时几乎发明了硬件超市，只是因为规模太大了。它把附近的工具店变成了一座充满木材、锤子、填缝剂、电锯和大卷电线的城市。我知道自己是在家得宝 (Home Depot) 蒙着眼睛，因为空气中有一种独特的品质——清脆、颗粒状，闻起来像木屑、油漆和电动工具的涂油金属。家得宝的气味深深地埋藏在我的童年里，介于“建造甲板”和“春天的第一天”之间。不管怎样，家得宝的网站也一样大。虽然它闻起来不像锯末，但更容易找到东西。我们的综述包括 Home Depot 促销代码，折扣从 20% 到 100 美元不等，新客户优惠券、免费送货优惠以及在线购买时可降低价格高达 50% 的 Pro 折扣。

paras.en: If you’re hoping to use this winter to make some much-needed improvements around the house, be sure to take advantage of the major discounts and deals during the Home Depot Black Friday sale. During the sale, you can save hundreds of dollars on home essentials like appliances, tools, furniture, storage, smart home tech, and more.
paras.zh: 如果您希望利用今年冬天对房屋进行一些急需的改进，请务必利用家得宝黑色星期五促销期间的主要折扣和优惠。在促销期间，您可以节省数百美元购买家用必需品，如电器、工具、家具、存储、智能家居技术等。

paras.en: Join the Home Depot Text Program for $5 Off
paras.zh: 加入 Home Depot 短信计划可享 5 美元折扣

paras.en: Shop Top Home Depot Sale Deals for up to $1,400 Off Appliances, Bath Items, and Tools
paras.zh: 购买热门 Home Depot 电器、沐浴用品和工具促销，最高可减 1,400 美元

paras.en: And as it turns out, the hardware giant also goes hard on discounts, slashing prices on grills, garden and outdoor power tools, and smokers like the new Traeger Woodridge (8/10, WIRED Recommends), which is also sold at Home Depot.
paras.zh: 事实证明，这家硬件巨头还大力打折，大幅削减烤架、花园和户外电动工具以及新款 Traeger Woodridge（8/10，连线推荐）等吸烟者的价格，该产品也在 Home Depot 出售。

paras.en: But that’s not all; Home Depot is covering the whole house! There are appliance deals of up to $1,400 off, $1,000 off washer and dryer sets, and bathroom deals of up to 40% off vanities, 25% off bathtubs, 20% off toilets, and 15% off showers.
paras.zh: 但这还不是全部。 Home Depot 覆盖了整个房子！家电优惠高达 1,400 美元，洗衣机和烘干机套件优惠 1,000 美元，浴室优惠高达 40% 的梳妆台折扣、25% 的浴缸折扣、20% 的马桶折扣和 15% 的淋浴间折扣。

paras.en: Plus, Home Depot has appliance bundle deals where you can get major discounts when you purchase multiple appliances at once.
paras.zh: 此外，家得宝 (Home Depot) 还提供家电捆绑优惠，当您一次购买多件家电时，您可以享受大幅折扣。

paras.en: Get 40% Off With Home Depot Deal of the Day Coupons
paras.zh: 使用 Home Depot 每日特惠优惠券享受 40% 折扣

paras.en: Home Depot coupons of the moment include whopper deals like 15% off storage solutions and 35% off washers and dryers. Explore more deals on kitchen and other furniture by checking out the deals of the moment here. As we’ve stated, there are so many ways to save at Home Depot, even when you’re shopping online. Special Buy of the Day deals include steep price drops on select products or entire brands—but these significant discounts last only 24 hours. That’s a whole lot of savings for one of the most expensive home renovations you can do. Another savings hack? Jump on products marked with “New Lower Price” to find them at their lowest price yet.
paras.zh: 目前家得宝 (Home Depot) 优惠券包括诸如存储解决方案 15% 折扣以及洗衣机和烘干机 35% 折扣等巨额优惠。在这里查看当前的优惠，探索有关厨房和其他家具的更多优惠。正如我们所说，即使您在线购物，在家得宝也有很多省钱的方法。每日特价优惠包括精选产品或整个品牌的大幅降价，但这些大幅折扣仅持续 24 小时。对于您可以进行的最昂贵的家居装修之一来说，这是一大笔节省。另一个储蓄黑客？跳转到标有“新的更低价格”的产品，以找到迄今为止最低的价格。

paras.en: Winter is a great time to stay inside and focus on home improvement projects. Home Depot has everything you need for remodels (including bulk buys). Right now, vinyl plank and tile flooring is up to 30% off, with options starting at 99 cents per square foot. Plus, power tool kit combos can save even more, with bundle deals of up to 70% off—including Deals of the Day flash sales on tools and appliances with rebates of up to $1,000. Deals include smart home items WIRED has covered extensively, like Nest learning thermostats (9/10, WIRED Recommends). Need advice on setting up a smart home? WIRED has your back. Not only do Deals of the Day (and over 1 million products) qualify for free shipping, but you can also get free delivery to your local Home Depot store or straight to your door with online orders over $45.
paras.zh: 冬天是呆在室内并专注于家居装修项目的好时机。家得宝 (Home Depot) 拥有您改造所需的一切（包括批量购买）。目前，乙烯基木板和瓷砖地板最高可享受 30% 的折扣，起价为每平方英尺 99 美分。此外，电动工具套件组合还可以节省更多，捆绑交易最高可享受 70% 的折扣，其中包括工具和电器的每日特惠闪购，折扣最高可达 1,000 美元。优惠包括《连线》广泛报道的智能家居产品，例如 Nest 学习恒温器（9/10，《连线》推荐）。需要有关设置智能家居的建议吗？ 《连线》为您提供支持。每日特惠（以及超过 100 万种产品）不仅可以享受免费送货服务，而且您还可以免费送货到您当地的 Home Depot 商店，或者网上订单超过 45 美元可直接送货上门。

paras.en: Save 20% With Home Depot Pro Xtra Discounts
paras.zh: Home Depot Pro Xtra 折扣可节省 20%

paras.en: Home Depot also offers a loyalty program called Pro Xtra for frequent fliers, whether you’re a contractor or just undergoing a serious remodel this year. This means exclusive prices up to 20% off, 10% discounts on bulk buys, a rewards point system, and occasional $50 off $250 coupons. Painting the house? The program also nets you 10 to 20% off paint and primers. Pro Xtra offers multiple tiers, from basic membership to Elite and VIP.
paras.zh: 家得宝还为常旅客提供名为 Pro Xtra 的忠诚度计划，无论您是承包商还是今年刚刚进行重大改造。这意味着独家价格高达 20% 的折扣、批量购买 10% 的折扣、奖励积分系统以及偶尔 250 美元优惠券 50 美元的折扣。画房子？该计划还为您提供 10% 至 20% 的油漆和底漆折扣。 Pro Xtra 提供多个级别，从基本会员到精英会员和 VIP。

paras.en: Special Buys of the Week are bargains worth checking out, and pros can get discounts with the Pro Special Buy of the Week—and that’s on top of exclusive coupons, bulk product discounts up to 20% off, and everyday discounted pricing on items. Hot offers this week include: free tools or batteries with your purchase of tools from Milwaukee, RYOBI, and more premium brands, plus 20% off flooring. Also grab 40% off bathroom products like Kohler showers, tubs, vanities, faucets, and toilets, including luxury upgrades like Horow smart toilets and bidets.
paras.zh: 本周特惠商品是值得一试的便宜商品，专业人士还可以通过本周专业特惠商品获得折扣，此外还有独家优惠券、高达 20% 的大宗产品折扣以及商品的每日折扣价格。本周热门优惠包括：购买 Milwaukee、RYOBI 和更多优质品牌的工具即可免费获得工具或电池，以及地板 20% 的折扣。还可享受 Kohler 淋浴、浴缸、梳妆台、水龙头和马桶等浴室产品 40% 的折扣，包括 Horow 智能马桶和坐浴盆等豪华升级产品。

paras.en: Get 10% Off With the Home Depot Military Discount
paras.zh: Home Depot 军事折扣可享受 10% 折扣

paras.en: Home Depot has long maintained a program offering discounts to active service members, veterans, and their spouses, offering 10% off all eligible purchases. You’ll need to register to verify your military status through SheerID, and from then on, you can just scan your virtual ID or enter your phone number at checkout, the same way you do at the grocery store. Note that military discounts are limited to $400 each calendar year, and this resets each year. Some commodity products are excluded, including lumber, wire, and building materials. Appliances are also out in the cold, but military families may still find special deals or tax-free shopping through Home Depot’s Military Exchange Program.
paras.zh: 家得宝长期以来一直维持一项为现役军人、退伍军人及其配偶提供折扣的计划，为所有符合条件的购买提供 10% 的折扣。您需要通过 SheerID 进行注册以验证您的军人身份，从那时起，您只需扫描您的虚拟身份证或在结帐时输入您的电话号码，就像在杂货店一样。请注意，每个日历年的军事折扣限额为 400 美元，并且每年都会重置。一些商品不包括在内，包括木材、电线和建筑材料。电器也受到冷落，但军人家庭仍然可以通过家得宝的军事交换计划找到特价或免税购物。

paras.en: Get $100 Off With Home Depot Coupon Codes for Credit Cardholders
paras.zh: 信用卡持卡人使用 Home Depot 优惠券代码可立减 100 美元

paras.en: If you haven’t opened a credit card account at Home Depot, now is a great time. If you have a new account, when you place your first order with your credit card, you can save up to $100 on qualifying purchases.

paras.en: Plus, you can get up to 24 months of financing on special-order and installed purchases of blinds, shades, and shutters with Home Depot promo code YU8QTSVQ3. You can also get up to 24 months of financing on installed custom closet purchases with Home Depot coupon code 7MD4H2YQ2.
paras.zh: 此外，您还可以使用 Home Depot 促销代码 YU8QTSVQ3 购买百叶窗、百叶窗和百叶窗的特殊订单和安装产品，获得长达 24 个月的融资。您还可以使用 Home Depot 优惠券代码 7MD4H2YQ2 购买已安装的定制衣柜，获得长达 24 个月的融资。

paras.en: Not sure what to get for your dad, the grad, or the newlyweds in your life? That’s where Home Depot gift cards come in. Home Depot gift cards are the perfect present for the person in your life who’s always starting a new DIY project, or for new homeowners who can use all the help they can get. It’s a great way to say ‘thank you’ or ‘congrats,’ and the giftee can choose what they want to invest in, so you can ensure it’s their perfect present. Plus, Home Depot gift cards come in both physical plastic cards and eGift Card options, with a variety of designs for even more gift personalization. You can redeem a Home Depot gift card in-store or online, and the gift card value never expires.
paras.zh: 不确定要为您的父亲、毕业生或生活中的新婚夫妇买什么？这就是家得宝 (Home Depot) 礼品卡的用武之地。家得宝 (Home Depot) 礼品卡是送给您生命中总是开始新的 DIY 项目的人或可以利用他们可以获得的所有帮助的新房主的完美礼物。这是表达“谢谢”或“恭喜”的好方法，而且受礼者可以选择他们想要投资的东西，这样您就可以确保这是他们的完美礼物。此外，家得宝礼品卡有实体塑料卡和电子礼品卡两种选择，具有多种设计，可实现更加个性化的礼品。您可以在店内或网上兑换家得宝礼品卡，且礼品卡价值永不过期。

paras.zh: 使用 My Best Buy 信用卡获得 10% 返利

paras.en: This Best Buy Credit Card deal is a solid offer for anyone shopping big on electronics like OLED TVs, headphones, soundbars, and other gear. paras.en: You can also choose financing options like 12-month financing on storewide purchases totalling $299 and up, 18-month financing on appliances and grills totaling $599 and up, or 24-month financing on unlocked phone purchases totaling $649 and up.
paras.zh: 您还可以选择融资选项，例如全店购买总额 299 美元及以上的 12 个月融资、总额 599 美元及以上的电器和烤架的 18 个月融资、或总额 649 美元及以上的解锁手机购买的 24 个月融资。

paras.en: Save up to 60% With Top Deals at Best Buy

paras.en: Best Buy offers some sweet daily deals, including Top Deals that could save you up to 60% off retail pricing, and 24-hour discounts on a rotating deal of the day to help you save on gear like laptops, TVs, appliances, and other products. These deals switch swiftly, so be sure to check back often so you can jump on the next big discount.
paras.zh: Best Buy 提供一些超值的每日优惠，包括可让您节省高达 60% 零售价折扣的热门优惠，以及当日轮换优惠的 24 小时折扣，帮助您节省笔记本电脑、电视、电器和其他产品等装备的费用。这些优惠瞬息万变，因此请务必经常回来查看，以便享受下一个大折扣。

paras.en: Join My Best Buy for Free Shipping, Member Prices, and More

paras.en: If you’re in it for the long haul, it’s worth signing up for My Best Buy. It’s free and you get all sorts of Best Buy discounts and promos, along with multiple other benefits, starting with Free Standard Shipping across all levels.
paras.zh: 如果您打算长期投资，那么值得注册 My Best Buy。它是免费的，您可以获得各种百思买折扣和促销，以及多种其他优惠，首先是所有级别的免费标准送货。

paras.en: Move up to the My Best Buy Plus ($50/year) or My Best Buy Total ($180/year) will get you benefits like two-day shipping, exclusive member prices and deals on thousands of items, access to exclusive sales events and products, and a 60-day return window on the majority of products.
paras.zh: 升级到“我的百思买 Plus”（50 美元/年）或“我的百思买总计”（180 美元/年）将为您带来诸多好处，例如两天送货、独家会员价格和数千种商品的优惠、参加独家销售活动和产品以及大多数产品的 60 天退货期限。

paras.en: The My Best Buy Total plan offers a few other extras, including protection plans like AppleCare+, free in-store and online support services for computers and tablets, 24/7 tech support, 20% off repairs, and more.
paras.zh: My Best Buy Total 计划还提供其他一些额外服务，包括 AppleCare+ 等保护计划、针对电脑和平板电脑的免费店内和在线支持服务、24/7 技术支持、20% 维修折扣等等。

paras.en: Score Bonus Perks as a My Best Buy Plus or Total Member
paras.zh: 作为 My Best Buy Plus 或 Total 会员获得额外福利

paras.en: Those aren’t the only perks of jumping on one of Best Buy’s paid membership plans. Join up with the My Best Buy Plus or My Best Buy Total plans and get a slew of other Membership Deals, including a daily chance to win $1,000 in My Best Buy certificates (through May 2).
paras.zh: 这些并不是加入百思买付费会员计划的唯一福利。加入 My Best Buy Plus 或 My Best Buy Total 计划并获得一系列其他会员优惠，包括每天有机会赢取 1,000 美元的 My Best Buy 礼券（截至 5 月 2 日）。

You can also get a 90-day free trial for McAfee Privacy and Identity Guardian Online protection (or 80% off a 1-year subscription), and a month of Discord Nitro for free, to enhance your Discord experience with personalized profiles, animated emojis, and more.
paras.zh: 付费会员优惠还可以解锁各种订阅优惠，包括 30 天免费 Fubo Pro、2 个月 Tastemade+ 食谱试用、6 个月免费 SiriusXM All Access 卫星广播、3 个月免费 YouTube Premium 以及 60 天免费 LifeLock ID 防盗保护（第一年订阅可享受 75% 的折扣）。您还可以获得 McAfee Privacy and Identity Guardian Online 保护的 90 天免费试用（或 1 年订阅可享受 80% 的折扣），以及免​​费使用一个月的 Discord Nitro，通过个性化个人资料、动画表情符号等增强您的 Discord 体验。

With the Best Buy Outlet, you’ll get top tech and super discounted prices, including clearance items, open-box, and refurbished items for even more savings. You can save up to 60% on open-box major appliances, on-sale laptops for as low as $299, up to 50% off select open-box TVs, and 40% on select open-box unlocked cell phones from Apple, Samsung and Google.
paras.zh: 如果您想升级您的电器，百思买直销店是一个不错的起点。通过百思买直销店，您将获得顶级技术和超级折扣价格，包括清仓商品、开箱商品和翻新商品，以节省更多。折扣商品包括笔记本电脑、平板电脑、电视、电器等畅销产品。购买开箱主要电器、低至 299 美元的特价笔记本电脑可节省高达 60% 的费用，购买精选开箱电视可节省高达 50% 的费用，购买 Apple、三星和谷歌的精选开箱解锁手机可节省 40% 的费用。

articles.title: Shareholders sue Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang over alleged affair with Chinese spy

paras.en: Nov. 10 (UPI) -- Nvidia shareholders sued the tech company and its CEO, Jensen Huang, accusing them of misleading the shareholders in connection with Huang's alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 11 月 10 日（合众国际社）——英伟达股东起诉这家科技公司及其首席执行官黄仁勋，指控​​他们在黄仁勋涉嫌与一名中国间谍嫌疑人有染一事上误导股东。

paras.en: The lawsuit, filed Monday, alleged that Huang and the company did not disclose that his alleged affair with Alice Huang, who is of no relation, "raised concerns in the national security community" that could threaten Nvidia's "reputation and business prospects."
paras.zh: 周一提起的诉讼称，黄和该公司没有披露他与没有任何关系的爱丽丝黄的所谓风流韵事，“引起了国家安全界的担忧”，可能威胁到英伟达的“声誉和商业前景”。

paras.en: Nvidia, a world leader in semiconductor design, announced Sunday that it opened an investigation into reports that Jensen Huang, who is also the company's co-founder, was the target of a foreign intelligence operation.
paras.zh: 全球半导体设计领域的领导者英伟达周日宣布，该公司已对有关该公司联合创始人黄仁勋成为外国情报机构目标的报道展开调查。

paras.en: Its board announced in a statement Tuesday that it had retained former acting U.S. Attorney of the Southern District of New York Joon H. Kim and his Watchtell, Lipton, Rosen & Kratz firm to conduct the investigation.
paras.zh: 其董事会在周二的一份声明中宣布，已聘请纽约南区前代理美国检察官 Joon H. Kim 及其 Watchtell, Lipton, Rosen & Kratz 公司来开展调查。

paras.en: The New York Times and the Financial Times reported earlier this year that Jensen Huang had an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive of Megaspeed in Singapore. The Times also reported that a U.S. intelligence memo circulated among the Trump administration members last spring alleged that Alice Huang had been recruited by China to spy on the Nvidia CEO.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》和《金融时报》今年早些时候报道称，黄仁勋与新加坡 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 有染。 《泰晤士报》还报道称，去年春天在特朗普政府成员中流传的一份美国情报备忘录称，黄爱丽被中国招募来监视英伟达首席执行官。

paras.en: China has denied the reports. Jensen Huang, who is married, admitted to having an affair Sunday but did not say with whom.
paras.zh: 中国否认了这些报道。已婚的黄仁勋周日承认有外遇，但没有透露与谁有外遇。

paras.en: In the class action lawsuit filed in federal court in California, shareholders led by investor Mark Kistenmacher are seeking unspecified damages. Shares in the company plummeted Monday, closing down 4.3% and reducing Nvidia's market value by about $190 billion. The lawsuit was filed about 5 minutes after market close, The Guardian reported.
paras.zh: 在向加州联邦法院提起的集体诉讼中，以投资者马克·基斯滕马赫 (Mark Kistenmacher) 为首的股东正在寻求未具体说明的损害赔偿。该公司股价周一暴跌，收盘下跌 4.3%，使英伟达市值减少约 1900 亿美元。据《卫报》报道，该诉讼是在收盘后约 5 分钟提起的。

paras.en: Nvidia-designed artificial intelligence chips are subject to U.S. export restrictions to China. The lawsuit also accuses the company of making false statements about its relationship with Megaspeed, which has allegedly been the subject of investigations into whether it diverted Nvidia chips to China despite these restrictions.
paras.zh: 英伟达设计的人工智能芯片受到美国对中国的出口限制。该诉讼还指控该公司对其与 Megaspeed 的关系做出虚假陈述，据称该公司正接受调查，调查其是否不顾这些限制将 Nvidia 芯片转移到中国。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday that the FBI is also investigating the situation concerning Nvidia and Jensen Huang, though he did not provide specifics On Monday, Trump said Jensen Huang "had no idea" that Alice Huang was a suspected Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二表示，联邦调查局也在调查有关英伟达和黄仁勋的情况，但他没有提供具体细节。周一，特朗​​普表示黄仁勋“不知道”爱丽丝·黄是涉嫌中国间谍。

paras.en: "I asked him that question: 'Did you have any idea that she was a spy?' " Trump said. "He said, 'I had no idea that she was a spy,' and I really believe him."
paras.zh: “我问他这个问题：‘你知道她是间谍吗？’ ”特朗普说道。 "He said, 'I had no idea that she was a spy,' and I really believe him."

paras.en: The president also said Monday that he did not know of Jensen Huang's connection to the alleged spy in May, when Jensen Huang joined Trump on a presidential trip to Beijing.
paras.zh: 总统周一还表示，他不知道黄仁勋与特朗普五月份的总统访问北京时与被指控的间谍有联系。

paras.en: However, The New York Times reported Tuesday that officials told Trump about the connection shortly before the trip. It marked at least the second time in seven months that Trump had been told about the intelligence reports, The Times said.
paras.zh: 然而，《纽约时报》周二报道称，官员们在特朗普出访前不久就告知了这一联系。 《泰晤士报》称，这至少是特朗普在七个月内第二次获悉这些情报报告。

paras.en: The president also said that he will not bring up the matter when he visits China again next week.
paras.zh: 总统还表示，他下周再次访华时不会提及此事。

paras.en: "I just know Jensen very well," Trump said Monday. "I just think he's a very honorable man."
paras.zh: “我非常了解詹森，”特朗普周一表示。 “我只是认为他是一个非常值得尊敬的人。”

articles.title: SUV strikes pedestrians in North Hollywood, killing three

paras.en: Nov. 10 (UPI) -- At least three people are dead after an SUV struck at least five pedestrians on a sidewalk in North Hollywood, authorities said Tuesday night.
paras.zh: 11 月 10 日（UPI）——当局周二晚表示，一辆 SUV 在北好莱坞人行道上撞倒至少 5 名行人，造成至少 3 人死亡。

paras.en: The incident occurred at about 5:55 p.m. PST near the North Hollywood Metro station, at the intersection of Lankershim and Chandler boulevards, the Los Angeles Police Department said in a statement.
paras.zh: 事件发生在下午5时55分左右。洛杉矶警察局在一份声明中表示，太平洋标准时间位于兰克希姆大道和钱德勒大道交叉口的北好莱坞地铁站附近。

paras.en: The driver of the white SUV was hospitalized in critical condition, according to the LAPD, which said the investigation was ongoing.
paras.zh: 据洛杉矶警察局称，这辆白色SUV的司机已被送往医院，情况危急，调查仍在进行中。

paras.en: The Los Angeles Fire Department said in a separate release that three people were pronounced dead at the scene and that LAFD paramedics transported at least three others in critical condition to local hospitals.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶消防局在另一份新闻稿中表示，三人在现场被宣布死亡，洛杉矶消防局的医护人员将至少三人送往当地医院，情况危急。

paras.en: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass confirmed that first responders were on the scene and that her office was closely coordinating with city departments as authorities investigate the cause of the crash.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶市长凯伦·巴斯证实，急救人员已赶到现场，她的办公室正在与市政府部门密切协调，当局正在调查事故原因。

paras.en: "I'm heartbroken for the families of everyone impacted," she said in a statement.
paras.zh: 她在一份声明中说：“我为每个受影响的人的家人感到心碎。”

articles.title: American film, TV, stage actor Stacy Keach dies at age 85

paras.en: Nov. 11 (UPI) -- Stacy Keach, a staple of film and television for decades known best for his portrayal of hard-boiled private detective Mike Hammer on television, has died, according to his wife. He was 85.
paras.zh: 11 月 11 日（合众国际社）——据史黛西·基奇 (Stacy Keach) 的妻子透露，史黛西·基奇 (Stacy Keach) 去世了。几十年来，史黛西·基奇 (Stacy Keach) 一直是电影和电视界的主角，因在电视上扮演冷酷的私家侦探迈克·哈默 (Mike Hammer) 而闻名。他85岁了。

paras.en: Keach died Tuesday at his home in Magdalenka, Poland, following a "long and difficult battle with a serious heart condition and heart failure," Malgosia Tomassi told Variety and The Hollywood Reporter.
paras.zh: 马尔戈西亚·托马西告诉《综艺》杂志和《好莱坞报道》，基奇周二在波兰马格达伦卡的家中去世，此前他“与严重的心脏病和心力衰竭进行了长期而艰难的斗争”。

paras.en: "He fought for so long, with extraordinary courage, determination and strength. He was a true warrior, facing his illness with the same remarkable spirit and resilience that defined his life," Tomassi said.
paras.zh: 托马西说：“他以非凡的勇气、决心和力量奋斗了这么久。他是一名真正的战士，以定义他一生的非凡精神和韧性面对疾病。”

paras.en: "Stacy was not only a legendary actor, admired and loved by audiences the world over, but also my beloved husband, my companion and the heart of our family. His passing leaves an immeasurable emptiness in our lives. But his extraordinary spirit, his unforgettable voice and the love he gave so generously will remain with us forever."
paras.zh: “斯泰西不仅是一位受到全世界观众钦佩和喜爱的传奇演员，也是我深爱的丈夫、我的伴侣和我们家庭的心。他的去世给我们的生活留下了不可估量的空虚。但他非凡的精神、他令人难忘的声音和他如此慷慨地给予的爱将永远留在我们身边。”

paras.en: Keach was born June 2, 1941, in Savannah, Ga., to actress Mary Cain Peckham and Walter Stacy Keach Sr. an actor, producer and director who created the legendary Tales of the Texas Rangers radio show of the 1950s, according to the younger Keach's official biography.
paras.zh: 基奇于 1941 年 6 月 2 日出生于佐治亚州萨凡纳，父亲是女演员玛丽·凯恩·佩卡姆 (Mary Cain Peckham)，母亲是演员、制片人和导演老沃尔特·史黛西·基奇 (Walter Stacy Keach Sr)。

paras.en: His biography on the Hollywood Walk of Fame website states that Keach began acting at the age of four in Taft, Texas, before graduating from Van Nuys High School in 1959, and later earning English and dramatic arts degrees at the University of California, Berkeley, in 1963.
paras.zh: 好莱坞星光大道网站上的传记显示，基奇四岁时在德克萨斯州塔夫脱开始演​​艺事业，1959 年从范奈斯高中毕业，随后于 1963 年在加州大学伯克利分校获得英语和戏剧艺术学位。

paras.en: Keach first drew national critical attention for his Shakespearean performances at the Oregon Shakespeare Festival in the early 1960s.
paras.zh: 1960 年代初，基奇在俄勒冈州莎士比亚戏剧节上的莎士比亚表演首次引起全国关注。

paras.en: He then attended the Yale School of Drama and was awarded a Fulbright scholarship to study at the London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art.
paras.zh: 随后，他就读于耶鲁大学戏剧学院，并获得富布赖特奖学金前往伦敦音乐与戏剧艺术学院学习。

paras.en: In 1968, Keach landed his first film role, a supporting role in The Heart is a Lonely Hunter, starring Alan Arkin and Sondra Locke.
paras.zh: 1968年，基奇获得了他的第一个电影角色，在由艾伦·阿金和桑德拉·洛克主演的《心是孤独的猎人》中担任配角。

paras.en: Over the nearly six decades that followed, Keach accumulated some 200 credits as an actor, appearing in diverse works including 1972's John Huston-directed sports drama Fat City, 1978's Cheech and Chong drug comedy Up in Smoke, 1980's Western The Long Riders, 1998's American History X and the 2013 Oscar-nominated Nebraska.
paras.zh: 在接下来的近六十年里，基奇作为演员积累了约 200 个荣誉，参演过多种作品，包括 1972 年约翰·休斯顿执导的体育剧《Fat City》、1978 年的 Cheech and Chong 毒品喜剧《Up in Smoke》、1980 年的西部片《The Long Riders》、1998 年的《American History X》和 2013 年奥斯卡提名的《Nebraska》。

paras.en: He continued to act into his later years, starring as Joe Burns, the father of Matt LeBlanc's Adam Burns in the CBS comedy Man with a Plan, which ran from 2016 to 2020.
paras.zh: 晚年他继续演艺事业，在哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 喜剧《有计划的人》(Man with a Plan) 中饰演乔·伯恩斯 (Joe Burns)，他是马特·勒布朗 (Matt LeBlanc) 饰演的亚当·伯恩斯 (Adam Burns) 的父亲，该剧于 2016 年至 2020 年播出。

paras.en: In 2019, he received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
paras.zh: 2019年，他在好莱坞星光大道上获得一颗星。

paras.en: During the pandemic, Keach performed in a Zoom production of Shakespeare's King Lear.
paras.zh: 疫情期间，基奇在 Zoom 制作的莎士比亚戏剧《李尔王》中演出。

paras.en: He told UPI in April 2020, at the height of the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, that he planned to use the time in quarantine to finish several other artistic projects, and encouraged fans to find ways to be productive.
paras.zh: 2020 年 4 月，在美国第一波 COVID-19 大流行最严重的时候，他告诉合众国际社，他计划利用隔离期间完成其他几个艺术项目，并鼓励粉丝寻找提高生产力的方法。

paras.en: "Read that book, write that play," he said. "I think it's a time we should think of it as an opportunity to do things you wouldn't necessarily get to do having to go to work."
paras.zh: “读那本书，写那剧本，”他说。 “我认为现在我们应该把它视为一个机会，去做一些你不一定要去上班才能做的事情。”

paras.en: During his career, Keach was nominated for two Golden Globes, winning the 1989 trophy for best performance by an actor in a limited series for his portrayal of American Writer Ernest Hemingway in the television miniseries Hemingway, a role that also netted him an Emmy nomination.
paras.zh: 在他的职业生涯中，基奇曾两次获得金球奖提名，并因在电视迷你剧《海明威》中饰演美国作家欧内斯特·海明威而获得 1989 年限定剧最佳男演员奖，该角色还为他赢得了艾美奖提名。

articles.title: Jack River Signs With G.Y.R.O., Releases First New Music In Three Years
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: The independent Australian singer, songwriter and advocate (real name: Holly Rankin) returns with a new deal via G.Y.R.O. (Get Your Record Out), and new music in “Borderline.”
paras.zh: 这位澳大利亚独立歌手、词曲作者和倡导者（真名​​：Holly Rankin）通过 G.Y.R.O. 与新合约回归。 （拿出你的唱片），以及“Borderline”中的新音乐。

paras.en: A lowkey electronic earworm, “Borderline” is Jack River’s first release since 2023’s Endless Summer, during which she performed over 20 shows while pregnant with her first daughter Maggie.
paras.zh: 《Borderline》是一款低调的电子耳虫歌曲，是 Jack River 自 2023 年的《Endless Summer》以来发行的首张专辑，在此期间，她在怀着第一个女儿 Maggie 期间表演了 20 多场演出。

paras.en: “Borderline” was written following her breakthrough night out on her own, capturing the emotions, the fears, the vulnerability and the strength that comes with rediscovering the world.
paras.zh: 《边界》是在她独自度过一个突破性的夜晚后创作的，捕捉了重新发现世界所带来的情感、恐惧、脆弱和力量。

paras.en: “This is a song about traveling beyond the borderline, back to one’s self, back to freedom,” she explains. “I wrote this song after one of my first nights alone in three years, overwhelmed with the feeling that my sense of self was returning, and the reckoning that comes with that. It’s the beginning of a new era for Jack River – with less rules, less constraints, and more independence.”
paras.zh: “这是一首关于超越边界、回归自我、回归自由的歌曲，”她解释道。 “三年来我第一次独自度过一个晚上后，我写下了这首歌，我对自我意识正在回归的感觉以及随之而来的清算感到不知所措。这是杰克河新时代的开始——更少的规则，更少的约束，更多的独立。”

paras.en: There’s more on the way. Rankin is hard at work on a collection of songs which will traverse those years of “change and transition,” in her “relationships, her career and her personal world,” reads a statement announcing the new project. “Motherhood brought fearlessness, conviction and a realization that there’s no time to mess around, bringing with it new discipline and boundaries, but also a sense of freedom.”
paras.zh: 还有更多的事情正在路上。兰金正在努力创作一系列歌曲，这些歌曲将穿越那些年的“变化和转变”，在她的“人际关系、她的职业生涯和她的个人世界”中，在宣布新项目的一份声明中写道。 “母亲的身份带来了无所畏惧、信念和一种认识，即没有时间胡闹，带来了新的纪律和界限，但也带来了自由感。”

paras.en: Jack River established her as one of the Australian music scene’s leading lights with her 2018 debut album Sugar Mountain, which snagged three ARIA Award nominations (breakthrough artist of the year, best pop release and engineer of the year), an AIR Award nomination (best independent pop album) and an APRA Award nomination (breakthrough songwriter of the year).
paras.zh: Jack River 凭借 2018 年首张专辑《Sugar Mountain》确立了她作为澳大利亚音乐界的领军人物之一的地位，该专辑获得了三项 ARIA 奖提名（年度突破艺人、年度最佳流行发行和工程师）、一项 AIR 奖提名（最佳独立流行专辑）和一项 APRA 奖提名（年度突破歌曲作者）。

paras.en: Andy Irvine, CEO and co-founder of G.Y.R.O., the Brisbane-based independent music distribution and label services specialist, welcomes Jack River to its roster. “Holly has a clear vision for her music and an unwavering determination to make the Australian industry better for artists,” he remarks. “The team at G.Y.R.O. are excited to harness that independent spirit and bring her new music to audiences here and around the world.”
paras.zh: 总部位于布里斯班的独立音乐发行和唱片公司服务专家 G.Y.R.O. 的首席执行官兼联合创始人安迪·欧文 (Andy Irvine) 欢迎 Jack River 加入其名册。 “霍莉对她的音乐有着清晰的愿景，并坚定不移地决心让澳大利亚音乐产业更好地为艺术家服务，”他评论道。 “G.Y.R.O. 的团队很高兴能够利用这种独立精神，将她的新音乐带给这里和世界各地的观众。”

articles.title: ‘Beyond Anything I Could Have Imagined’: Carl Cox  Presented With OBE By Prince William
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Oh yes, oh yes! Carl Cox has been presented with his OBE (Officer of the Order of the British Empire), with Prince William on royal duties.
paras.zh: 哦，是的，哦，是的！卡尔·考克斯 (Carl Cox) 荣获 OBE（大英帝国军官勋章），威廉王子则担任王室职务。

paras.en: The pioneering British DJ and record producer is recognized for his outstanding services to music, and was one of several music figures identified in the King’s Birthday Honours List back in June of this year.
paras.zh: 这位英国先锋 DJ 和唱片制作人因其对音乐的杰出贡献而受到认可，并且是今年 6 月国王生日荣誉名单中确定的几位音乐人物之一。

paras.en: King Charles’ first born, William, had the honor of presenting Cox with his award during a ceremony this week at Windsor Castle.
paras.zh: 查尔斯国王的长子威廉本周有幸在温莎城堡举行的仪式上向考克斯颁发了奖项。

paras.en: “I’m not quite sure I can put into words what today means to me,” Cox writes on his social channels. “Music has been my whole life. From those early days of falling in love with records and DJing, to travelling the world and sharing that love with so many people, I’ve never stopped being grateful that I get to do what I do.”
paras.zh: “我不太确定我能用语言表达今天对我来说意味着什么，”考克斯在他的社交频道上写道。 “音乐是我生命的全部。从早期爱上唱片和 DJ 到环游世界并与这么多人分享这种爱，我从未停止过感激我能做我所做的事情。”

paras.en: To receive his OBE from Prince William at Windsor Castle, “recognising nearly 50 years of doing something I absolutely love,” Cox writes, “is beyond anything I could have imagined.”
paras.zh: 考克斯写道，在温莎城堡获得威廉王子颁发的大英帝国勋章，“这是对我近 50 年来所做的绝对热爱的事情的认可，这超出了我的想象。”

paras.en: Cox isn’t just a DJ. He’s an institution, an integral part of the house and techno electronic music story, one of the first “superstar” DJs and a vinyl technician who mastered the three-deck and four-deck mixing techniques. He founded his label Intec Records in 1999, and is a familiar face behind the decks at the biggest festivals and clubs, everywhere.
paras.zh: 考克斯不仅仅是一名 DJ。他是一个机构，是 house 和 techno 电子音乐故事中不可或缺的一部分，是最早的“超级巨星”DJ 之一，也是掌握三层和四层混音技术的黑胶技术人员。他于 1999 年创立了自己的厂牌 Intec Records，是世界各地最大的音乐节和俱乐部幕后的熟悉面孔。

paras.en: As clubland remained in lockdown during the pandemic, Cox used the time wisely to complete his autobiography, “Oh Yes, Oh Yes!,” a reference to his catchphrase. The book dropped in August 2021, published by White Rabbit.
paras.zh: 由于俱乐部在大流行期间仍处于封锁状态，考克斯明智地利用这段时间完成了他的自传“哦是的，哦是的！”，这是他的口号。该书于 2021 年 8 月发售，由大白兔出版。

paras.en: “This honour means so much, not just to me personally, but because of where our music has come from and how far it has travelled. To see dance music recognised in this way is something I’m immensely proud of.”
paras.zh: “这项荣誉意义重大，不仅对我个人而言，而且因为我们的音乐来自何处以及它走了多远。看到舞曲音乐以这种方式得到认可，我感到非常自豪。”

paras.en: Signing off, he gives a shout out to “family, friends, everyone who has believed in me, supported me and danced with me over the years, thank you. You’ve all been part of this. My heart is very full today. I’m proud, humbled and deeply honoured. Thank you.”
paras.zh: 最后，他向家人、朋友、所有相信我、支持我、和我一起跳舞的人大声喊道，谢谢你们。你们都是这一切的一部分。今天我的心非常充实。我感到自豪、谦卑和深深的荣幸。谢谢你们。”

articles.title: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala & SZA to Headline Coachella 2027
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Dua Lipa, SZA and Tame Impala will headline Coachella 2027, the festival’s reps announced on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
paras.zh: 音乐节代表于 11 月 11 日星期三宣布，Dua Lipa、SZA 和 Tame Impala 将成为 2027 年 Coachella 音乐节的主角。

paras.en: Also joining the lineup over its two weekends are Daddy Yankee, Madonna, Phoebe Bridgers, Don Toliver, Zara Larsson, Weezer, Dom Dolla and many more.
paras.zh: 两个周末也加入阵容的还有洋基老爹、麦当娜、菲比·布里杰斯、唐·托利弗、扎拉·拉尔森、威泽、多姆·多拉等。

paras.en: “Kill Bill” hitmaker SZA has previously performed at the festival, playing sets in 2016 and 2018, and making a cameo during Justin Bieber’s headlining set in 2026. Tame Impala spearhead Kevin Parker is also a Coachella veteran, having headlined the festival in 2019 after playing sets in previous years.
paras.zh: 《Kill Bill》热门制作人 SZA 此前曾在音乐节上演出，曾于 2016 年和 2018 年演出，并在 2026 年贾斯汀·比伯 (Justin Bieber) 的头条演出中客串。Tame Impala 先锋凯文·帕克 (Kevin Parker) 也是科切拉 (Coachella) 的老将，在前几年演出后，曾在 2019 年担任音乐节的头条新闻。

paras.en: However, Lipa — whose 2024 Billboard 200 No. 2 album Radical Optimism featured Impala’s production on many of the songs — has never been on the lineup, having only ever taken a stage in the Valley as a guest performer during Martin Garrix’s set in 2017.
paras.zh: 然而，Lipa 从未出现在阵容中，他的 2024 年 Billboard 200 排名第二的专辑《Radical Optimism》中的许多歌曲都是由 Impala 制作的，他只在 2017 年 Martin Garrix 的演出中作为客座表演者登上了硅谷的舞台。

paras.en: The 2027 iteration of Coachella will take place across two weekends on April 9-11 and April 16-18. Information on ticket packages is already available on the festival’s website.
paras.zh: 2027 年科切拉音乐节将于 4 月 9 日至 11 日和 4 月 16 日至 18 日的两个周末举行。有关门票套餐的信息已在节日网站上提供。

paras.en: Fans who miss out on tickets can once again watch from their devices, as YouTube returns for its 15th year as the exclusive livestream partner for both weekends.
paras.zh: 错过门票的粉丝可以再次通过自己的设备观看，YouTube 第 15 周年再次成为这两个周末的独家直播合作伙伴。

paras.en: Leading up to the 2027 headliner announcement, there’d been much speculation that Lipa and Impala would be leading the bill. Their desert takeover will come after Bieber, Sabrina Carpenter and Karol G headlined the festival in Indio, Calif., in 2026, a year that also saw sets from KATSEYE, sombr, The XX, Disclosure, Teddy Swims, Devo, The Strokes, GIVĒON, Addison Rae, Labrinth, David Byrne, PinkPanteress, Laufey and more.
paras.zh: 在 2027 年头条新闻发布之前，人们一直猜测 Lipa 和 Impala 将领先该法案。 2026 年，比伯、萨布丽娜·卡彭特 (Sabrina Carpenter) 和卡罗尔·G (Karol G) 在加利福尼亚州印第奥 (Indio) 举办的音乐节上亮相后，他们将在沙漠中大放异彩，这一年还有 KATSEYE、sombr、The XX、Disclosure、Teddy Swims、Devo、The Strokes、GIVĒON、Addison Rae、Labrinth、David Byrne、PinkPanteress、Laufey 等乐队的演出。

paras.en: The year before that, 2025 headliners Lady Gaga, Green Day, Post Malone and Travis Scott headed a lineup that also featured Missy Elliott, Benson Boone, LISA, FKA Twigs, GloRilla, Tyla, Artemas, Charli xcx, Anitta, Clairo, ENHYPEN, Jimmy Eat World, T-Pain, Megan Thee Stallion, Zedd, JENNIE, Beabadoobee, Ty Dolla $ign, Rema, Shaboozey and more.
paras.zh: 此前一年，2025 年的头条新闻以 Lady Gaga、Green Day、Post Malone 和 Travis Scott 领衔，其他成员还包括 Missy Elliott、Benson Boone、LISA、FKA Twigs、GloRilla、Tyla、Artemas、Charli xcx、Anitta、Clairo、ENHYPEN、Jimmy Eat World、T-Pain、Megan Thee Stallion、Zedd、JENNIE、Beabadoobee、Ty Dolla $ign、Rema、Shaboozey 等。

paras.en: Passes go on sale from Friday, Nov. 13 at noon PT. For more visit coachella.com and check out the full bill below.
paras.zh: 通行证从太平洋时间 11 月 13 日星期五中午开始发售。如需了解更多信息，请访问 coachella.com 并查看下面的完整账单。

articles.title: ‘You’ve Got Mail’ Reboot in the Works at Warner Bros.
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: A new take on the beloved rom-com You’ve Got Mail is in the works at Warner Bros., The Hollywood Reporter has learned.
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》获悉，华纳兄弟正在制作备受喜爱的浪漫喜剧《情书》的新版本。

paras.en: Rather than a remake of the original 1998 film starring Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan, the new film will follow a new story, though plot details are being kept under wraps.
paras.zh: 这部新电影并不是翻拍由汤姆·汉克斯和梅格·瑞恩主演的 1998 年原版电影，而是将讲述一个新的故事，但情节细节仍处于保密状态。

paras.en: Jason Orley (Close Personal Friends, Bupkis and I Want You Back) has been tapped to direct the project. He’s also writing the current draft based on a screenplay by Deborah Kaplan and Harry Elfont. Neal Moritz and Tania Landau from the original movie are also returning to produce.
paras.zh: Jason Orley（《亲密的私人朋友》、《Bupkis》和《我要你回来》）已被任命执导该项目。他还在根据黛博拉·卡普兰和哈里·埃尔方特的剧本撰写当前的草稿。原版电影中的尼尔·莫里茨和塔尼亚·兰道也将回归制作。

paras.en: The 1998 pic, based on Miklós László’s 1937 Hungarian play Parfumerie, follows book superstore magnate Joe Fox (Hanks) and independent book shop owner Kathleen Kelly (Ryan) as they fall in love in the anonymity of the Internet. However, they’re both blissfully unaware that he’s trying to put her out of business. Greg Kinnear, Parker Posey, Jean Stapleton, Steve Zahn, Heather Burns and Dave Chappelle also starred in the film helmed by Nora Ephron.
paras.zh: 这部 1998 年的影片改编自 Miklós László 1937 年的匈牙利戏剧《Parfumerie》，讲述了图书超市巨头乔·福克斯（汉克斯饰）和独立书店老板凯瑟琳·凯利（瑞安饰）在互联网上匿名坠入爱河的故事。然而，他们都幸福地没有意识到他正试图让她破产。格雷戈·金尼尔、帕克·波西、吉恩·斯特普尔顿、史蒂夫·茨恩、希瑟·伯恩斯和戴夫·查佩尔也出演了诺拉·艾芙隆执导的这部电影。

paras.en: Upon its release, You’ve Got Mail grossed more than $250 million at the global box office, not adjusted for inflation. It became Ephron’s highest-grossing film to date, behind Sleepless in Seattle (1993). Ryan also earned a Golden Globe nomination the following year for best actress in a motion picture — comedy or musical for her performance as Kathleen.
paras.zh: 《电子情书》上映后，全球票房收入超过 2.5 亿美元（未考虑通货膨胀因素）。它成为艾弗隆迄今为止票房最高的电影，仅次于《西雅图不眠夜》（1993）。瑞安还凭借在第二年扮演凯瑟琳的表演获得了金球奖最佳喜剧或音乐片女主角提名。

paras.en: Orley is repped by UTA, Rise Management and Hansen, Jacobson, Teller, Hoberman, Newman, Warren, Richman, Rush, Kaller, & Gellman L.L.P.
paras.zh: Orley 由 UTA、Rise Management 和 Hansen、Jacobson、Teller、Hoberman、Newman、Warren、Richman、Rush、Kaller 和 Gellman L.L.P. 代表。

articles.title: Potential ‘Pretty Little Liars’ Reunion? Lucy Hale Says Cast Is “Willing and Would Want to” Reprise Roles
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Lucy Hale, Ashley Benson, Troian Bellisario, Shay Mitchell and Sasha Pieterse might be going back to Rosewood.
paras.zh: 露西·海尔 (Lucy Hale)、阿什莉·本森 (Ashley Benson)、特罗伊安·贝利萨里奥 (Troian Bellisario)、薛·米切尔 (Shay Mitchell) 和萨莎·彼得斯 (Sasha Pieterse) 可能会回到瑰丽酒店。

paras.en: During a recent video for Entertainment Tonight, Hale (who played Aria Montgomery) was asked by her Pretty Little Liars co-star Ian Harding (who played Ezra Fitz), “What would it take to get the whole Pretty Little Liars gang back together?” The pair is currently promoting their new holiday film The 12 Dates of Christmas, which saw them reunite onscreen.
paras.zh: 在《今夜娱乐》最近的一段视频中，黑尔（饰演阿丽亚·蒙哥马利）被她在《美少女的谎言》中的搭档伊恩·哈丁（饰演埃兹拉·菲茨）问到：“要怎样才能让整个《美少女的谎言》团伙重新团结起来？”两人目前正在宣传他们的新假日电影《圣诞节的十二个日期》，这部电影让他们在银幕上重聚。

paras.en: “I don’t think it would take much,” she replied. “I think everyone is willing and would want to. I think it’s just a matter of schedule and getting the right script. I think the script has to be right, the storyline has to be right.”
paras.zh: “我认为这不会花太多时间，”她回答道。 “我认为每个人都愿意并且愿意。我认为这只是一个时间表和获得正确剧本的问题。我认为剧本必须是正确的，故事情节必须是正确的。”

paras.en: The actress continued, “And where is Aria? What’s Aria doing? Especially all the girls that came out of Rosewood, I feel like they’re not ever able to escape it. So, I feel like they somehow maybe left town but found their way back.”
paras.zh: 这位女演员继续说道，“Aria在哪里？Aria在做什么？特别是所有从Rosewood出来的女孩，我觉得她们永远无法逃脱它。所以，我觉得她们可能以某种方式离开了城镇，但又找到了回来的路。”

paras.en: PPL follows four friends — Aria, Spencer Hastings (Bellisario), Hanna Marin (Benson) and Emily Fields (Mitchell) — who work together against an anonymous foe who threatens to reveal their darkest secrets, while also investigating the disappearance of their best friend, Alison DiLaurentis (Pieterse). Keegan Allen, Tyler Blackburn and Janel Parrish also starred.
paras.zh: 《PPL》讲述了四位朋友——阿丽亚、斯宾塞·黑斯廷斯（贝利萨里奥饰）、汉娜·马林（本森饰）和艾米丽·菲尔兹（米切尔饰）——他们共同对抗一个威胁要揭露他们最黑暗秘密的匿名敌人的故事，同时还调查他们最好的朋友艾莉森·迪劳伦蒂斯（皮特斯饰）的失踪事件。基冈·艾伦、泰勒·布莱克本和贾妮尔·帕里什也出演。

paras.en: Hale also predicted where Aria and Ezra would be in a potential revival after their characters ended up together and got married in the show’s 2017 series finale. “I do believe Aria and Ezra are still together. I believe they have kids. I believe Aria has written some books,” she said.
paras.zh: 黑尔还预测，在该剧 2017 年的大结局中，阿里亚和埃兹拉的角色最终在一起并结婚后，他们的复兴可能会发生什么。 “我确实相信 Aria 和 Ezra 仍然在一起。我相信他们有孩子。我相信 Aria 写了一些书，”她说。

paras.en: As for Harding, he hopes a reunion sees everyone “in a place that is kind of what they wanted but maybe not quite, and then something brings them all back together.” Hale suggested, “Like, a tragedy brings them all back to Rosewood or something. There’s gotta be a new version of ‘A’ as well.”
paras.zh: 至于哈丁，他希望重聚能看到每个人“在一个他们想要的地方，但可能并不完全是这样，然后有什么东西让他们重新聚在一起。”黑尔建议道，“就像一场悲剧让他们都回到了罗斯伍德什么的。也必须有一个新版本的‘A’。”

paras.en: The original hit series ran for seven seasons, from 2010 to 2017. It also spawned several spin-offs and reboots, including Ravenswood, Pretty Little Liars: The Perfectionists and Pretty Little Liars: Original Sin.
paras.zh: 最初的热门剧集从 2010 年到 2017 年播出了七季。它还催生了几部衍生剧和重启剧，包括《雷文斯伍德》、《美少女的谎言：完美主义者》和《美少女的谎言：原罪》。

articles.title: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, SZA and Daddy Yankee to Headline 2027 Coachella Festival
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: The mystery is over: the lineup and headliners have been revealed for next year’s Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival in Indio, California.
paras.zh: 谜团已经结束：明年在加利福尼亚州印第奥举行的科切拉谷音乐艺术节的阵容和头条新闻已经揭晓。

paras.en: The headliners set to hit the stage for two weekends, April 9-11 and April 16-18, 2027, are Dua Lipa on Friday, Tame Impala on Saturday and SZA on Sunday. Daddy Yankee has also been tapped as a fourth top-billed headliner to showcase a special production.
paras.zh: 将于 2027 年 4 月 9 日至 11 日和 4 月 16 日至 18 日这两个周末登场的头条新闻是周五的 Dua Lipa、周六的 Tame Impala 和周日的 SZA。 《洋基老爹》还被选为第四位收视率最高的头条新闻人物，以展示特别制作。

paras.en: Other artists for Friday include Madonna, Zara Larsson, Steve Lacey, JISOO, Kehlani and Leon Thomas. As for Saturday, Phoebe Bridgers, Weezer, Tiësto, Martin Garrix, Role Model and Adéla are set to take to the Coachella stages. And finally, on Sunday, other performers include Don Toliver, Dom Dolla, Kygo, The Neighbourhood and Becky G. See the full lineup below.
paras.zh: 周五的其他艺术家包括麦当娜、扎拉·拉尔森、史蒂夫·莱西、JISOO、Kehlani 和莱昂·托马斯。周六，Phoebe Bridgers、Weezer、Tiësto、Martin Garrix、Role Model 和 Adéla 将登上 Coachella 舞台。最后，周日的其他表演者包括 Don Toliver、Dom Dolla、Kygo、The Neighborhood 和 Becky G。请参阅下面的完整阵容。

paras.en: The official Coachella Instagram account wrote in the post’s caption, “The return to innocence.”
paras.zh: Coachella 官方 Instagram 账户在帖子标题中写道：“回归纯真。”

paras.en: The 2027 headliners follow the chart-topping artists who headlined the 2026 iteration of the famed music festival, which included Justin Bieber, Sabrina Carpenter, Karol G and Anyma. Last year, Carpenter delivered a theatrical production that featured a dazzling, vintage Hollywood-style set and several celebrity cameos. As for Bieber, he brought a more intimate set, leaning heavily on his Swag era while also playing some classic hits via YouTube clips from his laptop onstage. Karol G, who became the first Latina solo artist to headline the festival’s main stage, brought the energy back up on Sunday with a visually stunning and electric performance.
paras.zh: 2027 年的头条新闻紧随 2026 年著名音乐节的热门艺术家之后，其中包括贾斯汀·比伯 (Justin Bieber)、萨布丽娜·卡彭特 (Sabrina Carpenter)、卡罗尔·G (Karol G) 和 Anyma。去年，卡彭特制作了一部戏剧作品，其中包括令人眼花缭乱的复古好莱坞风格布景和几位名人客串。至于比伯，他带来了更加亲密的演出，很大程度上依赖于他的 Swag 时代，同时还在舞台上通过笔记本电脑通过 YouTube 剪辑播放了一些经典热门歌曲。卡罗尔·G (Karol G) 成为第一位登上音乐节主舞台的拉丁裔独唱艺术家，周日，他以令人惊叹的视觉效果和震撼人心的表演重新焕发了活力。

paras.en: Passes for Coachella 2027 go on sale Nov. 13 at 12 p.m. PT. YouTube also returns for its 15th year as the exclusive livestream partner for both weekends.
paras.zh: 2027 年 Coachella 音乐节通票将于 11 月 13 日中午 12 点发售PT。 YouTube 也连续第 15 年再次成为这两个周末的独家直播合作伙伴。

articles.title: U.S., China should ‘harbor no illusions’ as they cooperate, compete on AI, Bessent says

paras.en: The U.S. and China should "harbor no illusions" about their differences as they engage to contain the risks of artificial intelligence, while competing with each other at the same time, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said.
paras.zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，美国和中国在共同遏制人工智能风险的同时，也不应对彼此之间的分歧“抱有任何幻想”，同时又相互竞争。

paras.en: Bessent said in prepared remarks to the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations in New York Tuesday that the two governments had established a new dialogue mechanism on "super intelligence," or SI, aimed at guarding against "shared risks" and averting any "misunderstanding between our two systems."
paras.zh: 贝森特周二在纽约向美中关系全国委员会发表的事先准备好的讲话中表示，两国政府建立了关于“超级情报”（SI）的新对话机制，旨在防范“共同风险”并避免“我们两个体系之间的任何误解”。

paras.en: The mechanism will see both sides exchanging "best practices" for testing advanced models before they are released, and "keeping human judgement firmly in command of the technology," Bessent said, expecting both sides to alert each other to serious incidents involving the SI models.
paras.zh: 贝森特表示，在该机制中，双方将在高级模型发布前交流测试先进模型的“最佳实践”，并“让人类的判断牢牢掌握技术”，并希望双方就涉及 SI 模型的严重事件相互发出警报。

paras.en: Bessent, however, stopped short of making any commitment to limit advancement of the technology, as Beijing and Washington remain locked in an intense race to achieve global dominance in AI.
paras.zh: 然而，贝森特没有做出任何限制该技术进步的承诺，因为北京和华盛顿仍在争夺人工智能的全球主导地位。

paras.en: The Trump administration has largely resisted broadening restrictions on AI development over concerns of ceding a competitive edge to China, though the president has more recently signaled some openness to putting in place regulatory safeguards.
paras.zh: 由于担心将竞争优势拱手让给中国，特朗普政府在很大程度上拒绝扩大对人工智能发展的限制，尽管总统最近表示对实施监管保障措施持开放态度。

paras.en: "I don't mind guardrails," he said in a CBS interview released Sunday, adding that he did not want regulations to put the U.S. in "a deep second position" behind China, which he said had no such restrictions.
paras.zh: “我不介意护栏，”他在周日发布的哥伦比亚广播公司采访中表示，并补充说，他不希望监管措施将美国置于中国之后的“深深的第二位”，他说中国没有此类限制。

paras.en: China's foreign ministry in September dismissed calls to slow down frontier models, saying that fearmongering and confrontation would only disrupt global AI governance. Huiyao Wang, founder of Center for China and Globalization, a think tank that closely aligns with Beijing's thinking, said last month that the U.S.-China talks should "confront AI risks and manage them together."
paras.zh: 中国外交部9月份驳回了放慢前沿模型速度的呼吁，称散布恐慌和对抗只会扰乱全球人工智能治理。与北京思想密切一致的智库中国与全球化智库创始人王辉耀上个月表示，美中谈判应该“面对人工智能风险并共同管理”。

paras.en: During Xi's September visit, Washington and Beijing agreed to launch an AI dialogue with a communications channel to help defuse serious incidents. The two leaders are expected to meet for the third time next week, with Bessent joining, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Leaders' Meeting from Nov. 18 to 19.
paras.zh: 在习近平 9 月访问期间，华盛顿和北京同意通过通信渠道启动人工智能对话，以帮助化解严重事件。预计两国领导人将于下周在 11 月 18 日至 19 日举行的亚太经合组织领导人会议期间第三次会面，贝森特也将参加。

paras.en: As the technology advances, the two nations will need to demonstrate how they can "reconcile the demands of competition with the responsibilities of leadership," Bessent said in his Tuesday speech. "Our interests will not always coincide, and our approach to every challenge likewise will not always converge," he added.
paras.zh: 贝森特在周二的演讲中表示，随着技术的进步，两国将需要展示如何“协调竞争的要求与领导的责任”。他补充说：“我们的利益不会总是一致，我们应对每项挑战的方法也不会总是一致。”

paras.en: Washington had briefly suspended access by foreign nationals to Anthropic's Mythos and Fable 5 models in June before restoring it weeks later. The U.S. government has also restricted exports of the most advanced chips to Beijing, and accused Chinese developers of copying American models through what it calls industrial-scale distillation.
paras.zh: 6 月份，华盛顿曾短暂暂停外国人访问 Anthropic 的《神话》和《神鬼寓言 5》模型，几周后又恢复了访问。美国政府还限制向北京出口最先进的芯片，并指责中国开发商通过所谓的工业规模蒸馏复制美国模式。

paras.en: Xie Feng, China's ambassador to the U.S., told the audience at the gala that efforts by both countries were "indispensable" to addressing issues from global flashpoints to "improving artificial intelligence governance." Cooperation "may not resolve every challenge," he said, but "none can be resolved without it."
paras.zh: 中国驻美国大使谢锋在晚会上对观众表示，从全球热点问题到“改善人工智能治理”，两国的努力“不可或缺”。他说，合作“可能无法解决所有挑战”，但“没有合作，任何挑战都无法解决”。

paras.en: The event was organized at a time when controversy around Nvidia Corp CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy has been making headlines.
paras.zh: 此次活动举办之际，围绕英伟达公司首席执行官黄仁勋与涉嫌中国间谍的风流韵事的争议已成为头条新闻。

paras.en: The billionaire tech executive, who joined Trump's delegation to Beijing in May and was invited to the state dinner in Washington in September, is at the center of a major corporate and national security scandal after admitting to an extramarital affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom the U.S. intelligence officials suspect of espionage.
paras.zh: 这位亿万富翁科技高管于 5 月随特朗普代表团访问北京，并受邀参加 9 月在华盛顿举行的国宴。在承认与一名被美国情报官员怀疑为间谍活动的中国女商人发生婚外情后，他成为了重大企业和国家安全丑闻的焦点。

paras.en: While Huang's presence at the upcoming summit has been thrown into doubt, other business leaders such as Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and Mastercard's Michael Miebach could be on Trump's delegation next week, according to South China Morning Post.
paras.zh: 据《南华早报》报道，虽然黄仁勋是否出席即将举行的峰会受到质疑，但特斯拉和 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克以及万事达卡的迈克尔·米巴赫等其他商界领袖可能会在下周出现在特朗普代表团中。

articles.title: Investors pivot to defensive stocks as markets enter a ‘state of alert’

paras.en: Markets are in a "state of alert," according to analysts monitoring a pivot from riskier tech sector bets into defensive stocks.
paras.zh: 分析师表示，市场正处于“警戒状态”，他们正在关注风险较高的科技股转向防御性股票的情况。

paras.en: Technology stocks — a key driver of rallies in recent years — have been notably volatile in 2026. Concerns about artificial intelligence — particularly when it comes to capital expenditure, cash flow, debt and circular financing — have sparked multiple bouts of volatility this year.
paras.zh: 科技股是近年来上涨的主要推动力，在 2026 年波动尤为明显。对人工智能的担忧——尤其是在资本支出、现金流、债务和循环融资方面——今年引发了多轮波动。

paras.en: The Democrats' sweep of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections amplified pressure on the sector last week.
paras.zh: 民主党上周在美国中期选举中横扫国会加大了该行业的压力。

paras.en: Wall Street's tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index is up by around 8.7% since the start of the year as of Nov. 9 close, but gave up some of its year-to-date gains in October when it shed 5.3% over the course of the month. The index — home to Big Tech names including Nvidia, Microsoft, Alphabet and Apple — has staged a recovery in recent days, but remains in the red for November and is down 0.7% for the month so far after dipping into correction territory last week.
paras.zh: 截至 11 月 9 日收盘，华尔街以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数自年初以来上涨了约 8.7%，但在 10 月份下跌了 5.3%，回吐了今年迄今的部分涨幅。该指数——包括英伟达、微软、Alphabet 和苹果在内的大型科技公司的所在地——最近几天已经出现复苏，但 11 月份仍处于亏损状态，自上周跌入调整区域后，本月迄今已下跌 0.7%。

paras.en: The Nasdaq isn't the only tech-focused index to have seen big losses over the past month. South Korea's Kospi index, which is heavily exposed to the semiconductor sector, lost 16.2% in October and is down more than 8% month-to-date.
paras.zh: 纳斯达克指数并不是过去一个月唯一出现大幅下跌的科技股指数。韩国综合股价指数 (Kospi) 10 月份下跌 16.2%，本月迄今下跌超过 8%。

paras.en: The MSCI World Information Technology index lost 7% in October, and has shed a further 4.6% so far this month. MSCI's U.S.-only IT index is down 11.5% since October.
paras.zh: MSCI 世界信息技术指数 10 月份下跌 7%，本月迄今已进一步下跌 4.6%。 MSCI 的美国 IT 指数自 10 月份以来已下跌 11.5%。

paras.en: At the same time, stocks in defensive sectors have seen broad gains.
paras.zh: 与此同时，防御性板块的股票普遍上涨。
