paras.en: Online harassment of women isn't unusual anywhere. Studies by a variety of organizations show that somewhere between 40% and 60% of all women worldwide have experienced it, while 65% have witnessed it.
paras.zh: 在任何地方，网络骚扰女性的现象并不罕见。多个组织的研究表明，全世界 40% 到 60% 的女性都经历过这种情况，而 65% 的女性亲眼目睹过这种情况。

paras.en: There is no single standard for assessing the level of online harassment because surveys often use different types of questions or research methods. But in general, women around the Middle East appear to be dealing with a higher-than-global-average level of what is known as "technology facilitated gender-based violence," or TFGBV.
paras.zh: 由于调查经常使用不同类型的问题或研究方法，因此没有统一的标准来评估在线骚扰的程度。但总体而言，中东地区的女性所面临的“技术助长的性别暴力”（TFGBV）似乎高于全球平均水平。

paras.en: The United Nations Population Fund defines TFGBV as a harmful act "that is committed, assisted, aggravated or amplified ... by the use of information communication technologies," or other digital tools, "against a person on the basis of their gender."
paras.zh: 联合国人口基金将 TFGBV 定义为“通过使用信息通信技术”或其他数字工具“针对某人的性别”实施、协助、加剧或放大的有害行为。

paras.en: According to research by UN Women, the UN body dedicated to gender equality, 68% of women in the Middle East have had to deal with it, while almost all — close to 100% — have seen it online.
paras.zh: 根据联合国妇女署（致力于性别平等的联合国机构）的研究，68% 的中东女性都曾遇到过这种情况，而几乎所有女性（接近 100%）都在网上看到过这种情况。

paras.en: In a 2025 study, UN Women found that 49% of women using the internet in the Middle East don't feel safe from online harassment. The number goes up to almost 70% if the women are more publicly visible activists, journalists or politicians.
paras.zh: 在 2025 年的一项研究中，联合国妇女署发现，49% 的中东地区使用互联网的女性对网络骚扰感到不安全。如果女性是更公开的活动家、记者或政治家，这一数字将上升到近 70%。

paras.en: And it is already clear that the increased availability of artificial intelligence-powered applications is making online harassment worse.
paras.zh: 很明显，人工智能驱动的应用程序可用性的增加正在使在线骚扰变得更加严重。

paras.en: AI has the potential to supercharge this kind of abuse, the UN Women briefing points out, "both by facilitating the spread of targeted disinformation as well as the proliferation of image-based abuse and deepfake pornographic videos."
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署的简报指出，人工智能有可能加剧这种虐待行为，“通过促进有针对性的虚假信息的传播以及基于图像的虐待和深度伪造色情视频的扩散”。

paras.en: Of the women who had experienced online violence while working, around a quarter had already identified "abuse that was generated or amplified by AI tools," the briefing said.
paras.zh: 简报称，在工作时经历过网络暴力的女性中，约有四分之一已经发现“人工智能工具产生或放大的虐待行为”。

paras.en: The potential for using the latest technology in order to harass people online has always been there, says Siddharth Venkataramakrishnan, an analyst at the London-based Institute for Strategic Dialogue (ISD), which investigates extremism. "But it's just become easier to produce harmful content at scale and in a hyper-targeted way. And the production of non-consensual imagery is a real marker of the democratization of that technology, so it's moving away from primarily targeting celebrities to just regular people."
paras.zh: 伦敦战略对话研究所 (ISD) 专门研究极端主义，其分析师 Siddharth Venkataramakrishnan 表示，利用最新技术在网上骚扰他人的可能性一直存在。 “但以超有针对性的方式大规模制作有害内容变得更加容易。未经同意的图像的制作是该技术民主化的真正标志，因此它正在从主要针对名人转向仅针对普通人。”

paras.en: Venkataramakrishnan has been researching incidents that occurred at the beginning of 2026 when Grok, the AI-powered chatbot belonging to Elon Musk's company SpaceXAI, became able to alter photographs to depict a fully dressed subject as nearly naked. The scandal caused Grok's services to be restricted but, as Venkataramakrishnan pointed out, safeguards across different AI models tend to be inconsistent and users can still find work-arounds to get similar results.
paras.zh: Venkataramakrishnan 一直在研究 2026 年初发生的事件，当时埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 公司 SpaceXAI 旗下的人工智能聊天机器人 Grok 能够修改照片，将衣着整齐的拍摄对象描绘成几乎裸体。该丑闻导致 Grok 的服务受到限制，但正如 Venkataramakrishnan 指出的那样，不同人工智能模型的保护措施往往不一致，用户仍然可以找到解决方法来获得类似的结果。

paras.en: In conservative cultures in the Middle East, the threat of this kind of half-naked picture of a woman being published has serious real-life implications, mostly because of what is and isn't acceptable for women around the region.
paras.zh: 在中东的保守文化中，这种女性半裸照片被出版的威胁会对现实生活产生严重影响，主要是因为该地区的女性可以接受什么，不可以接受什么。

paras.en: What makes the increase in AI-generated fakes even more problematic in the Middle East is that online abuse also has a higher chance of having offline effects.
paras.zh: 在中东，人工智能生成的假货数量增加的问题更加严重，因为在线滥用行为也更有可能产生线下影响。

paras.en: "Norms related to honor, family reputation and male control can turn digital abuse into real-world consequences," a June briefing by the World Bank notes.
paras.zh: 世界银行 6 月份的一份简报指出：“与荣誉、家庭声誉和男性控制相关的规范可能会将数字滥用转化为现实世界的后果。”

paras.en: It's also often not easy for people targeted with this kind of abuse to find legal protection or even somewhere to report it. While some Middle Eastern countries have cybercrime laws, most don't specifically address gender-based online violence nor have they been updated to grapple with AI-related abuse.
paras.zh: 对于遭受此类虐待的人来说，寻求法律保护甚至举报也并不容易。虽然一些中东国家制定了网络犯罪法，但大多数国家并没有专门解决基于性别的网络暴力，也没有进行更新以应对与人工智能相关的滥用行为。

paras.en: Last year's UN Women survey found that 36% of women said they were just told to ignore the online violence, while 23% were blamed for it themselves and 12% were subjected to physical punishment by their families because of it.
paras.zh: 去年联合国妇女署的调查发现，36%的女性表示她们只是被告知不要理会网络暴力，而23%的女性则将责任归咎于自己，12%的女性因此受到家人的体罚。

paras.en: Other studies indicate that only about 7% of women who experienced technology-facilitated violence later report it to law enforcement. Various concerns stop them from doing so, including having to present sexualized images or answer personal questions in front of strangers — often also anathema to many women in the region.
paras.zh: 其他研究表明，在遭受技术暴力的女性中，只有大约 7% 后来向执法部门举报。各种担忧阻止她们这样做，包括必须在陌生人面前展示性感图片或回答个人问题——这往往也是该地区许多女性所厌恶的。

paras.en: The women who had experienced online harassment said they would often just block the perpetrators and around a quarter said they then became more careful about what they posted online. Twenty percent deleted their accounts or left social media altogether.
paras.zh: 经历过网络骚扰的女性表示，她们通常会屏蔽肇事者，大约四分之一的女性表示，随后她们对在网上发布的内容变得更加谨慎。百分之二十的人删除了自己的帐户或完全离开了社交媒体。

paras.en: The rapid growth in AI-enabled harassment can also be more problematic in the Middle East because of the situations the women targeted find themselves living in.
paras.zh: 由于目标女性所处的环境，人工智能骚扰的快速增长在中东也可能造成更大的问题。

paras.en: Displacement, war, conflict and instability can all make women more vulnerable to online abuse and exploitation. Even the rapid development of AI-related technologies in a country without corresponding legal guardrails or digital literacy can increase the risk.
paras.zh: 流离失所、战争、冲突和不稳定都可能使妇女更容易受到网络虐待和剥削。即使在没有相应法律护栏或数字素养的国家，人工智能相关技术的快速发展也会增加风险。

paras.en: For example, observers point out that Saudi Arabia, a generally conservative country with strict rules for female behavior, is going through an accelerated program of digital transformation.
paras.zh: 例如，观察人士指出，沙特阿拉伯是一个总体上保守的国家，对女性行为有严格的规定，但它正在加速数字化转型。

paras.en: And in Syria, after the ousting of the dictatorial Assad regime, many Syrians "rushed into social media to speak freely," journalist Zaina Erhaim wrote for the Arab Reform Initiative in July this year.
paras.zh: 在叙利亚，独裁阿萨德政权被推翻后，许多叙利亚人“涌入社交媒体畅所欲言”，记者扎伊娜·埃尔海姆 (Zaina Erhaim) 今年 7 月为《阿拉伯改革倡议》撰文。

paras.en: Previously. digital polices had been closely policed by Syria's dictator and a political post could see the writer thrown in jail. But now Syrians "are navigating this newfound liberty without guardrails, oversight or protection," Erhaim argues, and female activists are paying a high price for it, especially where "gender intersects with sect."
paras.zh: 之前。数字政策受到叙利亚独裁者的严密监管，政治帖子可能会让作者被投入监狱。但埃尔海姆认为，现在叙利亚人“在没有护栏、监督或保护的情况下享受这种新发现的自由”，而女性活动人士为此付出了高昂的代价，特别是在“性别与教派交叉的地方”。

paras.en: In a policy paper published in May, the Syrian Women's Political Movement explained just how bad online abuse had become. In focus groups with 120 women from all around Syria, the majority of participants agreed that digital abuse had become a way of shutting them up. Younger activists reported personal pictures were being stolen from social media, then used against them.
paras.zh: 在五月发表的一份政策文件中，叙利亚妇女政治运动解释了网络虐待的严重程度。在由来自叙利亚各地的 120 名女性参加的焦点小组中，大多数参与者都认为数字滥用已经成为让她们闭嘴的一种方式。年轻的活动人士报告说，社交媒体上的个人照片被盗，然后被用来对付他们。

paras.en: "Smear campaigns targeting women's 'honor' and systemic defamation are actively deployed as punitive measures against any women who attempt to express a critical political opinion," the organization wrote, arguing that what was needed was a law that criminalized digital violence.
paras.zh: 该组织写道：“针对女性‘荣誉’的抹黑运动和系统性诽谤被积极部署，作为对任何试图表达批评性政治观点的女性的惩罚措施。”该组织认为，需要的是一项将数字暴力定为刑事犯罪的法律。

paras.en: If you or someone you know have experienced any kind of gender-based violence, the website lila.help (https://lila.help) lists trustworthy helplines and NGOs that offer support in almost every country around the world.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人经历过任何形式的性别暴力，lila.help 网站 (https://lila.help) 列出了值得信赖的帮助热线和非政府组织，它们在世界上几乎每个国家/地区提供支持。

articles.title: Yemeni forces, Houthis exchange attacks, claim to inflict heavy losses

paras.en: Fighting continues to rage in Yemen, with forces aligned with the country’s internationally recognised government claiming to have killed and wounded at least 190 Houthi fighters in hundreds of air and artillery attacks.
paras.zh: 也门的战斗继续激烈，与该国国际公认政府结盟的部队声称在数百次空袭和炮击中打死打伤至少 190 名胡塞武装分子。

paras.en: Majed Abdullah al-Nuzaili, a spokesman for Yemen’s government forces, said on Tuesday that the attacks targeted Houthi positions in Lahij, Taiz, Marib, al-Jawf, Hajjah and al-Bayda governorates.
paras.zh: 也门政府军发言人马吉德·阿卜杜拉·努扎利周二表示，袭击目标是拉希季、塔伊兹、马里卜、焦夫、哈杰和贝达省的胡塞武装阵地。

paras.en: In a statement, he said Yemeni government forces carried out at least 29 air strikes and 39 drone attacks. They also fired 62 rockets and carried out 744 artillery attacks, he added.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中表示，也门政府军发动了至少 29 次空袭和 39 次无人机袭击。他补充说，他们还发射了 62 枚火箭弹并进行了 744 次炮击。

paras.en: “Initial field reports indicate that about 190 Houthi commanders and fighters were killed or injured,” al-Nuzaili said. Up to 130 vehicles and combat assets used by the Iran-allied group were damaged or destroyed, he said.
paras.zh: “初步实地报告显示，约 190 名胡塞武装指挥官和战斗人员死亡或受伤，”努扎伊利说。他说，伊朗联盟组织使用的多达 130 辆车辆和战斗资产遭到损坏或摧毁。

paras.en: Al Jazeera could not verify the battlefield claims.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台无法核实战场的说法。

paras.en: The fighting in Yemen comes amid regional tensions triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran.
paras.zh: 也门的战斗正值美以对伊朗战争引发地区紧张局势之际。

paras.en: Yemen’s internationally recognised government, which is backed by Saudi Arabia, has launched a counteroffensive, dubbed Operation Dawn of Yemen, to retake territory lost to the Houthis, an armed group also known as Ansar Allah (Arabic for Supporters of God), in September. The Saudi-led coalition has supported the government’s ground campaign with air strikes, and the Houthis have fired missiles at the kingdom, targeting airports and oil facilities.
paras.zh: 得到沙特阿拉伯支持的也门国际公认政府于 9 月发起了名为“也门黎明行动”的反攻，以夺回被胡塞武装夺取的领土。沙特领导的联军通过空袭支持政府的地面行动，胡塞武装向沙特发射导弹，目标是机场和石油设施。

paras.en: According to the World Health Organization, at least 1,771 people have been killed in the hostilities in Yemen since August, with at least 7,959 wounded. More than 300,000 people have also been displaced.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，自8月以来也门的敌对行动已造成至少1,771人死亡，至少7,959人受伤。超过30万人也流离失所。

paras.en: The Houthis said on Tuesday that Yemen’s Saudi-backed forces launched 109 air strikes and missile attacks on the rebel-controlled capital, Sanaa, as well as on Houthi positions in al-Jawf, Saada, Taiz, Lahij and Marib.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装周二表示，沙特支持的也门部队对叛军控制的首都萨那以及焦夫、萨达、塔伊兹、拉希季和马里卜的胡塞阵地发动了 109 次空袭和导弹袭击。

paras.en: Yahya Saree, the Houthi spokesman, said the attacks killed and wounded “a large number of women and children”.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装发言人叶海亚·萨里表示，袭击造成“大量妇女和儿童”伤亡。

paras.en: Separately, Saree also claimed the Houthis killed and wounded “a large number” of government-aligned fighters in attacks on al-Madaribah and Ras al-Ara areas in the Lahij governorate on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 另外，萨雷还声称胡塞武装在周二对拉希季省的迈达里巴和拉斯阿拉地区的袭击中打死和打伤“大量”与政府结盟的武装分子。

paras.en: He said dozens more government soldiers were killed and wounded in attacks on al-Jawf earlier in the day.
paras.zh: 他说，当天早些时候，焦夫袭击事件中又有数十名政府士兵死伤。

paras.en: Saree added that the Houthis also targeted the Saudi capital, Riyadh, and an Aramco oil facility in Abqaiq in the kingdom’s Eastern province.
paras.zh: 萨雷补充说，胡塞武装还瞄准了沙特首都利雅得以及沙特东部省份布盖格的阿美石油设施。

paras.en: Earlier in the day, the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two missiles fired by the Houthis towards the kingdom’s capital, Riyadh, and another aimed at its southern region.
paras.zh: 当天早些时候，沙特领导的联军表示，拦截了胡塞武装向沙特首都利雅得发射的两枚导弹，以及另一枚针对其南部地区的导弹。

articles.title: South African swimmer Tatjana Smith switches allegiance to Netherlands

paras.en: South Africa’s most decorated Olympic athlete, Tatjana Smith, is changing nations to compete for the Netherlands, a decision she acknowledges “may disappoint or break the hearts” of some supporters.
paras.zh: 南非获得最多荣誉的奥运会运动员塔贾娜·史密斯 (Tatjana Smith) 正在更换国家队，为荷兰队参赛，她承认这一决定“可能会让一些支持者感到失望或心碎”。

paras.en: “I’ve decided to swim for the Netherlands,” two-time Olympic swimming champion Smith said in a tearful video message on Instagram on Tuesday.
paras.zh: “我决定为荷兰队游泳，”两届奥运会游泳冠军史密斯周二在 Instagram 上发布的一段泪流满面的视频中说道。

paras.en: “I know that not everyone will understand or agree with my decision,” she said, citing “financial and practical challenges” that can make a swimming career difficult to sustain.
paras.zh: “我知道并不是每个人都会理解或同意我的决定，”她说，并指出“财务和实际挑战”可能会使游泳事业难以维持。

paras.en: Smith won the 100-metre breaststroke gold medal at the 2024 Paris Olympics and, as Tatjana Schoenmaker, the 200-metre breaststroke at the Tokyo Games held in 2021.
paras.zh: 史密斯在 2024 年巴黎奥运会上赢得了 100 米蛙泳金牌，并在 2021 年东京奥运会上以塔贾娜·舍恩梅克 (Tatjana Schoenmaker) 的身份赢得了 200 米蛙泳金牌。

paras.en: She also took two silvers, in the 100-metre breaststroke at Tokyo and the 200-metre breaststroke in Paris, to become South Africa’s most successful Olympic athlete.
paras.zh: 她还在东京的 100 米蛙泳和巴黎的 200 米蛙泳中获得两枚银牌，成为南非最成功的奥运会运动员。

paras.en: “To South Africa, when I was a little girl, my biggest dream was to represent my country at the Olympics,” Smith said.
paras.zh: “在南非，当我还是个小女孩时，我最大的梦想就是代表我的国家参加奥运会，”史密斯说。

paras.en: “I got to live that dream, and it gave me more than I could have ever imagined.”
paras.zh: “我必须实现这个梦想，它给了我比我想象的更多的东西。”

paras.en: She holds dual citizenship with the Netherlands.
paras.zh: 她拥有荷兰双重国籍。

paras.en: “Both countries are a part of who I am,” the 29-year-old Smith said. “But dreams can change as you grow.”
paras.zh: “这两个国家都是我的一部分，”29 岁的史密斯说。 “但梦想会随着你的成长而改变。”

paras.en: She retired from competitive swimming after Paris and announced a comeback two months ago, targeting the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics – now in Dutch orange instead of South African green and gold.
paras.zh: 巴黎奥运会结束后，她从竞技游泳退役，两个月前宣布复出，目标是参加 2028 年洛杉矶奥运会——现在的衣服是荷兰橙色，而不是南非绿色和金色。

paras.en: “This gives me the opportunity to explore another part of my identity and the heritage that I’ve never experienced through sport.
paras.zh: “这让我有机会探索我的身份和传统的另一部分，这是我从未通过体育经历过的。

paras.en: “The opportunity also offers greater high performance support and the potential to build a more sustainable career.”
paras.zh: “这个机会还提供了更大的高绩效支持以及建立更可持续职业生涯的潜力。”

paras.en: Smith added that athletes need a system in which they can thrive and not just survive, suggesting she would have “greater high performance support” in future. She said she would continue training in South Africa.
paras.zh: 史密斯补充说，运动员需要一个让他们能够茁壮成长而不仅仅是生存的系统，这表明她未来将获得“更大的高性能支持”。她说她将继续在南非接受训练。

paras.en: Fellow South African swimmer Chad le Clos also has four medals although just one gold.
paras.zh: 南非游泳运动员查德·勒克洛斯也获得了四枚奖牌，尽管只有一枚金牌。

articles.title: Netanyahu fights to stay relevant as Israel’s opposition closes in

paras.en: In the last few days, in marked contrast to an election campaign defined by its bitterness and the closeness of its personal attacks, Israel’s current prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu has spoken of national unity and coming together with the opposition bloc that edged out his ruling coalition in October’s election.
paras.zh: 在过去的几天里，与以痛苦和人身攻击为特征的竞选活动形成鲜明对比的是，以色列现任总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡(Benjamin Netanyahu)谈到了民族团结，并与在10月选举中击败其执政联盟的反对派集团走到了一起。

paras.en: On Saturday, the same day that Israeli President Isaac Herzog tasked former Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government capable of commanding the Knesset, Netanyahu published a video on his social media account claiming Israel to be facing the genuine risk of civil war if a government were established with the support of Arab parties which he accused of wanting to “eliminate the State of Israel”.
paras.zh: 周六，就在以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格责成前参谋长加迪·艾森科特组建一个能够指挥议会的政府的同一天，内塔尼亚胡在其社交媒体账户上发布了一段视频，声称如果在阿拉伯政党的支持下建立政府，以色列将面临真正的内战风险，他指责这些阿拉伯政党想要“消灭以色列国”。

paras.en: Two days later, Netanyahu returned to the theme of existential threat in a further video, calling upon the leaders of the more successful bloc to recognise the “needs of the hour” and join, under his leadership, a single unified government that would also include the ultra-Orthodox parties, at least one of which is understood to be in talks with Eisenkot, as well as the prime minister’s controversial allies on the far right, Bezalel Smotrich and Itamar Ben-Gvir.
paras.zh: 两天后，内塔尼亚胡在另一段视频中回到了生存威胁的主题，呼吁更成功集团的领导人认识到“时代的需要”，并在他的领导下加入一个统一的政府，该政府还包括极端正统派政党，据了解至少其中一个政党正在与艾森科特进行谈判，以及总理备受争议的极右盟友贝扎雷尔·斯莫特里奇和伊塔马尔·本格维尔。

paras.en: “It’s all a game at the moment. It’s leverage, it’s one-upmanship, it’s psyops, it’s spin, it’s counter-spin,” former Israeli government adviser Daniel Levy said of the invariably long and complex negotiations that take place ahead of establishing a government,
paras.zh: 以色列前政府顾问丹尼尔·利维在谈到建立政府之前总是进行的漫长而复杂的谈判时说：“目前这都是一场游戏。这是杠杆作用，这是胜者为王，这是心理战，这是旋转，这是反旋转。”

paras.en: Currently, with the new Knesset being sworn in on Tuesday, speculation is focussing on the role of the Ultra Orthodox, or haredim, parties, which have traditionally offered support to Netanyahu in return for measures shielding their young male yeshiva students from the military draft in defiance off a Super Court ruling of June 2024.
paras.zh: 目前，随着新一届议会于周二宣誓就职，人们的猜测集中在极端正统派或正统派政党的角色上，这些政党传统上向内塔尼亚胡提供支持，以换取采取措施保护其年轻男性犹太学院学生免受兵役的影响，无视超级法院 2024 年 6 月的裁决。

paras.en: Nevertheless, irrespective of the past political cover offered to their members by Netanyahu, there are suggestions that one of the Ultra Orthodox parties United Torah Judaism (UTJ) – which refused to endorse Netanyahu’s selection to build a government by the President – is preparing to throw in behind Eisenkot, with the objections of one of the opposition’s principal figures Avigdor Lieberman said to be quieted in the face of either partnering with one of the Arab parties or the continued rule of Lieberman’s nemesis, Netanyahu and the prospect of further elections.
paras.zh: 然而，无论内塔尼亚胡过去向其成员提供的政治掩护如何，有迹象表明，极端正统政党之一的联合托拉犹太教（UTJ）——拒绝支持内塔尼亚胡选择由总统组建政府——正准备支持艾森科特，反对派主要人物之一阿维格多·利伯曼的反对意见据说在面对要么与阿拉伯政党之一合作，要么继续利伯曼的宿敌内塔尼亚胡的统治以及进一步选举的前景。

paras.en: “‘It’s political strategy, that’s all,” Netanyahu’s former aide, Israeli pollster Mitchell Barak said from Jerusalem. ‘But he’s negotiating from a weakened position. With the UTJ, Eisenkot’s got 67 seats,’ he said of the numbers needed to gain a working majority in the 120 seat Knesset, “so, of course, Netanyahu’s going to do all he can to reinforce his bloc; Barak said of negotiations regarded by many as critical to Netanyahu’s personal future.
paras.zh: “这只是政治策略，仅此而已，”内塔尼亚胡的前助手、以色列民意调查专家米切尔·巴拉克在耶路撒冷表示。 “但他是在处于弱势地位的情况下进行谈判的。艾森科特在联合工会联盟中获得了 67 个席位，”他在谈到在议会 120 个席位中获得多数席位所需的席位数时说道，“因此，内塔尼亚胡当然会尽其所能来加强他的集团；巴拉克在谈到许多人认为对内塔尼亚胡个人未来至关重要的谈判时说道。

paras.en: Netanyahu faces a number of challenges that speak directly to both his political legacy and personal freedom that he will lose all influence over should Eisenkot succeed him.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡面临着许多挑战，这些挑战直接关系到他的政治遗产和个人自由，如果艾森科特接替他，他将失去所有影响力。

paras.en: Foremost are like to be the multiple corruption charges that is is presently on trial for and, despite his claims of innocence that he has already preemptively petitioned the country’s President and his former political rival, Isaac Herzog for. Secondly, and more pressingly is the question of his and his government’s culpability for the alleged failings ahead of the October 7 Hamas led attack that triggered the genocide unleashed upon Gaza by Israel and the multiple strikes and attacks launched by Israel non regional neighbors in the years since.
paras.zh: 最重要的是目前正在审理的多项腐败指控，尽管他声称自己无罪，但他已经先发制人地向该国总统和他的前政治对手艾萨克·赫尔佐格请愿。其次，更紧迫的问题是，他和他的政府对 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击引发了以色列对加沙的种族灭绝以及以色列非地区邻国在随后几年发动的多次袭击和袭击之前的所谓失败负有责任。

paras.en: Many of the new MKs being sworn in on Tuesday, including bereaved family members, reservists, advocates for the 250 or so Israelis taken captive that day and Eisenkot himself, who lost a son and two nephews in the genocide that followed, are all tied directly to October 7 and the wars that followed together creating a chamber where feelings over the October 7 attack and where culpability for its lies are said to run close to the surface.
paras.zh: 许多周二宣誓就职的新议员，包括失去亲人的家人、预备役军人、当天被俘虏的大约 250 名以色列人的支持者，以及在随后的种族灭绝中失去一个儿子和两个侄子的艾森科特本人，都与 10 月 7 日以及随后发生的战争直接相关，这些战争一起创造了一个密室，人们对 10 月 7 日袭击的感受以及对其谎言的罪责据说已经浮出水面。

paras.en: In particular, attention is likely to focus sharply on Netanyahu himself, whose supposed miscalculations ahead of the attack, stories of numerous missed warnings and who was subsequently accused of dragging out the war, or sacrificing the welfare off the captives for his own political ends. Key among the opposition’s aims for the first day of parliamentary business is set to be the installation of Matan Kahana, a member of Eisenkot’s Yashar (“straight”) party and a keen advocate of a state inquiry into Netanyahu and the government’s failings ahead of the Hamas led attack.
paras.zh: 特别是，人们的注意力可能会集中在内塔尼亚胡本人身上，他在袭击前被认为误判，多次错过警告，随后被指控拖延战争，或为了自己的政治目的牺牲俘虏的福利。反对派议会第一天的主要目标是让马坦·卡哈纳就职，他是艾森科特领导的亚沙尔（“异性恋”）党的成员，热心主张对内塔尼亚胡和政府在哈马斯领导的袭击之前的失误进行国家调查。

paras.en: “Having so many people connected so directly to October 7 is going to increase the temperature, but it’s become so politicized that a win for one side automatically becomes a loss for the other, so the bereaved family on the right can say we need to increase our militarism in honor of my son, and the bereaved family in the center says we need to enlist more people.
paras.zh: “有这么多人直接与 10 月 7 日联系将会加剧局势，但它已经变得如此政治化，一方的胜利自动成为另一方的损失，所以右边的失去亲人的家庭可以说我们需要加强我们的军国主义以纪念我的儿子，而中间的失去亲人的家庭则说我们需要招募更多的人。

paras.en: “Netanyahu can try to influence that but for the first time in a long time, he seems a bit lost,” Israeli political analyst Nimrod Flaschenberg said.
paras.zh: 以色列政治分析家尼姆罗德·弗拉森伯格表示：“内塔尼亚胡可以尝试影响这一点，但很长一段时间以来，他第一次似乎有点迷失。”

paras.en: However, how lost Netanyahu may be, or how grounded his claims of pending civil war or destruction at the hands of regional adversaries may be, ultimately, his political and potentially personal fate now lies with an opposition that outstrips his own numerically and a volatile Knesset eager to comb over the mistakes of the past.
paras.zh: 然而，无论内塔尼亚胡有多么迷失，或者他关于即将发生的内战或地区对手造成的破坏的说法有多么有根据，最终，他的政治和潜在的个人命运现在取决于一个在数量上超过他自己的反对派和一个急于梳理过去错误的不稳定的议会。

paras.en: “There’s no appetite on the other side to go in with Netanyahu for a unity government,” Levy said,
paras.zh: 利维说：“另一方没有兴趣与内塔尼亚胡一起组建联合政府。”

paras.en: “The only real circumstances under which that happen is if he can create a security emergency,” he said following a weekend where the UK press had reported daily phone calls from Netanyahu to the Trump administration urging renewed war on Iran.
paras.zh: “发生这种情况的唯一真正情况是他是否能够制造安全紧急状态，”他在周末表示，英国媒体报道了内塔尼亚胡每天给特朗普政府打电话，敦促对伊朗重新开战。

articles.title: Kushner and Witkoff renew peace talks to end war between Russia and Ukraine
articles.author: Eleanor Beardsley

paras.en: Kushner and Witkoff renew peace talks to end war between Russia and Ukraine
paras.zh: 库什纳和维特科夫重启和平谈判以结束俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争

paras.en: President Trump's top envoy is in Abu Dhabi with negotiators from Russia and Ukraine to resume peace talks.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统的高级特使正在阿布扎比与俄罗斯和乌克兰的谈判代表一起恢复和平谈判。

paras.en: Some other news now. Russian, American and Ukrainian negotiators are meeting today in Abu Dhabi. They are resuming peace talks over the war in Ukraine - talks that have not happened since February. The U.S. negotiators are presidential envoy Steve Witkoff and presidential son-in-law Jared Kushner. President Trump says he believes peace is achievable this time. NPR's Eleanor Beardsley is covering this from Ukraine's capital, Kyiv. Hey there, Eleanor.
paras.zh: 现在还有一些其他消息。俄罗斯、美国和乌克兰谈判代表今天在阿布扎比举行会议。他们正在恢复有关乌克兰战争的和平谈判——这是自二月份以来从未进行过的谈判。美国谈判代表是总统特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和总统女婿贾里德·库什纳。特朗普总统表示，他相信这次和平是可以实现的。美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley) 在乌克兰首都基辅报道此事。嘿，埃莉诺。

paras.en: INSKEEP: Other than thousands of additional dead, has anything changed since the last talks nine months ago?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：除了数千人死亡之外，自九个月前的上次会谈以来还有什么变化吗？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Well, in many ways, nothing has changed. And on the other hand, perhaps a lot is changing. Let me explain. The war still grinds on in eastern Ukraine, where the front line is essentially frozen, though Ukraine did erase minimal Russian gains this year in a fall offensive. We're heading into another winter of Russia targeting Ukraine's energy infrastructure in cities like Kyiv. Putin has not wavered from his maximalist demands. He wants Ukraine to give over the remaining between 20% and 30% of the Donbas region that Russian forces have been unable to conquer. Ukraine still says that's a red line because this fortress belt of cities protects the rest of the country. So that's the same.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：嗯，在很多方面，一切都没有改变。另一方面，也许很多事情正在发生变化。让我解释一下。乌克兰东部的战争仍在继续，那里的前线基本上被冻结了，尽管乌克兰确实在今年的秋季攻势中消灭了俄罗斯的最小成果。我们即将进入俄罗斯的另一个冬天，目标是基辅等城市的乌克兰能源基础设施。普京并没有动摇他的最高要求。他希望乌克兰交出俄罗斯军队无法征服的剩余20%至30%的顿巴斯地区。乌克兰仍然称这是一条红线，因为这条城市堡垒带保护着该国其他地区。所以那是一样的。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: And yet, Steve, in the past days, much has changed. Trump and his policies were repudiated in the midterm elections. And while Ukrainians understand this was not about them, they still hope things can change when a new Congress comes in in January. And I spoke with Oleksandr Merezhko. He's chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Ukrainian Parliament. Here he is.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：然而，史蒂夫，在过去的日子里，发生了很多变化。特朗普及其政策在中期选举中遭到否定。尽管乌克兰人明白这与他们无关，但他们仍然希望一月份新国会成立时事情能够改变。我与亚历山大·梅列日科进行了交谈。他是乌克兰议会外交事务委员会主席。他在这里。

paras.en: OLEKSANDR MEREZHKO: For us, it's a hopeful sign. And it sort of raised the level of optimism in Ukraine with regard to our relations with the United States because American people and the Congress has always been on the side of Ukraine. And now we hope that the number of supporters of Ukraine in the Congress will rise.
paras.zh: OLEKSANDR MEREZHKO：对我们来说，这是一个充满希望的迹象。这在某种程度上提高了乌克兰对我们与美国关系的乐观程度，因为美国人民和国会一直站在乌克兰一边。现在我们希望国会中乌克兰的支持者人数能够增加。

paras.en: INSKEEP: OK. So a few things are changing. What is different for Russia?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：好的。所以有些事情正在改变。俄罗斯有何不同？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Well, for Russia, the midterms are not good news. Things are going very well with the Trump administration that recently waived sanctions on diesel, which allows Russia to finance this war. So analysts are saying Putin may try to squeeze as much as he can out of the Trump administration before the new Congress comes in.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：对于俄罗斯来说，中期选举并不是好消息。特朗普政府最近放弃了对柴油的制裁，这使得俄罗斯能够为这场战争提供资金，事情进展顺利。因此分析人士表示，普京可能会在新一届国会就任之前，尽可能地从特朗普政府中挤出权力。

paras.en: INSKEEP: OK. At least in foreign affairs, the president still has a lot of latitude. So let's talk about the way the president has discussed this. He says these negotiations could include some larger arrangement for European security, but what makes him think this round could be more successful than in the past?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：好的。至少在外交事务上，总统还有很大的自由度。那么我们来谈谈总统讨论这个问题的方式。他表示，这些谈判可能包括一些更大的欧洲安全安排，但是什么让他认为这一轮谈判可能比过去更成功？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Well, it's not entirely clear. But U.S. officials speaking on background said they want to create a new long-term security framework that would not just be about Russia and Ukraine but include all of Europe. And the administration says it believes this could possibly unlock concessions from both Kyiv and Moscow.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：嗯，目前还不完全清楚。但美国官员在背景发言中表示，他们希望建立一个新的长期安全框架，该框架不仅涉及俄罗斯和乌克兰，还包括整个欧洲。美国政府表示，它相信这可能会促使基辅和莫斯科双方做出让步。

paras.en: INSKEEP: OK. So you widen the playing field. You increase the number of players, but Europeans are not part of these negotiations. Is that right?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：好的。所以你扩大了竞争环境。你增加了球员的数量，但欧洲人不参与这些谈判。是这样吗？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Yes, Steve. That's right. There are representatives from the U.K., Germany, France and Italy in Abu Dhabi, but they're not taking part directly. That's frightening for Europe. Any changes they want to be preceded by a ceasefire - any talks. Kremlin watchers say this situation for Putin is a dream - to sit down with Trump one-on-one while Europe is sidelined. And there's also a new negotiator on the Russian team. He's the top Kremlin official who - right before the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, he gave the ultimatum to NATO to roll back to its 1997 borders. Steve, that was before Poland and the Baltics joined. I asked Ukrainian lawmaker Inna Sovsun if anything different could come out of these talks. Here she is.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：是的，史蒂夫。这是正确的。阿布扎比有来自英国、德国、法国和意大利的代表，但他们并没有直接参加。这对欧洲来说是可怕的。他们希望在任何改变之前先停火——任何谈判。克里姆林宫观察人士表示，对于普京来说，这种情况是一个梦想——在欧洲处于边缘地位的情况下与特朗普一对一地坐下来。俄罗斯团队中还有一位新的谈判代表。他是克里姆林宫的最高官​​员，就在全面入侵乌克兰之前，他向北约发出了最后通牒，要求其退回 1997 年的边界。史蒂夫，那是在波兰和波罗的海国家加入之前。我问乌克兰议员因娜·索夫孙（Inna Sovsun）这些会谈是否会产生不同的结果。她在这里。

paras.en: INNA SOVSUN: We see no reason for Putin to suddenly agree to some sort of peace deal. There is no pressure being put on him.
paras.zh: 伊纳·索夫孙：我们认为普京没有理由突然同意某种和平协议。他没有受到任何压力。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Now, she believes Putin thinks he's winning, especially in Ukrainian cities, where she said she expects Russia to fully use this fifth winter of the war to plunge Ukrainians into the cold and dark in an effort to crush their will.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：现在，她相信普京认为自己正在获胜，特别是在乌克兰城市，她说她希望俄罗斯充分利用战争的第五个冬天，让乌克兰人陷入寒冷和黑暗，以粉碎他们的意志。

paras.en: INSKEEP: Fifth winter of the war. Thank you. Eleanor, thanks so much.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：战争的第五个冬天。谢谢。埃莉诺，非常感谢。

paras.en: INSKEEP: That's NPR's Eleanor Beardsley in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：这是基辅 NPR 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley)。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly 4 hours of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly 4 hours of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰在美国斡旋下在阿布扎比举行近4个小时的会谈

paras.en: ABU DHABI, United Arab Emirates — Russia and Ukraine on Tuesday held their first U.S.-mediated talks in nine months on ending the 4 1/2-year-old war, with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio calling the meeting "very productive" and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy saying the session was "constructive and quite substantive."
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国阿布扎比——周二，俄罗斯和乌克兰就结束长达 4.5 年的战争举行了九个月来首次由美国斡旋的会谈，美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥称这次会议“非常富有成效”，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基则表示这次会议“具有建设性且相当实质性”。

paras.en: Hopes of ending Europe's biggest conflict since World War II are tempered, however, by the absence of any significant breakthroughs in three previous rounds of talks earlier this year.
paras.zh: 然而，由于今年早些时候的前三轮谈判没有取得任何重大突破，结束欧洲自二战以来最严重冲突的希望受到了影响。

paras.en: There's nothing to suggest a new posture that would lead to a breakthrough, but circumstances surrounding the talks have been changed by the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections as well as increased pressure on Russia's wartime economy. Moscow also is seeking to break Ukrainians' will as another winter sets in by ramping up its battering of the country's power grid.
paras.zh: 没有任何迹象表明会采取新的姿态来取得突破，但美国中期选举的结果以及俄罗斯战时经济压力的增加已经改变了谈判的环境。随着另一个冬天的到来，莫斯科还试图通过加大对乌克兰电网的打击力度来打破乌克兰人的意愿。

paras.en: Neither Rubio nor Zelenskyy attended the talks in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates. The session lasted four hours and another is scheduled for a second day Wednesday.
paras.zh: 卢比奥和泽连斯基均未出席在阿联酋首都阿布扎比举行的会谈。会议持续了四个小时，另一场会议定于第二天周三举行。

paras.en: Delegations from Moscow and Kyiv met as Washington, represented by U.S. President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner and envoy Steve Witkoff, renewed its push to stop the fighting.
paras.zh: 来自莫斯科和基辅的代表团会面，华盛顿以美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳和特使史蒂夫·威特科夫为代表，再次推动停止战斗。

paras.en: "It looks like the talks in Abu Dhabi were very productive," Rubio said in Paris at the Group of Seven meeting, although he urged patience. "There's a lot of work to be done in that regard. It's not like something that's on the verge of being solved in the next 24 hours or anything like that."
paras.zh: 卢比奥在巴黎七国集团会议上表示，“看来阿布扎比的谈判非常富有成效”，不过他敦促大家保持耐心。 “在这方面还有很多工作要做。这不像是在未来 24 小时内就能解决的问题或类似的事情。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy said the talks were largely about humanitarian issues, including prisoner exchanges and returning Ukrainian civilians in captivity, as well as children taken from the country. Security guarantees also were discussed, he added during an appearance at the University of Copenhagen in Denmark.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，会谈主要讨论人道主义问题，包括交换囚犯、遣返被囚禁的乌克兰平民以及从该国被带走的儿童。他在丹麦哥本哈根大学露面时补充道，安全保障也得到了讨论。

paras.en: A senior Ukrainian official who spoke on condition of anonymity because he was not authorized to comment publicly said Ukraine and Russia talked about a large scale prisoner swap, although the details will be discussed in the coming days.
paras.zh: 一位因无权公开发表评论而要求匿名的乌克兰高级官员表示，乌克兰和俄罗斯讨论了大规模囚犯交换，不过细节将在未来几天讨论。

paras.en: The three-way meeting was the first since February
paras.zh: 这是三方会议自二月份以来的首次会议

paras.en: The two-day session is the first such meeting since February on Russia's full-scale invasion, which analysts and humanitarian organizations say has killed hundreds of thousands of soldiers and thousands of civilians.
paras.zh: 这次为期两天的会议是自二月份以来首次就俄罗斯的全面入侵举行此类会议。分析人士和人道主义组织称，俄罗斯的全面入侵已造成数十万士兵和数千平民死亡。

paras.en: Kushner said he believed there were "some good ideas how to bridge" the differences between the two sides.
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，他相信“有一些好主意可以弥合”双方之间的分歧。

paras.en: Trump, whose stance on the war has varied, must reckon with Democrats taking over the U.S. Congress in January following the U.S. elections. Democrats could demand more support for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普对战争的立场各不相同，他必须考虑到民主党在美国大选后一月份接管美国国会的情况。民主党可能要求对乌克兰提供更多支持。

paras.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz told ZDF television Monday night that "I don't have overly high expectations" for the talks.
paras.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨周一晚间对德国电视二台表示，“我对此次会谈并没有过高的期望”。

paras.en: There are no signs the fighting is abating, and the talks come against a backdrop of new long-range strikes by both Russia and Ukraine. The two armies are largely deadlocked on the front line.
paras.zh: 没有迹象表明战斗正在减弱，而且会谈是在俄罗斯和乌克兰发动新的远程打击的背景下进行的。两军在前线基本陷入僵局。

paras.en: Russia launched 162 drones of various types and a ballistic missile at Ukraine overnight, Ukraine's air force said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰空军表示，俄罗斯连夜向乌克兰发射了 162 架各类无人机和一枚弹道导弹。

paras.en: Russia's Defense Ministry said its forces downed 155 Ukrainian drones overnight in eight Russian regions, as well as over the Crimean Peninsula, which Moscow illegally annexed from Ukraine in 2014.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，俄罗斯军队一夜之间在俄罗斯八个地区以及克里米亚半岛上空击落了 155 架乌克兰无人机，克里米亚半岛是莫斯科 2014 年从乌克兰非法吞并的。

paras.en: Kushner says the U.S. aims to build on past experience
paras.zh: 库什纳表示美国的目标是借鉴过去的经验

paras.en: Kushner said in opening remarks that the goal of the talks is to "create a new framework and a new understanding building upon the different institutions and understandings of the past."
paras.zh: 库什纳在开幕词中表示，会谈的目标是“在过去的不同机构和理解的基础上创建一个新的框架和新的理解”。

paras.en: "We take what's worked, we try to identify what's failed, why we're in this position and hopefully create a new framework that leads us for decades, if not centuries, of peace," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们采取行之有效的方法，尝试找出失败的方法，了解为什么我们处于这种境地，并希望创建一个新的框架，引导我们实现数十年甚至数百年的和平。”

paras.en: NATO commander U.S. Gen. Alexus Grynkewich, who was also present, said the U.S. delegation looked forward "to working with both sides as we seek to advance the progress we've made in the past and continue this pursuit to set the foundations for a lasting peace."
paras.zh: 出席会议的北约司令美国将军亚历克苏斯·格林克维奇表示，美国代表团期待“与双方合作，寻求推进我们过去取得的进展，并继续这一努力，为持久和平奠定基础。”

paras.en: Rustem Umerov, the head of Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service who leads Kyiv's delegation, thanked the U.S. for its peace efforts.
paras.zh: 率领基辅代表团的乌克兰对外情报局局长鲁斯泰姆·乌梅罗夫感谢美国为和平所做的努力。

paras.en: "Our people are waiting to end this war. And we hope that we will achieve the lasting peace for Ukraine," he said.
paras.zh: “我们的人民正在等待结束这场战争。我们希望乌克兰能够实现持久和平，”他说。

paras.en: Ukrainians meet first with European and NATO officials
paras.zh: 乌克兰首先会见欧洲和北约官员

paras.en: The head of the Russian delegation, Vladimir Medinsky, expressed hope the meeting "will allow us to advance on the path towards peace in the interests of the people of Russia and the people of Ukraine."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯代表团团长弗拉基米尔·梅丁斯基表示，希望这次会议“能让我们在和平道路上前进，造福俄罗斯和乌克兰人民的利益”。

paras.en: Umerov said the day began with a meeting between the Ukrainian team, the U.S. envoys and representatives from the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, NATO and the European Commission.
paras.zh: 乌梅罗夫说，当天乌克兰代表团、美国特使以及英国、法国、德国、意大利、北约和欧盟委员会的代表举行了会议。

paras.en: Russia has objected to the Europeans' involvement in the three-way talks, but said EU representatives could join at a later stage.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯反对欧洲参与三方谈判，但表示欧盟代表可以在稍后阶段加入。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine hold to their demands
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰坚持自己的要求

paras.en: The Russian and Ukrainian governments remain far apart on key elements of any prospective deal.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰政府在任何潜在协议的关键要素上仍存在很大分歧。

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin wants Ukraine to pull its troops back from four regions of Ukraine that Moscow annexed in September 2022 but has never fully captured. He also demands that Ukraine abandon its bid to join NATO and accept strict limits on its military, among other issues.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京希望乌克兰从莫斯科于 2022 年 9 月吞并但从未完全占领的四个乌克兰地区撤军。他还要求乌克兰放弃加入北约并接受对其军事的严格限制等问题。

paras.en: Putin wants a comprehensive peace deal on those conditions and won't agree to a general halt in hostilities, arguing that it would only allow Ukrainian troops to rest and replenish their weapons stockpiles.
paras.zh: 普京希望在这些条件下达成全面和平协议，并且不会同意全面停止敌对行动，他认为这只会让乌克兰军队休息并补充武器库存。

paras.en: Zelenskyy rejects Putin's demands to voluntarily cede territory. He also rejects any limits on Ukraine's military or its arrangements with Western partners, which Kyiv sees as essential security guarantees to stop Moscow from invading again.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基拒绝普京自愿割让领土的要求。他还拒绝对乌克兰的军事或其与西方伙伴的安排进行任何限制，基辅认为这是阻止莫斯科再次入侵的重要安全保障。

paras.en: Ukraine argues an immediate ceasefire is the necessary first step toward negotiating a wider settlement and says a direct meeting between Putin and Zelenskyy is the only way territorial issues can be settled. Putin has spurned those suggestions.
paras.zh: 乌克兰认为，立即停火是谈判达成更广泛解决方案的必要第一步，并表示普京和泽连斯基之间的直接会面是解决领土问题的唯一途径。普京拒绝了这些建议。

paras.en: Moscow and Kyiv sent experienced negotiators
paras.zh: 莫斯科和基辅派出了经验丰富的谈判代表

paras.en: The Russian and Ukrainian delegations include senior officials who have attended previous rounds of talks.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰代表团中包括参加过前几轮会谈的高级官员。

paras.en: Russia's chief negotiator is Medinsky, a Putin aide who has led Moscow's team since the first full-fledged peace negotiations with Ukraine in Istanbul in March 2022, although exploratory talks took place earlier in neighboring Belarus. The Russian delegation also includes deputy foreign ministers Sergei Ryabkov and Mikhail Galuzin and military intelligence chief Igor Kostyukov.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯的首席谈判代表是普京的助手梅丁斯基，自 2022 年 3 月在伊斯坦布尔与乌克兰首次全面和平谈判以来，他一直领导着莫斯科的团队，尽管探索性谈判早些时候已在邻国白俄罗斯进行。俄罗斯代表团还包括外交部副部长谢尔盖·里亚布科夫和米哈伊尔·加卢津以及军事情报局局长伊戈尔·科斯秋科夫。

paras.en: Ukraine's delegation includes Zelenskyy's chief of staff, Kyrylo Budanov.
paras.zh: 乌克兰代表团成员包括泽连斯基的幕僚长凯里洛·布达诺夫。

paras.en: The U.S. says a broader European security deal is in the works
paras.zh: 美国表示正在酝酿一项更广泛的欧洲安全协议

paras.en: Last week, Trump declared that some kind of grand deal about European security was in the works, describing it as "a big agreement" that is "going to involve more than Ukraine."
paras.zh: 上周，特朗普宣布某种有关欧洲安全的重大协议正在酝酿之中，并将其描述为“一项重大协议”，“涉及的范围将不仅仅是乌克兰”。

paras.en: Kushner said Monday on X that a "comprehensive and lasting settlement will also require direct engagement between Russia and our European partners on the broader security arrangements that affect them."
paras.zh: 库什纳周一表示，“全面、持久的解决方案还需要俄罗斯和我们的欧洲伙伴就影响他们的更广泛的安全安排进行直接接触。”

paras.en: Moscow has welcomed that approach. "The idea of defining clear parameters for a future security architecture, and only then moving on to resolving the actual Russian-Ukrainian conflict, is quite sensible," said Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov.
paras.zh: 莫斯科对这种做法表示欢迎。俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫表示：“为未来的安全架构定义明确的参数，然后再着手解决实际的俄罗斯-乌克兰冲突，这一想法是相当明智的。”

articles.title: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
paras.zh: 众议院将投票弹劾赫格塞斯。并且，最高法院允许边境墙工程继续进行

paras.en: The House may vote this week on a resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Rep. Thomas Massie, R-KY, reintroduced articles of impeachment accusing Hegseth of high crimes and misdemeanors. The eight specific charges include three charges for illegally waging war against Iran, one for ignoring laws to minimize civilian casualties, one for overseeing extrajudicial killings of alleged drug boats in the Caribbean and Eastern Pacific, and one for capturing Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro without congressional authorization. Hegseth has called the articles a sham.
paras.zh: 众议院可能于本周就弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格斯的决议进行投票。肯塔基州共和党众议员托马斯·马西重新提出弹劾条款，指控赫格斯犯有重罪和轻罪。这八项具体指控包括三项针对伊朗非法发动战争的指控，一项针对无视尽量减少平民伤亡的法律的指控，一项针对在加勒比海和东太平洋地区监督法外处决涉嫌贩毒船的指控，以及一项针对未经国会授权抓捕委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的指控。赫格斯称这些文章是骗局。

paras.en: - 🎧 Only a few Republicans need to support impeachment in the House for it to be possible, NPR's Sam Gringlas tells Up First. This would lead to a Senate trial. Removing Hegseth from the Pentagon requires 67 senators, which will be challenging even once Democrats take control. But Massie told reporters he believes it will be possible, and opposition to the war in his fellow Republicans' home states could convince them to get on board. Massie says some members of Congress have come around to the idea that the administration must be held accountable for violating congressional war powers
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Sam Gringlas 告诉 Up First，只需少数共和党人在众议院支持弹劾即可实现。这将导致参议院审判。将赫格斯从五角大楼除名需要 67 名参议员，即使民主党掌权后这也将是一项挑战。但马西告诉记者，他相信这是可能的，而且他的共和党同胞所在州对战争的反对可能会说服他们加入进来。马西说，一些国会议员已经转变观念，认为政府必须对侵犯国会战争权力的行为负责

paras.en: - ➡️ Also on House Republicans' agenda: a closed-door meeting today to pick a minority leader for the next Congress. The decision is down to current House Majority Leader Steve Scalise, R-La., and Ohio's Jim Jordan, a co-founder of the far-right House Freedom Caucus.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 众议院共和党人的议程还包括：今天举行闭门会议，为下一届国会挑选一位少数党领袖。这一决定取决于现任众议院多数党领袖、路易斯安那州共和党人史蒂夫·斯卡利斯(Steve Scalise)和俄亥俄州的吉姆·乔丹(Jim Jordan)，后者是极右翼众议院自由核心小组的联合创始人。

paras.en: President Trump has acknowledged that the war he initiated with Iran harmed his party in the midterms. Weeks before the election, the president said he was going to hold off on any strikes in Iran. While campaigning, he hinted at potential actions to proceed with the war and teased a significant move to end it. Now, Trump says there's no need for further strikes if talks are ongoing.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统承认，他对伊朗发起的战争在中期选举中损害了他的政党。选举前几周，总统表示他将推迟对伊朗的任何袭击。在竞选期间，他暗示了可能采取的继续战争的行动，并暗示将采取重大行动来结束战争。现在，特朗普表示，如果谈判正在进行，就没有必要发动进一步的袭击。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Deepa Shivaram says it's possible that Trump might resume military action if he doesn't get the deal he wants, because he has shown a pattern of shifting on his rhetoric since the war began. The president has also insisted that the war was necessary and he would do it again. Shivaram says Trump is starting to shift focus to shape his legacy in these last two years of his presidency. He is trying to frame the unpopular war as a success by saying Iran's nuclear stock is eliminated and that was his goal. In the remainder of his time in office, he wants to establish himself as a dealmaker and peacemaker.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的迪帕·希瓦拉姆 (Deepa Shivaram) 表示，如果特朗普没有达成他想要的协议，他可能会恢复军事行动，因为自战争开始以来，他已经表现出一种言论转变的模式。总统还坚称战争是必要的，他会再次发动战争。希瓦拉姆表示，特朗普在总统任期的最后两年开始将重点转移到塑造他的政治遗产上。他试图将这场不受欢迎的战争描述为成功，称伊朗的核库存已被消除，这就是他的目标。在余下的任期内，他希望将自己打造成交易撮合者和和事佬。

paras.en: Nvidia's stock slipped around 4.25% after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with a woman U.S. intelligence suspects of spying for China. This news sent shockwaves from Wall Street to Capitol Hill. AMD, Nvidia's main AI chip competitor, saw its shares jump more than 13%.
paras.zh: 在首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名美国情报部门涉嫌为中国从事间谍活动的女性发生婚外情后，英伟达股价下跌约 4.25%。这一消息从华尔街到国会山都引起了震动。 Nvidia 的主要 AI 芯片竞争对手 AMD 股价上涨超过 13%。

paras.en: - 🎧 Nvidia is central to the U.S.-China competition over AI, which could make Huang's statements and actions of high interest to Beijing, NPR's John Ruwitch says. The woman Huang admitted to having an affair with is an executive at MegaSpeed, a Singapore-based company that Nvidia has collaborated with. The controversy centers around whether MegaSpeed was helping Chinese firms bypass chip export controls. The New York Times reports that the U.S. Commerce Department is investigating MegaSpeed and that the woman was giving information to Beijing. NPR has not independently verified these claims.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的约翰·鲁维奇 (John Ruwitch) 表示，英伟达是中美人工智能竞争的核心，这可能会让黄仁勋的言论和行动引起北京方面的高度兴趣。黄承认与她有染的女子是英伟达合作过的新加坡公司 MegaSpeed 的一名高管。争议的焦点是 MegaSpeed 是否正在帮助中国公司绕过芯片出口管制。 《纽约时报》报道称，美国商务部正在调查 MegaSpeed，该女子正在向北京提供信息。 NPR 尚未独立核实这些说法。

paras.en: The U.S. Supreme Court yesterday gave the Trump administration the green light to proceed with plans to build hundreds of miles of border barriers and security infrastructure in west Texas. The decision was made despite ongoing court hearings. This plan has faced bipartisan backlash for its involvement of Big Bend National Park, a cherished area known for its stunning canyons and pristine desert landscape. In a five-page decision, the Court asserted that the federal judge who issued an injunction against the construction lacked the authority to intervene.
paras.zh: 美国最高法院昨天批准特朗普政府继续在德克萨斯州西部修建数百英里的边境屏障和安全基础设施的计划。尽管法庭听证会仍在进行中，但还是做出了这一决定。该计划因涉及大弯国家公园而遭到两党的强烈反对，大弯国家公园是一个以其令人惊叹的峡谷和原始沙漠景观而闻名的珍贵地区。在一份长达五页的裁决中，法院声称，针对该建筑发布禁令的联邦法官无权进行干预。

paras.en: Democrats did really well with Gen Z voters in last week's midterm election, snagging nearly a 50-point lead among voters under 30. This is a major comeback from 2024, when young voters leaned toward Trump. This year's results signal that the youngest generation of voters are issuing a strong rebuke of Republicans, and they're ready to fight for an American dream that feels just out of reach. Here's how Gen Z voters helped fuel a blue wave:
paras.zh: 在上周的中期选举中，民主党在 Z 世代选民中的表现非常好，在 30 岁以下选民中领先近 50 个百分点。这是自 2024 年以来的一次重大逆转，当时年轻选民倾向于特朗普。今年的结果表明，最年轻的一代选民正在对共和党发出强烈谴责，他们已经准备好为感觉遥不可及的美国梦而奋斗。以下是 Z 世代选民如何推动蓝色浪潮的：

paras.en: - 🌊 Americans ages 18-29 have historically voted at lower rates than older voters. But this year, Gen Z accounted for 11% of the total vote. In the Texas Senate race, Democrat James Talarico won by 12 percentage points. Among Gen Z voters, he won by 60 points.
paras.zh: - 🌊 18-29 岁的美国人历来投票率低于年长选民。但今年，Z 世代占总选票的 11%。在德克萨斯州参议员竞选中，民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科 (James Talarico) 以 12 个百分点的优势获胜。在 Z 世代选民中，他以 60 个百分点的优势获胜。

paras.en: - 🌊 Democrats credit their strong slate of candidates for boosting enthusiasm, but strong opposition to Trump also played a key role.
paras.zh: - 🌊 民主党人认为他们强大的候选人名单提高了热情，但对特朗普的强烈反对也发挥了关键作用。

paras.en: - 🌊 Democrats gained support from some young voters who backed Trump two years ago, including white and Latino men. Both blocs voted blue by double digits this year. The party also narrowed the margins with young rural voters and those without college degrees.
paras.zh: - 🌊 民主党获得了一些两年前支持特朗普的年轻选民的支持，其中包括白人和拉丁裔男性。今年，两个阵营都以两位数的投票支持率。该党还缩小了与年轻农村选民和没有大学学位的选民的差距。

paras.en: - 🌊 Some gains may have been influenced by young Trump voters who chose not to participate in this election, but it's unclear how many of them there were.
paras.zh: - 🌊 一些收益可能受到选择不参加这次选举的年轻特朗普选民的影响，但目前尚不清楚有多少人。

paras.en: Visitors, ecologists, park rangers and residents all cherish Cumberland Island, Ga., but they often disagree on the best ways to protect it. Feral horses, hogs and deer roam freely across the 18-mile island. Since 1972, Congress has mandated the preservation of thousands of wilderness acres under National Park Service protection. The island showcases a rich human history, including Native American artifacts, Spanish missions and grand Gilded Age mansions from the Carnegie era. Today, descendants of industrialist Thomas Carnegie still reside on private property. Now, a park service land-swap proposal with the family could greenlight new construction. The new development could ignite a clash among stakeholders over what true island preservation actually looks like.
paras.zh: 游客、生态学家、公园管理员和居民都珍视佐治亚州坎伯兰岛，但他们常常在保护该岛的最佳方法上存在分歧。野马、野猪和鹿在这座 18 英里长的岛屿上自由漫步。自 1972 年以来，国会已授权国家公园管理局保护数千英亩的荒野。该岛展示了丰富的人类历史，包括美洲原住民文物、西班牙传教士和卡内基时代的镀金时代宏伟豪宅。如今，实业家托马斯·卡内基的后裔仍然居住在私有财产上。现在，公园服务部门与这家人的土地交换提案可能会为新建筑开绿灯。新的开发项目可能会引发利益相关者之间关于真正的岛屿保护到底是什么样子的冲突。

paras.en: - M. John Harrison's The End of Everything has won the 2026 Booker Prize. It follows Philip, who searches for "artifacts" along the coast of Kent, England, in a post-apocalyptic future.
paras.zh: - 约翰·哈里森 (M. John Harrison) 的《一切的终结》荣获 2026 年布克奖。它讲述了菲利普在后世界末日的未来沿着英国肯特海岸寻找“文物”的故事。

paras.en: - British comedian Russell Brand has been sentenced to more than 10 years in prison after being found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.
paras.zh: - 英国喜剧演员拉塞尔·布兰德因一项强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪被判入狱 10 多年。

paras.en: - For his efforts to challenge menstrual stigma, 18-year-old Aadvik Jain is one of this year's recipients of the Diana Award, an international recognition for young changemakers working to improve lives in their communities.
paras.zh: - 18 岁的 Aadvik Jain 因努力挑战月经耻辱而成为今年戴安娜奖的获得者之一，该奖是对致力于改善社区生活的年轻变革者的国际认可。

articles.title: Jaylen Brown repeatedly snubs ex-teammate Jayson Tatum as Celtics crush Sixers 'lambchops and some gravy'

paras.en: Former Celtics All-Star Jaylen Brown confronted ex-running mate Jayson Tatum at a dinner table in France last June over their future in Boston, and that bad blood finally resurfaced on the hardwood Tuesday night.
paras.zh: 去年六月，前凯尔特人队全明星球员杰伦·布朗在法国的餐桌上与前竞选搭档杰森·塔图姆就他们在波士顿的未来进行了对峙，周二晚上，这种不和终于在硬木地板上重新浮现。

paras.en: According to ESPN insider Shams Charania, that awkward European sit-down marked the last time the two stars spoke face-to-face.
paras.zh: 据 ESPN 内部人士沙姆斯·查拉尼亚 (Shams Charania) 报道，那次尴尬的欧洲会面标志着两位球星最后一次面对面交谈。

paras.en: Boston had just struck out on Giannis Antetokounmpo, who ended up in Miami instead. Celtics brass had put Brown on the table in those talks. Once Brown caught wind he was being shopped, he went straight to Tatum to find out where he stood and whether Tatum still wanted him in Boston.
paras.zh: 波士顿刚刚三振了扬尼斯·阿德托昆博，后者最终去了迈阿密。凯尔特人高层在这些谈判中将布朗放在了谈判桌上。当布朗得知自己正在被收购时，他直接去找塔图姆，想了解他的立场以及塔图姆是否仍然希望他留在波士顿。

paras.en: Charania reported that Brown approached and confronted Tatum at the dinner table specifically to address their future as a tandem and gauge where Tatum stood on the entire situation.
paras.zh: 查拉尼亚报道说，布朗在餐桌上与塔图姆进行了接触，专门讨论了他们作为串联人的未来，并衡量了塔图姆对整个局势的立场。

paras.en: Boston traded Brown to Philadelphia days later, effectively ending communication between the two. Tatum called and texted, but Brown never answered.
paras.zh: 几天后，波士顿将布朗交易到费城，有效地结束了两人之间的沟通。塔图姆打电话发短信，但布朗从未回复。

paras.en: Seconds before tip-off Tuesday night in Philly, Tatum walked over and tapped Brown on the chest to say hello. Brown gave him absolute zero back. Eyes locked dead ahead, Brown didn't flinch, didn't dap him up, and blew right past him like Tatum wasn't there.
paras.zh: 周二晚上在费城，比赛开始前几秒钟，塔图姆走过来，拍拍布朗的胸口打招呼。布朗给了他绝对的零回报。布朗的眼睛死死地盯着前方，没有退缩，也没有拍打他，而是从他身边飞过，就像塔图姆不在那里一样。

paras.en: Asked before Tuesday's tip if he planned to clear the air, Brown said, "There's nothing to talk about." Brown then dropped the first on-court faceoff between the two, as Philadelphia fell 123-101 to Boston.
paras.zh: 在周二的消息公布之前，当被问及他是否打算澄清误会时，布朗说：“没什么可谈的。”随后，布朗在两人之间的第一次场上对峙中落败，费城队以 123-101 输给了波士顿队。

paras.en: After the final buzzer, Brown hugged several of his former teammates before heading back to the locker room, leaving the floor without saying a word to Tatum.
paras.zh: 终场哨响后，布朗拥抱了几位前队友，然后回到更衣室，离开了球场，没有对塔图姆说一句话。

paras.en: Brown had 13 points against his former team. Tatum had 21 on 8-for-17 shooting.
paras.zh: 布朗在对阵老东家的比赛中拿下13分。塔图姆17投8中得到21分。

paras.en: When Tatum claimed on video last month that the trade caught him off guard, Brown hit back on Instagram with a blue cap emoji. Tatum tried shutting down the drama to reporters: "This ain't no f---ing Shaq and Kobe. There's no beef."
paras.zh: 当塔图姆上个月在视频中声称这笔交易让他措手不及时，布朗在 Instagram 上用蓝色帽子表情符号进行了回击。塔图姆试图对记者结束这场闹剧：“这不是沙克和科比。没有牛肉。”

paras.en: Brown countered on camera: "I saw that he said it's no beef and I think he's right. There's no beef. Jayson comes from a wonderful family. We've accomplished some great things. He's a hell of a basketball player. He's got a great PR team. It's no beef. But it might be a little lambchops and some gravy."
paras.zh: 布朗在镜头前反驳道：“我看到他说这不是牛肉，我认为他是对的。没有牛肉。杰森来自一个美好的家庭。我们已经完成了一些伟大的事情。他是一名出色的篮球运动员。他有一支很棒的公关团队。这不是牛肉。但可能是一点羊排和一些肉汁。”

paras.en: Drafted third overall in back-to-back drafts (Brown in 2016, Tatum in 2017), the duo reached five conference finals, two NBA Finals and won the 2024 NBA title.
paras.zh: 两人在连续选秀中以第三顺位被选中（2016年布朗，2017年塔图姆），两人五次进入分区决赛，两次进入NBA总决赛，并赢得了2024年NBA总冠军。

paras.en: Debates over franchise ownership followed. Tatum earned First Team All-NBA nods, while Brown won the 2024 Eastern Conference Finals MVP and Finals MVP awards.
paras.zh: 关于特许经营权所有权的争论随之而来。塔图姆入选 NBA 最佳阵容第一阵容，而布朗则赢得 2024 年东部决赛 MVP 和总决赛 MVP 奖项。

paras.en: Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela
paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Multiple dead after vehicle crashes into food stand near North Hollywood Metro station

paras.en: Three people were killed, and multiple others were injured after they were hit by a white SUV that crashed into a food stand near a North Hollywood Metro bus stop in Los Angeles on Tuesday night, according to authorities.
paras.zh: 据当局称，周二晚间，一辆白色SUV撞向洛杉矶北好莱坞地铁巴士站附近的一个食品摊，造成三人死亡，多人受伤。

paras.en: The collision was reported at around 5:55 p.m. near the Metro stop at the corner of Lankershim and Chandler boulevards, according to the Los Angeles Fire Department.
paras.zh: 据报道，碰撞发生在下午 5 点 55 分左右。据洛杉矶消防局称，位于兰克希姆大道和钱德勒大道拐角处的地铁站附近。

paras.en: "One vehicle reportedly involved with pedestrians," the fire department said in an alert.
paras.zh: 消防部门在一份警报中表示：“据报道，其中一辆汽车与行人发生了碰撞。”

paras.en: The fire department said three people were pronounced dead at the scene.
paras.zh: 消防部门表示，三人当场被宣告死亡。

paras.en: Paramedics transported at least three others to a local hospital in critical condition, the department said.
paras.zh: 该部门表示，医护人员将至少三人送往当地一家医院，情况危急。

paras.en: "I'm heartbroken for the families of everyone impacted," Mayor Karen Bass said in a statement posted on X. "We will continue to provide updates as more information becomes available."
paras.zh: 市长凯伦·巴斯 (Karen Bass) 在 X 上发布的一份声明中表示：“我为所有受影响的人的家人感到心碎。随着更多信息的出现，我们将继续提供最新消息。”

paras.en: The Los Angeles Police Department said the driver was hospitalized in critical condition after his white SUV struck at least five pedestrians, according to an LAPD statement posted on X. The man, who is in his 60s, is being evaluated by LAPD drug recognition experts to determine whether he was under the influence.
paras.zh: 根据 X 上发布的洛杉矶警察局声明，洛杉矶警察局表示，这名司机的白色 SUV 撞到了至少 5 名行人，目前情况危急，目前已入院治疗。洛杉矶警察局药物识别专家正在对这名 60 多岁的男子进行评估，以确定他是否受到影响。

paras.en: The circumstances surrounding the collision remain under investigation.
paras.zh: 碰撞事件的具体情况仍在调查中。

paras.en: "It'll be a prolonged but a very deliberate investigation to determine what happened here," LAPD Chief Jim McDonnell told reporters. "Our hearts go out to the families of the victims that were struck here tonight."
paras.zh: 洛杉矶警察局局长吉姆·麦克唐纳告诉记者：“这将是一项漫长但非常审慎的调查，以确定这里发生了什么。” “我们的心与今晚遭受袭击的受害者家属同在。”

articles.title: Veterans Day 2026 brings free meals at popular restaurants — and some deals don't end Nov. 11

paras.en: Veterans and active-duty military members can find free food and other promotions at restaurants across the country on Veterans Day, Nov. 11. Some offers also give customers a reason to return for another deal later.
paras.zh: 11 月 11 日退伍军人节，退伍军人和现役军人可以在全国各地的餐馆找到免费食品和其他促销活动。有些优惠还为顾客提供了稍后再次光顾的理由。

paras.en: About 30 restaurant brands are included in Dinova's 2026 Veterans Day Dining Guide, according to Alison Quinn, the company's Florida-based president.
paras.zh: Dinova 佛罗里达州总裁艾莉森·奎因 (Alison Quinn) 表示，大约 30 个餐厅品牌被纳入 Dinova 2026 年退伍军人节餐饮指南。

paras.en: The guide is in its fifth year and includes national and regional chains like Bonefish Grill, Carrabba's Italian Grill, Hooters, Outback Steakhouse and Red Lobster.
paras.zh: 该指南已出版第五年，涵盖了 Bonefish Grill、Carrabba's Italian Grill、Hooters、Outback Steakhouse 和 Red Lobster 等全国性和地区性连锁店。

paras.en: "What we're starting to see now is it's going beyond Veterans Day, to try to give back to the vets in a way that is more meaningful," Quinn told Fox News Digital. "Just not about one day but come back and we'll give you something again."
paras.zh: 奎因告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“我们现在开始看到，它超越了退伍军人节，试图以更有意义的方式回馈退伍军人。” “只是不是有一天，但回来后我们会再次给你一些东西。”

paras.en: Quinn pointed to California-based Hoffman Hospitality Group, which is offering select meals to veterans and a $10 bonus card for a future visit. Lucille's Smokehouse Bar-B-Que is among the group's brands.
paras.zh: Quinn 提到了总部位于加利福尼亚州的霍夫曼酒店集团 (Hoffman Hospitality Group)，该集团为退伍军人提供精选餐食，并为未来的访问提供 10 美元的奖励卡。 Lucille's Smokehouse Bar-B-Que 是该集团的品牌之一。

paras.en: Outback Steakhouse is offering a complimentary Bloomin' Onion and soft drink, along with a meal offer for a return visit, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，Outback Steakhouse 提供免费的 Bloomin' Onion 和软饮料，以及回访时的餐食优惠。

paras.en: Other deals listed in the guide include 10 free boneless wings and fries at Buffalo Wild Wings, a complimentary Red's Big Tavern Burger at Red Robin, free shrimp at Red Lobster and a free All-American Smash at Smashburger.
paras.zh: 指南中列出的其他优惠包括 Buffalo Wild Wings 的 10 个免费无骨鸡翅和薯条、Red Robin 的免费 Red's Big Tavern 汉堡、Red Lobster 的免费虾以及 Smashburger 的免费 All-American Smash。

paras.en: Dinova started the guide to share offers with veterans and, in some cases, active-duty military personnel, Quinn said. The company's business dining network includes about 25,000 restaurants and 600 corporate partners, she said.
paras.zh: 奎因说，迪诺瓦启动该指南是为了与退伍军人，有时甚至是现役军人分享优惠。她说，该公司的商务餐饮网络包括约 25,000 家餐厅和 600 家企业合作伙伴。

paras.en: Downloads of the guide have increased over the years, Quinn said, and the promotions may be useful for veterans or active-duty personnel who are struggling or "living under a tight budget."
paras.zh: 奎因说，多年来该指南的下载量有所增加，这些促销活动可能对那些苦苦挣扎或“生活在预算紧张下”的退伍军人或现役人员有用。

paras.en: Asked which deal she would choose, Quinn singled out Eddie Merlot's complimentary cheeseburger. Her father is an 85-year-old veteran, she said, and she plans to tell him about it.
paras.zh: 当被问及她会选择哪一项优惠时，奎因特别提到了埃迪·梅洛的免费芝士汉堡。她说，她的父亲是一位 85 岁的退伍军人，她打算告诉他这件事。

paras.en: Veterans and active-duty military members should bring identification and check with their local restaurant before visiting, Quinn said. Participation and ID requirements can vary by location and offer.
paras.zh: 奎因说，退伍军人和现役军人应携带身份证件，并在前往当地餐厅之前进行核实。参与和 ID 要求可能因地点和优惠而异。

articles.title: Woman in Saudi Arabia sentenced to 100 lashes for giving birth outside marriage
articles.author: Deepa Parent

paras.en: A Kenyan mother in Saudi Arabia has reportedly been sentenced to 100 lashes after giving birth outside marriage.
paras.zh: 据报道，沙特阿拉伯的一名肯尼亚母亲因婚外生育而被判处 100 下鞭打。

paras.en: Under the Saudi sharia law system, sex outside marriage is a criminal offence. But it is women who are disproportionately targeted, say rights groups, which have condemned the punishment as an “act of violence”.
paras.zh: 根据沙特伊斯兰教法体系，婚外性行为属于刑事犯罪。但人权组织表示，女性成为了不成比例的目标，他们谴责这种惩罚是一种“暴力行为”。

paras.en: Although many unmarried women give birth in Saudi Arabia, rights groups say the Kenyan mother’s case only came to light because she had been taken to a hospital, which are required to report single women giving birth to the authorities.
paras.zh: 尽管许多未婚妇女在沙特阿拉伯生孩子，但人权组织表示，肯尼亚母亲的案件之所以曝光，是因为她被送往医院，而医院必须向当局报告单身妇女生孩子的情况。

paras.en: “Most of them give birth at home, that’s why they aren’t reported,” said Ekaterina Porras Sivolobova, founder of Do Bold, a non-profit organisation advocating for migrant workers’ rights in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 倡导海湾移民工人权利的非营利组织 Do Bold 的创始人叶卡捷琳娜·波拉斯·西沃洛波娃 (Ekaterina Porras Sivolobova) 表示：“她们中的大多数人在家中分娩，因此没有被报道。”

paras.en: The Kenyan mother, Esther Wanja Muthoni, was a domestic worker recruited to work as housekeeper and nanny in Saudi Arabia. She reportedly became pregnant during a brief relationship with an Egyptian man and said that the child’s father had since left the country.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚母亲埃丝特·万贾·穆索尼 (Esther Wanja Muthoni) 是一名家庭佣工，被招募到沙特阿拉伯担任管家和保姆。据报道，她在与一名埃及男子短暂交往期间怀孕，并表示孩子的父亲后来离开了该国。

paras.en: A 2024 Guardian investigation found a number of Kenyan single mothers were abandoned by their children’s fathers out of fear of being arrested for having extramarital sex. After the ruling, which was issued last month, Muthoni told the New York Times she was afraid about not being able to endure the lashes and said: “I don’t deserve this.”
paras.zh: 《卫报》2024 年的一项调查发现，许多肯尼亚单亲母亲因担心因婚外性行为而被捕，而被孩子的父亲抛弃。上个月发布裁决后，穆索尼告诉《纽约时报》，她担心无法忍受鞭打，并表示：“我不应该受到这样的惩罚。”

paras.en: The case comes as a planned visit to Saudi Arabia by Reem Alsalem, the UN special rapporteur on violence against women and girls, was postponed last week. Alsalem said she had intended to “raise the situation of specific cases during the visit. If the visit does not take place soon, I will do so separately through the established channels that we have as mandate holders.”
paras.zh: 此案发生之际，联合国暴力侵害妇女和女童问题特别报告员雷姆·阿尔萨勒姆计划对沙特阿拉伯的访问于上周被推迟。阿尔萨勒姆表示，她本来打算“在访问期间提出具体案件的情况。如果访问不能很快进行，我将通过我们作为任务负责人拥有的既定渠道单独进行访问。”

paras.en: Maryam Aldossari, acting director at the UK-based rights organisation ALQST (al-qist means “justice” in Arabic), said the ruling was an act of violence and the woman should have been sent back to Kenya and not punished.
paras.zh: 英国人权组织 ALQST（al-qist 在阿拉伯语中意为“正义”）的代理主任玛丽亚姆·阿尔多萨里 (Maryam Aldossari) 表示，这一裁决是一种暴力行为，这名妇女应该被送回肯尼亚而不是受到惩罚。

paras.en: “It just shows the hypocrisy behind so-called Saudi reform. We know MBS [Mohammed bin Salman, the Saudi crown prince] has been trying to show the world that Saudi is becoming a modern country that empowers women, yet we see the court sentence a mother to 100 lashes,” said Aldossari.
paras.zh: “这只是显示了所谓沙特改革背后的虚伪。我们知道MBS（沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼）一直试图向世界表明沙特正在成为一个赋予妇女权力的现代化国家，但我们却看到法庭判处一位母亲100下鞭打，”阿尔多萨里说。

paras.en: In April 2020, Saudi announced a reform to end flogging as a judicial punishment. However, it only applied to ta’zir offences, where judges have discretion over punishments. Although most flogging sentences fell into this category, flogging remained a possible punishment for certain hudud (fixed punishments under Islamic law) offences, such as alcohol consumption and adultery, ALQST said in a report in 2021.
paras.zh: 2020年4月，沙特宣布进行改革，结束鞭刑这一司法处罚。然而，它仅适用于塔齐尔罪行，法官对惩罚有自由裁量权。 ALQST 在 2021 年的一份报告中表示，尽管大多数鞭刑刑罚属于此类，但鞭刑仍然是对某些 hudud（伊斯兰法规定的固定惩罚）犯罪行为的可能惩罚，例如饮酒和通奸。

paras.en: Sivolobova said it had been difficult to help in cases involving Kenyan mothers compared with those from other countries. “I haven’t been able to get help from the Kenyan authorities to support these women,” she said.
paras.zh: 西沃洛波娃表示，与其他国家的母亲相比，涉及肯尼亚母亲的案件很难提供帮助。 “我无法从肯尼亚当局获得帮助来支持这些妇女，”她说。

paras.en: The Saudi government was approached for comment.
paras.zh: 记者联系沙特政府征求意见。

articles.title: Aldi cuts hundreds of UK head office and logistics roles as part of global cost trimming
articles.author: Sarah Butler

paras.en: Aldi’s UK business is cutting hundreds of head office and logistics roles as part of a global effort to trim costs at the budget grocer.
paras.zh: 阿尔迪的英国业务正在削减数百个总部和物流职位，作为全球削减预算杂货店成本的努力的一部分。

paras.en: The retailer is consulting with its technology team on the loss of up to 150 roles after 103 redundancies in its finance and administration team earlier this year and almost 20 more redundancies among buying directors.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，该零售商财务和管理团队裁员 103 人，采购总监又裁员近 20 人，目前该零售商正在就裁减多达 150 名职位的事宜与技术团队进行协商。

paras.en: One affected worker described the cuts as “shortsighted” and said they showed that “upper management [are] woefully out of touch with the reality”.
paras.zh: 一名受影响的员工称此次裁员是“短视”，并表示这表明“高层管理人员与现实严重脱节”。

paras.en: Jobs in stores have not been affected, although Aldi said it had reduced the number of regional managers slightly, affecting a handful of high-paying roles.
paras.zh: 尽管阿尔迪表示已略微减少了区域经理的数量，影响了少数高薪职位，但商店的工作岗位并未受到影响。

paras.en: The German-owned group is reducing the number of people in local country operations as it centralises more work.
paras.zh: 这家德资集团正在减少当地业务的人员数量，以集中更多的工作。

paras.en: Aldi is outsourcing finance, procurement and administration roles to India, among other countries, as part of a deal with Genpact, a company that helps businesses develop the use of AI technology.
paras.zh: 作为与简柏特（Genpact）协议的一部分，阿尔迪正在将财务、采购和管理职责外包给印度等国家。简柏特是一家帮助企业开发人工智能技术应用的公司。

paras.en: Sources said consultation was set to begin on redundancies in payroll in the coming months. The company has also recently reduced the number of cleaning hours for the agency workers at its head office in Atherstone, Warwickshire.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，未来几个月将开始就裁员问题进行磋商。该公司最近还减少了沃里克郡阿瑟斯通总部机构工作人员的清洁时间。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Aldi said: “At Aldi, our promise to customers is that we will always offer great quality products at unbeatable prices. Across our international business, we continuously review all aspects of our operations to ensure we operate simply, efficiently and use our global scale to deliver on that promise.
paras.zh: 阿尔迪发言人表示：“在阿尔迪，我们对客户的承诺是，我们将始终以无与伦比的价格提供优质的产品。在我们的国际业务中，我们不断审查我们运营的各个方面，以确保我们的运营简单、高效，并利用我们的全球规模来兑现这一承诺。”

paras.en: “We are therefore making some adjustments to the way parts of our UK business are structured. Any changes are being introduced gradually and following a consultation period. We recognise that this is difficult for those involved, so we are giving colleagues as much notice as possible, with full support available to everyone affected.”
paras.zh: “因此，我们正在对英国部分业务的结构方式进行一些调整。任何改变都将在咨询期后逐步实施。我们认识到这对相关人员来说很困难，因此我们尽可能多地通知同事，并为所有受影响的人提供全力支持。”

paras.en: The company said it had invested £300m in lowering prices on 900 products in the UK this year.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，今年已投资 3 亿英镑，用于降低英国 900 种产品的价格。

paras.en: The cuts in the UK come as Aldi struggles to keep up the pace of growth. UK sales at the chain rose only 0.4% in the 12 weeks to 1 November, according to the latest industry data from Worldpanel by Numerator, with Aldi’s market share falling back by 0.1 percentage point year on year.
paras.zh: 英国的裁员正值阿尔迪努力跟上增长步伐之际。根据Numerator Worldpanel的最新行业数据，截至11月1日的12周内，该连锁店在英国的销售额仅增长了0.4%，阿尔迪的市场份额同比下降了0.1个百分点。

paras.en: The fall came as the average unit price at Aldi fell by 0.1%, making Aldi the only retailer reducing overall prices during the period.
paras.zh: 阿尔迪的平均单价下降了0.1%，成为该期间唯一一家降低整体价格的零售商。

paras.en: The retailer has faced tougher competition from the traditional supermarkets, several of which now match it on price on key items alongside their much wider range of other products.
paras.zh: 该零售商面临着来自传统超市的更激烈的竞争，其中一些超市现在在关键商品的价格上与它相匹配，而且其其他产品的范围更广。

paras.en: Morrisons cut hundreds of head office roles this spring shortly after Sainsbury’s eliminated 300 head office jobs as it restructured its technology team and Argos delivery network, and Tesco laid off a similar number of people as it changed the way it operated bakeries. This summer, Asda said up to 1,000 jobs were at risk as it introduced more automation into its logistics operation.
paras.zh: 今年春天，塞恩斯伯里百货公司(Sainsbury's)因重组其技术团队和Argos配送网络而裁掉了300个总部职位后不久，莫里森公司就裁掉了数百个总部职位，而特易购(Tesco)也因改变面包店经营方式而裁掉了类似数量的员工。今年夏天，阿斯达表示，由于在物流运营中引入了更多自动化技术，多达 1,000 个工作岗位面临风险。

articles.title: One Nation Victoria candidate apologises for slew of offensive comments about lesbians, Indians and Julia Gillard
articles.author: Henry Belot

paras.en: A One Nation candidate in Victoria has apologised for a series of offensive comments including repeated references to Australian-Indians as “curry munchers”, comparing a woman in burqa to a bag of rubbish, and sharing an image calling Julia Gillard a slut.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州的一名一国党候选人为一系列冒犯性言论道歉，其中包括多次将澳大利亚印第安人称为“咖喱狂”、将身穿罩袍的女性比作一袋垃圾，以及分享一张称朱莉娅·吉拉德为荡妇的照片。

paras.en: The party’s candidate for Greenvale on Melbourne’s north-western fringe, Chris Moore, also made derogatory comments about lesbians and refugees and once posted that he “doesn’t like the way the new homo cleaner at work looks at me”.
paras.zh: 墨尔本西北边缘格林维尔的该党候选人克里斯·摩尔(Chris Moore)也对女同性恋和难民发表了贬义言论，并曾发帖表示，他“不喜欢工作中新来的同性恋清洁工看我的方式”。

paras.en: One Nation Victoria has not disendorsed the candidate over the comments, which were made on his personal Facebook page between 2010 and 2012.
paras.zh: 维多利亚一国党并没有否认这位候选人在 2010 年至 2012 年间在其个人 Facebook 页面上发表的言论。

paras.en: In a statement, Moore told Guardian Australia “these were unthoughtful posts I shared as a young man among close friends”.
paras.zh: 摩尔在一份声明中告诉澳大利亚卫报，“这些是我年轻时在亲密朋友中分享的未经深思熟虑的帖子”。

paras.en: “They don’t reflect who I am today,” Moore said. “Today I’m focused on doing the right thing by the voters of Greenvale, and giving them a strong voice in the Victorian Parliament.”
paras.zh: “它们并不能反映今天的我，”摩尔说。 “今天，我专注于为格林维尔的选民做正确的事情，并让他们在维多利亚议会中拥有强有力的声音。”

paras.en: In 2012, Moore shared a picture of a woman and a child both wearing a burqa and standing between two full plastic rubbish bags. He then posted: “Haha spot the difference.”
paras.zh: 2012年，摩尔分享了一张照片，照片中一名妇女和一个孩子都穿着罩袍，站在两个装满塑料垃圾袋之间。然后他发帖说：“哈哈，找出不同之处。”

paras.en: Moore also shared an image of Gillard and the Home and Away character Alf Stewart. The image of Gillard was accompanied by the caption: “smash my box Alf!” The image of Stewart was accompanied with: “If I wanted a greasy red box I’d go to KFC ya slut.”
paras.zh: 摩尔还分享了吉拉德和《聚散离合》中角色阿尔夫·斯图尔特的照片。吉拉德的照片附有标题：“砸碎我的盒子阿尔夫！”斯图尔特的形象伴随着：“如果我想要一个油腻的红色盒子，我会去肯德基，你这个荡妇。”

paras.en: Moore also posted saying he “should probably stop shouting ‘Curry Muncher’ at the TV when I’ve got Indians living next door”. He also posted that he “wonders who does the dishes in a lesbian relationship?”
paras.zh: 摩尔还发帖称，“当我隔壁住着印度人时，他可能应该停止在电视上大喊‘咖喱大餐’”。他还发帖说，他“想知道在女同性恋关系中谁洗碗？”

paras.en: In 2010 he posted: “Just got the curry munchers to wash his car and pretty happy with the way it came up, looks like the boat people are good for something after all?”
paras.zh: 2010 年，他发帖称：“刚刚让吃咖喱的人来洗他的车，对结果很满意，看来船民们还是有什么用处的？”

paras.en: Greenvale is a fairly safe Labor seat with a margin of 7.1%. It is held by Iwan Walters, a parliamentary secretary for multicultural affairs.
paras.zh: 格林维尔是一个相当安全的工党席位，优势率为 7.1%。该委员会由负责多元文化事务的议会秘书伊万·沃尔特斯 (Iwan Walters) 主持。

paras.en: The electorate has a large Islamic and West Asian population. It has one of the highest proportions of people born in the Middle East and the lowest share of people with no religion.
paras.zh: 选民中有大量伊斯兰教和西亚人口。它是中东出生人口比例最高的国家之一，无宗教信仰人口比例最低的国家之一。

paras.en: At the last election, there was a swing of almost 15% against Labor on a two-party preferred basis.
paras.zh: 在上次选举中，在两党偏好的基础上，反对工党的支持率出现了近 15% 的摇摆。

paras.en: On Tuesday, One Nation Victoria disendorsed its candidate for Preston, Franco Guardiani, whose private social media account described Adolf Hitler as the “GOAT” and claimed that “importing Islam is making pedophilia legal”.
paras.zh: 周二，维多利亚一国党不认可其普雷斯顿候选人佛朗哥·瓜迪尼，他的私人社交媒体账户将阿道夫·希特勒描述为“山羊”，并声称“引入伊斯兰教使恋童癖合法化”。

paras.en: The party’s Victorian leader, Warren Pickering, said Guardiani was disendorsed as soon as the comments were confirmed.
paras.zh: 该党维多利亚州领导人沃伦·皮克林(Warren Pickering)表示，瓜迪尼的言论一经证实，就遭到了反对。

paras.en: “At a time when Jewish Australians are experiencing unprecedented persecution, we are appalled that these comments have been made,” Pickering said.
paras.zh: 皮克林说：“在澳大利亚犹太裔正在经历前所未有的迫害之际，我们对这些言论感到震惊。”

paras.en: Guardiani said he was disappointed by the party’s decision to dump him but understood their decision.
paras.zh: 瓜迪尼表示，他对党解雇他的决定感到失望，但理解他们的决定。

paras.en: One Nation also disendorsed its candidate for the seat of Melbourne, Matthew Collins, over now-deleted comments on social media regarding a number of issues including sexual consent and pornographic jokes. Collins has apologised for the comments.
paras.zh: 一国党还反对其墨尔本选区候选人马修·柯林斯(Matthew Collins)，因为他在社交媒体上发表的有关性同意和色情笑话等一系列问题的评论现已被删除。柯林斯已为这些言论道歉。

paras.en: It is unclear how these candidate’s personal social media histories were not detected during candidate selection and vetting processes. The party has claimed to have invested time and money into improving this process.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这些候选人的个人社交媒体历史为何在候选人选择和审查过程中未被检测到。该党声称已投入时间和金钱来改进这一流程。

paras.en: In Victoria, One Nation candidates must provide their personal social media accounts for vetting. They are also interviewed by a three-person selection panel including Pickering and two party officials.
paras.zh: 在维多利亚州，一国党候选人必须提供个人社交媒体帐户以供审查。他们还接受了由皮克林和两名党官员组成的三人选拔小组的面试。

articles.title: Headquarters of Haitian gang destroyed, El Salvador's president says

paras.en: The headquarters of one of Haiti's largest crime gangs has been destroyed by El Salvador's military, the Salvadoran president has said.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多总统表示，海地最大犯罪团伙之一的总部已被萨尔瓦多军队摧毁。

paras.en: The infamous 400 Mawozo gang, which is known for kidnappings and intimidation tactics, was targeted in a ground and air attack at a complex on the outskirts of Haiti's capital, Port-au-Prince.
paras.zh: 臭名昭著的 400 Mawozo 团伙以绑架和恐吓手段而闻名，该团伙在海地首都太子港郊区的一处建筑群遭到地面和空中袭击。

paras.en: It is El Salvador's first military action on a Haitian target since it deployed more than 2,000 soldiers there last month, as part of a mission to rescue four missing Salvadoran technicians.
paras.zh: 这是萨尔瓦多自上个月在海地部署了 2000 多名士兵以来首次对海地目标采取军事行动，作为营救四名失踪萨尔瓦多技术人员的任务的一部分。

paras.en: Haiti has been plagued by gang violence for years, with heavily armed groups controlling large parts of the capital, and beyond.
paras.zh: 海地多年来一直受到帮派暴力的困扰，全副武装的组织控制着首都及其他地区的大部分地区。

paras.en: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele announced the news on X, external, boasting that most of the gang members fled without trying to fight.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多总统纳伊布·布克莱在X号外部宣布了这一消息，并吹嘘大多数团伙成员没有试图战斗就逃跑了。

paras.en: "We destroyed the house of [gang leader] LanmÃ² San Jou and the 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters," he wrote on Tuesday.
paras.zh: “我们摧毁了 [帮派头目] Lanmá San Jou 的房屋和 400 Mawozo 帮派的总部，”他周二写道。

paras.en: The post was accompanied by video of several helicopters firing on a large complex, reportedly in the suburb of Croix-des-Bouquets, the gang's stronghold.
paras.zh: 该帖子还附有几架直升机向一处大型建筑群开火的视频，据报道，该建筑群位于该团伙的据点 Croix-des-Bouquets 郊区。

paras.en: As the helicopters circle above, dozens of people can be seen running out of the property, fleeing the strikes.
paras.zh: 当直升机在上空盘旋时，可以看到数十人逃离家园，逃离空袭。

paras.en: Several media outlets have reported that as many as 20 people were killed, however that has not been confirmed by authorities. There has also been no official confirmation of the extent of the damage at the property, with Haitians questioning whether it has been destroyed or just damaged.
paras.zh: 多家媒体报道称，有多达20人死亡，但这一消息尚未得到当局证实。官方也没有证实该财产的损坏程度，海地人质疑该财产是否已被摧毁或只是被损坏。

paras.en: The Miami Herald reports that the gang's leader, Wilson "LanmÃ² San Jou" Joseph, was not there at the time.
paras.zh: 据《迈阿密先驱报》报道，该团伙的头目威尔逊·“Lanmá San Jou”·约瑟夫当时并不在场。

paras.en: The BBC has not been able to verify the video posted by Bukele, nor whether the property is indeed the gang's headquarters.
paras.zh: BBC尚无法核实布克莱发布的视频，也无法核实该房产是否确实是该团伙的总部。

paras.en: Haiti's National Police drone task force was involved in the attack, supported by Salvadoran soldiers, the Miami Herald reports, citing several sources.
paras.zh: 据《迈阿密先驱报》援引多位消息人士的话报道，海地国家警察无人机特遣部队在萨尔瓦多士兵的支持下参与了此次袭击。

paras.en: Posting on X after the strikes, Haitian Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-AimÃ© thanked the Salvadoran military's commitment "in the fight against gangs", and said the two nations would keep working together, along with the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF), to "regain control of the territory and restore state authority".
paras.zh: 海地总理阿利克斯·迪迪埃·菲尔斯-艾梅在袭击发生后在 X 上发帖，感谢萨尔瓦多军方“打击帮派”的承诺，并表示两国将继续与联合国支持的镇压帮派部队 (GSF) 合作，“重新控制领土并恢复国家权威”。

paras.en: "THE GANGS WILL GET NO SLEEP!" he added.
paras.zh: “这些帮派将无法入睡！”他补充道。

paras.en: Some 2,000 Salvadoran soldiers were deployed to Haiti last month after four air force technicians were abducted at gunpoint while food shopping in October.
paras.zh: 10 月份，四名空军技术人员在采购食品时遭到持枪绑架，上个月，约 2000 名萨尔瓦多士兵被部署到海地。

paras.en: El Salvador's right-wing president has vowed to bring the men home alive and warned the gang to release them immediately or face sustained pressure from his military.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多右翼总统发誓要把这些人活着带回家，并警告该团伙立即释放他们，否则将面临来自军队的持续压力。

paras.en: The four abducted men were working as part of the GSF, made up of troops from several nations, initially led by soldiers from Chad.
paras.zh: 这四名被绑架的男子是 GSF 的一部分，该部队由来自多个国家的部队组成，最初由来自乍得的士兵领导。

paras.en: President Bukele's move to send thousands of Salvadoran troops to Haiti has raised concerns, with critics saying they are not all working within the command structure of the GSF. It has raised questions about the operational legitimacy and legality of their actions in the Caribbean nation.
paras.zh: 布克莱总统向海地派遣数千名萨尔瓦多军队的举动引起了人们的担忧，批评者称他们并不都在全球安全部队的指挥结构内工作。这对他们在这个加勒比国家的行动的合法性和合法性提出了质疑。

paras.en: Amnesty International has urged both countries to "ensure all operations conducted by Salvadoran forces in Haiti comply with international human rights law".
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织敦促两国“确保萨尔瓦多军队在海地开展的所有行动均遵守国际人权法”。

paras.en: Such concerns do not appear to phase Bukele, however, who continues to directly warn and target the gang leaders.
paras.zh: 然而，布克莱似乎并没有因为这种担忧而陷入困境，他继续直接警告并针对帮派头目。

paras.en: The attack on the supposed gang headquarters seemingly came after a user on X had urged Bukele to attack the complex.
paras.zh: 对所谓的帮派总部的攻击似乎是在 X 上的一名用户敦促布克莱攻击该建筑群之后发生的。

paras.en: "Where is that house? Give us the exact address, and we'll destroy it," he replied to the post, which has now been taken down, apparently for violating X's rules.
paras.zh: “那栋房子在哪里？给我们确切的地址，我们会毁掉它，”他回复了这篇帖子，该帖子现已被删除，显然是因为违反了 X 的规则。

paras.en: The 400 Mawozo gang is the largest criminal organisation in Haiti, and known for kidnappings, extortion, murders and arms trafficking.
paras.zh: 400 Mawozo 团伙是海地最大的犯罪组织，以绑架、勒索、谋杀和贩运武器而闻名。

paras.en: Haiti is the poorest country in the Americas and remains largely under gang control.
paras.zh: 海地是美洲最贫穷的国家，很大程度上仍处于帮派控制之下。
