paras.en: At least 5,700 people have been killed or injured there by gangs or during operations against them between 1 January and 11 September this year alone, the United Nations has said.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，仅今年 1 月 1 日至 9 月 11 日期间，该地区就至少有 5,700 人被帮派或针对帮派的行动打死或打伤。

paras.en: El Salvador has recorded huge reductions in gang violence under President Bukele as part of a sweeping crackdown, and he has vowed to do the same in Haiti.
paras.zh: 作为全面镇压行动的一部分，萨尔瓦多在总统布克莱的领导下，帮派暴力大幅减少，他也发誓要在海地采取同样的行动。

paras.en: However, human rights groups have argued that the way he has done it is unlawful, with the open-ended extension of emergency laws, the treatment of detainees in El Salvador's high-security mega-prison and the mass trials of alleged gang members.
paras.zh: 然而，人权组织认为，他的做法是非法的，无限期地延长紧急状态法，对待萨尔瓦多戒备森严的巨型监狱中的被拘留者，以及对被指控的帮派成员进行大规模审判。

articles.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now

paras.en: An effort to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war on Iran without congressional authorisation, has failed on Capitol Hill.
paras.zh: 弹劾美国国防部长皮特·赫格赛斯（Pete Hegseth）的努力在国会山失败了，指控他未经国会授权对伊朗发动战争。

paras.en: A majority of the House of Representatives agreed to refer impeachment articles to a committee - essentially killing the effort introduced by dissident Republican congressman Thomas Massie of Kentucky - for now.
paras.zh: 众议院多数议员同意暂时将弹劾条款提交给一个委员会，这基本上扼杀了肯塔基州持不同政见的共和党众议员托马斯·马西提出的努力。

paras.en: In his first news briefing from the Pentagon in six months, Hegseth called the impeachment effort a "farce" and "sabotage".
paras.zh: 赫格斯在六个月来五角大楼的首次新闻发布会上称弹劾努力是一场“闹剧”和“破坏”。

paras.en: The bid to find the cabinet secretary guilty of misconduct and ultimately remove him from office was seen as a long shot as it could have required a number of other Republicans to defy President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 判定这位内阁秘书犯有不当行为并最终将他免职的努力被视为可能性不大，因为这可能需要其他一些共和党人反抗唐纳德·特朗普总统。

paras.en: Massie was the only Republican to vote against moving the resolution to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 马西是周二唯一投票反对将该决议提交共和党领导的众议院司法委员会的共和党人。

paras.en: His effort failed in a 211-204 vote, with more than a dozen members, including 11 Democrats, missing the vote.
paras.zh: 他的努力以 211 票对 204 票失败，包括 11 名民主党人在内的十多名议员缺席投票。

paras.en: The move to send the measure to the panel effectively kills the effort, as there is only a short period of time left in this Congress before Democrats take control in January.
paras.zh: 将措施发送给专家组的举动实际上扼杀了这一努力，因为在民主党一月份掌权之前，本届国会只剩下很短的时间了。

paras.en: President Trump celebrated the vote in a post on Truth Social, saying the effort "has miserably FAILED".
paras.zh: 特朗普总统在《Truth Social》上发帖庆祝投票结果，称这一努力“惨败”。

paras.en: "Again, Victories in Venezuela and Iran, the Best Recruitment Numbers in the History of the Military (Long waiting lists to get in!), and Spirit like rarely seen before, led to the EXONERATION of a Great American Patriot," Trump said, referring to Hegseth.
paras.zh: “再次，委内瑞拉和伊朗的胜利、军队历史上最好的招募人数（等待入伍的名单很长！）以及前所未有的精神，导致了一位伟大的美国爱国者的无罪，”特朗普在谈到赫格塞斯时说道。

paras.en: After the vote, Massie said he "wasn't surprised" but "was disappointed", according to BBC's US media partner CBS.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司(BBC)美国媒体合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司(CBS)报道，投票后，马西表示，他“并不感到惊讶”，但“感到失望”。

paras.en: "My diagnosis of Congress is these people know what to do," he added. "They just can't bring themselves to do it, even when it would benefit them politically."
paras.zh: “我对国会的诊断是这些人知道该怎么做，”他补充道。 “他们就是不愿意这么做，即使这会给他们带来政治上的好处。”

paras.en: Massie had previously acknowledged his impeachment bid may not succeed immediately, but argued it could help push Trump to replace Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.
paras.zh: 马西此前承认，他的弹劾申请可能不会立即成功，但他认为，这可能有助于推动特朗普在民主党启动自己的弹劾程序之前取代赫格塞斯。

paras.en: The Kentucky congressman also said that removing Hegseth now would give the Senate time to approve a replacement while Republicans were still in power.
paras.zh: 这位肯塔基州国会议员还表示，现在罢免赫格斯塞斯将使参议院有时间在共和党仍在掌权时批准继任者。

paras.en: Impeachment resolutions can be carried past the end of a congressional term, meaning Democrats would be able to take it up next year.
paras.zh: 弹劾决议可以在国会任期结束后继续实施，这意味着民主党将能够在明年提出弹劾决议。

paras.en: The Democrats will take control of both chambers of Congress in January following a successful midterm election that allowed them control of both chambers.
paras.zh: 中期选举成功后，民主党将控制参众两院，并于一月份控制参众两院。

paras.en: House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Republican, had predicted earlier in the day that the impeachment bid would fail.
paras.zh: 众议院议长、共和党人迈克·约翰逊当天早些时候曾预测弹劾行动将会失败。

paras.en: In the eight articles of impeachment formally introduced in the House on Monday, Massie said Hegseth was "breaking the law and must be held accountable" for fighting a war in Iran for more than 90 days without lawmakers' approval.
paras.zh: 在周一正式向众议院提交的八项弹劾条款中，马西表示，赫格塞斯在未经议员批准的情况下在伊朗发动了90多天的战争，“违反了法律，必须承担责任”。

paras.en: The impeachment articles also accused Hegseth of overseeing "extrajudicial killings" in the US campaign against boats alleged to be carrying drugs in the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea.
paras.zh: 弹劾条款还指控赫格斯在美国针对太平洋和加勒比海涉嫌运载毒品的船只的行动中监督“法外处决”。

paras.en: At a news conference on Tuesday, Hegseth called efforts to impeach him a political stunt by a Trump administration opponent who was "disgruntled and defeated".
paras.zh: 在周二的新闻发布会上，赫格塞斯称弹劾他的努力是特朗普政府对手“心怀不满和失败”的政治噱头。

paras.en: Hegseth also argued Massie's resolution endangered national security, because it communicated to US adversaries "that the United States will actually punish its own warriors and its own civilian leadership for successfully executing lawful military operations".
paras.zh: 赫格斯还认为，马西的决议危及国家安全，因为它向美国对手传达了“美国实际上将惩罚成功执行合法军事行动的自己的战士和文职领导人”。

paras.en: "This is not patriotism. This is sabotage," he said.
paras.zh: “这不是爱国主义。这是破坏行为，”他说。

paras.en: He echoed some statements Trump had made during a surprise appearance at the White House briefing room on Monday, including touting a rise in military recruitment levels.
paras.zh: 他呼应了特朗普周一出人意料地出现在白宫新闻发布室时发表的一些言论，包括吹捧军队招募水平的上升。

paras.en: But Hegseth said Massie was motivated by policy differences and "not high crimes, not misdemeanours, not treason, not bribery, not the kinds of offences the founders intended when they wrote the impeachment clause".
paras.zh: 但赫格斯表示，马西的动机是政策差异，“不是重罪，不是轻罪，不是叛国罪，不是贿赂罪，也不是国父们在撰写弹劾条款时所打算的那种罪行”。

paras.en: Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year to a Trump-backed opponent, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it began in February.
paras.zh: 马西今年早些时候在连任中输给了特朗普支持的对手，自二月份伊朗战争开始以来，他一直对特朗普和伊朗战争持批评态度。

paras.en: He had already incurred the president's ire for demanding the Trump administration release files on deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
paras.zh: 他因要求特朗普政府公布已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的文件而激怒了总统。

paras.en: While Hegseth has survived politically for now, many lawmakers - including some Republicans - have questioned how long he can last in the administration.
paras.zh: 尽管赫格赛斯目前在政治上幸存下来，但许多立法者 - 包括一些共和党人 - 质疑他能在政府任职多久。

paras.en: Texas Senator Ted Cruz, a Republican, said on Tuesday he expected Hegseth to resign or be fired by Trump.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州共和党参议员特德·克鲁兹周二表示，他预计赫格塞斯将辞职或被特朗普解雇。

articles.title: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave

paras.en: The family of former US President John F Kennedy has sued to block construction of a triumphal arch that President Donald Trump plans to build in the nation's capital.
paras.zh: 美国前总统约翰·F·肯尼迪的家人提起诉讼，要求阻止唐纳德·特朗普总统计划在美国首都建造凯旋门。

paras.en: Nine members of the political dynasty argue the 250ft (76m) structure would block the view of Kennedy's grave, as well as the graves of thousands of veterans buried at Arlington National Cemetery in Virginia.
paras.zh: 该政治王朝的九名成员认为，这座 250 英尺（76m）高的建筑会挡住肯尼迪坟墓以及埋葬在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿国家公墓的数千名退伍军人坟墓的视线。

paras.en: Last week, a US judge temporarily halted the project on the heels of a vote allowing construction to proceed.
paras.zh: 上周，在投票允许施工继续进行后，一名美国法官暂时叫停了该项目。

paras.en: The White House said it was "unfortunate" to see that some members of the Kennedy family had joined litigation against an arch "intended to honor our heroes who rest in Arlington Cemetery".
paras.zh: 白宫表示，“不幸”的是，肯尼迪家族的一些成员加入了针对“旨在纪念安息在阿灵顿公墓的英雄”的拱门的诉讼。

paras.en: "The judiciary should not be abused to politicize a structure designed to unite our nation," White House spokesman Davis R Ingle said in a statement to the BBC.
paras.zh: 白宫发言人戴维斯·R·英格尔（Davis R Ingle）在给英国广播公司（BBC）的一份声明中表示：“司法机构不应被滥用，将旨在团结我们国家的机构政治化。”

paras.en: "We will continue making the case for this beautiful and fitting monument and are confident we will be fully vindicated as this litigation proceeds," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“我们将继续为这座美丽而合适的纪念碑辩护，并相信随着诉讼的进行，我们将得到充分证明。”

paras.en: Last week the project won approval from the National Capital Planning Commission.
paras.zh: 上周，该项目获得了国家首都计委的批准。

paras.en: But US District Judge Tanya Chutkan then ruled there should be a 14-day pause before any work can start on the arch as litigation plays out.
paras.zh: 但美国地区法官 Tanya Chutkan 随后裁定，随着诉讼的进行，拱门施工应暂停 14 天，然后才能开始施工。

paras.en: The Kennedy family filed its complaint under a joint lawsuit brought by the state of Virginia and Washington DC seeking to block construction, arguing that the arch will damage "historically significant sightlines" if erected at the gateway of the cemetery.
paras.zh: 肯尼迪家族在弗吉尼亚州和华盛顿特区提起的联合诉讼中提出申诉，寻求阻止施工，称如果将拱门竖立在公墓门口，将损害“具有历史意义的视线”。

paras.en: The plaintiffs include seven children of Robert and Ethel Kennedy, as well as their grandson - former Democrat congressman Joe Kennedy - and Ted Kennedy's son Edward Kennedy Jr.
paras.zh: 原告包括罗伯特·肯尼迪和埃塞尔·肯尼迪的七个孩子，以及他们的孙子——前民主党国会议员乔·肯尼迪——和特德·肯尼迪的儿子小爱德华·肯尼迪。

paras.en: It does not include Trump cabinet official Robert F Kennedy Jr, who leads the Department of Health and Human Services.
paras.zh: 其中不包括领导卫生与公共服务部的特朗普内阁官员小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪。

paras.en: Their motion moves to intervene in two other lawsuits filed by conservationists and veterans seeking to halt the construction.
paras.zh: 他们的动议旨在干预自然资源保护主义者和退伍军人提出的另外两起寻求停止建设的诉讼。

paras.en: They say the arch would be a "permanent denigration" of the gravesites and that the Kennedy offspring "would never again be able to appreciate both sites as they always have before, and as the Kennedy family always intended".
paras.zh: 他们表示，这座拱门将是对墓地的“永久诽谤”，肯尼迪的后代“将永远无法再像以前那样欣赏这两个遗址，也不能像肯尼迪家族一直希望的那样”。

paras.en: The Kennedy family argues the structure "will permanently cast shadows over and damage historically significant sightlines to the existing gravesites and memorials established in the Kennedy family's honor" at the cemetery.
paras.zh: 肯尼迪家族认为，该建筑“将永久地给公墓中为纪念肯尼迪家族而建立的现有墓地和纪念碑投下阴影，并损害具有历史意义的视线”。

paras.en: The structure would also "fundamentally alter the experience of visiting the gravesites", including the memorials of hundreds of thousands of US veterans, the Kennedys said.
paras.zh: 肯尼迪家族表示，该建筑还将“从根本上改变参观墓地的体验”，包括数十万美国退伍军人的纪念碑。

paras.en: The complaint said that the National Park Service and Interior Department authorised construction on 5 November 2026 without the necessary congressional approval.
paras.zh: 诉状称，国家公园管理局和内政部未经必要的国会批准，于 2026 年 11 月 5 日授权施工。

paras.en: The so-called Arc de Trump is one of the president's efforts to remake the capital city and is meant to commemorate the country's 250th anniversary.
paras.zh: 所谓的特朗普凯旋门是总统重塑首都的努力之一，旨在纪念建国 250 周年。

paras.en: Last year, he also added his name to the Kennedy Center, a major Washington DC cultural institution named in honour of JFK.
paras.zh: 去年，他还将自己的名字加入了肯尼迪中心，这是华盛顿特区的一个主要文化机构，以纪念肯尼迪命名。

paras.en: Trump's name remained on the facade for six months until the addition was ruled illegal and removed.
paras.zh: 特朗普的名字在正面保留了六个月，直到添加的部分被裁定为非法并被删除。

articles.title: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 recap

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada, reaffirmed its position as the largest construction trade show in North America, drawing more than 140,000 construction professionals from 128 countries across the globe. For Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, the week was an incredible opportunity to showcase innovation, strengthen partnerships and gain valuable insights into the future of the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Throughout the busy week, attendees had the chance to speak with our experts and watch live demonstrations of our brake systems, along with our advanced brake and transmission friction solutions for the construction industry.
paras.zh: 在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 重申了其作为北美最大的建筑贸易展的地位，吸引了来自全球 128 个国家的超过 140,000 名建筑专业人士。对于 CentroMotion 品牌 Carlisle Brake & Friction 来说，本周是展示创新、加强合作伙伴关系以及获得对建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来的宝贵见解的绝佳机会。在忙碌的一周中，与会者有机会与我们的专家交谈并观看我们制动系统的现场演示，以及我们为建筑行业提供的先进制动和传动摩擦解决方案。

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG is more than a trade show, it’s a barometer for where the industry is headed. Top trends included integrating autonomous equipment, advanced digital tools and sustainable technologies. The exhibition footprint spanned more than 3 million square feet with greater than 2,000 exhibitors, and attendees covered miles of exhibits sprawled across indoor and outdoor spaces.
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 不仅仅是一个贸易展，它还是行业发展方向的晴雨表。主要趋势包括集成自主设备、先进的数字工具和可持续技术。展览面积超过 300 万平方英尺，参展商超过 2,000 家，与会者覆盖了遍布室内和室外空间的数英里展品。

paras.en: At the show, Carlisle Brake & Friction highlighted its advanced brake systems and friction technologies designed to withstand extreme duty cycles and demanding off‑highway applications. Attendees experienced firsthand the performance, quality, and engineering expertise that define the CarlisleCBF brand. The CentroMotion booth was a hub of activity, and the team welcomed OEM leaders and aftermarket specialists. These interactions went beyond showcasing our products, they enhanced relationships and increased our team’s understanding of the industry’s evolving needs. Check out this video https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8 for more detail about our booth and featured products serving the market.
paras.zh: 在展会上，卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司重点介绍了其先进的制动系统和摩擦技术，旨在承受极端的工作循环和苛刻的非公路应用。与会者亲身体验了 CarlisleCBF 品牌的性能、质量和工程专业知识。 CentroMotion 展位是活动中心，团队欢迎 OEM 领导者和售后市场专家。这些互动不仅仅是展示我们的产品，它们还增强了关系并增加了我们团队对行业不断变化的需求的了解。请观看此视频 https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8，了解有关我们的展位和服务于市场的特色产品的更多详细信息。

paras.en: The show floor was packed with the latest advancements across construction, aggregate, concrete and lifting. Attendees explored:
paras.zh: 展厅里充满了建筑、骨料、混凝土和起重方面的最新进展。与会者探讨：

paras.en: • New and upgraded equipment and machinery in action
paras.zh: • 新的和升级的设备和机械投入使用

paras.en: • Advances in automation, electrification and equipment intelligence
paras.zh: • 自动化、电气化和设备智能化的进步

paras.en: • Digital tools focused on productivity, fleet management and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 专注于生产力、车队管理和作业现场可视性的数字工具

paras.en: • Solutions designed to improve safety, efficiency and sustainability
paras.zh: • 旨在提高安全性、效率和可持续性的解决方案

paras.en: Hands on demos and a live equipment showcase gave attendees the opportunity to see innovations in action and understand how they can be applied on real jobsites.
paras.zh: 动手演示和现场设备展示让与会者有机会看到创新的实际应用，并了解如何将它们应用到实际工作现场。

paras.en: Technology continued to be a major focus at CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026. Exhibitors and education sessions highlighted these key updates as transformational in construction operations:
paras.zh: 技术仍然是 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 的主要焦点。参展商和教育会议强调了这些关键更新对建筑运营的变革：

paras.en: • Digital workflows and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 数字化工作流程和工地可视性

paras.en: • Sustainability and emissions reduction
paras.zh: • 可持续发展和减排

paras.en: • Workforce challenges and talent development
paras.zh: • 劳动力挑战和人才发展

paras.en: Together, these topics reflected an industry adapting to change while looking toward long term growth.
paras.zh: 这些主题共同反映了行业在适应变化的同时寻求长期增长。

paras.en: Looking ahead: The future of construction
paras.zh: 展望未来：建筑业的未来

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG shines a bold spotlight on the companies and innovations redefining what’s next in the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Our team’s conversations and key learnings will help shape our strategies for the coming year, and we’re committed to driving progress!
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 大胆聚焦于重新定义建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来发展的公司和创新。我们团队的对话和重要经验将有助于制定我们来年的战略，我们致力于推动进步！

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India
paras.zh: 新工厂将非公路湿式摩擦摩擦片生产带至印度

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司 (Carlisle Brake & Friction) 已破土动工，以扩大其位于印度钦奈的制造业务，该工厂位于世界上增长最快的工业地区之一。 Carlisle CBF 在该地区生产机电一体化产品已超过 15 年，将搬迁至更大的工厂，增加非公路用纸湿式摩擦片和钢制隔板的生产。新设施计划于 2027 年开业。

paras.en: The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.
paras.zh: 扩大空间的目的是为了满足印度和东南亚农业、建筑业、特别是采矿业不断增长的需求所需的制造能力。本地生产将提高供应链响应能力，同时支持成本敏感市场的原始设备和售后市场要求。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 正在钦奈新工厂建立最先进的湿式摩擦制造设施，与成熟的全球制造工艺相媲美，以打造更具弹性的区域平台。此次扩张增强了我们提供耐用湿式摩擦产品的能力，有助于保持关键非公路设备的生产力。

articles.title: Crash Champions Expands in Ohio
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Crash Champions has announced the opening of its 27th Ohio located at 1255 East Mall Drive in Holland, Ohio.
paras.zh: Crash Champions 宣布其第 27 家俄亥俄州分店位于俄亥俄州 Holland East Mall Drive 1255 号。

paras.en: The 18,701-square-foot facility, which includes 15,927 square feet of production space, expands Crash Champions’ ability to provide convenient, high-quality collision repair services to customers and business partners in Holland, Lucas County and the surrounding region. It also marks Crash Champions’ first location in the greater Toledo, Ohio market.
paras.zh: 该工厂占地 18,701 平方英尺，其中包括 15,927 平方英尺的生产空间，扩大了 Crash Champions 为荷兰、卢卡斯县及周边地区的客户和业务合作伙伴提供便捷、高质量碰撞维修服务的能力。这也标志着 Crash Champions 在俄亥俄州大托莱多市场开设了第一家店。

paras.en: “We’re excited to officially open our doors in Holland and continue building on our strong presence across Ohio,” said Matt Ebert, founder and CEO of Crash Champions. “Our growth is about supporting our local customers and business partners, and we look forward to serving the Toledo market with the craftsmanship, care and professionalism they have come to expect with the Crash Champions brand.”
paras.zh: Crash Champions 创始人兼首席执行官马特·埃伯特 (Matt Ebert) 表示：“我们很高兴能够在荷兰正式开业，并继续巩固我们在俄亥俄州的强大影响力。” “我们的成长是为了支持我们的当地客户和业务合作伙伴，我们期待着为托莱多市场提供他们所期望的 Crash Champions 品牌的工艺、关怀和专业精神。”

paras.en: Customers at the new Holland location will also have access to the benefits that define the Crash Champions repair experience, including free estimates, repairs and calibrations backed by a lifetime warranty and flexible payment options through the company’s Fix Now Pay Later program.
paras.zh: 荷兰新工厂的客户还将享受 Crash Champions 维修体验所带来的好处，包括终身保修支持的免费评估、维修和校准，以及通过公司的“先修后付”计划灵活的付款方式。

paras.en: Recently certified as a Great Place To Work, Crash Champions operates more than 650 repair centers across 39 states and continues to create career opportunities for professionals interested in building rewarding careers within the collision repair industry.
paras.zh: Crash Champions 最近被认证为最佳工作场所，在 39 个州运营着 650 多个维修中心，并继续为有兴趣在碰撞维修行业建立高回报职业的专业人士创造就业机会。

paras.en: To explore career opportunities with Crash Champions, visit careers.crashchampions.com.
paras.zh: 要探索 Crash Champions 的职业机会，请访问 Careers.crashchampions.com。

paras.en: For more information on Crash Champions, visit crashchampions.com.
paras.zh: 有关碰撞冠军的更多信息，请访问 crashchampions.com。

articles.title: Opus IVS, asTech Launch ADAS MAP – Mobile IQ
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Opus IVS and asTech have announced ADAS MAP – Mobile IQ, a mobile application designed to give automotive professionals on-demand access to vehicle-specific advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) information and guidance. The application combines AI-powered assistance with vehicle-specific tools to help mobile technicians, collision repairers, insurance appraisers and other automotive professionals quickly find relevant information wherever they are working.
paras.zh: Opus IVS 和 asTech 宣布推出 ADAS MAP – Mobile IQ，这是一款移动应用程序，旨在让汽车专业人士按需访问车辆特定的高级驾驶员辅助系统 (ADAS) 信息和指导。该应用程序将人工智能辅助与车辆专用工具相结合，帮助移动技术人员、碰撞维修人员、保险评估人员和其他汽车专业人士无论在哪里工作都能快速找到相关信息。

paras.en: ADAS MAP – Mobile IQ features ADAS-IQ, an AI-powered assistant that allows users to ask questions and receive guidance through voice, text, images, uploaded PDF estimates, and vehicle-specific data on the ADAS MAP mobile app. ADAS-IQ helps users make faster, more accurate, and more confident repair and calibration decisions.
paras.zh: ADAS MAP – Mobile IQ 采用 ADAS-IQ，这是一种人工智能驱动的助手，允许用户通过 ADAS MAP 移动应用程序上的语音、文本、图像、上传的 PDF 估算和车辆特定数据提出问题并接收指导。 ADAS-IQ 可帮助用户做出更快、更准确、更自信的维修和校准决策。

paras.en: The application also supports VIN-based ADAS service history searches and image-based identification of ADAS systems and calibration requirements, bringing multiple sources of information together in one mobile platform.
paras.zh: 该应用程序还支持基于 VIN 的 ADAS 服务历史搜索以及基于图像的 ADAS 系统识别和校准要求，将多个信息源整合到一个移动平台中。

paras.en: “Automotive professionals need access to accurate, vehicle-specific ADAS information as vehicles become more complex,” said Brian Herron, CEO asTech, Opus IVS, and BlueDriver. “Mobile IQ brings ADAS intelligence directly to the point of service, giving professionals a convenient way to access information and guidance as they inspect, repair, and calibrate vehicles.”
paras.zh: asTech、Opus IVS 和 BlueDriver 首席执行官 Brian Herron 表示：“随着车辆变得越来越复杂，汽车专业人士需要访问准确的、特定于车辆的 ADAS 信息。” “Mobile IQ 将 ADAS 智能直接带到服务点，为专业人员在检查、维修和校准车辆时提供一种便捷的方式来获取信息和指导。”

paras.en: For more information on Opus IVS, visit opusivs.com.
paras.zh: 有关 Opus IVS 的更多信息，请访问 opusivs.com。

paras.en: For more information on asTech, visit asTech.com.
paras.zh: 有关 asTech 的更多信息，请访问 asTech.com。

articles.title: Autel In-Shop: Wheel Alignment & ADAS at Martin’s Tire
articles.author: Eric Garbe

paras.en: In shops across the country, the right tools make all the difference between simply getting the job done and building long-term success. In Burton, Michigan, Martin’s Tire and Service has found that difference in Autel technology.
paras.zh: 在全国各地的商店中，正确的工具对于完成工作和取得长期成功至关重要。在密歇根州伯顿，Martin’s Tire and Service 发现了 Autel 技术的差异。

paras.en: In this episode of Autel In-Shop, host Eric Garbe visits owner Martin Woods to see how Autel equipment powers a 10-bay operation that offers everything from full-service auto repair to wheel alignments and ADAS calibrations.
paras.zh: 在这一集中的 Autel In-Shop 中，主持人 Eric Garbe 拜访了业主 Martin Woods，了解 Autel 设备如何为 10 个车位的运营提供动力，提供从全方位汽车维修到车轮定位和 ADAS 校准的一切服务。

paras.en: That transformation starts with the IA900 ADAS alignment and ADAS calibration system. “We currently use the Autel IA900 as our frame and absolutely love it. It’s easy to use and quick to set up, so it’s great ROI,” Woods says. Technicians also rely on Autel scan tools for diagnostics. From seamless TPMS programming to quick key replacements, Autel tools keep Martin’s Tire and Service ready for every customer need.
paras.zh: 这一转变始于 IA900 ADAS 对准和 ADAS 校准系统。 “我们目前使用 Autel IA900 作为车架，并且非常喜欢它。它易于使用且设置快速，因此投资回报率很高，”Woods 说。技术人员还依靠 Autel 扫描工具进行诊断。从无缝 TPMS 编程到快速钥匙更换，Autel 工具使马丁的轮胎和服务随时满足每个客户的需求。

paras.en: And, with reliable support, Woods says issues never slow them down. “I make a phone call and within 10 minutes I’m back on the road,” he says. “If you want to make more money faster, buy Autel. If you want your technicians to see that you’re trying to make their life easier, buy Autel.”
paras.zh: 而且，伍兹表示，有了可靠的支持，问题永远不会让他们放慢脚步。 “我打个电话，10 分钟内我就又上路了，”他说。 “如果你想更快地赚更多钱，请购买 Autel。如果你希望你的技术人员看到你正在努力让他们的生活更轻松，请购买 Autel。”

articles.title: Celette AI Webtools wins SEMA Show’s best new collision repair and refinish product award
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Celette AI Webtools won first place for the 2026 SEMA Show’s New Product Awards for Best Collision Repair and Refinish Product Tuesday.
paras.zh: Celette AI Webtools 周二荣获 2026 年 SEMA 展会新产品奖最佳碰撞修复和修补产品第一名。

paras.en: Bossauto Innova’s Ionizer Pro and Innovative Tools & Technologies’ Innovative Truck Cab Protectors were runners-up for Best Collision Repair and Refinish Product.
paras.zh: Bossauto Innova 的 Ionizer Pro 和 Innovative Tools & Technologies 的创新卡车驾驶室保护器获得最佳碰撞修复和修补产品亚军。

paras.en: Celette describes its Webtools AI as a “unified software ecosystem for modern structural repair,” in a February news release. All of Celette’s structural software, databases and compatible measurement tools converge on the one platform, it adds.
paras.zh: Celette 在 2 月份的新闻稿中将其 Webtools AI 描述为“用于现代结构修复的统一软件生态系统”。它补充说，Celette 的所有结构软件、数据库和兼容的测量工具都集中在一个平台上。

paras.en: It functions as a cloud-based software hub, the release says. This includes compatibility layers for selected third-party benches and gauges. It also digitally documents and reports tools.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，它充当基于云的软件中心。这包括选定的第三方工作台和仪表的兼容性层。它还以数字方式记录和报告工具。

paras.en: Andrew Batenhorst, Barry Dorn and Kye Yeung, all Collision Industry Conference (CIC) committee chairs, served as judges for the awards and spoke about the products during the CIC meeting Tuesday.
paras.zh: 碰撞行业会议 (CIC) 委员会主席 Andrew Batenhorst、Barry Dorn 和 Kye Yeung 担任该奖项的评委，并在周二的 CIC 会议上谈到了这些产品。

paras.en: Batenhorst said he uses the new Celette Webtools AI in his shop.
paras.zh: Batenhorst 表示，他在自己的商店中使用了新的 Celette Webtools AI。

paras.en: “It is a generational leap in terms of ease of use and connectivity,” Batenhorst said. “It has fixed a lot of the bugs it had in the past, but what is cool is that it is compatible with other brands.”
paras.zh: “在易用性和连接性方面，这是一个代际的飞跃，”巴滕霍斯特说。 “它修复了过去存在的许多错误，但最酷的是它与其他品牌兼容。”

paras.en: He adds that it has made life easier for the technicians in his shop.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这让他店里的技术人员的生活变得更加轻松。

paras.en: Yeung said Bossauto Innova’s Ionizer Pro is different from other guns he’s used.
paras.zh: Yeung 表示 Bossauto Innova 的 Ionizer Pro 与他使用过的其他枪不同。

paras.en: “It basically can record and tell you firsthand what distance and what temperature is needed,” Yeung said.
paras.zh: “它基本上可以记录并直接告诉你需要多远的距离和多少温度，”杨说。

paras.en: Batenhorst said Innovative Tools & Technologies’ Innovative Truck Cab Protectors is simple but ingenious.
paras.zh: 巴滕霍斯特表示，创新工具与技术的创新卡车驾驶室保护装置简单但巧妙。

paras.en: “As you’re lifting the bed up and away from the frame, it gives a really nice cushion to prevent you from accidentally chipping the paint on the back of the cab,” Batenhorst said.
paras.zh: “当你将床抬起并远离框架时，它会提供一个非常好的缓冲垫，以防止你意外地将驾驶室后面的油漆剥落，”巴滕霍斯特说。

paras.en: Dorn said that the protector was debated by the judges because the idea is simple.
paras.zh: 多恩表示，法官们对保护者进行了辩论，因为这个想法很简单。

paras.en: “But we’ve never seen anything like it,” he said.
paras.zh: “但我们从未见过这样的事情，”他说。

paras.en: A lot of thought went into each decision made by the judges, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，评委们做出的每一个决定都经过了深思熟虑。

paras.en: “We want to bring forth the best thing that’s going to revolutionize the collision industry,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们希望推出最好的产品，彻底改变碰撞行业，”他说。

paras.en: Yeung added that SEMA looks for industry experts to judge.
paras.zh: Yeung补充说，SEMA正在寻找行业专家来评判。

paras.en: “We take it seriously because this could be life-changing for these companies,” Yeung said. “We look at innovation; we look at price point. We look at how the industry can use this product.”
paras.zh: “我们认真对待它，因为这可能会改变这些公司的生活，”杨说。 “我们关注创新；我们关注价格点。我们关注行业如何使用该产品。”

paras.en: Justine Hubbard, SEMA new product showcase manager, told CIC that the showcase is the number one destination for all buyers that attend the SEMA show.
paras.zh: SEMA新产品展示经理Justine Hubbard告诉CIC，该展示是所有参加SEMA展会的买家的第一目的地。

paras.en: “We call it a trade show within a trade show,” Hubbard said. “So we are a one-stop shop of everything that is new this year.”
paras.zh: “我们称之为贸易展中的贸易展，”哈伯德说。 “所以我们是今年所有新品的一站式商店。”

paras.en: It is a way for an exhibitor to increase their brand exposure, she said. She said the average visitor spent 21 minutes in New Products and 78% of buyers/media reported visiting an exhibitor’s booth after seeing their product in the showcase.
paras.zh: 她说，这是参展商增加品牌曝光度的一种方式。她表示，参观者平均在新产品上花费 21 分钟，78% 的买家/媒体表示在展示中看到他们的产品后参观了参展商的展位。

paras.en: The showcase can be found in the Lower South Hall, Booth #41271.
paras.zh: 该展示位于下南厅，展位号：41271。

paras.en: More than 1,300 products competed for top honors across 15 New Products Showcases categories.
paras.zh: 超过 1,300 种产品在 15 个新产品展示类别中角逐最高荣誉。

paras.en: “The SEMA Show New Product Awards celebrate the ingenuity driving the automotive aftermarket forward,” SEMA CEO Mike Spagnola said in a release. “This year’s honorees demonstrate how our industry continues to anticipate customer needs and turn bold ideas into market-ready products.”
paras.zh: SEMA 首席执行官 Mike Spagnola 在一份新闻稿中表示：“SEMA 展会新产品奖旨在表彰推动汽车售后市场向前发展的独创性。” “今年的获奖者展示了我们的行业如何继续预测客户需求并将大胆的想法转化为市场就绪的产品。”

articles.title: South Carolina’s governor-elect holds first press conference at auto body shop
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Alan Wilson, South Carolina’s next governor, held his first press conference after the mid-term election at a West Columbia body shop where he worked his first job at 15, according to local media.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，南卡罗来纳州下一任州长艾伦·威尔逊 (Alan Wilson) 在西哥伦比亚的一家车身修理厂举行了中期选举后的首次新闻发布会，他 15 岁时就在那里开始了第一份工作。

paras.en: The governor-elect said he worked at Reeley’s Auto Body shop as a car washer.
paras.zh: 这位当选州长说，他在里利汽车车身店担任洗车工。

paras.en: He told the media that the shop is symbolic.
paras.zh: 他告诉媒体，这家商店具有象征意义。

paras.en: “A shop like this is where you come to fix a car, repair a car, improve a car, and that’s really what this transition is about,” News19 reports Wilson as saying.
paras.zh: 据 News19 报道，威尔逊表示：“像这样的商店是你修理汽车、修理汽车、改进汽车的地方，这就是这次转变的真正目的。”

paras.en: He said his transition into the role is repairing and improving a governmental system that is “broken or damaged.”
paras.zh: 他表示，他的过渡是为了修复和改善“破碎或受损”的政府系统。

paras.en: Wilson, current Attorney General, said an audit of the state’s government will be his first course of action. This will include a public website that publishes government data for the general public.
paras.zh: 现任总检察长威尔逊表示，对州政府进行审计将是他的首要行动方针。这将包括一个向公众发布政府数据的公共网站。

paras.en: He also said he will ask lawmakers to give the governor the power to temporarily suspend the gas tax during price spikes. He added that the neighboring Georgia governor has this authority.
paras.zh: 他还表示，他将要求立法者赋予州长在价格上涨期间暂时停止征收汽油税的权力。他补充说，邻近的佐治亚州州长拥有这一权力。

paras.en: “I also understand that we rely on the gas tax to fund infrastructure projects and road construction,” News19 reports Wilson as saying. He adds that the power will need guardrails.
paras.zh: 据 News19 报道，威尔逊表示：“我还了解到，我们依靠燃油税来资助基础设施项目和道路建设。”他补充说，电力需要护栏。

paras.en: Improving roads and bridges has been a part of Wilson’s campaign platform.
paras.zh: 改善道路和桥梁一直是威尔逊竞选纲领的一部分。

paras.en: “As part of his Families First Audit Initiative, he will modernize the Department of Transportation, demand transparency, streamline project timelines, and make sure every region of the state benefits from long-overdue improvements,” Wilson’s campaign website says. “Wilson understands rural communities have different infrastructure needs than urban communities. But we can’t prioritize one over the other–they both need attention.”
paras.zh: 威尔逊的竞选网站称，“作为家庭优先审计计划的一部分，他将实现交通部的现代化，要求透明度，简化项目时间表，并确保该州的每个地区都从早该进行的改进中受益。” “威尔逊了解农村社区与城市社区的基础设施需求不同。但我们不能优先考虑其中一个——它们都需要关注。”

paras.en: Fox Carolina previously reported that lowering insurance premiums is a part of Wilson’s plan. This includes reforming the Department of Insurance to allow for public audits of rate increases. He’d also required the department to give quarterly updates to the governor’s office and yearly reports on major carriers to the public.
paras.zh: 福克斯卡罗莱纳州此前报道称，降低保险费是威尔逊计划的一部分。这包括改革保险部，以允许对费率上涨进行公开审计。他还要求该部门每季度向州长办公室提供最新情况，并向公众提供有关主要航空公司的年度报告。

paras.en: South Carolina’s insurance commissioner position is appointed by the governor.
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州的保险专员职位由州长任命。

articles.title: Hyundai recalls vehicles for software malfunction that disables airbag
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Hyundai has recalled 37,901 vehicles due to a software malfunction that disables the airbag, according to a National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) report.
paras.zh: 根据美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 的报告，现代汽车因软件故障导致安全气囊失效而召回了 37,901 辆汽车。

paras.en: The recall includes 2019-2022 Hyundai Veloster and 2019-2023 Hyundai Kona Electric models.
paras.zh: 此次召回包括 2019-2022 年款现代 Veloster 和 2019-2023 年款现代 Kona Electric 车型。

paras.en: “The subject vehicles are equipped with an Airbag Control Unit (ACU) that detects crash signals and commands deployment of the airbag(s) and seat belt pretensioner(s),” the recall states. ”Under certain driving conditions, data may become corrupted during routine writing to the ACU’s memory, causing the airbag malfunction indicator light (MIL) to illuminate and the airbag system to deactivate.”
paras.zh: 召回声明称：“受影响的车辆配备了安全气囊控制单元（ACU），可以检测碰撞信号并命令展开安全气囊和安全带预紧器。” “在某些驾驶条件下，数据在对 ACU 内存进行例行写入期间可能会损坏，导致安全气囊故障指示灯 (MIL) 亮起并且安全气囊系统停用。”

paras.en: A deactivated airbag system may not deploy the vehicle’s airbags during a crash, increasing the risk of injury to vehicle occupants.
paras.zh: 停用的安全气囊系统在发生碰撞时可能无法展开车辆的安全气囊，从而增加车辆乘员受伤的风险。

paras.en: “A system reboot or power interruption while the ACU is writing data to its internal memory may result in data corruption,” the report states.
paras.zh: 报告指出：“ACU 将数据写入内存时，系统重新启动或电源中断可能会导致数据损坏。”

paras.en: Hyundai started an investigation in August, 2024 after receiving an increase in airbag warning light warranty claims.
paras.zh: 现代汽车在收到安全气囊警告灯保修索赔增加后于 2024 年 8 月开始调查。

paras.en: The automaker worked with ACU supplier ZF Group to conduct a series of technical reviews of recovered parts. The reviews included focusing on fault-detection conditions and proposed replication methods.
paras.zh: 该汽车制造商与 ACU 供应商采埃孚集团合作，对回收零件进行了一系列技术审查。审查的重点包括故障检测条件和提出的复制方法。

paras.en: The two companies also performed electrical stress testing and held multiple vehicle-level replication tests in 2025.
paras.zh: 两家公司还进行了电气压力测试，并在 2025 年进行了多次车辆级复制测试。

paras.en: By October 2026, Hyundai was updating its field data analysis and began finalizing its findings to date for review by its North America Safety Decision Authority (NASDA).
paras.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，现代汽车正在更新其现场数据分析，并开始最终确定迄今为止的调查结果，以供北美安全决策局 (NASDA) 审查。

paras.en: After reviewing the investigation findings, the company decided to conduct a safety recall, the report states.
paras.zh: 报告称，在审查调查结果后，该公司决定进行安全召回。

paras.en: As of November, Hyundai is aware of 331 unique incidents reported from October 2019 through September of this year.
paras.zh: 截至11月，现代汽车已知悉2019年10月至今年9月报告的331起独特事件。

paras.en: The report adds that no crashes, fires, or injuries have been related to this condition.
paras.zh: 报告补充说，目前还没有与这种情况相关的撞车、火灾或受伤事故。

paras.en: Owners are instructed to bring their vehicle to a Hyundai dealer for an ACU software update. The remedy will be offered at no cost to owners for all affected vehicles.
paras.zh: 车主应将车辆带到现代经销商处进行 ACU 软件更新。所有受影响车辆的车主将免费获得补救措施。

paras.en: NHTSA announced last week that it will invest $1.5 million to help states improve vehicle recall rates to keep roads safe.
paras.zh: NHTSA 上周宣布将投资 150 万美元帮助各州提高车辆召回率，以确保道路安全。

paras.en: “A vehicle with an open recall creates an avoidable hazard on our roads,” said NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison in a news release. “By giving states the resources to flag open recalls when drivers register or renew their vehicles, we can keep dangerous cars off our roads and American families safe.”
paras.zh: NHTSA 局长乔纳森·莫里森 (Jonathan Morrison) 在一份新闻稿中表示：“公开召回的车辆对我们的道路造成了本可避免的危险。” “通过向各州提供资源，在司机注册或更新车辆时标记公开召回，我们可以让危险车辆远离我们的道路，并保证美国家庭的安全。”

paras.en: - “The development and execution of a reliable process to inform vehicle owners of any open safety recalls when registering their vehicles
paras.zh: - “制定并执行可靠的流程，在登记车辆时通知车主任何公开的安全召回

paras.en: - “Data-driven methods to measure recall completions
paras.zh: -“衡量召回完成情况的数据驱动方法

paras.en: - “Comprehensive reports outlining the methodologies and processes used so best practices can be shared.”
paras.zh: - “综合报告概述了所使用的方法和流程，以便共享最佳实践。”

paras.en: Morrison announced the funding during a “Recalls Next: Technological Innovation & Safety Recalls” event.
paras.zh: 莫里森在“下一步召回：技术创新与安全召回”活动中宣布了这笔资金。

paras.en: NHTSA learned during the Takata airbag recalls that convincing consumers to remedy a recall is complicated, he said. Researchers found some consumers were confused about what the recall meant or simply didn’t remember receiving the notices.
paras.zh: 他说，国家公路交通安全管理局在高田安全气囊召回事件中了解到，说服消费者对召回进行补救是很复杂的。研究人员发现，一些消费者对召回的含义感到困惑，或者根本不记得收到过通知。

paras.en: “That’s troubling, because it means they didn’t necessarily ignore a serious warning,” Morrison said. “Some didn’t internalize the danger at all. The notices didn’t convey to them that a defective inflator could rupture and send metal shrapnel toward their faces—even when the notices literally said as much. It didn’t resonate that they – or someone they loved – could die if they didn’t act—even when informed through multiple channels.”
paras.zh: 莫里森说：“这令人不安，因为这意味着他们不一定忽视严重警告。” “有些人根本没有意识到危险。通知并没有告诉他们，有缺陷的充气机可能会破裂，并将金属弹片射向他们的脸——即使通知上确实说了这么多。他们——或者他们所爱的人——如果不采取行动，可能会死亡——即使通过多种渠道告知，这并没有引起他们的共鸣。”

paras.en: NHTSA oversaw nearly 900 vehicle safety recalls affecting more than 29 million vehicles last year. The agency’s data shows 3-year-old vehicles have an average completion rate of 68%, while 15-year-old vehicles have an 18% completion rate.
paras.zh: 去年，NHTSA 监管了近 900 起车辆安全召回事件，影响了超过 2900 万辆汽车。该机构的数据显示，车龄3年的车辆平均完成率为68%，而车龄15年的车辆平均完成率为18%。

paras.en: “Surveys tell us that about four in 10 owners named inconvenience as a main reason for not completing a recall,” Morrison said. “That should be taken seriously.”
paras.zh: 莫里森说：“调查显示，大约十分之四的车主将不便视为未完成召回的主要原因。” “这应该被认真对待。”

paras.en: State motor vehicle agencies have been effective partners in amplifying research messaging, he said. He added that during the Takata recall, DMV letters sometimes produced repair rates two to three times higher than manufacturer notices alone.
paras.zh: 他说，国家机动车辆机构在扩大研究信息方面一直是有效的合作伙伴。他补充说，在高田召回期间，DMV 信件产生的维修率有时比制造商单独通知的维修率高出两到三倍。

paras.en: People recognize their DMV as an authoritative source of information that provides mail for critical transactional purposes linked to the ability to drive, Morrison said.
paras.zh: 莫里森说，人们将DMV视为权威信息来源，为与驾驶能力相关的关键交易目的提供邮件。

paras.en: “If somebody sees the DMV logo on an official piece of mail and doesn’t open it, their driver’s license or vehicle registration might expire, which is connected to their ability to work, run errands, take care of family, and generally participate in society,” he explained. “Registration renewal creates a natural opportunity to reach an owner with information that matters.”
paras.zh: “如果有人在官方邮件上看到 DMV 标志但没有打开它，他们的驾驶执照或车辆登记可能会过期，这与他们工作、办事、照顾家庭和普遍参与社会的能力有关，”他解释道。 “注册续订创造了一个自然的机会，可以向业主提供重要信息。”

paras.en: Morrison said NHTSA has also seen improvements in recall completions through other state avenues, such as Virginia’s EZPass toll collection system. The collaboration produced Takata recall completion rates eight to 10 times higher than comparable methods.
paras.zh: 莫里森表示，NHTSA 还发现其他州渠道（例如弗吉尼亚州的 EZPass 收费系统）的召回完成率有所提高。此次合作使高田召回完成率比同类方法高出 8 至 10 倍。

paras.en: A collaboration with a vehicle auction company also resulted in repairs on about 90% of vehicles traded in with open recalls, he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，与一家汽车拍卖公司的合作还导致约 90% 的公开召回车辆得到了维修。

paras.en: NHTSA also recently launched a bulk VIN lookup tool that allows users to check up to 100 VINs at once for open safety recalls, making searches easier for dealerships, fleet operators and others managing multiple vehicles, Morrison said.
paras.zh: 莫里森说，NHTSA 最近还推出了批量 VIN 查找工具，允许用户一次检查多达 100 个 VIN，以进行公开安全召回，从而使经销商、车队运营商和其他管理多辆车辆的其他人更容易进行搜索。

paras.en: The agency has opened a public docket for feedback on recalls. Comments will be accepted here through Dec. 5.
paras.zh: 该机构已公开征求有关召回的反馈意见。在此之前，我们将在 12 月 5 日之前接受评论。

articles.title: Schrader Adds Five OE Replacement TPMS Sensors
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Schrader announced the latest expansion of its OE replacement TPMS sensor portfolio to cover newer vehicle applications. The company announced five new part numbers:
paras.zh: 喜莱德 (Schrader) 宣布最新扩展其 OE 替代 TPMS 传感器产品组合，以涵盖较新的车辆应用。该公司宣布了五个新零件号：

paras.en: - PN 29292: Schrader TPMS Sensor Gen7 PAL Epsilon Clamp-in for Ram applications.
paras.zh: - PN 29292：适用于 RAM 应用的 Schrader TPMS 传感器 Gen7 PAL Epsilon 夹钳。

paras.en: - PN 29310: Schrader TPMS Sensor with Clamp-in Adjustable Angle Valve for Ram applications.
paras.zh: - PN 29310：带有夹入式可调角阀的 Schrader TPMS 传感器，适用于柱塞应用。

paras.en: - PN 29322: Schrader TPMS Sensor with Clamp-in Adjustable Angle Valve for Ram applications.
paras.zh: - PN 29322：带有夹入式可调角阀的 Schrader TPMS 传感器，适用于冲压应用。

paras.en: - PN 29287: Schrader TPMS Sensor with Rubber Snap-in Fixed Angle for Buick, Chevrolet and GMC applications.
paras.zh: - PN 29287：带有橡胶卡入式固定角度的 Schrader TPMS 传感器，适用于别克、雪佛兰和 GMC 应用。

paras.en: - PN 29290: Schrader TPMS Sensor with Clamp-in Adjustable Angle Valve for Cadillac and Chevrolet applications.

articles.title: Free Webinar: Air Suspension Diagnostics in Action
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Knowing how air suspension systems work is one thing. Diagnosing electrical faults and making the right repairs is another. When fault codes, sensor readings, and system data point to different possibilities, how do you pinpoint the actual problem?
paras.zh: 了解空气悬架系统的工作原理是一回事。诊断电气故障并进行正确的维修是另一回事。当故障代码、传感器读数和系统数据指向不同的可能性时，您如何确定实际问题？

paras.en: • Topic: Real-World Air Suspension Diagnostics: From Fault to Repair
paras.zh: • 主题：现实世界的空气悬架诊断：从故障到维修

paras.en: • Time: 2:00 pm Eastern / 11:00 am Pacific
paras.zh: • 时间：东部时间下午 2:00 / 太平洋时间上午 11:00

paras.en: In this free technical training webinar sponsored by Arnott, you’ll see two real-world air suspension diagnostics performed step by step using a 2022 Ram 1500 and a 2017 Audi Q7. Building on foundational air suspension knowledge, we’ll demonstrate how to use fault codes, wiring diagrams, and live data to track down electrical issues, identify root causes, and determine the right repair.
paras.zh: 在这个由 Arnott 赞助的免费技术培训网络研讨会中，您将看到使用 2022 年 Ram 1500 和 2017 年奥迪 Q7 逐步执行的两次真实空气悬架诊断。基于基础空气悬架知识，我们将演示如何使用故障代码、接线图和实时数据来追踪电气问题、确定根本原因并确定正确的维修方案。

paras.en: Through both demonstrations, you’ll follow the diagnostic process from initial troubleshooting to repair verification, including analyzing sensor and valve data, tracing electrical faults, and performing post-repair leak tests. Walk away with a more structured approach to diagnosing air suspension problems and the confidence to verify your repairs.
paras.zh: 通过这两个演示，您将了解从初始故障排除到维修验证的诊断过程，包括分析传感器和阀门数据、跟踪电气故障以及执行维修后泄漏测试。使用更结构化的方法来诊断空气悬架问题，并有信心验证您的维修情况。

paras.en: • Step-by-step electrical troubleshooting and fault isolation
paras.zh: • 逐步电气故障排除和故障隔离

paras.en: • Identifying and interpreting air suspension fault codes
paras.zh: • 识别和解释空气悬架故障代码

paras.en: • Analyzing live sensor and valve data to pinpoint problems
paras.zh: • 分析实时传感器和阀门数据以查明问题

paras.en: • Verifying system operation and performing post-repair leak tests
paras.zh: • 验证系统运行并执行维修后泄漏测试

articles.title: How It’s Made – and Why I Can’t Stop Watching
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: I have a confession to make: I’m obsessed with How It’s Made.
paras.zh: 我要坦白：我对它的制作方式很着迷。

paras.en: If you’re unfamiliar with the TV series, it originally aired from 2001-2019, though it still lives on many different platforms. The show takes viewers inside factories and workshops to show how everyday products are manufactured. From tires and engine components to golf balls, pencils and potato chips, the show pulls back the curtain on the machines, materials and processes that make it all possible.
paras.zh: 如果您不熟悉这部电视剧，它最初于 2001 年至 2019 年播出，尽管它仍然存在于许多不同的平台上。该节目将观众带入工厂和车间，展示日常产品的制造过程。从轮胎和发动机部件到高尔夫球、铅笔和薯片，展览拉开了使这一切成为可能的机器、材料和工艺的帷幕。

paras.en: I’ve seen hundreds of episodes and I still can’t get enough of it. Like Zombieland, if How It’s Made is on TV, I’m stopping to watch.
paras.zh: 我已经看了几百集了，但仍然看不够。就像《僵尸乐园》一样，如果电视上播放《它是如何制作的》，我就会停下来观看。

paras.en: My wife, on the other hand, does not share my enthusiasm. While I’m glued to the television watching a machine turn a chunk of metal into a precision component, she’s wondering how anyone could find this entertaining. I’ve tried explaining the appeal, but apparently watching 20 minutes of automated manufacturing isn’t her idea of a great evening.
paras.zh: 另一方面，我的妻子并不认同我的热情。当我盯着电视看机器将一块金属变成精密部件时，她想知道怎么会有人觉得这很有趣。我试图解释这种吸引力，但显然观看 20 分钟的自动化制造并不是她心目中的美好夜晚。

paras.en: What fascinates me isn’t just how things are made. It’s the fact that someone had to figure out how to make them in the first place.
paras.zh: 让我着迷的不仅仅是事物的制作方式。事实上，首先必须有人弄清楚如何制作它们。

paras.en: Think about that for a moment. Somewhere along the line, someone looked at a problem, imagined a solution, designed a machine or process, tested it, made mistakes, adjusted the design and eventually figured out how to produce something consistently, efficiently and at scale.
paras.zh: 想一想。在这个过程中，有人审视了一个问题，设想了一个解决方案，设计了一台机器或流程，对其进行了测试，犯了错误，调整了设计，并最终弄清楚如何一致、高效和大规模地生产产品。

paras.en: Who thinks of this stuff? And how do they even begin?
paras.zh: 谁想到这个东西？他们是如何开始的呢？

paras.en: I find that kind of ingenuity incredible. Even something as ordinary as a tire represents years of engineering, experimentation and refinement. The materials, tread design, manufacturing equipment and quality-control processes all exist because somebody asked a question and set out to find the answer.
paras.zh: 我发现这种独创性令人难以置信。即使像轮胎这样普通的东西也代表着多年的工程、实验和改进。材料、胎面设计、制造设备和质量控制流程都是因为有人提出问题并开始寻找答案而存在的。

paras.en: That same curiosity belongs in the classroom and the service bay.
paras.zh: 同样的好奇心也存在于教室和服务区。

paras.en: The best automotive technicians don’t just know how to replace a failed component. They want to understand why it failed, how it works and what the engineers were trying to accomplish when they designed it.
paras.zh: 最好的汽车技术人员不仅仅知道如何更换故障部件。他们想了解它失败的原因、它是如何工作的以及工程师在设计它时想要实现的目标。

paras.en: And that’s where instructors play such an important role.
paras.zh: 这就是教练发挥如此重要作用的地方。

paras.en: Teaching a student how to perform a procedure is essential. But teaching that student to question, investigate and understand the reasoning behind the procedure is what builds a great technician.
paras.zh: 教学生如何执行程序至关重要。但教导学生质疑、调查和理解程序背后的推理才是培养优秀技术人员的关键。

paras.en: When an instructor explains why a particular sensor works the way it does, why a diagnostic test matters or how a system’s components interact, they’re doing more than preparing students to pass a certification exam. They’re helping develop the curiosity and problem-solving skills that will carry those students through their careers.
paras.zh: 当讲师解释为什么特定传感器会这样工作、为什么诊断测试很重要或者系统组件如何相互作用时，他们所做的不仅仅是为学生通过认证考试做准备。他们正在帮助培养学生的好奇心和解决问题的能力，从而帮助他们完成职业生涯。

paras.en: Today’s students will spend their working lives servicing vehicles filled with technology that continues to evolve. Some may eventually become the engineers, designers or innovators who develop the next generation of automotive systems. Others will be the technicians who figure out how to diagnose and repair those systems when something doesn’t work as intended.
paras.zh: 今天的学生将在他们的工作生涯中为充满不断发展技术的车辆提供服务。有些人最终可能成为开发下一代汽车系统的工程师、设计师或创新者。其他人将是技术人员，他们在系统出现问题时找出如何诊断和修复这些系统的方法。

paras.en: Either way, it starts with wanting to know how things work.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，首先要了解事物是如何运作的。

paras.en: Maybe that’s why I find How It’s Made so entertaining. Every episode reminds me that behind even the simplest product is a series of questions, challenges and solutions. And behind those solutions are people who refused to stop asking, “What if we tried this?”
paras.zh: 也许这就是为什么我觉得《它是如何制作的》如此有趣的原因。每一集都提醒我，即使是最简单的产品背后也存在一系列问题、挑战和解决方案。在这些解决方案背后，人们不断地问：“如果我们尝试一下会怎样？”

paras.en: That’s the kind of thinking we should encourage in every automotive classroom.
paras.zh: 这就是我们应该在每个汽车课堂中鼓励的思维方式。

paras.en: As for my wife, I don’t expect her to join me for a marathon of industrial manufacturing anytime soon. But the next time an episode shows how an automotive component is made, I’ll probably call her into the room anyway.
paras.zh: 至于我的妻子，我并不指望她很快就能和我一起参加工业制造的马拉松。但下次当一集展示汽车零部件是如何制造时，我可能会把她叫到房间里。

paras.en: Because seriously, how do people come up with this stuff?
paras.zh: 因为说真的，人们是怎么想出这个东西的？

articles.title: Autel Integrates Alldata Repair With MaxiSYS Tablets
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Autel U.S. and Alldata have partnered to connect Autel’s MaxiSYS diagnostic software with Alldata Repair on select MaxiSYS tablets. Alldata provides original equipment manufacturer (OEM) repair information. The integration connects vehicle fault codes with corresponding OEM diagnostic information, bringing scan results and repair procedures together on one screen, the companies said.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 和 Alldata 合作，将 Autel 的 MaxiSYS 诊断软件与指定 MaxiSYS 平板电脑上的 Alldata Repair 连接起来。 Alldata 提供原始设备制造商 (OEM) 维修信息。两家公司表示，该集成将车辆故障代码与相应的 OEM 诊断信息连接起来，将扫描结果和维修程序集中在一个屏幕上。

paras.en: Supported models include the MaxiSYS Ultra S2, MS919 S2 and MS909 S2. The integration also supports the MaxiSYS Ultra, MS919, MS909, Ultra ADAS and Ultra EV.
paras.zh: 支持的型号包括 MaxiSYS Ultra S2、MS919 S2 和 MS909 S2。该集成还支持 MaxiSYS Ultra、MS919、MS909、Ultra ADAS 和 Ultra EV。

paras.en: From a fault code in MaxiSYS, users can open the associated Alldata information for the selected vehicle. They can review OEM code descriptions, detection criteria, possible causes and diagnostic procedures.
paras.zh: 用户可以通过 MaxiSYS 中的故障代码打开所选车辆的关联 Alldata 信息。他们可以查看 OEM 代码描述、检测标准、可能的原因和诊断程序。

paras.en: A split-screen view displays MaxiSYS diagnostic results alongside Alldata. This allows technicians to consult factory instructions while viewing the fault they are investigating.
paras.zh: 分屏视图与 Alldata 一起显示 MaxiSYS 诊断结果。这使得技术人员可以在查看他们正在调查的故障时查阅工厂说明。

paras.en: Technicians can follow links within Alldata to related testing, removal and installation procedures, illustrations and service precautions.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以通过 Alldata 中的链接查看相关测试、拆卸和安装程序、插图和维修预防措施。

paras.en: The integration carries vehicle and fault-code information into the repair-information workflow, reducing the need for separate searches. It also helps technicians move from diagnosis to repair.
paras.zh: 该集成将车辆和故障代码信息纳入维修信息工作流程，从而减少单独搜索的需要。它还可以帮助技术人员从诊断转向修复。

paras.en: The integration also provides access to Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence, Alldata’s newest solution. It combines OEM repair information, real-world repair intelligence and AI-assisted insights in one diagnostic workflow, according to the company.
paras.zh: 该集成还提供对 Alldata 最新解决方案 Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence 的访问。据该公司称，它将 OEM 维修信息、现实世界的维修智能和人工智能辅助的见解结合在一个诊断工作流程中。

articles.title: Advics Offers More Aftermarket Brake Pads, Rotors
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Advics announced the availability of 56 new brake pad kit SKUs and three new disc brake rotor SKUs.
paras.zh: Advics 宣布推出 56 款新刹车片套件 SKU 和 3 款新盘式制动器转子 SKU。

paras.en: The 56 new ultra-premium brake pad kit SKUs provide approximately 62.8 million vehicles in operation (VIO) axle coverage in the U.S. and Canada. The expansion covers import models including Acura, Honda, Infiniti, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Hyundai and Kia applications.
paras.zh: 这 56 个全新超高级刹车片套件 SKU 为美国和加拿大约 6280 万辆运营车辆 (VIO) 提供车轴覆盖。此次扩展涵盖了讴歌、本田、英菲尼迪、马自达、三菱、日产、现代和起亚等进口车型。

paras.en: Advics is also expanding its ultra-premium disc brake rotor line with three new SKUs for Toyota and Lexus applications, providing approximately 858,000 VIO axle coverage in the U.S. and Canada.
paras.zh: Advics 还通过适用于丰田和雷克萨斯应用的三个新 SKU 扩展其超优质盘式制动器转子产品线，在美国和加拿大提供约 858,000 个 VIO 车轴覆盖范围。

paras.en: All three rotor SKUs are manufactured in the U.S.
paras.zh: 所有三个转子 SKU 均在美国制造。

articles.title: PennGrade Offers Gear Oil Fill Pouches
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn has introduced new 1-quart Precision Fill Pouches for its line of gear oils.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚一年级 | Brad Penn 为其齿轮油系列推出了新型 1 夸脱精密填充袋。

paras.en: According to the company, the pouch is designed to help reach tight and awkward fill locations where bottles can be difficult to maneuver. It features a precision-fill spout for greater control during gear oil changes and top-offs, the company added.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，该袋子的设计目的是帮助到达狭窄且尴尬的灌装位置，这些位置的瓶子很难操纵。该公司补充说，它具有精密加注嘴，可以在齿轮油更换和加注过程中实现更好的控制。

paras.en: The new pouch format is available for PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn Multi-Purpose “Classic” Gear Oil GL-4 SAE 80W-90, designed for many traditional manual transmissions and transaxles. The formulation is specifically suited for transmissions containing brass, bronze, copper and other soft-metal components, the company added.
paras.zh: 新的袋子格式可用于 PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn 多用途“经典”齿轮油 GL-4 SAE 80W-90，专为许多传统手动变速箱和变速驱动桥而设计。该公司补充说，该配方特别适用于含有黄铜、青铜、铜和其他软金属部件的变速箱。

paras.en: PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn Full Synthetic Limited Slip Gear Oils in SAE 75W-90 and SAE 75W-140 are also offered in the new pouches. These GL-5 formulations are designed for clutch-type limited slip differentials and demanding gear applications. The 75W-140 grade is specifically recommended for applications involving higher payloads and shock loading, the company notes.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚一年级 |新包装袋中还提供 SAE 75W-90 和 SAE 75W-140 的 Brad Penn 全合成限滑齿轮油。这些 GL-5 配方专为离合器式限滑差速器和要求苛刻的齿轮应用而设计。该公司指出，75W-140 等级特别推荐用于涉及更高有效载荷和冲击载荷的应用。

articles.title: Bosch Blue Disc Brake Rotors Line Announced
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Bosch Mobility Aftermarket announced the launch of its Bosch Blue disc brake rotors line.
paras.zh: 博世移动售后市场宣布推出博世蓝色盘式制动器转子系列。

paras.en: According to Bosch, the rotors feature the same composition, weight and vane design as OE parts. The company touts precise machining and high-quality casting to ensure reliable braking and a long lifespan, protective paint coatings on the hat and edge, and a non-directional finish for stopping performance.
paras.zh: 据博世称，转子的成分、重量和叶片设计与原厂部件相同。该公司吹捧精确的加工和高质量的铸造，以确保可靠的制动和较长的使用寿命，帽子和边缘上的保护性油漆涂层，以及用于停止性能的非定向表面处理。

paras.en: “Bosch Blue rotors were designed to give shop owners an everyday option that delivers quality, performance and value – helping end-customers get the most from their repair investment without sacrificing confident performance,” said Bobby Mathius, senior product marketing manager at Bosch Mobility Aftermarket. “With 830 total part numbers across the Bosch Blue disc brake rotors line, shop owners and technicians can confidently recommend and install Blue rotors for 95% of foreign and domestic vehicles currently on the road.”
paras.zh: 博世移动售后市场高级产品营销经理 Bobby Mathius 表示：“博世 Blue 转子旨在为店主提供质量、性能和价值的日常选择，帮助最终客户从维修投资中获得最大回报，同时又不牺牲自信的性能。” “博世 Blue 盘式制动器转子系列共有 830 个零件号，店主和技术人员可以自信地为目前在路上行驶的 95% 的外国和国内车辆推荐和安装 Blue 转子。”
