paras.zh: “理想情况下，所有这些都需要在一个站点上进行，以便临床医生可以在这些活动之间快速切换。”

paras.en: Hunter IVF said it had its first one-on-one consultation with Calvary Health Care about the changes on October 30, a little more than a month out from the proposed sale date.
paras.zh: Hunter IVF 表示，它于 10 月 30 日与 Calvary Health Care 就这些变化进行了第一次一对一咨询，距离拟议的销售日期还有一个多月的时间。

paras.en: "These discussions were held very late, with not a great deal of notice for us to reallocate a lot of the logistics of our care," Dr Knight said.
paras.zh: 奈特博士说：“这些讨论进行得很晚，没有太多通知我们重新分配我们的护理后勤工作。”

paras.en: The sale of the two hospitals is still subject to the transfer of a licence, granted by the NSW government, as well as a determination from the Australian competition watchdog.
paras.zh: 两家医院的出售仍需等待新南威尔士州政府授予的许可证转让以及澳大利亚竞争监管机构的决定。

paras.en: The pending sale has sparked concerns about access to women's and community healthcare in regional NSW, where some patients travel for hours to receive specialised care in Newcastle.
paras.zh: 待定的出售引发了人们对新南威尔士州地区妇女和社区医疗保健的担忧，一些患者要花几个小时才能到纽卡斯尔接受专门护理。

paras.en: On Sunday, hundreds of people rallied against the sale in Newcastle.
paras.zh: 周日，数百人集会反对纽卡斯尔的出售。

paras.en: Ms Denniss said the decision not to offer IVF services for religious reasons was unfair to women who faced barriers to natural conception.
paras.zh: 丹尼斯女士表示，出于宗教原因不提供试管受精服务的决定对于面临自然受孕障碍的女性来说是不公平的。

paras.en: "We are not trying to play God," she said.
paras.zh: “我们并不是想扮演上帝，”她说。

paras.en: "We just want to have the same opportunity to start a family like everyone else."
paras.zh: “我们只是想像其他人一样有同样的机会组建家庭。”

paras.en: NSW Health Minister Ryan Park has vowed to work with other providers to ensure access to services continues across the region.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州卫生部长瑞安·帕克 (Ryan Park) 誓言将与其他提供商合作，确保整个地区继续获得服务。

paras.en: "We'll have a look at the volume of people utilising those services, then we will work out what capacity we have as a system and then work out what others may do," he said.
paras.zh: “我们将了解使用这些服务的人数，然后我们将计算出我们作为一个系统拥有的容量，然后计算出其他人可以做什么，”他说。

paras.en: The minister said the intervention of the state in private hospital sales could put more community health services at risk.
paras.zh: 该部长表示，国家对私立医院销售的干预可能会使更多的社区医疗服务面临风险。

paras.en: "That includes cardiac services, anaesthesia, general surgery … a range of different services that we certainly don't want to see taken out of the community," he said.
paras.zh: “这包括心脏服务、麻醉、普通外科……一系列不同的服务，我们当然不希望看到这些服务被撤出社区，”他说。

paras.en: Calvary Health Care declined multiple requests for an interview, but said in a statement that the acquisitions would provide greater stability for the hospitals, their employees and the community.
paras.zh: Calvary Health Care 拒绝了多次采访请求，但在一份声明中表示，这些收购将为医院、员工和社区提供更大的稳定性。

paras.en: It said discussions with local clinicians were ongoing.
paras.zh: 它表示正在与当地临床医生进行讨论。

articles.title: Victorian polling centre closures a 'kick in the teeth', say voters
articles.author: Nate Woodall and Fiona Parker

paras.en: Residents in central Victoria say the closure of three local polling booths is a "kick in the teeth" for rural communities, with voters facing longer trips to cast their ballots in the upcoming state election.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州中部的居民表示，关闭三个当地投票站对农村社区来说是一个“打击”，因为选民在即将到来的州选举中将面临更长的路途投票。

paras.en: An analysis of Victorian Electoral Commission data has revealed 36 regional towns that had a polling booth at the 2022 state election will no longer have one within five kilometres.
paras.zh: 对维多利亚州选举委员会数据的分析显示，在 2022 年州选举中设有投票站的 36 个乡镇，五公里范围内将不再有投票站。

paras.en: In nine of those towns, the nearest voting centre was at least 10km away for this election.
paras.zh: 在其中 9 个城镇中，本次选举最近的投票中心距离至少 10 公里。

paras.en: The furthest is Lalbert, in the state's north-west, where voters will need to travel to Quambatook, about 24km away. Only 26 voters cast their ballot in Lalbert in 2022.
paras.zh: 最远的是该州西北部的拉尔伯特（Lalbert），选民需要前往约 24 公里外的坎巴图克（Quambatook）。 2022 年，只有 26 名选民在拉尔伯特投票。

paras.en: The Victorian Electoral Commission (VEC) has confirmed three booths west of Bendigo at Bridgewater on Loddon, Tarnagulla and Marong are among those not being reopened.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州选举委员会（VEC）已确认本迪戈以西、洛登、塔纳古拉和马龙的布里奇沃特的三个摊位未重新开放。

paras.en: Jill Hobbs, president of the Bridgewater on Loddon Development group said the group was told last week that its Memorial Hall would not be needed this year.
paras.zh: Bridgewater on Loddon 开发集团总裁吉尔·霍布斯 (Jill Hobbs) 表示，该集团上周被告知，今年将不需要其纪念馆。

paras.en: "No explanation. Was our amenity deficient in some way?" Ms Hobbs said.
paras.zh: “没有解释。我们的设施有什么缺陷吗？”霍布斯女士说道。

paras.en: "We have no idea, we just got told [it's] not going to be used this time."
paras.zh: “我们不知道，我们只是被告知这次不会使用。”

paras.en: Bridgewater voters will now need to travel to Inglewood, about 8 kilometres away.
paras.zh: 布里奇沃特选民现在需要前往约 8 公里外的英格尔伍德 (Inglewood)。

paras.en: Last week, the VEC reversed a decision to close a polling booth that would have left residents in the western Victorian town of Kaniva facing an 80-kilometre round-trip to vote.
paras.zh: 上周，VEC 推翻了关闭投票站的决定，该决定将使维多利亚州西部小镇卡尼瓦的居民面临 80 公里的往返投票。

paras.en: Ms Hobbs said while central Victorians weren't facing as much of an inconvenience, the decision was still "another little kick in the teeth for rural communities".
paras.zh: 霍布斯女士表示，虽然维州中部并没有面临那么多不便，但这一决定仍然是“对农村社区的又一个小小的打击”。

paras.en: "We can't sell a democracy sausage now and raise any money for a community organisation," she said.
paras.zh: “我们现在不能出售民主香肠并为社区组织筹集任何资金，”她说。

paras.en: "Those local people that would have been working there to supplement their household income, they can't work there anymore."
paras.zh: “那些本来可以在那里工作以贴补家庭收入的当地人，他们不能再在那里工作了。”

paras.en: She said the group had tried to contact the VEC to have the booth reinstated but had received only automated replies.
paras.zh: 她说，该组织曾试图联系 VEC 以恢复该摊位，但只收到自动回复。

paras.en: Lack of communication 'very disappointing'
paras.zh: 缺乏沟通“非常令人失望”

paras.en: Marong resident Michael Shay said there had always been a polling centre in the town in the 30 years he had lived there.
paras.zh: Marong 居民迈克尔·谢伊 (Michael Shay) 表示，他住在那里 30 年来，镇上一直有一个投票中心。

paras.en: He said both Marong Primary School and Marong Town Hall, which have both been used as voting centres at previous state and federal elections, applied to be a centre at this election but did not hear back.
paras.zh: 他说，马龙小学和马龙市政厅在之前的州和联邦选举中都被用作投票中心，他们申请成为这次选举的投票中心，但没有收到回复。

paras.en: He said many residents would not realise their local booth had gone until they went looking for it.
paras.zh: 他说，许多居民直到去寻找时才意识到当地的摊位已经不见了。

paras.en: "A lot of people that get the paperwork will just assume that there's going to be a local polling booth," Mr Shay said.
paras.zh: 谢伊先生说：“很多拿到文件的人只会假设当地会有一个投票站。”

paras.en: "We've got a lot of elderly people and the township has grown phenomenally in the last five years.
paras.zh: “我们有很多老年人，过去五年来该镇发展迅速。

paras.en: "Just very disappointing and feels like we're getting let down by the bureaucrats again."
paras.zh: “非常令人失望，感觉我们又被官僚们失望了。”

paras.en: The nearest voting centres for Marong residents are at Maiden Gully and Lockwood, about 10 kilometres away.
paras.zh: 最近的 Marong 居民投票中心位于 Maiden Gully 和 Lockwood，相距约 10 公里。

paras.en: Mr Shay said residents without a car would struggle to get there.
paras.zh: 谢伊先生表示，没有汽车的居民很难到达那里。

paras.en: "There's a lot of people in town that are probably going to have to rely on public transport, and on a weekend there's no public transport to go and vote," he said.
paras.zh: “镇上有很多人可能不得不依赖公共交通，而周末没有公共交通可以去投票，”他说。

paras.en: Tarnagulla voters will need to travel about 8 kilometres to Newbridge.
paras.zh: Tarnagulla 选民需要行驶约 8 公里才能到达 Newbridge。

paras.en: Brian Ryan, president of the Bridgewater Recreation Reserve committee, said the group earlier this year applied for their community hub to be re-used as a voting centre, as it had been at previous elections.
paras.zh: 布里奇沃特休闲保护区委员会主席布莱恩·瑞安 (Brian Ryan) 表示，该组织今年早些时候申请将其社区中心重新用作投票中心，就像之前的选举一样。

paras.en: He said they only learned the town wouldn't have a voting centre at all after the group contacted the VEC to ask why it had not made its usual booking.
paras.zh: 他说，在该组织联系 VEC 询问为何没有进行常规预订后，他们才得知该镇根本没有投票中心。

paras.en: "Regional Victoria's getting kicked around again … they're public service, they should be serving the public and they're not," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“维多利亚地区再次受到攻击……他们是公共服务部门，他们应该为公众服务，但他们没有。”

paras.en: Victorian Electoral Commissioner Sven Bluemmel said the VEC reviewed its voting centre network at every election, taking into account venue availability, accessibility and how many voters each location could serve.
paras.zh: 维州选举专员 Sven Bluemmel 表示，VEC 在每次选举时都会审查其投票中心网络，考虑场地的可用性、可达性以及每个地点可以服务的选民数量。

paras.en: "We don't own these venues, so every election we basically start from scratch," Mr Bluemmel said.
paras.zh: “我们不拥有这些场地，所以每次选举我们基本上都是从头开始，”布鲁梅尔先生说。

paras.en: He said venues were finalised about a month out from election day because some only became available closer to the date.
paras.zh: 他说，场地是在距离选举日大约一个月后才确定的，因为有些场地只有在临近选举日时才开放。

paras.en: Mr Bluemmel acknowledged the closures would be difficult for some people.
paras.zh: 布鲁梅尔先生承认，关闭对一些人来说会很困难。

paras.en: "For those individuals, I understand that and of course that's unfortunate, but that is also why we have other ways of voting," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“对于这些人来说，我理解这一点，这当然是不幸的，但这也是我们有其他投票方式的原因。”

paras.en: He said there were more voting centres than ever before, particularly for early voting in regional Victoria.
paras.zh: 他说，投票中心比以往任何时候都多，特别是维多利亚州地区的提前投票。

paras.en: Ms Hobbs said she would vote early, but believed doing so meant missing out on last-minute information before election day.
paras.zh: 霍布斯女士表示，她会提前投票，但她认为这样做意味着错过选举日前最后一刻的信息。

paras.en: She said what frustrated her most was that new booths had opened in larger regional centres including Ballarat, Maryborough and Ararat.
paras.zh: 她说，最令她沮丧的是，巴拉瑞特、玛丽伯勒和亚拉拉特等较大的区域中心开设了新摊位。

paras.en: "If it hadn't have been the fact that they have opened up other booths in the bigger centres, then it would probably not upset me as much."
paras.zh: “如果不是他们在更大的中心开设了其他摊位，那么我可能不会那么难过。”

paras.en: Applications for postal voting will close on Wednesday, November 25.
paras.zh: 邮寄投票申请将于 11 月 25 日星期三截止。

paras.en: - The ABC used Claude, an AI tool made by Anthropic, to help match venues across two datasets and calculate distances. The findings, including every town counted, were checked against the VEC's published data.
paras.zh: - ABC 使用 Anthropic 开发的人工智能工具 Claude 来帮助匹配两个数据集的场地并计算距离。调查结果（包括统计的每个城镇）均与 VEC 公布的数据进行了核对。

paras.en: - The analysis compared the VEC's list of 2022 election-day voting centres with its 2026 voting venues spreadsheet, as published on November 7. Both 2026 election day and early voting centres were counted, as the VEC says all early voting centres will also be open on election day.
paras.zh: - 该分析将 VEC 的 2022 年选举日投票中心清单与 11 月 7 日发布的 2026 年投票地点电子表格进行了比较。2026 年选举日和提前投票中心都被计算在内，因为 VEC 表示所有提前投票中心也将在选举日开放。

paras.en: - A town was only counted if no 2026 venue fell within 5km of its 2022 polling booth. Places where the same venue is still in use under a different suburb name, or where another venue is less than 2km away, were excluded. Towns that lost some but not all of their booths were not counted.
paras.zh: - 只有在 2026 年投票站 5 公里范围内没有 2026 年投票站的情况下，该城镇才会被计入在内。同一场馆仍在以不同郊区名称使用的地方，或者距离不到 2 公里的另一个场馆的地方被排除在外。失去部分但不是全部摊位的城镇不被计算在内。

paras.en: - Distances are measured in a straight line from the 2022 booth to the nearest 2026 venue, so travel by road may be further. The 2026 spreadsheet does not include coordinates. Where a 2026 venue was also used in 2022, the VEC's 2022 coordinates were used. Otherwise, the centre of the venue's suburb was used, which may place it a few kilometres from its true location.
paras.zh: - 距离是从 2022 年展位到最近的 2026 年场馆的直线距离，因此通过公路旅行可能会更远。 2026 年电子表格不包含坐标。如果 2022 年也使用 2026 年场地，则使用 VEC 的 2022 年坐标。否则，会使用场地郊区的中心，这可能会使其距离真实位置几公里。

paras.en: - Werribee South, which also lost its booth, was excluded because it sits on Melbourne's urban fringe despite being classed as inner regional by the Australian Bureau of Statistics.
paras.zh: - Werribee South 也失去了展位，但由于位于墨尔本城市边缘而被排除在外，尽管它被澳大利亚统计局归类为内陆地区。

paras.en: - The VEC can still change its venue list before election day, as it did when it reinstated a polling booth at Kaniva.
paras.zh: - VEC 仍然可以在选举日之前更改其地点列表，就像恢复卡尼瓦投票站时所做的那样。

articles.title: Experts urge people not to drink raw milk as products pushed online
articles.author: Ned Hammond

paras.en: Experts call for stronger enforcement of ban on human consumption of raw milk with products pushed in online communities
paras.zh: 专家呼吁加强网络社区推广产品禁止人类食用原奶的执法力度

paras.en: The AMAQ is warning people of the dangers of drinking unpasteurised milk, the sale of which is banned nation-wide for human consumption due to the common presence of potentially deadly bacteria.
paras.zh: AMIQ 警告人们饮用未经高温消毒的牛奶的危险，由于普遍存在潜在致命细菌，全国范围内禁止销售未经高温消毒的牛奶供人类食用。

paras.en: Communications expert Susan Grantham says social media algorithms are encouraging consumption of the products, with a recent survey finding one-in-six Australians are partaking.
paras.zh: 传播专家苏珊格兰瑟姆表示，社交媒体算法正在鼓励这些产品的消费，最近的一项调查发现六分之一的澳大利亚人正在参与其中。

paras.en: AMAQ president Erica Gannon is calling for greater enforcement of existing regulations around the marketing and sale of raw milk products.
paras.zh: AMIQ 总裁埃里卡·甘农 (Erica Gannon) 呼吁加强对原料奶产品营销和销售的现有法规的执行力度。

articles.title: World Athletics raises qualifying standards for 2028 LA Olympics, gets tough on endurance events

paras.en: World Athletics raises qualifying standards for 2028 LA Olympics, gets tough on endurance events
paras.zh: 世界田径提高 2028 年洛杉矶奥运会的资格标准，对耐力项目采取严厉措施

paras.en: 2:22:20 women's marathon entry time faster than any Canadian has ever run
paras.zh: 2:22:20 女子马拉松报名时间比任何加拿大人都快

paras.en: Athletes chasing qualification for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics will face much tougher entry standards than for Paris two years ago, with World Athletics on Tuesday tightening benchmarks across track events while increasing reliance on world rankings.
paras.zh: 争夺 2028 年洛杉矶奥运会资格的运动员将面临比两年前巴黎奥运会更严格的准入标准，世界田径周二收紧了田径项目的基准，同时增加了对世界排名的依赖。

paras.en: The global governing body said around 40 per cent of athletes would qualify through entry standards and 60 per cent through world rankings, compared with a 50-50 split at the Paris 2024 Olympics.
paras.zh: 该全球管理机构表示，大约 40% 的运动员将通过入门标准获得参赛资格，60% 的运动员将通过世界排名获得参赛资格，而 2024 年巴黎奥运会上，这一比例为 50-50 人。

paras.en: The qualification system includes 23 men's events, 23 women's events and two mixed relays - the 4x100m mixed relay, making its Olympic debut and the 4x400m mixed relay.
paras.zh: 资格赛体系包括23个男子项目、23个女子项目和两项混合接力——首次亮相奥运会的4x100米混合接力和4x400米混合接力。

paras.en: The toughest increases came in the endurance events, where athletes will need to run faster than the marks required for Paris.
paras.zh: 最艰难的增长出现在耐力项目中，运动员需要跑得比巴黎要求的分数更快。

paras.en: - World Athletics lowered the men's marathon standard from 2:08:10 to 2:05:00, more than three minutes quicker than the Paris benchmark and tightened the women's requirement from 2:26:50 to 2:22:20.
paras.zh: - 世界田径将男子马拉松标准从2:08:10降低到2:05:00，比巴黎基准快了三分钟多，并将女子马拉松要求从2:26:50收紧到2:22:20。

paras.en: - In the men's 5,000 metres, the standard was cut from 13:05 to 12:50, while the women's equivalent fell from 14:52 to 14:34.
paras.zh: - 男子5000米标准时间由13:05缩短至12:50，女子5000米标准时间由14:52缩短至14:34。

paras.en: - Sprint events have also become more demanding. The men's 100m standard dropped from 10.00 seconds to 9.93, while the women's mark was cut from 11.07 to 10.96.
paras.zh: - 冲刺赛的要求也变得更高。男子100m标准从10.00秒下降到9.93秒，女子100m标准从11.07秒下降到10.96秒。

paras.en: - Middle-distance athletes face steeper targets as well, with the men's 1,500m standard reduced from 3:33.50 to 3:30.00 and the women's from 4:02.50 to 3:57.50.
paras.zh: - 中长跑运动员也面临着更陡峭的目标，男子1500m标准从3:33.50减少到3:30.00，女子从4:02.50减少到3:57.50。

paras.en: World Athletics said meeting the entry standard alone would not automatically secure an Olympic berth.
paras.zh: 世界田径协会表示，仅满足准入标准并不能自动获得奥运会席位。

paras.en: - Andrew Davies delivers fastest-ever marathon debut by Canadian in Toronto Waterfront race
paras.zh: - 安德鲁·戴维斯 (Andrew Davies) 在多伦多海滨比赛中创造了加拿大人有史以来最快的马拉松首秀

paras.en: - Athletics worlds to be staged in Africa for the first time with Nairobi as host
paras.zh: - 田径世锦赛将首次在非洲举办，内罗毕作为东道主

paras.en: If more athletes achieve the standard than available quota places in an event, spots will be awarded to those with the best performances during the qualification period.
paras.zh: 如果达到标准的运动员多于赛事中可用的配额，则资格赛期间表现最好的运动员将获得参赛资格。

paras.en: "In this case no athletes will be qualified by world rankings," the governing body added.
paras.zh: “在这种情况下，没有运动员能够获得世界排名资格，”管理机构补充道。

paras.en: For marathon runners, the qualification period will run Nov. 1, 2026 to April 30, 2028.
paras.zh: 对于马拉松运动员来说，资格期为2026年11月1日至2028年4月30日。

paras.en: The window opens Dec. 19 for the 10,000m, combined events, race walks, and relays, while all other events will have a qualification period from June 19, 2027 to June 18, 2028.
paras.zh: 10,000m、综合项目、竞走和接力项目的窗口期将于 12 月 19 日开放，而所有其他项目的资格期将从 2027 年 6 月 19 日到 2028 年 6 月 18 日。

paras.en: The athletics competition at Los Angeles 2028 will be held from July 15-30 at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum, which will host the primary track & field program.
paras.zh: 2028 年洛杉矶奥运会田径比赛将于 7 月 15 日至 30 日在洛杉矶纪念体育馆举行，该体育场将举办主要的田径项目。

articles.title: David Walliams, U.K. comedian and author, accused of preying on teenage girls
articles.author: Philip Drost

paras.en: David Walliams, U.K. comedian and author, accused of preying on teenage girls
paras.zh: 英国喜剧演员兼作家大卫·威廉姆斯被指控性侵少女

paras.en: Walliams identified as initially-unnamed celebrity who tried to block allegations being published
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯最初被认为是试图阻止指控发表的未透露姓名的名人

paras.en: British comedian and author David Walliams has been accused by multiple women of using his celebrity status to prey on them at a young age, often for sex, according to a three-year investigation by the Guardian and ITV News.
paras.zh: 根据《卫报》和英国独立电视台新闻部为期三年的调查，英国喜剧演员兼作家大卫·威廉姆斯被多名女性指控利用自己的名人身份在年轻时对她们进行性骚扰，通常是为了发生性关系。

paras.en: Walliams has also been accused of inappropriate behaviour in the workplace during his time on the show Britain’s Got Talent, where he was a judge for 10 years, and at his former publisher HarperCollins, which has since dropped him.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯还被指控在工作场所存在不当行为，他曾在《英国达人秀》节目中担任评委10年，在他的前出版商《哈珀柯林斯》杂志上也被指控有不当行为，后者后来解雇了他。

paras.en: Walliams has denied the allegations. Earlier this year, his lawyers took a case to the U.K.'s High Court in an effort to stop the Guardian and ITV News from publishing the claims and naming him in their reporting.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯否认了这些指控。今年早些时候，他的律师向英国高等法院提起诉讼，试图阻止《卫报》和独立电视台新闻发表这些指控并在报道中提及他的名字。

paras.en: A judge rejected his injunction request last week, but protected his identity until late Monday.
paras.zh: 法官上周拒绝了他的禁令请求，但直到周一晚些时候才保护他的身份。

paras.en: That case was dismissed last week, meaning those claims could be shared. Walliams's legal team claimed that if those allegations were made public, he'd take his own life, according to a story by the BBC.
paras.zh: 该案于上周被驳回，这意味着这些主张可以被分享。据英国广播公司报道，威廉姆斯的法律团队声称，如果这些指控被公开，他将自杀。

paras.en: While most women say they were over the age of 18 during their interactions with Walliams, two say they were 15 when they first met him.
paras.zh: 虽然大多数女性表示，在与威廉姆斯交往时她们已经年满 18 岁，但有两位女性表示，她们第一次见到他时才 15 岁。

paras.en: One woman told the Guardian and ITV News she met Walliams in 2004 at a fan event, when she was 15 and he was 32. He was starring in the hit BBC comedy series Little Britain at the time, and she hoped to one day be a comedy writer.
paras.zh: 一位女士告诉《卫报》和独立电视台新闻，她于 2004 年在一次粉丝活动中认识了威廉姆斯，当时她 15 岁，威廉姆斯 32 岁。当时他正在主演 BBC 热门喜剧剧集《小不列颠》，她希望有一天能成为一名喜剧作家。

paras.en: Matt Lucas, left, and Walliams, right — dressed as their characters Lou Todd and Andy Pipkin — signed copies of their comedy CD in January 2004. It was at such a fan event where one of Walliams' accusers says she first met him. (Steve Finn/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 马特·卢卡斯（左）和威廉姆斯（右）装扮成他们的角色卢·托德和安迪·皮普金，于 2004 年 1 月签署了他们的喜剧 CD。威廉姆斯的一位指控者说，正是在这样的一次粉丝活动中，她第一次见到了他。 （史蒂夫·芬恩/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: At the event, she says he called her "a very attractive lady" and wouldn't stop staring at her. She gave Walliams some scripts she'd written and her contact information, and after that, she says, he called her at home.
paras.zh: 在活动中，她说他称她为“一位非常有魅力的女士”，并且不停地盯着她看。她给了威廉姆斯一些她写的剧本和联系信息，之后，她说，他给她家里打电话。

paras.en: She claims he told her the scripts were very funny, and said they should stay in touch. During the call, she says her age was discussed several times.
paras.zh: 她声称他告诉她剧本非常有趣，并说他们应该保持联系。她说，在电话中，她的年龄被讨论了好几次。

paras.en: As time went on, and communication continued, she says the conversation turned sexual, and Walliams asked for pictures of her naked. At the age of 17, she says her and Walliams had consensual sex.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，沟通继续进行，她说谈话变成了性行为，威廉姆斯要求她提供裸体照片。 17 岁时，她说她和威廉姆斯发生了两厢情愿的性行为。

paras.en: Walliams told the Guardian and ITV News that he doesn't remember asking for such pictures, and that he believed she was 18 at the time they had sex.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯告诉《卫报》和独立电视台新闻，他不记得索要过这样的照片，而且他相信他们发生性关系时她才 18 岁。

paras.en: Walliams won a Pride of Britain Award in 2006 as the Most Influential Public Figure, after raising money for the charity campaign Sports Relief by swimming across the English Channel. (Ian Walton/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 2006 年，威廉姆斯通过游泳横渡英吉利海峡为慈善运动“体育救济”筹集资金，荣获“英国骄傲奖”“最具影响力公众人物”称号。 （伊恩沃尔顿/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Another woman also claims to have met Walliams when she was 15, after the two connected on the social network MySpace in 2007. She says they arranged a meet-up when she was in London where they kissed in an alleyway; she said he later touched her sexually at his house and then suggested they connect again when she turned 16.
paras.zh: 另一位女士也声称，她在 15 岁时就认识了威廉姆斯，两人于 2007 年在社交网络 MySpace 上建立了联系。她说，当她在伦敦时，他们安排了一次见面，并在一条小巷里接吻；两人在 2007 年在社交网络 MySpace 上建立了联系。她说，后来他在自己家里对她进行了性接触，然后建议他们在她 16 岁时再次联系。

paras.en: Walliams denies having sexual contact with the second woman, and says he's never engaged in the grooming of young women.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯否认与第二名女性发生性接触，并表示他从未为年轻女性提供美容服务。

paras.en: Other women have also levelled claims that Walliams tried to take advantage of them at a vulnerable age.
paras.zh: 其他女性也声称，威廉姆斯试图在她们脆弱的年纪利用她们。

paras.en: Alleged harassment at HarperCollins and Britain's Got Talent
paras.zh: 《哈珀柯林斯》和《英国达人秀》涉嫌骚扰

paras.en: Walliams, who has sold more than 26 million children's books in the U.K. such as Gangsta Granny and Billionaire Boy, was dropped by his publishing company HarperCollins in 2025. The company has since announced it will also no longer publish his back catalogue of books.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯在英国销售了超过 2600 万本儿童读物，例如《黑帮奶奶》和《亿万富翁男孩》，他于 2025 年被他的出版公司哈珀柯林斯公司解雇。此后该公司宣布也将不再出版他的过往图书目录。

paras.en: According to information obtained by the Guardian and ITV News, that action was taken because of concerns raised over the years, including allegations of an inappropriate sexual relationship with a young female employee.
paras.zh: 根据《卫报》和独立电视台新闻获得的信息，采取这一行动是因为多年来引发的担忧，包括与一名年轻女员工发生不正当性关系的指控。

paras.en: David Walliams has sold millions of copies of children's books through the publisher HarperCollins, which has since dropped him. (Ben Pruchnie/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 大卫·威廉姆斯通过哈珀柯林斯出版商售出了数百万册儿童读物，但该出版社后来放弃了他。 （本·普鲁奇尼/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Walliams also made a name for himself as one of the judges for Britain's Got Talent from 2012 to 2022. There he was accused of inviting teenage girls to the show as guests, as well as harassing young women who worked on the show.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯还因担任 2012 年至 2022 年英国达人秀评委之一而名声大噪。他被指控邀请十几岁的女孩作为嘉宾参加节目，并骚扰节目中的年轻女性。

paras.en: In November of 2022, Walliams was recorded saying disparaging and sexual comments toward contestants. He has since left the show.
paras.zh: 2022 年 11 月，威廉姆斯被记录对参赛者发表了贬低和性评论。此后他离开了节目。

paras.en: All the while, Walliams and his alleged proclivity to date younger women was the butt of jokes among comedians in the U.K.
paras.zh: 一直以来，威廉姆斯和他所谓的与年轻女性约会的倾向一直是英国喜剧演员的笑柄。

paras.en: Walliams denies any wrongdoing. In a letter to journalists with the Guardian and ITV news who were working on the story, he wrote: "I am not a sexual predator. I have not broken the law, but I am devastated that some of the women I met 10 to 20 years ago have now expressed hurt or anger towards me."
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯否认有任何不当行为。在写给负责报道此事的《卫报》和英国独立电视台新闻记者的一封信中，他写道：“我不是性掠夺者。我没有违反法律，但我感到震惊的是，我在 10 到 20 年前遇到的一些女性现在对我表达了伤害或愤怒。”

paras.en: "I realize I did not always take people's feelings properly into account. That is something I regret. And whilst a power imbalance is inevitable when one party is famous, abusing that power is something else entirely and it is something that I never did."
paras.zh: “我意识到我没有总是适当考虑人们的感受。这是我感到遗憾的事情。虽然当一个政党出名时权力失衡是不可避免的，但滥用权力完全是另一回事，这是我从未做过的事情。”

paras.en: Walliams had the opportunity to appeal the High Court's decision allowing the Guardian and ITV News to publish their findings, but Walliams and his legal team didn't file an appeal or request for more time to do so.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯有机会对高等法院允许《卫报》和独立电视台新闻发布其调查结果的决定提出上诉，但威廉姆斯和他的法律团队没有提出上诉或要求更多时间这样做。

articles.title: Carney selects new ambassador to China, plans to announce 'in very short order'
articles.author: Sophia Laporte

paras.en: Carney selects new ambassador to China, plans to announce 'in very short order'
paras.zh: 卡尼选出新任驻华大使，计划“在短时间内”宣布

paras.en: Canada without a permanent ambassador in Beijing since April
paras.zh: 加拿大自四月起没有常驻北京大使

paras.en: Canadians will know the name of their new ambassador to China "in very short order," said Prime Minister Mark Carney on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼周二表示，加拿大人将“很快”知道新任驻华大使的名字。

paras.en: The position has been unfilled for six months.
paras.zh: 该职位已空缺六个月。

paras.en: "It's a little longer than we would have liked," Carney said at a news conference in Montreal. "We wanted to get the right person and we have found that right person."
paras.zh: 卡尼在蒙特利尔举行的新闻发布会上表示：“这比我们希望的要长一点。” “我们想要找到合适的人，我们已经找到了合适的人。”

paras.en: He said the standard formal diplomatic process is underway to have China, the host country, approve the proposed candidate.
paras.zh: 他说，标准的正式外交程序正在进行中，以便东道国中国批准拟议的候选人。

paras.en: Jennifer May served as Canada's last ambassador to China, stepping down from her role in April to become Carney's foreign and defence policy adviser in the Privy Council Office.
paras.zh: 詹妮弗·梅（Jennifer May）担任加拿大最后一位驻华大使，于四月卸任，成为卡尼在枢密院办公室的外交和国防政策顾问。

paras.en: She was Canada's first female ambassador to the People's Republic of China, and had been appointed to the role in September 2022.
paras.zh: 她是加拿大第一位驻中华人民共和国女大使，于 2022 年 9 月被任命。

paras.en: "As I leave Beijing, I do so with deep gratitude for the experiences, partnerships and friendships built here, and with anticipation for the challenges ahead," May said in a LinkedIn post earlier this year.
paras.zh: “当我离开北京时，我对在这里建立的经历、伙伴关系和友谊深表感谢，并对未来的挑战充满期待，”梅在今年早些时候的领英帖子中表示。

paras.en: "I am proud of the work we've done to navigate complex realities, advance Canada's interests, support Canadian businesses and deliver new priorities under a new government."
paras.zh: “我为我们在应对复杂现实、促进加拿大利益、支持加拿大企业以及在新政府领导下实现新优先事项所做的工作感到自豪。”

paras.en: The announcement comes ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation's (APEC) leaders' summit in China next week, which Carney is expected to attend from Nov. 18 to 19.
paras.zh: 这一消息是在下周于中国举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人峰会之前宣布的，卡尼预计将于 11 月 18 日至 19 日出席该峰会。

paras.en: There, Carney says he and Chinese President Xi Jinping will discuss several topics including global security and the two countries' economic partnership, which he described as "something that is deepening, but has clear guardrails in terms of the areas in which we're involved."
paras.zh: 卡尼表示，他和中国国家主席习近平将在会上讨论包括全球安全和两国经济伙伴关系在内的多个话题，他称这种伙伴关系“正在深化，但在我们参与的领域有明确的护栏”。

paras.en: "The advantage of these meetings is that you can raise issues directly and frankly and I will be raising the importance with which we attach to the non-interference in our affairs by China and other countries," Carney said.
paras.zh: 卡尼说：“这些会议的优点是你可以直接、坦率地提出问题，我将提高我们对中国和其他国家不干涉我们事务的重视。”

articles.title: Iran denies role in fridge hack, France summons ambassador

paras.en: Iran on Tuesday dismissed French accusations that its Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) was behind a cyberattack on hundreds of supermarkets last month, as Paris summoned Tehran's ambassador to discuss the incident.
paras.zh: 伊朗周二驳回了法国关于其伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）上个月对数百家超市进行网络攻击的指控，巴黎召见德黑兰大使讨论这一事件。

paras.en: "Iran's Foreign Ministry categorically rejects the French government's baseless and one-sided accusations against Iran regarding alleged cyber activities in France," the ministry said, adding that it "strongly condemns this hackneyed policy of leveling accusations against the Islamic Republic."
paras.zh: 伊朗外交部表示，“伊朗外交部断然拒绝法国政府就法国境内涉嫌网络活动对伊朗提出的毫无根据和片面的指控”，并补充说，“强烈谴责这种针对伊斯兰共和国提出指控的陈词滥调政策”。

paras.en: The alleged attack, which began overnight on October 11-12, raised the temperatures in supermarket refrigerators and freezer units, spoiling produce and even causing fires in isolated instances.
paras.zh: 此次所谓的袭击于 10 月 11 日至 12 日夜间开始，导致超市冰箱和冷冻柜的温度升高，导致农产品变质，甚至在个别情况下引发火灾。

paras.en: A series of similar incidents have since followed in Europe and beyond, even including a failed attack on cooling units at French blood banks this month, though it is not yet clear if these subsequent events are connected.
paras.zh: 此后，欧洲及其他地区发生了一系列类似事件，甚至包括本月对法国血库冷却装置的一次失败袭击，尽管目前尚不清楚这些后续事件是否有关联。

paras.en: France summons ambassador, says it rules 'nothing' out in response
paras.zh: 法国召见大使称不排除“不排除”回应

paras.en: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said on Tuesday that his government would "rule nothing out and will take all measures — including those we may not disclose publicly — that we deem proportionate and necessary to deter any further attacks."
paras.zh: 法国外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗周二表示，法国政府将“不排除任何可能性，并将采取一切我们认为适当且必要的措施，包括我们可能不会公开披露的措施，以阻止任何进一步的袭击。”

paras.en: Barrot was speaking amid a G7 foreign ministers' meeting in Paris that included discussions with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on the conflict with Iran.
paras.zh: 巴罗是在巴黎举行的七国集团外长会议上发表上述言论的，会议期间与美国国务卿马可·卢比奥就与伊朗的冲突进行了讨论。

paras.en: Barrot even said that despite a change in tone from the Trump administration since the midterm election defeat in the US, the risk of a renewed escalation with Iran could not be ruled out, "otherwise, we would not have devoted so much time and energy over the past two days to addressing these issues with our American counterpart."
paras.zh: 巴罗特甚至表示，尽管美国中期选举失利后特朗普政府语气有所转变，但不能排除与伊朗关系再度升级的风险，“否则，我们不会在过去两天投入这么多时间和精力与美国同行解决这些问题。”

paras.en: France summoned the Iranian ambassador on Tuesday and said it would be seeking European-level sanctions in response.
paras.zh: 法国周二召见伊朗大使，并表示将寻求欧洲层面的制裁作为回应。

paras.en: The EU said it would seek to provide a "swift and united response" pending discussion with member states.
paras.zh: 欧盟表示，在与成员国讨论之前，它将寻求提供“迅速和统一的反应”。

paras.en: "As the EU, we have consistently called on all states to refrain from malicious behavior in the cyberspace, and we will continue to address such malicious behavior, making use of all the tools that we have, also under the EU cyber diplomacy toolbox, including sanctions," spokesman Anouar El Anouni said.
paras.zh: 发言人阿努阿尔·阿努尼（Anouar El Anouni）表示：“作为欧盟，我们一贯呼吁所有国家不要在网络空间采取恶意行为，我们将继续利用我们拥有的所有工具以及欧盟网络外交工具箱下的所有工具，包括制裁，来解决此类恶意行为。”

paras.en: Barrot said that the goal of any response would be "to deter anyone who might be tempted, in Iran or elsewhere, to do it again."
paras.zh: 巴罗特表示，任何回应的目的都是“阻止任何可能在伊朗或其他地方再次这样做的人”。

paras.en: Iran accuses French of 'projecting' its own failures
paras.zh: 伊朗指责法国“预测”自己的失败

paras.en: Tehran appeared to threaten retaliatory measures of its own if sanctions materialized, saying it would "not hesitate to take necessary and appropriate measures to safeguard its national interests and security in the face of unlawful foreign activities."
paras.zh: 德黑兰似乎威胁称，如果制裁落实，德黑兰将“毫不犹豫地采取必要和适当的措施，在面对非法外国活动时维护其国家利益和安全”。

paras.en: It accused France of "merely projecting its own governance failures" with its allegations.
paras.zh: 它指责法国的指控“只是投射其自身的治理失败”。

paras.en: "A government that cannot even manage the temperature of its own refrigerators now seeks to shift the blame onto foreign actors through these preposterous accusations," it said.
paras.zh: 报告称：“一个连自己冰箱的温度都无法管理的政府现在试图通过这些荒谬的指控将责任归咎于外国行为者。”

paras.en: What did Paris prosecutors say about suspected Iranian involvement?
paras.zh: 巴黎检察官对涉嫌伊朗参与的事件有何评论？

paras.en: Paris prosecutor Laure Beccuau said on Monday that she had opened an investigation into leading members of Shahid Kaveh, a cyber unit that is part of Iran's multi-force specialist military, the IRGC, that answers directly to its religious leadership.
paras.zh: 巴黎检察官劳尔·贝库奥 (Laure Beccuau) 周一表示，她已对沙希德·卡维 (Shahid Kaveh) 的主要成员展开调查。沙希德·卡维 (Shahid Kaveh) 是伊朗多部队专业军队伊斯兰革命卫队 (IRGC) 的一部分，是一个网络单位，直接听命于伊朗宗教领袖。

paras.en: She said her office had requested arrest warrants against two Shahid Kaveh officials and was investigating others.
paras.zh: 她说，她的办公室已请求对两名沙希德·卡维官员发出逮捕令，并正在调查其他人。

paras.en: She described the entity as "an offensive cyber unit affiliated with the Electronic and Cyber Center of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps."
paras.zh: 她将该实体描述为“隶属于伊斯兰革命卫队电子和网络中心的进攻性网络单位”。

paras.en: French cyber intelligence agencies said the unit conducted "large-scale campaigns targeting industrial equipment for the purpose of sabotage." It said it primarily targeted Israel and the US, but also France and other European countries.
paras.zh: 法国网络情报机构表示，该部门“针对工业设备进行了大规模的破坏活动”。它说它主要针对以色列和美国，还有法国和其他欧洲国家。

paras.en: Beccuau said that the attack targeted roughly 700 of France's roughly 10,000 supermarkets. It used web interfaces to "initiate abnormal, indefinite defrost cycles," and also to disable automated alerts from sensors designed to go off when temperatures exceeded certain levels.
paras.zh: 贝库奥表示，这次袭击针对的是法国约 10,000 家超市中的约 700 家。它使用网络界面“启动异常的、无限期的除霜周期”，并禁用传感器的自动警报，这些传感器的设计目的是在温度超过一定水平时发出警报。

paras.en: Sweden's Civil Defense Minister Carl-Oskar Bohlin warned that more cyberattacks could be expected in the coming months, as AI tools make it easier to detect and exploit vulnerabilities.
paras.zh: 瑞典民防部长卡尔-奥斯卡·博林警告称，未来几个月可能会出现更多网络攻击，因为人工智能工具使检测和利用漏洞变得更加容易。

paras.en: He said that it was not yet possible to say if hacks targeted Swedish supermarkets last week were connected, not least because the type of sabotage would have "been easy to copy" after seeing the initial reports in October.
paras.zh: 他表示，目前还无法判断上周针对瑞典超市的黑客攻击是否有关联，尤其是因为在看到 10 月份的初步报告后，这种破坏行为“很容易复制”。

articles.title: Victims of Nazi war in Poland call on Germany for support

paras.en: "We can no longer wait," declared Polish victims' organizations in a dramatic appeal to German civil society, published on November 5 on the website of the Foundation for Polish–German Reconciliation.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日，波兰受害者组织在波兰-德国和解基金会网站上发表了一份向德国民间社会发出的戏剧性呼吁，声明称：“我们不能再等待了。”

paras.en: "Around 50,000 survivors of Nazi persecution during the German occupation still live in Poland today. They include former concentration camp and prison inmates, people deported to Germany for forced labor and those subjected to other forms of Nazi repression," wrote the signatories of the appeal.
paras.zh: “德国占领期间纳粹迫害的大约 5 万名幸存者至今仍生活在波兰。他们包括前集中营和监狱囚犯、被驱逐到德国从事强迫劳动的人以及遭受其他形式纳粹镇压的人，”呼吁书的签署者写道。

paras.en: The open letter pointed out that many of the survivors are over 90 years old, struggling with illness and rising costs, and in need of help in their daily lives. "For many, any further delay in deciding to provide assistance means that help will come too late," said the appeal, which was distributed in German, Polish and English.
paras.zh: 公开信指出，许多幸存者已经90多岁了，与疾病和不断上涨的费用作斗争，日常生活需要帮助。呼吁书以德语、波兰语和英语发布，“对许多人来说，进一步拖延提供援助的决定就意味着帮助来得太晚了”。

paras.en: While Germany has recognized its moral responsibility toward the remaining survivors of Nazi persecution, the signatories pointed out that a corresponding decision on possible reparations by the German federal government has yet to be made.
paras.zh: 尽管德国承认其对纳粹迫害的剩余幸存者负有道义责任，但签署者指出，德国联邦政府尚未就可能的赔偿做出相应的决定。

paras.en: "Today, we appeal primarily to German civil society to provide humanitarian support to survivors of Nazi persecution living in Poland," they wrote, addressing businesses, foundations, associations and private citizens. "Every donation matters."
paras.zh: 他们写道：“今天，我们主要呼吁德国民间社会为生活在波兰的纳粹迫害幸存者提供人道主义支持。” “每笔捐款都很重要。”

paras.en: Reparations offered to date seen as insufficient
paras.zh: 迄今为止提供的赔偿被视为不足

paras.en: The unresolved issue of war reparations has clouded German-Polish relations for decades.
paras.zh: 几十年来，战争赔偿这一悬而未决的问题一直困扰着德波关系。

paras.en: Following the 1989 democratic transition in Central and Eastern Europe and the reunification of Germany, the federal government provided 500 million deutschmarks to Holocaust victims in Poland. More than 1 million people received support through these funds. Former forced laborers also received payments from the EVZ Foundation, which works to preserve the memory of the victims of National Socialist persecution.
paras.zh: 1989年中东欧民主转型和德国统一后，联邦政府向波兰大屠杀受害者提供了5亿德国马克。超过 100 万人通过这些资金获得了支持。前强迫劳工还收到了 EVZ 基金会的付款，该基金会致力于保存国家社会主义迫害受害者的记忆。

paras.en: However, given the scale of German crimes during World War II, the reparations provided to date have been considered as insufficient by large parts of Polish society. German occupation policy in Poland was characterized by systematic crimes against the Polish population. An estimated 6 million Polish citizens were killed during the war, including about 3 million Polish Jews.
paras.zh: 然而，鉴于德国在二战期间犯下的罪行规模，波兰社会大部分人认为迄今为止提供的赔偿是不够的。德国对波兰的占领政策的特点是针对波兰人民的系统性犯罪。据估计，有 600 万波兰公民在战争中丧生，其中包括约 300 万波兰犹太人。

paras.en: As part of the "General Plan East," a large portion of the population was to be displaced, enslaved or murdered. As early as 1939, the "Intelligenzaktion" specifically targeted the Polish elites, including teachers, clergy, civil servants and intellectuals. In addition, approximately 2.5 million Poles were deported to the German Reich for forced labor and made to work there under inhumane conditions.
paras.zh: 作为“东方总体计划”的一部分，很大一部分人口将流离失所、被奴役或被谋杀。早在1939年，“情报行动”就专门针对波兰精英，包括教师、神职人员、公务员和知识分子。此外，大约 250 万波兰人被驱逐到德意志帝国进行强迫劳动，并在不人道的条件下工作。

paras.en: When it came to power in 2015, Poland's right-wing conservative Law and Justice Party (PiS) made the issue of war reparations a central focus of Warsaw's policy toward Berlin. The PiS government estimated Poland's war losses at 6.2 trillion zloty (approx. €1.3 trillion/$1.58 trillion) and officially demanded this sum from Berlin in October 2022.
paras.zh: 2015年波兰右翼保守派法律与正义党(PiS)上台后，将战争赔款问题作为华沙对柏林政策的核心焦点。 PiS 政府估计波兰的战争损失为 6.2 万亿兹罗提（约合 1.3 万亿欧元/1.58 万亿美元），并于 2022 年 10 月正式向柏林要求这笔款项。

paras.en: Tusk rejects €200 million as insufficient
paras.zh: 图斯克拒绝 2 亿欧元，称其不足

paras.en: The center-left government led by Donald Tusk has distanced itself from these demands since Tusk's election victory in December 2023. However, the government has also made no secret of the fact that Poland is expecting a "creative solution" from its German partner, according to Foreign Minister Radek Sikorski.
paras.zh: 自图斯克于 2023 年 12 月赢得选举以来，由唐纳德·图斯克领导的中左翼政府一直与这些要求保持距离。不过，波兰外交部长拉德克·西科尔斯基表示，政府也毫不掩饰波兰期待其德国伙伴提出“创造性解决方案”的事实。

paras.en: Former German Chancellor Olaf Scholz had offered €200 million ($224 million) prior to his visit to Poland in the summer of 2024, an offer rejected by Tusk as insufficient. The talks held since then between Berlin and Warsaw have failed to produce a solution.
paras.zh: 德国前总理奥拉夫·肖尔茨在 2024 年夏天访问波兰之前曾提出 2 亿欧元（2.24 亿美元）的报价，但图斯克拒绝了这一报价。此后柏林和华沙之间举行的会谈未能达成解决方案。

paras.en: In a final declaration following the German-Polish government consultations in December 2025, the German government promised to "analyze possibilities for additional support for Polish victims of Nazi aggression and the German occupation of Poland."
paras.zh: 在 2025 年 12 月德国与波兰政府磋商后的最终声明中，德国政府承诺“分析为纳粹侵略和德国占领波兰的波兰受害者提供额外支持的可能性”。

paras.en: "Currently, there is no decision regarding a humanitarian gesture and the draft budget reflects this status," Josef Hinterseher, deputy spokesperson for Germany's Federal Foreign Office, told reporters on September 23.
paras.zh: 德国联邦外交部副发言人约瑟夫·辛特塞赫 (Josef Hinterseher) 9 月 23 日对记者表示：“目前，还没有关于人道主义姿态的决定，预算草案反映了这一状况。”

paras.en: Germany's Greens still hope for 'humanitarian gesture'
paras.zh: 德国绿党仍希望采取“人道主义姿态”

paras.en: Germany's opposition Greens party has not given up hope of a turnaround in its efforts to secure a "humanitarian gesture."
paras.zh: 德国反对党绿党并未放弃努力扭转“人道主义姿态”的希望。

paras.en: "Our parliamentary group submitted a request to the budget committee to secure funding for this 'humanitarian gesture.' Unfortunately, the request was rejected," Franziska Brantner, co-chair of the Greens, told DW on Thursday in Warsaw.
paras.zh: “我们的议会小组向预算委员会提交了一项请求，要求为这一‘人道主义举措’提供资金。不幸的是，这一请求被拒绝了，”绿党联合主席弗兰齐斯卡·布兰特纳周四在华沙告诉德国之声。

paras.en: "Hope dies last, so we will do everything in our power to ensure that the coalition makes this change after all," she emphasized. Brantner sees the budget committee's "final review session," which will take place this week, as a last chance.
paras.zh: 她强调说：“希望最后会破灭，因此我们将尽一切努力确保联盟最终能够做出这一改变。”布兰特纳认为，预算委员会将于本周举行的“最终审查会议”是最后一次机会。

paras.en: The issue of reparations still plays an important role in Polish society, even more than 80 years after the end of the war. There is hardly a family that did not suffer during the war. In the latest German-Polish Barometer — a representative survey that has been conducted for 25 years — 53% of respondents stated that the suffering of the Polish people is not sufficiently acknowledged in Germany. Only 18% believed that the Germans have done enough.
paras.zh: 即使在战争结束80多年后，赔偿问题仍然在波兰社会中发挥着重要作用。几乎没有一个家庭没有在战争中遭受苦难。在最新的德国-波兰晴雨表（一项已经进行了 25 年的代表性调查）中，53% 的受访者表示，德国没有充分认识到波兰人民的苦难。只有 18% 的人认为德国人做得足够了。

paras.en: German private donors support the victims' fund
paras.zh: 德国私人捐助者支持受害者基金

paras.en: Jakub Deka, chairman of the Foundation for Polish–German Reconciliation, believes the appeal by the victims' associations could now mobilize Germany's civil society. Following an initial appeal in May directed at the German federal government, several hundred Germans responded with donations ranging from €50 to several hundred euros.
paras.zh: 波德和解基金会主席雅库布·德卡认为，受害者协会的呼吁现在可以动员德国民间社会。继 5 月份向德国联邦政府发出初步呼吁后，数百名德国人响应捐款，捐款金额从 50 欧元到数百欧元不等。

paras.en: To date, a total of more than €35,000 ($39,000) has been deposited into the foundation's account. Several people in need have already received one-time assistance from this fund. "It's a drop in the bucket, but every little bit helps," Deka told DW.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，总计超过 35,000 欧元（39,000 美元）已存入基金会账户。已有多名有需要的人获得了该基金的一次性援助。德卡告诉德国之声：“这只是杯水车薪，但每一点点滴都会有帮助。”

paras.en: The foundation's chairman quotes Jerzy Tarasiewicz — who led the victims' association in the Polish city of Gdansk for many years — as a cautionary reminder. In January, Tarasiewicz was quoted in an interview with the daily newspaper Gazeta Wyborcza as saying: "They [the Germans] are waiting for us to die."
paras.zh: 该基金会主席引用了多年来领导波兰格但斯克市受害者协会的耶日·塔拉谢维奇的话作为警告。一月份，塔拉谢维奇在接受《Gazeta Wyborcza》日报采访时说道：“他们（德国人）正在等我们死。”

paras.en: Tarasiewicz, who was born in 1942 on a German farm where his parents were performing forced labor, died in late September at the age of 84 without being able to witness this "humanitarian gesture."
paras.zh: 塔拉谢维奇 1942 年出生在德国的一个农场，他的父母在那里从事强迫劳动，他于 9 月下旬去世，享年 84 岁，未能亲眼目睹这一“人道主义姿态”。

paras.en: "It is a painful reminder that the victims cannot wait any longer," said Deka.
paras.zh: 德卡说：“这是一个痛苦的提醒，受害者不能再等了。”

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: UK Privy Council overrules Trinidad and Tobago gay sex law

paras.en: A man from Trinidad and Tobago has won a legal appeal lasting almost a decade in the last court of appeal available to him — the judicial committee of the Privy Council in former colonial power Britain.
paras.zh: 一名来自特立尼达和多巴哥的男子在他可以使用的最后一个上诉法院——前殖民国家英国枢密院司法委员会——赢得了一场持续近十年的法律上诉。

paras.en: Jason Jones, a gay man born in Trinidad and Tobago, had challenged the Caribbean nation's Sexual Offences Act outlawing consensusal sex between adult males, saying that it breached his fundamental rights under the country's constitution.
paras.zh: 出生于特立尼达和多巴哥的同性恋者贾森·琼斯（Jason Jones）对这个加勒比国家的《性犯罪法》提出质疑，该法禁止成年男性之间的共识性行为，称这侵犯了他根据该国宪法享有的基本权利。

paras.en: He initially won his case at Trinidad and Tobago's High Court, but the government and religious organizations managed to partially overturn the ruling once more, prompting Jones to the take the case to the island nation's highest appellate authority — the Privy Council in the UK.
paras.zh: 他最初在特立尼达和多巴哥高等法院胜诉，但政府和宗教组织再次部分推翻了裁决，促使琼斯将此案提交给该岛国最高上诉机构——英国枢密院。

paras.en: "To discriminate against somebody simply because of who they choose to love is simply ridiculous," Jones told the Associated Press after Tuesday's judgment was rendered.
paras.zh: “仅仅因为某人选择爱谁而歧视他们，这简直是荒谬的，”周二判决作出后，琼斯告诉美联社。

paras.en: The Privy Council in London is the final court of appeal for some Commonwealth countries including Trinidad and Tobago, although that issue was already contentious in some circles prior to Tuesday's ruling.
paras.zh: 伦敦枢密院是包括特立尼达和多巴哥在内的一些英联邦国家的终审上诉法院，尽管在周二的裁决之前，这个问题在某些圈子里已经存在争议。

paras.en: A panel of five judges unanimously allowed Jones' appeal, dismissing a counter-appeal from the Caribbean country's Attorney General.
paras.zh: 由五名法官组成的陪审团一致同意琼斯的上诉，驳回加勒比国家总检察长的反上诉。

paras.en: It found that two sections of the country's Sexual Offenses Act 1986, criminalizing "buggery" and "serious indecency" respectively among same-sex couples, violated Jones' fundamental rights to private and family life set out in the 1976 constitution.
paras.zh: 调查发现，该国《1986 年性犯罪法》中的两个部分分别将同性伴侣之间的“鸡奸”和“严重猥亵”定为犯罪，侵犯了琼斯在 1976 年宪法中规定的私人和家庭生活的基本权利。

paras.en: The court wrote in its ruling that "the rights and interests of Mr Jones which are at stake involve a particularly important facet of his existence and identity since the ability to form an intimate and loving relationship with another person lies at the core of the right to private and family life."
paras.zh: 法院在裁决中写道，“琼斯先生的权利和利益受到威胁，涉及他的存在和身份的一个特别重要的方面，因为与他人形成亲密和爱的关系的能力是私人和家庭生活权利的核心。”

paras.en: The anti-gay laws that call for up to five years in prison have not been enforced in recent history, but critics say they still send an intimidating message.
paras.zh: 要求最高五年监禁的反同性恋法律在近代历史上并未得到执行，但批评者表示，这些法律仍然发出了恐吓信息。

paras.en: Judge Philip Sales said as he announced the ruling that "the current understanding of the fundamental individual right to respect for private and family life is that it protects such a core part of human identity as one's sexual orientation."
paras.zh: 法官菲利普·赛尔斯在宣布裁决时表示，“目前对尊重私人和家庭生活的个人基本权利的理解是，它保护人类身份的核心部分，例如性取向。”

paras.en: Sales added that "laws which seek to criminalize such activities cannot be justified."
paras.zh: 塞尔斯补充说，“试图将此类活动定为犯罪的法律是没有道理的。”

paras.en: Trinidadian authorities argued that because the 1986 laws were passed with a super-majority and constituted criminal penalties that dated back to colonial times, prior to the constitution, they could be considered "existing law" and override the individual constitutional rights in certain circumstances.
paras.zh: 特立尼达当局辩称，由于 1986 年法律以绝对多数通过，并且构成了可追溯到殖民时代、在宪法之前的刑事处罚，因此它们可以被视为“现有法律”，并在某些情况下凌驾于个人宪法权利之上。

paras.en: But the Privy Council judges found that the so-called "proviso" for this special status — "unless the Act is shown not to be reasonably justifiable in a society that has proper respect for the rights and freedoms of the individual" — had not been met.
paras.zh: 但枢密院法官发现，这种特殊地位的所谓“附带条件”——“除非该法案在一个适当尊重个人权利和自由的社会中被证明不合理”——并未得到满足。

paras.en: One of Jones' lawyers, Anand Ramlogan, is a former attorney general of Trinidad and Tobago and argued against this position earlier in the case.
paras.zh: 琼斯的律师之一阿南德·拉姆洛根 (Anand Ramlogan) 是特立尼达和多巴哥的前总检察长，他在本案早些时候反对这一立场。

paras.en: "Constitutional rights exist precisely because majorities are not always right," Ramlogan said. "They ensure that the dignity and equality of every citizen are not left to the changing tides of public opinion."
paras.zh: “宪法权利的存在正是因为多数并不总是正确的，”拉姆洛根说。 “他们确保每个公民的尊严和平等不会受到不断变化的舆论浪潮的影响。”

paras.en: Jason Jones is a 61-year-old born in Trinidad and Tobago.
paras.zh: Jason Jones 61 岁，出生于特立尼达和多巴哥。

paras.en: Openly gay since the age of 16, he said he fled the country in 1996 because of homophobic violence and discrimination.
paras.zh: 他从 16 岁起就公开自己是同性恋，他说自己因恐同暴力和歧视而于 1996 年逃离该国。

paras.en: Speaking to the Associated Press on Tuesday after what he termed a "stunning victory," he said he would describe himself as a "very angry gay man," whose anger had helped him persist in his legal appeal for so many years.
paras.zh: 周二，在他所谓的“令人震惊的胜利”之后，他对美联社发表讲话，称自己是一个“非常愤怒的同性恋者”，正是他的愤怒帮助他多年来坚持了法律上诉。

paras.en: "Society has treated me worse than a criminal," he said. "There is a real sense of vindication with this judgment. Finally, the courts are seeing that they need to step up because our politicians are so toothless."
paras.zh: “社会对待我比对待罪犯还要糟糕，”他说。 “这一判决具有真正的辩护意义。最后，法院认为他们需要站出来，因为我们的政客是如此无能。”

paras.en: He said he became inspired to speak out after losing friends to HIV/AIDS and after meeting American singer-songwriter Nina Simone when she toured the island nation for three weeks in 1984, when he was 19.
paras.zh: 他说，在失去了感染艾滋病毒的朋友之后，以及在 1984 年美国歌手兼作曲家尼娜·西蒙 (Nina Simone) 在这个岛国进行三周巡演时认识了她之后，他开始发声，当时他才 19 岁。

paras.en: "Nina was the one who said, 'Jason, get off this rock and go see the world,'" he said, calling it a defining and life-changing experience.
paras.zh: “尼娜说，‘杰森，离开这块岩石，去看看这个世界，’”他说，称这是一次决定性的、改变生活的经历。

paras.en: Trinidad and Tobago may not enforce its 'buggery' law, but it carries a custodial sentence
paras.zh: 特立尼达和多巴哥可能不会执行其“鸡奸”法，但会判处监禁

paras.en: Trinidad and Tobago's government, the country's Council of Evangelical Churches and its largest Hindu organization, Sanatan Dharm Maha Sabha, contested the case, which has wound its way through several courts since the appeal was launched in 2017.
paras.zh: 特立尼达和多巴哥政府、该国福音派教会理事会及其最大的印度教组织 Sanatan Dharm Maha Sabha 对此案提出异议，自 2017 年发起上诉以来，该案已在多个法院审理。

paras.en: In 2018, Trinidad's High Court found the laws unconstitutional. But in 2025, a local appeals court partially reversed the ruling. Trinidad's Court of Appeals subsequently allowed Jones to seek a ruling from the final appeals court in England.
paras.zh: 2018年，特立尼达高等法院裁定这些法律违宪。但到了 2025 年，当地上诉法院部分推翻了裁决。特立尼达上诉法院随后允许琼斯向英格兰终审法院寻求裁决。

paras.en: The case was being closely watched by activists across the Caribbean, with similar laws in place in several other countries in the region.
paras.zh: 此案受到加勒比地区活动人士的密切关注，该地区其他几个国家也制定了类似的法律。

paras.en: The Bahamas decriminalized homosexuality in 1991.
paras.zh: 巴哈马于 1991 年将同性恋合法化。

paras.en: The UK repealed laws in overseas territories Anguilla, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Montserrat and the Turks and Caicos Islands in 2001.
paras.zh: 英国于2001年废除了海外领土安圭拉、英属维尔京群岛、开曼群岛、蒙特塞拉特以及特克斯和凯科斯群岛的法律。

paras.en: Judges in Barbados, Dominica, St. Lucia and Antigua and Barbuda have also recently struck down similar laws.
paras.zh: 巴巴多斯、多米尼克、圣卢西亚、安提瓜和巴布达的法官最近也废除了类似的法律。

paras.en: But in former British colonies Grenada, Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago and St. Vincent and the Grenadines it remains a crime.
paras.zh: 但在前英国殖民地格林纳达、牙买加、特立尼达和多巴哥以及圣文森特和格林纳丁斯，这仍然是一种犯罪行为。

paras.en: The UK only decriminalized gay sex in 1967, more than four centuries after the so-called "buggery" laws were first introduced under King Henry VII, and more than a century after the last executions for the crime. People still faced prosecution or the threat of it for consensual adult gay sex until after World War II, with surely the most famous later-years case being that of computing and codebreaking pioneer and war hero Alan Turing.
paras.zh: 英国直到 1967 年才将同性恋合法化，距亨利七世国王首次引入所谓的“鸡奸”法已有四个多世纪，距最后一次因该罪行被处决也已过去一个多世纪。直到第二次世界大战结束后，人们仍然因自愿的成人同性恋性行为而面临起诉或威胁，其中最著名的案件无疑是计算和密码破译先驱和战争英雄艾伦·图灵的案件。

articles.title: Trump administration again boycotts UN human rights review

paras.en: The United States has again boycotted a United Nations examination of its human rights record, drawing criticism from rights groups who say violations under President Donald Trump are surging to levels not seen in decades.
paras.zh: 美国再次抵制联合国对其人权记录的审查，招致人权组织的批评，他们称唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的侵犯人权行为已飙升至数十年来未见的水平。

paras.en: US representatives on Tuesday failed to show up at the UN in Geneva for the review, which all 193 UN member states undergo every four to five years.
paras.zh: 周二，美国代表未能出席联合国日内瓦办事处的审查，所有 193 个联合国成员国每四到五年都会进行一次审查。

paras.en: “The delegation of the United States is not present in the room,” UN Human Rights Council President Sidharto Reza Suryodipuro, of Indonesia, announced as the session was set to begin.
paras.zh: “美国代表团不在会议室，”联合国人权理事会主席、印度尼西亚人西达托·礼萨·苏廖迪普罗在会议即将开始时宣布。

paras.en: The US refusal to participate prompted the UN body to delay examining the US human rights record until January. This is the second year in a row that Washington has skipped its own review.
paras.zh: 美国拒绝参与，促使联合国机构将美国人权记录的审查推迟到一月份。这是华盛顿连续第二年跳过自己的审查。

paras.en: The US withdrew from the council in February 2025 shortly after Trump began his second presidential term, claiming it was biased against Israel.
paras.zh: 特朗普开始第二个总统任期后不久，美国于 2025 年 2 月退出该委员会，声称该委员会对以色列存在偏见。

paras.en: The Trump administration has been a fierce critic of the UN, withdrawing Washington from key agencies, slashing its funding and bypassing the body in launching the war on Iran.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府一直强烈批评联合国，将华盛顿从关键机构中撤出，削减其资金，并绕过联合国对伊朗发动战争。

paras.en: A US State Department spokesperson said participation would imply endorsement of the council’s work.
paras.zh: 美国国务院发言人表示，参与将意味着对该委员会工作的认可。

paras.en: “[We] give no credibility to the agency,” the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: “[我们]对该机构没有任何可信度，”发言人说。

paras.en: “This irredeemable body makes a mockery of human rights through consistent failures to uphold its own ‘values’ as it pushes anti-American rhetoric,” the official added, without responding to allegations about the US record.
paras.zh: 这位官员补充道：“这个不可救药的机构在宣扬反美言论时始终未能维护自己的‘价值观’，这是对人权的嘲弄。”但他没有回应有关美国记录的指控。

paras.en: The 47-member council has not directly criticised Washington’s rights record. However, experts have expressed alarm over issues such as migrant deportations, which Washington maintains are carried out in accordance with US immigration law.
paras.zh: 这个由 47 名成员组成的委员会并未直接批评华盛顿的人权记录。然而，专家们对移民驱逐出境等问题表示担忧，华盛顿坚称这些问题是根据美国移民法进行的。

paras.en: UN documents show countries had planned to raise issues such as abortion access and the death penalty.
paras.zh: 联合国文件显示，各国计划提出堕胎和死刑等问题。

paras.en: US and international non-governmental organisations also sent nearly 200 UN submissions covering topics from migration to racial discrimination.
paras.zh: 美国和国际非政府组织还向联合国提交了近 200 份意见书，涵盖从移民到种族歧视等主题。

paras.en: “Enough is enough,” Jamil Dakwar, of the American Civil Liberties Union, told reporters in Geneva.
paras.zh: 美国公民自由联盟的贾米尔·达克瓦尔在日内瓦对记者说：“我们受够了。”

paras.en: “We’ve seen attacks on fundamental human rights and civil liberties unprecedented in generations,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们看到了几代人以来前所未有的对基本人权和公民自由的攻击，”他补充道。

paras.en: Fourteen countries are due to take part in the review process in Geneva this month. During Trump’s first term in office, the US submitted its UN Universal Periodic Review (UPR) report.
paras.zh: 十四个国家将于本月在日内瓦参加审查程序。特朗普第一任期内，美国提交了联合国普遍定期审议（UPR）报告。

paras.en: Eric Tistounet, a visiting professor at the Geneva Graduate Institute who was the council’s first secretary, said the US walkout could affect the credibility of the council’s review system.
paras.zh: 日内瓦研究生院客座教授、该委员会第一秘书埃里克·蒂斯托内特表示，美国的罢工可能会影响该委员会审查制度的可信度。

paras.en: “If the predominant global power, which has always claimed to adhere to the human rights norms, doesn’t show up and doesn’t even justify why, then you are in big trouble,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果一直声称遵守人权规范的全球主导力量不露面，甚至不解释原因，那么你就有大麻烦了。”

articles.title: UK children’s author David Walliams accused of grooming minors

paras.en: British comedian and children’s author David Walliams, 55, has been accused of grooming teenage fans and sexually assaulting a 15-year-old girl at his house, according to British media outlets.
paras.zh: 据英国媒体报道，55 岁的英国喜剧演员兼儿童作家大卫·威廉姆斯 (David Walliams) 被指控诱骗青少年粉丝，并在家中性侵一名 15 岁女孩。

paras.en: The Guardian newspaper and ITV News broadcaster published a joint investigation on Tuesday into allegations by multiple women who gave firsthand accounts of Walliams’s alleged misconduct.
paras.zh: 《卫报》和英国独立电视台新闻广播公司周二对多名女性提出的指控进行了联合调查，这些女性提供了威廉姆斯涉嫌不当行为的第一手资料。

paras.en: Walliams denied targeting teenagers and using his fame to manipulate them to have sex, his lawyers told the media.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯的律师告诉媒体，他否认以青少年为目标，并利用自己的名气操纵他们发生性行为。

paras.en: Walliams said he “behaved thoughtlessly” in a letter addressing journalists, which was published by The Guardian.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯在《卫报》发表的一封致记者的信中表示，他的行为“轻率”。

paras.en: “I am not a sexual predator. I have not broken the law, but I am devastated that some of the women I met 10 to 20 years ago have now expressed hurt or anger towards me,” he wrote.
paras.zh: “我不是性掠夺者。我没有违反法律，但我感到震惊的是，我 10 到 20 年前遇到的一些女性现在对我表达了伤害或愤怒，”他写道。

paras.en: Walliams is best known for starring in the BBC’s popular “Little Britain” sketch show in the early 2000s.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯因在 2000 年代初主演 BBC 热门小品节目《小不列颠》而闻名。

paras.en: He authored more than 40 books, including “Mr. Stink”, “Gangsta Granny” and “The Boy in the Dress”, with his work translated into more than 50 languages and reportedly selling 50 million copies.
paras.zh: 他创作了 40 多本书，包括《臭先生》、《黑帮老太》和《穿裙子的男孩》，他的作品被翻译成 50 多种语言，据报道销量达 5000 万册。

paras.en: He was also a judge on ITV’s “Britain’s Got Talent” for years but stepped down in 2022 after apologising for making “disrespectful comments” about auditioning contestants.
paras.zh: 他还曾担任独立电视台《英国达人秀》评委多年，但因对试镜选手做出“不尊重的评论”而道歉后于 2022 年辞职。

paras.en: Following ITV News and The Guardian’s investigation, the BBC said it was removing some programmes and would conduct a review of “all material featuring and written by David Walliams on our platforms”.
paras.zh: 在独立电视台新闻和卫报进行调查后，英国广播公司表示正在删除一些节目，并将对“我们平台上由大卫·威廉姆斯主演和撰写的所有材料”进行审查。

paras.en: Last year, his publisher, HarperCollins, dropped him after he faced accusations of harassing young female colleagues, which he denied.
paras.zh: 去年，他的出版商哈珀柯林斯出版社在他面临骚扰年轻女同事的指控后解雇了他，但他否认了这一指控。

paras.en: He sought a court injunction to prevent ITV News and The Guardian from identifying him in their reporting but was blocked by a UK High Court judge last week.
paras.zh: 他寻求法院禁令，以阻止英国独立电视台新闻和卫报在报道中识别他的身份，但上周被英国高等法院法官阻止。

paras.en: Walliams’s lawyer, Sara Mansoori, told the court he had made an attempt on his life when he received letters from the publications seeking his response to the allegations. She said he later made another attempt, and he was admitted to hospital for psychiatric care last month.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯的律师萨拉·曼苏里 (Sara Mansoori) 告诉法庭，当他收到媒体要求他对指控做出回应的信件时，他曾试图杀害自己。她说他后来再次尝试，上个月被送进医院接受精神科治疗。

paras.en: A summary of the court judgement stated that some of the alleged conduct could amount to criminal offences if proven.
paras.zh: 法院判决摘要指出，一些被指控的行为如果得到证实，可能构成刑事犯罪。

paras.en: Nearly all the women alleging sexual misconduct by Walliams were identified only by first names.
paras.zh: 几乎所有指控威廉姆斯性行为不端的女性都只透露了名字。

paras.en: A woman named as “Jade” said Walliams, then aged 36, contacted her through a social media page showing her age as 15 and invited her to his house in 2007. She accused him of “sexual assault” and “grooming”.
paras.zh: 一位名叫“杰德”的女士说，当时 36 岁的威廉姆斯通过一个显示她 15 岁的社交媒体页面联系了她，并于 2007 年邀请她去他家。她指控他“性侵犯”和“诱骗”。

paras.en: Walliams’s lawyers denied sexual contact with Jade.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯的律师否认与杰德发生性接触。

paras.en: A woman named as “Alex” told The Guardian that he first met her when she was a 15-year-old aspiring comedy writer and he was 32. She alleged that they engaged in sexual conduct for the first time at his home when she was 17 and he was 34.
paras.zh: 一位名叫“亚历克斯”的女士告诉《卫报》，他第一次见到她时，她是一名有抱负的喜剧作家，而他 32 岁。她声称，他们第一次在他家里发生性行为，当时她 17 岁，他 34 岁。

paras.en: “I think I was groomed, 100 percent. We met when I was 15, and he was promising to help me,” she said.
paras.zh: “我认为我受到了 100% 的培养。我们在我 15 岁的时候认识的，他答应帮助我，”她说。

paras.en: It is illegal in the UK for someone older than 18 to intentionally communicate with a child younger than 16 for a sexual purpose. Walliams’s lawyers told The Guardian he believed Alex was 18.
paras.zh: 在英国，18 岁以上的人出于性目的故意与 16 岁以下的儿童进行交流是违法的。威廉姆斯的律师告诉《卫报》，他认为亚历克斯只有 18 岁。

articles.title: US Senate advances major bill boosting energy infrastructure

paras.en: The United States Senate has voted to move forward on a bipartisan bill that would speed up the process to build new data centres and energy infrastructure in the country.
paras.zh: 美国参议院投票决定推进一项两党法案，该法案将加快在该国建设新数据中心和能源基础设施的进程。

paras.en: Nearly all of the chamber’s Republicans, as well as more than a dozen Democrats, voted 73-25 on Monday to take up the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act, which supporters, including US President Donald Trump, have said is necessary to meet the nation’s growing demand for electricity.
paras.zh: 周一，几乎所有众议院共和党议员以及十多名民主党议员以 73 票对 25 票通过了两党美国负担能力和就业法案，包括美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在内的支持者表示，该法案对于满足国家日益增长的电力需求是必要的。

paras.en: “This Bill is a BIG WIN for U.S. ENERGY INDEPENDENCE and DOMINANCE”, Trump posted on social media Monday as he encouraged lawmakers to support it.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一在社交媒体上发帖称，“这项法案是美国能源独立和主导地位的重大胜利”，并鼓励立法者支持该法案。

paras.en: The legislation would overhaul the permitting process for major energy projects – both clean energy and fossil fuel-run – across the US, reduce deadlines for environmental reviews and impose restrictions on when projects can be challenged in the country’s courts. It would also force owners of energy-hungry data centres to pay for the infrastructure that is needed to power them.
paras.zh: 该立法将彻底改革美国各地主要能源项目（包括清洁能源和化石燃料项目）的许可程序，缩短环境审查的最后期限，并对项目在美国法院受到质疑的时间施加限制。它还将迫使高耗能数据中心的所有者支付为其供电所需的基础设施费用。

paras.en: Growing anger in the US over those facilities’ use in powering artificial intelligence (AI), which has resulted in rising electricity bills for customers across the country, helped fuel last week’s takeover of the US Congress by Democrats.
paras.zh: 美国国内对这些设施用于为人工智能（AI）提供动力的愤怒日益高涨，导致全国各地客户的电费上涨，助长了民主党上周接管美国国会。

paras.en: “The people sent us a very clear message on Tuesday that they expect us to lower the costs in their daily lives,” Democratic Senator Martin Heinrich, the ranking member on the Senate Energy and Natural Resources Committee, said on Monday. “We don’t have to wait for the new Congress to start lowering costs. We can do that today.”
paras.zh: “人们周二向我们发出了非常明确的信息，他们希望我们降低他们日常生活的成本，”参议院能源和自然资源委员会高级成员、民主党参议员马丁·海因里希周一表示。 “我们不必等待新国会开始降低成本。我们今天就可以做到这一点。”

paras.en: Authors of the bill claim it will provide $19bn in savings on residential electricity bills through 2040. The number of solar and wind projects connecting to the US electric grid would be doubled, with data centres paying $55bn over the next 10 years to cover their power usage.
paras.zh: 该法案的作者声称，到 2040 年，它将为住宅电费节省 190 亿美元。连接到美国电网的太阳能和风能项目的数量将增加一倍，数据中心将在未来 10 年内支付 550 亿美元来支付其用电费用。

paras.en: But despite the bill’s claims of increasing clean energy projects, environmental organisations are opposed to the legislation. They argue it would also lock in development of fossil fuels, weaken environmental laws and make it harder for US residents to challenge projects in their communities.
paras.zh: 但尽管该法案声称要增加清洁能源项目，但环保组织仍反对该立法。他们认为，这还将锁定化石燃料的开发，削弱环境法，并使美国居民更难挑战其社区的项目。

paras.en: Earlier this year, a coalition of national groups – including the Climate Justice Alliance, Indigenous Environmental Network and Western Environmental Law Center – issued a joint statement opposing the bill.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，包括气候正义联盟、原住民环境网络和西方环境法中心在内的国家团体联盟发表了一份联合声明，反对该法案。

paras.en: “We cannot allow the lies to continue, as the facts are clear: If this backroom permitting reform deal is pushed through, it will enable a no-guardrails buildout of dangerous projects that will harm our health and environment, drive up energy costs, and violate our rights,” they said in September.
paras.zh: 他们在 9 月份表示：“我们不能允许谎言继续下去，因为事实很清楚：如果这项幕后允许改革协议获得通过，它将导致危险项目的无护栏建设，这些项目将损害我们的健康和环境，推高能源成本，并侵犯我们的权利。”

paras.en: “This will be especially harmful for communities of color and lower income neighborhoods already overburdened by pollution and climate impacts.”
paras.zh: “这对于已经因污染和气候影响而不堪重负的有色人种社区和低收入社区尤其有害。”

paras.en: While the legislation received rare overwhelming support from both major political parties, the Democrats’ midterm win could complicate its final passage.
paras.zh: 尽管该法案罕见地获得了两大政党的压倒性支持，但民主党的中期胜利可能会使该法案的最终通过变得复杂化。

paras.en: Some in the party argue that the legislation should be shelved until new Democratic majorities in the US House and Senate are sworn in early next year.
paras.zh: 党内一些人认为，这项立法应该被搁置，直到明年初民主党在美国众议院和参议院的新多数席位宣誓就职。

paras.en: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, who is on track to become the body’s new speaker in January, criticised the bill last week, warning it “falls short” in several areas.
paras.zh: 众议院少数党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯（Hakeem Jeffries）有望在一月份成为众议院新任议长，他上周批评了该法案，警告说该法案在多个领域“存在缺陷”。

paras.en: “We must once again support the clean energy economy and combat the climate crisis with the fierce urgency of now,” a Jeffries spokesperson said in a statement released to the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯发言人在向美联社发布的一份声明中表示：“我们必须再次支持清洁能源经济，并以当前的紧迫性应对气候危机。”

paras.en: Jeffries’s office added: “Leader Jeffries will not rubber-stamp legislation that emerges from the Senate without more constructive involvement with our Caucus as we fight to make life more affordable for the American people.”
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯的办公室补充道：“在我们努力让美国人民的生活变得更加负担得起的过程中，如果没有更多建设性地参与我们的核心小组，杰弗里斯领导人不会对参议院提出的立法盖上橡皮图章。”

articles.title: Indonesia's VP offers resignation as questions mount over his eligibility
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Indonesia's VP offers resignation as questions mount over his eligibility
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚副总统因资格质疑而提出辞职

paras.en: JAKARTA, Indonesia — Indonesia's vice president offered to resign during a meeting with President Prabowo Subianto on Tuesday, according to officials, adding to the turmoil at the highest levels of the country's leadership.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚雅加达——据官员称，印度尼西亚副总统周二在与总统普拉博沃·苏比安托会面时提出辞职，这加剧了该国最高领导层的混乱。

paras.en: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka, the 39-year-old son of former President Joko Widodo, held over two hours of talks with Prabowo, according to State Secretariat Minister Prasetyo Hadi.
paras.zh: 据国务秘书部长普拉塞蒂奥·哈迪称，前总统佐科·维多多 39 岁的儿子副总统吉布兰·拉卡布明·拉卡与普拉博沃进行了两个多小时的会谈。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear whether Prabowo accepted the resignation, Hadi told reporters at a news conference at the presidential palace. The president advised Raka to "continue pursuing legal avenues to defend the validity of his academic documents," Hadi said.
paras.zh: 哈迪在总统府举行的新闻发布会上对记者表示，目前尚不清楚普拉博沃是否接受辞职。哈迪说，总统建议拉卡“继续寻求法律途径来捍卫其学术文件的有效性”。

paras.en: As he left his office later in the day, Raka made a brief statement to reporters without addressing the resignation offer.
paras.zh: 当天晚些时候，拉卡离开办公室时向记者发表了简短声明，但没有提及辞职提议。

paras.en: "I respect all criticism and feedback from the public regarding the developments that are taking place," Raka said. "I do not want the current situation to become a prolonged political controversy."
paras.zh: 拉卡说：“我尊重公众对正在发生的事态发展的所有批评和反馈。” “我不希望目前的局势成为一场旷日持久的政治争议。”

paras.en: The resignation offer comes amid growing pressure on Raka over a court dispute involving his academic credentials. It was apparently not related to an ongoing probe into allegations that top police officials, including the president's chief of staff Gen. Listyo Sigit Prabowo, had been involved in a wiretap targeting the president. Three other police generals have also been implicated in the case.
paras.zh: 在拉卡提出辞职之际，拉卡因涉及其学历的法庭纠纷而面临越来越大的压力。这显然与正在进行的调查无关，指控包括总统办公厅主任利斯特乔·西吉特·普拉博沃 (Listyo Sigit Prabowo) 将军在内的高级警察官员参与了针对总统的窃听活动。另外三名警察将军也与此案有关。

paras.en: Listyo previously served as national police chief under Widodo, who has not been implicated in the wiretapping investigation.
paras.zh: 利斯特奥此前曾担任维多多领导下的国家警察局长，但他并未卷入窃听调查。

paras.en: The developments come amid a widening political rift between Prabowo and Widodo. The popular former president backed Prabowo's presidential bid after he chose Raka as a running mate.
paras.zh: 这些事态发展正值普拉博沃和维多多之间的政治分歧不断扩大之际。这位受欢迎的前总统在选择拉卡作为竞选伙伴后支持普拉博沃的总统竞选。

paras.en: The controversy over Raka's academic qualifications escalated last month after the Supreme Court ruled that the documents he submitted regarding his overseas education did not meet election requirements.
paras.zh: 上个月，最高法院裁定拉卡提交的有关海外教育的文件不符合选举要求后，有关拉卡学历的争议升级。

paras.en: The ruling intensified political pressure on Raka and fueled calls from some lawmakers for his impeachment.
paras.zh: 这一裁决加剧了拉卡面临的政治压力，并引发了一些议员要求弹劾他的呼声。

paras.en: Widodo faces unrelated allegations that he used a fake university diploma, which he denies.
paras.zh: 维多多面临着不相关的指控，称他使用了假大学文凭，但他否认了这一点。

articles.title: 'Like gods reigning over humans': Many defectors see daughter of North Korea's Kim as heir apparent
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: 'Like gods reigning over humans': Many defectors see daughter of North Korea's Kim as heir apparent
paras.zh: “就像神统治人类一样”：许多脱北者将朝鲜金正恩的女儿视为法定继承人

paras.en: SEOUL, South Korea — Until she fled North Korea three years ago, Kim Yumi felt deeply frustrated whenever state TV showed leader Kim Jong Un with his young daughter. The message, she felt, was clear and worrying: North Korea was laying the groundwork for an eventual hereditary transfer of power, this time to Kim's daughter.
paras.zh: 韩国首尔——三年前逃离朝鲜之前，每次国家电视台播放领导人金正恩和他年幼的女儿的画面时，金由美都感到深深的沮丧。她认为，这个信息既明确又令人担忧：朝鲜正在为最终的世袭权力移交奠定基础，这次权力移交给金正恩的女儿。

paras.en: Publicly questioning the Kim dynasty's hold on power would mean severe persecution. Already angered by draconian pandemic regulations that ruined her family's fishing business, she defected to South Korea by boat with her family.
paras.zh: 公开质疑金氏王朝的权力将意味着严厉的迫害。她已经对严厉的流行病法规毁掉了她家族的渔业生意感到愤怒，于是与家人一起乘船叛逃到韩国。

paras.en: "My husband and I didn't want our children to live under a fourth-generation dictatorship. As parents, we thought the best thing we could do for our children was to give them freedom," said Kim Yumi, 32, who now lives in Seoul.
paras.zh: “我和丈夫不希望我们的孩子生活在第四代独裁统治下。作为父母，我们认为能为孩子做的最好的事情就是给他们自由，”现居首尔的 32 岁金由美 (Kim Yumi) 说。

paras.en: North Korea allows no dissent and harshly punishes attempts to flee the country. Established in 1948, the nation is nominally a socialist republic, but in reality it is an authoritarian dynasty, with three generations of the Kim family ruling in succession. There was no known public resistance during its previous two successions — from state founder Kim Il Sung to his son Kim Jong Il in 1994 and then from Kim Jong Il to his son Kim Jong Un in 2011.
paras.zh: 朝鲜不允许任何异议，并严厉惩罚企图逃离该国的人。该国成立于1948年，名义上是社会主义共和国，但实际上是一个独裁王朝，由金氏家族三代人连续统治。在前两次继任期间，没有出现任何已知的公众抵制——从1994年国家创始人金日成到他儿子金正日，再到2011年从金正日到他儿子金正恩。

paras.en: This time, North Korea is apparently trying something radical.
paras.zh: 这一次，朝鲜显然正在尝试一些激进的做法。

paras.en: Kim Jong Un's repeated public appearances with his daughter over the past four years have led to speculation that she's being groomed as her father's heir.
paras.zh: 过去四年来，金正恩多次带着女儿公开露面，引发人们猜测她正在被培养成父亲的继承人。

paras.en: The question of who will become North Korea's next leader is crucial because that person will face a huge challenge — governing an impoverished, nuclear-armed nation whose 26 million people have little political freedom and live under strict state surveillance while being cut off from much of the outside world.
paras.zh: 谁将成为朝鲜下一任领导人的问题至关重要，因为这个人将面临巨大的挑战——治理一个贫穷、拥有核武器的国家，这个国家的 2600 万人民几乎没有政治自由，生活在国家的严格监视之下，同时与外界大部分隔绝。

paras.en: North Koreans have no say in the selection of their future leader, and analysts and defectors say they will passively accept a third dynastic succession — at least publicly.
paras.zh: 朝鲜人在选择未来领导人方面没有发言权，分析人士和脱北者表示，他们将被动接受第三次王朝继承——至少在公开场合如此。

paras.en: To gauge North Koreans' private views, The Associated Press spoke with nearly a dozen defectors who still have contacts in North Korea or witnessed the country's previous power successions, as well as several experts.
paras.zh: 为了了解朝鲜人的私下看法，美联社采访了近十几名在朝鲜仍然有联系或目睹该国先前权力更替的脱北者以及几位专家。

paras.en: Most defectors believe the girl is Kim's heir
paras.zh: 大多数叛逃者认为这个女孩是金正恩的继承人

paras.en: Not much is known about Kim's daughter except that she's reportedly about 13 and named Kim Ju Ae.
paras.zh: 人们对 Kim 的女儿知之甚少，只知道她大约 13 岁，名叫 Kim Ju Ae。

paras.en: Since late 2022, she has made dozens of public appearances, all of them with her father at big events like weapons tests and military parades. State media has called her Kim's "most beloved" and "respected" child. Her status has been emphasized by images showing an elderly general kneeling before her and her standing in front of her father.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年底以来，她已数十次公开露面，所有这些都是与她的父亲一起出席武器测试和阅兵等大型活动。官方媒体称她为金正恩“最心爱”和“最受尊敬”的孩子。照片显示一位年长的将军跪在她面前，而她站在她父亲面前，这凸显了她的地位。

paras.en: South Korea's spy agency says she is Kim's likely heir. Eight of the 11 defectors interviewed by the AP shared that view; the others disagreed, citing the North's deeply patriarchal culture.
paras.zh: 韩国间谍机构称她可能是金正恩的继承人。美联社采访的 11 名脱北者中，有 8 名持相同观点。其他人则不同意，并指出朝鲜根深蒂固的父权文化。

paras.en: "During her visits to missile launch sites and factories, the way senior North Korean officials treat Kim Ju Ae involves protocols reserved for a successor, not the ones simply for a daughter of Kim Jong Un," said Tae Yongho, a former minister at North Korea's Embassy in London who defected to South Korea in 2016. "They are repeating the same protocol and treatment they provided for Kim Jong Un," when he accompanied his father as his heir.
paras.zh: 2016 年叛逃到韩国的前朝鲜驻伦敦大使馆公使泰容浩 (Tae Yongho) 表示，“在金珠爱视察导弹发射场和工厂期间，朝鲜高级官员对待金主爱的方式涉及为继任者保留的礼节，而不仅仅是金正恩女儿的礼节。”“他们正在重复他们为金正恩提供的同样礼节和待遇”，当时金正恩作为继承人陪伴着他的父亲。

paras.en: Kang Mi-Jin, a defector who runs a company analyzing North Korea's economy, said her contacts inside the North told her over smuggled phones that they think Kim Ju Ae is in line to succeed her father.
paras.zh: 叛逃者姜美珍（Kang Mi-Jin）经营一家分析朝鲜经济的公司，她说，她在朝鲜境内的联系人通过走私电话告诉她，他们认为金珠爱（Kim Ju Ae）有望接替她父亲。

paras.en: Jung Gwang-il, a defector who specializes in smuggling outside information to North Korea, said the North Koreans he meets as they visit Chinese border towns also hold the same belief.
paras.zh: 专门向朝鲜走私外部信息的叛逃者郑光日(Jung Gwang-il)表示，他在访问中国边境城镇时遇到的朝鲜人也持有同样的信念。

paras.en: Former NBA star Dennis Rodman was the first to reveal her identity, holding her as a baby during a 2013 trip to Pyongyang.
paras.zh: 前 NBA 球星丹尼斯·罗德曼 (Dennis Rodman) 第一个透露了她的身份，2013 年平壤之行时，她还抱着婴儿。

paras.en: Doubts remain about a woman becoming North Korea's leader
paras.zh: 对于女性成为朝鲜领导人仍存疑虑

paras.en: Much of the skepticism about Kim Ju Ae as a potential leader stems from her being female. South Korean officials believe she has a younger sibling whose gender hasn't been confirmed.
paras.zh: 对金珠爱作为潜在领导人的怀疑很大程度上源于她是女性。韩国官员认为她有一个弟弟妹妹，但其性别尚未得到证实。

paras.en: Women in North Korea remain deeply underrepresented in senior posts. Only one of 17 department directors for the ruling Workers' Party is a woman. That woman is Kim Jong Un's influential younger sister, Kim Yo Jong, according to South Korea's Unification Ministry.
paras.zh: 朝鲜高级职位中的女性比例仍然严重不足。执政的工人党 17 名部门主任中只有一名女性。据韩国统一部称，这名女性就是金正恩有影响力的妹妹金与正。

paras.en: "My contacts in North Korea say it would be nonsensical to revere that little girl as their supreme leader," said Kim Jeong-Ah, a former North Korean army officer who resettled in South Korea in 2009.
paras.zh: “我在朝鲜的联系人说，将这个小女孩尊为他们的最高领袖是荒谬的，”2009 年重新定居韩国的前朝鲜军官金正雅 (Kim Jeong-Ah) 说。

paras.en: Lee Si-young, a defector who heads the Seoul-based Free North Korea Radio station, said that some of her older contacts in North Korea aren't happy with a woman taking power. But she said members of the Kim family "are like gods reigning over humans so gender really doesn't matter."
paras.zh: 首尔自由朝鲜广播电台负责人、脱北者李时英表示，她在朝鲜的一些老熟人对女性掌权感到不满。但她表示，金氏家族的成员“就像统治人类的神一样，所以性别真的并不重要。”

paras.en: Kim's push for hereditary power transfer faces little resistance at home
paras.zh: 金正恩推动世袭权力转移在国内几乎没有遇到阻力

paras.en: Whether or not the girl succeeds her father, observers agree that Kim Jong Un, 42, is likely to designate one of his children to prolong his family's rule, a move they expect would face little resistance at home. South Korea's spy agency recently assessed that Kim is extremely obese and at high risk of cardiovascular disease but shows no other signs of poor health.
paras.zh: 无论这个女孩是否继承她父亲的王位，观察人士一致认为，42 岁的金正恩可能会指定他的一个孩子来延长其家族的统治，他们预计这一举动在国内不会遇到什么阻力。韩国间谍机构最近评估称，金正恩极度肥胖，患心血管疾病的风险很高，但没有显示出其他健康状况不佳的迹象。

paras.en: North Koreans will passively "accept a hereditary succession as something that they should go along with," said Ahn Chan-il, a defector and scholar who heads the World Institute for North Korean Studies in Seoul.
paras.zh: 首尔世界朝鲜研究所所长、脱北者兼学者安赞一 (Ahn Chan-il) 表示，朝鲜人将被动地“接受世袭继承制，这是他们应该接受的”。

paras.en: During North Korea's first leadership transition, in 1994, the new leader, Kim Jong Il, then 52, had already spent two decades as the official successor working alongside his father to run the country.
paras.zh: 1994 年，朝鲜第一次领导层换届期间，时年 52 岁的新领导人金正日已经作为正式接班人与父亲一起治理国家长达二十年。

paras.en: The second succession, in 2011, was more uncertain. Kim Jong Un, who was then 27, was seen by outsiders as too young and inexperienced. He quickly consolidated his grip on power, however, by orchestrating high-profile executions and purges, including the 2013 killing of his powerful uncle Jang Song Thaek.
paras.zh: 2011 年的第二次继承更加不确定。当时27岁的金正恩在外界看来太年轻、缺乏经验。然而，他通过策划高调的处决和清洗，包括 2013 年杀害他有权有势的叔叔张成泽 (Jang Song Thaek)，迅速巩固了自己对权力的控制。

paras.en: "A hereditary power succession system has been institutionalized in North Korea, just like presidential elections in our system," said Oh Gyeong-seob, an analyst at Seoul's Korea Institute for National Unification. "North Korea's ruling elite accepts it as a matter of course. So do its general citizens."
paras.zh: “朝鲜的世袭权力继承制度已经制度化，就像我们制度中的总统选举一样，”首尔韩国国家统一研究所的分析师吴庆燮说。 “朝鲜的统治精英认为这是理所当然的。其普通公民也是如此。”

paras.en: Choi Song-juk, who fled North Korea in 2015, said she had been so brainwashed that she had no complaints about the North's two earlier power successions. She now calls them "nonsense."
paras.zh: 2015年逃离朝鲜的崔成竹(Choi Song-juk)表示，她被洗脑得很深，对朝鲜之前的两次权力继承没有任何抱怨。她现在称它们为“无稽之谈”。

paras.en: Defector Jeon Jae-hyun said North Korea's pervasive surveillance apparatus keeps people from voicing their discontent with the government and helps enforce political loyalty.
paras.zh: 脱北者全在贤表示，朝鲜无处不在的监控装置使人们无法表达对政府的不满，并有助于增强政治忠诚度。

paras.en: Defector Kim Yumi said she had never heard about the girl until Kim Jong Un publicly introduced his daughter at a long-range missile launch site in November 2022.
paras.zh: 脱北者金由美表示，她从未听说过这个女孩，直到 2022 年 11 月金正恩在远程导弹发射场公开介绍他的女儿。

paras.en: "Ordinary people know absolutely nothing about private lives of the Kim family," said Kim Yumi, who now runs a YouTube channel on North Korea. "They don't really try to know about it and don't pay attention to it because doing so could put them in danger."
paras.zh: “普通人对金氏家族的私生活一无所知，”现在经营朝鲜 YouTube 频道的金由美 (Kim Yumi) 说。 “他们并没有真正尝试去了解它，也没有关注它，因为这样做可能会让他们处于危险之中。”

articles.title: U.S. boycotts U.N. human rights review for second year running
articles.author: Imogen Foulkes

paras.en: U.S. boycotts U.N. human rights review for second year running
paras.zh: 美国连续第二年抵制联合国人权审查

paras.en: GENEVA, Switzerland — The United States has left an empty chair at a key United Nations human rights review for the second year running, becoming the only U.N. member state ever to do so.
paras.zh: 瑞士日内瓦——美国连续第二年在联合国重要的人权审查中留下了一个空椅子，成为唯一一个这样做的联合国成员国。
